From these patterns we identify seven recurring sources of asymmetry -- access to models, data, documentation, logs, expertise, compute, and infrastructure -- that reflect a broader pattern that we call the privatization of proof: when control over proof falls in the hands of private actors that can demand justification for access while ensuring that justification remains out of reach. We further argue that different types of access can be fungible: in the absence of a certain type of access (e.g., to model internals), one may be able to use alternative forms of access (e.g., sufficient compute, query access, and access to user logs) and to obtain a functionally equivalent amount of information. We propose a three-part test that can help resolve AI access disputes in litigation, drawing on concepts such as proportionality and reasonable alternatives. Our test relies on a few observations, including that the cause of action can provide a baseline for access.

AI.tldr: This paper examines evidence access barriers in AI-related litigation, identifying seven asymmetry sources and introducing "privatization of proof" as a key challenge. The authors propose that different access types can be fungible and suggest a three-part test for resolving access disputes.
AI.motivation: Evidence is increasingly difficult to obtain in AI-related disputes; proprietary models, platform logs, and protected databases hide decisive facts, leading to merit-worthy cases being settled or dismissed due to asymmetries in access, resources, and expertise.
AI.method: The authors ground their analysis in past and ongoing legal cases, identifying seven recurring sources of asymmetry (models, data, documentation, logs, expertise, compute, infrastructure) and proposing that different types of access can be functionally fungible.
AI.result: The authors identify seven specific sources of asymmetry and introduce the concept of "privatization of proof" — when private actors control proof while demanding justification for access without ensuring such justification is attainable.
AI.conclusion: The paper culminates in a three-part test for resolving AI access disputes in litigation, incorporating proportionality and reasonable alternatives principles, with the cause of action serving as a baseline for access determinations.

title: The Shape of Testimony: A Scalable Framework for Oral History Archive Comparison
summary: Researchers in Holocaust studies have often distinguished between two styles of oral survivor testimony: the USC Shoah Foundation's interviews tend to follow a structured, interviewer-guided format, whereas the Yale Fortunoff Video Archive generally favors a more free-form, open-ended style. This distinction has influenced both scholarly research and the development of later archives. In this study, we critically examine that claim by conducting a large-scale computational analysis of more than 1,600 testimonies from both collections. Leveraging discourse segmentation, topic modeling, and large language model (LLM) based analysis, we quantify the "structuredness" level of testimonies through topic coherence, interviewer-survivor dynamics, and the distribution of question types. Our results generally corroborate the structural differences identified in earlier research, while also revealing significant overlaps between the collections, both within individual interviews and across common narrative patterns. This complicates the simple "structured vs. free-form" dichotomy often applied to these oral histories. Beyond revisiting a foundational claim in Holocaust studies, our work provides a scalable, replicable framework for comparative corpus analysis. As a proof of concept, it suggests broader applications for digital oral history, narrative analysis, and the design of citizen-science annotation platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过计算分析方法（话语分割、主题建模、LLM）对1600余份大屠杀幸存者证词进行比较分析，验证了USC Shoah Foundation与Yale Fortunoff两个档案在结构化程度上的差异假设，但同时揭示了二者之间存在的重要重叠，复杂化了该领域长期以来的"结构化 vs.自由式"二元划分。
AI.motivation: Holocaust研究领域长期存在一个基础性假设：USC Shoah Foundation的证词访谈采用结构化、访谈者引导的形式，而Yale Fortunoff Video Archive则偏好更自由式、开放性的风格。这一区分影响了后续的学术研究和档案建设，但该假设本身从未经过大规模实证检验。
AI.method: 研究采用了多种计算方法对1600余份证词进行大规模分析：(1)话语分割（discourse segmentation）；(2)主题建模（topic modeling）；(3)大型语言模型（LLM）分析。通过话题一致性、访谈者-幸存者互动动态和问题类型分布三个维度来量化证词的"结构化程度"。
AI.result: 研究结果总体上证实了先前研究识别的结构性差异，但同时揭示了两个档案之间存在显著重叠——既体现在单个访谈内部，也体现在共同的叙事模式中。这一发现使简单化的"结构化 vs.自由式"二元框架变得复杂化。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个可扩展、可复现的语料库比较分析框架，证明了对两个档案之间差异的量化验证，并揭示了简单的"结构化 vs.自由式"二元划分是不够准确的。研究还提出了该框架在数字口述历史、叙事分析和公民科学标注平台设计中的更广泛应用前景。

title: The Attribution Impossibility: No Feature Ranking Is Faithful, Stable, and Complete Under Collinearity
comment: 66 pages, 12 figures, 305 Lean 4 theorems. Code at https://github.com/DrakeCaraker/dash-impossibility-lean
summary: No feature ranking can be simultaneously faithful, stable, and complete when features are collinear. For collinear pairs, ranking reduces to a coin flip. We prove this impossibility, quantify it for four model classes, resolve it via ensemble averaging (DASH), and machine-verify it with 305 Lean 4 theorems. We characterize the complete attribution design space: exactly two families of methods exist -- faithful-complete methods (unstable, with rankings that flip up to 50% of the time) and ensemble methods like DASH (stable, reporting ties for symmetric features) -- and no method lies outside this dichotomy. The impossibility is quantitative: the attribution ratio diverges as 1/(1-rho^2) for gradient boosting, is infinite for Lasso, and converges for random forests. DASH (Diversified Aggregation of SHAP) is provably Pareto-optimal among unbiased aggregations, achieving the Cramer-Rao variance bound with a tight ensemble size formula. In a survey of 77 public datasets, 68% exhibit attribution instability. Switching to conditional SHAP does not escape the impossibility when features have equal causal effects. The framework includes practical diagnostics -- a Z-test workflow and single-model screening tool -- and has direct consequences for fairness auditing: SHAP-based proxy discrimination audits are provably unreliable under collinearity. The design space theorem, diagnostics, and impossibility are mechanically verified in Lean 4 (305 theorems from 16 axioms, 0 sorry) -- to our knowledge, the first formally verified impossibility in explainable AI.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：在特征共线（collinearity）条件下，不存在任何特征重要性排序能同时满足"忠实性（faithful）、稳定性（stable）、完整性（complete）"三者，m=2 共线对的排序等价于抛硬币。作者形式化地刻画了完整的归因设计空间——恰好存在两族方法（单模型的忠实-完整族、集成式的稳定-并列族），并给出 DASH（对 SHAP 值做集成平均）作为构造性解法，证明其在无偏聚合中 Pareto 最优且达到 Cramér–Rao 方差界；全部结果经 305 个 Lean 4 定理（16 公理、0 sorry）机器验证，为可解释 AI 中首个形式化验证的不可能性结果。
AI.motivation: SHAP 等特征归因排序在工程中被广泛使用，但实践中"最重要特征"会随随机种子改变。作者指出这不是数据量、超参或软件缺陷，而是单模型范式在共线设计下的数学不可能性。既有工作（Bilodeau 2024、Huang & Marques-Silva 2024、Srinivas & Fleuret 2019、Rao 2025）均未分析"稳定性"维度，也未给出可判别架构的定量界或构造性解法。作者类比 Chouldechova(2017)/Kleinberg et al.(2017) 的公平性不可能性，定位本文为"可解释性领域的 Arrow 定理"，并追问：完整的可行方法集合到底是什么样子。
AI.method: 1) 形式化三项要求（faithful/stable/complete），并以 Rashomon 性质（对称特征的近最优模型给出相反排序）为唯一假设，四行反证得出不可能性定理（Thm 5），零公理依赖。2) 迭代优化器定义与置换闭合性论证（Rashomon 必然性，Thm 9/12）。3) 定量界：GBDT 分裂计数公理 + 高斯条件化推导归因比 1/(1-ρ²)（α 修正 1/(1-αρ²)，α≈2/π 来自量化理论），Lasso 为 ∞，随机森林 O(1/√T) 收敛。4) DASH 集成平均：平衡集成下对称特征等权（Cor 19）、Cramér–Rao 界与 Rao–Blackwell、Rao–Blackwell 效率、Pareto 最优（Thm 22）、集成规模下界 M_min=⌈2.71σ²/Δ²⌉。5) 设计空间定理（Thm 28）与一般化的对称 Bayes 二分定理（Thm 37），含模型选择、因果发现（CPDAG）两个新实例。6) 扩展：条件 SHAP 不可能性、公平审计不可能性、FIM 直接路径、Le Cam 查询复杂度下界、SNR 校准。7) 诊断工具：多模型 Z 检验（Berry–Esseen 误差界）与单模型分裂频率筛查（可交换性、有效样本量 T_eff）。8) 实证：合成数据、Breast Cancer、11 数据集诊断表、77 数据集普遍度调查、跨实现/跨方法/类别不平衡/缺失值/时间序列/LLM 注意力等 12+ 组鲁棒性实验。9) Lean 4 形式化（54 文件、305 定理、16 公理、Consistency.lean 构造显式模型证明公理系统相容）。
AI.result: 核心结果：(1) 归因不可能性：m=2 时排序翻转率恰为 1/2（实证 48%，理论上限 0.500 在 108 种超参配置下全部命中）；m>2 无并列时 2/m²，一旦必须打破并列（完整性要求）即回到 1/2。(2) 设计空间二分为族 A（U=1/2、C=complete、S≤1-3m²/(P³-P)）与族 B（U=0、C=ties、S=1-O(1/M)），理想点 (1,0,complete) 不可行；理想三参数被压缩为单一权衡轴 M。(3) 定量：GBDT 1/(1-αρ²) 发散、Lasso ∞、RF 收敛，α=2/π 拟合 R²=0.89。(4) DASH 在 M=25 时翻转率 <1%，M=50 时 worst perimeter↔worst area 对 0%；相对单模型降 4–5 倍（中位数需多 57% 模型，ARE=2/π=0.637）。(5) 普遍度：77 数据集中 68%（95% CI 56–77%）存在 >10% 翻转率，P≥20 时达 93%；医疗数据集 67%。(6) Z 检验与翻转率相关 |r|>0.89（9/10 数据集），单模型筛查精度 94–100%（低维）/48–67%（高维）。(7) 公平审计在共线代理变量下为"抛硬币"，K 个代理属性同时正确概率 (1/2)^K；(8) 条件 SHAP 在因果效应相等时无法逃脱，Δβ 在 ρ=0.9 需 ≈0.9 差异才能稳定。(9) Lean：305 定理 0 sorry，公理系统相容已构造证明，且形式化过程发现 2 处逻辑不一致与 1 处类型错误。
AI.conclusion: 归因不稳定是共线性的结构性数学必然而非工程缺陷，可行方法集合被完整刻画为两族且无第三条路；实践路径是"分组→单模型筛查→多模型 Z 检验确认→DASH 集成共识（M≥25）"，并以组级别报告（并列 + 翻转率 + Z 值）替代强制排序；M_min=⌈2.71σ²/Δ²⌉ 给出最优集成规模。监管含义：基于单模型 SHAP 的代理歧视审计不可靠，不稳定性披露构成 EU AI Act 13(3)(b)(ii) 下的"已知且可预见情形"，作者给出可直接使用的披露模板与供需方行动清单。局限：分裂计数公理假设完全信号捕获（实证 α 修正）、等相关结构与平衡集成理想化、方差界仍为公理化、Rao–Blackwell 最优性部分与 LLM 注意力情形未形式化。附录 F/G/H 还诚实论证了与 Arrow 定理无可行的非平凡统一框架、拓扑方法无额外内容、范畴化提升亦无实质新意。

title: Evaluation of Pipelines for Data Integration into Knowledge Graphs
summary: Integrating new data into knowledge graphs (KG) typically involves different tasks that are executed within workflows or pipelines There are many possible pipelines for a specific integration problem but there is not yet a general approach to evaluate the overall quality and performance of such pipelines to be able to determine the best choices. We therefore propose a new benchmark KGI-Bench to evaluate integration pipelines that ingest different kinds of input data into an existing KG. We evaluate pipelines by analyzing their output, i.e., the updated KG, with the three complementary quality metrics coverage, correctness and consistency. We also provide benchmark datasets (seed KG, overlapping input data of three formats, reference KG as a ground truth) for the movie domain. To demonstrate the applicability and usefulness of the proposed benchmark, we comparatively evaluate 12 pipelines and analyze their behavior across different input data formats and design choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGI-Bench基准测试，用于评估知识图谱集成管道的质量。通过覆盖度、正确性和一致性三个指标，对12种不同管道进行了对比分析，为知识图谱数据集成提供了系统性评估框架。
AI.motivation: 将新数据集成到知识图谱(KG)中通常涉及不同工作流或管道中的任务；针对特定的集成问题存在多种可能的管道，但目前尚无通用方法来评估这些管道的整体质量和性能。
AI.method: 提出新基准测试KGI-Bench，用于评估将不同类型输入数据摄取到现有KG中的集成管道；通过三个互补的质量指标（覆盖度、正确性、一致性）评估管道；提供电影领域的基准数据集。
AI.result: 比较评估了12种管道；分析了不同输入数据格式和设计选择下的管道行为。
AI.conclusion: KGI-Bench能够有效评估知识图谱集成管道的质量和性能，为选择最佳集成方案提供了系统性基准。

title: ACCoRD: Actor-Critic Conflict Resolution with Deep learning for O-RAN xApps
summary: Conflict Mitigation (ConMit) is a crucial part of intelligent network control in Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN). In this paper, we propose a method named ACCoRD to resolve detected control conflicts in Near-Real Time RAN Intelligent Controller using a Conflict Resolution (CR) Agent with an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) trained with a reinforcement learning algorithm PPO-Clip. The implemented ANN analyzes data about the network and conflicting control decisions to infer optimal CR actions. The CR Agent gathers feedback from the network after each resolved conflict to assess its efficiency and adjust the ANN's weights during batch training. The evaluation of the proposed approach is based on simulation data. A new methodology for evaluating CR solutions is proposed. Results show that the proposed ANN-based method improves on the efficiency of rule-based approaches by significantly reducing negative network events caused by conflicting control decisions in medium and high traffic scenarios.

AI.tldr: ACCoRD 是一种面向 O-RAN Near-RT RIC 的冲突解决（Conflict Resolution）方法：在既有 Conflict Mitigation Framework 内引入一个基于 Actor-Critic 深度强化学习（PPO-Clip 训练）的冲突解决代理（CR Agent），由人工神经网络读取冲突控制决策与网络全局状态，输出逐决策头的解决动作（保留/带冷却拒绝/参数±1 步长调整），并依据网络负向事件（乒乓切换、RLF、呼叫阻塞）变化构造奖励在线更新策略。仿真结果显示：在中、高负载场景下显著优于规则化优先级方法，而在低负载下与规则法相当。
AI.motivation: O-RAN 多厂商异构部署导致 RAN 智能控制器（RIC）内多个 xApp 并发下发控制决策时产生冲突（direct/indirect/implicit），冲突缓解（ConMit）成为智能网络控制的关键环节。现有方案存在明显局限：基于固定优先级/冷却的规则法无法适应动态网络状况；QoS 感知方法依赖非标准 xApp 输入，难以多商用部署；基于数字孪生的方案面临计算时延与模型精度问题；从 SMA 层直接禁用应用的方案（如 PACIFISTA）会同时消除正负收益；而 xApp 蒸馏类 ML 方案运维复杂、缺乏“即插即用”能力。因此需要一种无需显式规则、能随网络条件自适应的 Conflict Resolution 方法。
AI.method:
方法层面：ACCoRD 部署于 Conflict Mitigation Framework 的 Conflict Resolution Agent 中，数据流为：xApp 以 E2 Control 消息下发决策 → Conflict Detection Agent 检测并上报冲突 → ACCoRD 提取上下文并预处理 → 前向计算策略 logits 与 critic 值 → 按掩码解释并执行解决动作 → 触发事后观测以计算奖励。

（1）输入特征：控制决策特征采用定长 slot 张量 (N_ConfDec, 5)，每 slot 含 4 维参数类型 one-hot（none/CIO/TTT/hysteresis）与按类型边界 min-max 归一化的参数值；全局特征为 11 维（小区态：hysteresis/CIO/TTT 当前值、可用性负载<100%、非乒乓切换率、总吞吐按 100 Mbps 归一；用户态：移动速度按 100 m/s、请求比特率按 1 Gbps、满意度、连接成功率、吞吐按 1 Mbps 归一）。

（2）输出：每个决策头输出 N_A=4 个动作 logits（NO_MODIFICATION、REJECTION_WITH_COOLDOWN、INCREASE_1、DECREASE_1），经 Softmax 转为概率；同时输出布尔 validity mask（无效 slot 置 -∞，避免对 padding 训练）；critic 输出标量状态值 V(s) 用于计算优势。

（3）网络结构：共享两层 MLP(ReLU) 控制决策特征编码器；N_ConfDec 个 actor 头，每头输入 = 本决策编码特征 + 参数类型嵌入 + 全局特征 + 其余决策编码的均值池化摘要（实现局部最优与全局一致的上下文感知）；critic 为三层 MLP(ReLU，首层后 LayerNorm)，输入全局特征与全部决策编码的均值池化。

（4）训练：PPO-Clip，截断目标；经验以 400 s 为间隔收集，批训练做 3 个 PPO epoch；监控近似 KL 散度，高散度触发学习率调整或提前终止；每批次对 critic 做 12 步 Huber 损失预训练以改善基线估计；超参：epochs=3、clip=0.10、目标 KL=0.015、熵系数 0.007、actor 学习率 1e-5、critic 学习率 1e-4。

（5）奖励：在检测时刻 t=0 与解决后 t=T_reward 处取滚动窗口 T_meas 观测，归一化后对乒乓切换(C_PP)、RLF(C_RLF)、呼叫阻塞(C_CB)的变化做加权和并归一化（本文采用均衡权重 w=1.0）。ACCoRD 动作按类型映射到合法离散配置步（如 3GPP TTT 取值），INCREASE/DECREASE_1 映射到 xApp 支持的单个逻辑步。

（6）仿真：8 个 5G 基站的六边形/同心环形布局（中心 1 宏站 + 微站共址，6 个微站各 3 个 120° 小区），半径 450 m；Small/Medium/Large 三种负载分别 57/76/100 UE，另有 1 个参考 UE；运行 Mobility Robustness Optimization（优化 hysteresis、TTT）与 Mobility Load Balancing（优化 CIO）两个 xApp，产生间接冲突。

（7）实验与评测：基线为 No CM（框架关闭）、规则法 Prioritization with Cooldown（分别优先 MRO 与优先 MLB）以及 ACCoRD；先训练 10000 s 仿真，再做 1000 s 评测，丢弃前 200 s，每种配置用 36 组随机 UE 初始布局重复；提出新指标 Relative Penalty Score：加权惩罚 P = 0.05·C_PP + 0.40·C_RLF + 0.40·C_CB，再按最优方法归一化为 P_rel = P/P_best×100%。
AI.result:
Small 负载：Prio. MRO 最优（平均惩罚 292.13，102.5%），ACCoRD 次之（297.73，104.1%，落后 1.6 pp），说明低负载下规则法已足够；Medium 负载：ACCoRD 最优（402.84，101.4%），优于 Prio. MRO（412.82，104.2%）2.8 pp，优于 No CM 5.7 pp、优于 Prio. MLB 11.8 pp；Large 负载：ACCoRD 最优（549.87，101.6%），领先 Prio. MRO 4.0 pp、No CM 6.7 pp、Priorit. MLB 10.3 pp；Prio. MLB 在所有负载下均最差。

案例分析（Medium 最优运行）显示学到的策略具有明确的可解释结构：CIO 类冲突一律拒绝以稳定小区边界、抑制负载振荡；TTT 与 hysteresis 类决策倾向拒绝或按单步增大，制造“切换惯性”以抑制瞬时信道波动；约 64% 的冲突中所有冲突决策被全部拒绝，实质起到噪声滤除作用、以网络稳定性优先，源于均衡奖励中对服务中断的高惩罚；该策略显著降低乒乓切换与呼叫阻塞，同时保持 RLF 具竞争力。

复杂度与时延：推理复杂度 O(N_ConfDec·L·d²)，critic 仅用于训练不进入实时链路，实际规模 N_ConfDec=3、L=4、d=519，单次前向约 3.2 M 次乘加运算，在标准 CPU 上为微秒至低毫秒级，满足 Near-RT 10 ms–1 s 控制环时延要求。
AI.conclusion: ACCoRD 证明以 PPO-Clip 训练的 Actor-Critic ANN 可在 Near-RT RIC 中有效替代静态规则完成冲突解决，其优势随网络负载与冲突频率上升而扩大，可被视为 O-RAN 冲突缓解从“规则化”向“学习型动态优化”演进的可行路径；后续工作包括引入用户/切片等控制目标类型嵌入以扩展冲突作用域、在不重构网络的前提下扩展决策头数量以支持更大冲突集、扩充动作空间（多步调整、无冷却拒绝）、非均衡奖励权重与更多 KPI（PRB 利用率、频谱效率）分析、针对稀有冲突事件（出现时间<10%）的训练失衡处理，以及向硬件在环与空口物理测试床的真实环境验证过渡。

title: Probabilistic Attribution For Large Language Models
summary: The generative nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reflected in the conditional probabilities they compute to sample each response token given the previous tokens. These probabilities encode the distributional structure that the model learns in training and exploits in inference. In this work, we use these probabilities to situate LLMs within the mathematical theory of stochastic processes. We use this framework to design a model-agnostic probabilistic token attribution measure, using Bayes rule to invert the next-token log-probabilities so as to capture the models internal representation of the distribution over token sequences. The representation is independent of the models computational structure. This representation yields the conditional probability of the response given the prompt, and of the response given the prompt with a token marginalized away. Our attribution score is the log of the ratio of these probabilities. We further compute the entropies of a single prompts token distributions, conditioned on the remaining context. The interplay between entropy and attribution score sheds light on LLM behavior. We evaluate 8 models across 7 prompts and investigate anomalies, token sensitivity, response stability, model stability, and training convergence, thereby improving interpretability and guiding users to focus on uncertain or unstable parts of the generation.

AI.tldr: 本文将大型语言模型置于随机过程理论框架下，提出一种基于贝叶斯规则的可跨模型泛化的概率归因方法，通过分析token条件概率与边际概率的比值及熵值来解释模型行为，评估了8个模型在7个提示上的表现。
AI.motivation: Current interpretability methods for LLMs often depend on specific model architectures, limiting their generalizability. There is a need for model-agnostic approaches that can leverage the inherent probabilistic structure encoded in LLM token generation to understand model behavior.
AI.method: The authors situate LLMs within the mathematical theory of stochastic processes and use Bayes rule to invert next-token log-probabilities, creating a model-agnostic probabilistic token attribution measure that captures the model's internal representation of token sequence distributions independent of computational structure. They compute the conditional probability of responses given prompts (with and without token marginalization) and analyze the ratio of these probabilities alongside token distribution entropies.
AI.result: The framework successfully enables analysis across 8 models and 7 prompts, revealing patterns in anomalies, token sensitivity, response stability, model stability, and training convergence.
AI.conclusion: The proposed probabilistic attribution measure successfully provides model-agnostic interpretability for LLMs, revealing insights into token sensitivity, response stability, model stability, and training convergence across multiple models.

title: A Dataset of Reproducible Flaky-Test Failures
summary: Flaky tests pass and fail non-deterministically when run on the same version of code. Although many techniques have been proposed to detect, debug, and repair flaky tests, reproducing their failures remains a major challenge due to their inherent nondeterminism. Many flaky test datasets exist to help researchers study them, but these datasets are often composed of disjoint sets of flaky tests, where each dataset provides unique information, such as flaky tests of different categories, failure logs of flaky tests, or flaky tests reported by developers vs. flaky tests found by automated tools. In this work, we aim to create a reproducible dataset of flaky tests, curated from both developer issue reports and a popular dataset of flaky tests. Compared to prior flaky test datasets, our dataset is the first to provide (1) a reproducible environment to compile flaky tests, (2) scripts to reproduce failures, (3) scripts to automatically apply flaky test fixes and ensure that the tests are no longer flaky, and (4) execution logs of flaky test passing and failing. We present ReproFlake, a dataset of 1115 reproducible flaky tests across four flaky test categories. We create guidelines to help others contribute to this reproducible dataset, and demonstrate how to use our dataset to understand challenges in reproducing flaky test failures (e.g., challenges researchers may face when using prior flaky test datasets), the characteristics (e.g., location of the fix and its correlation with the flaky test category), and difficulties researchers may face in using our dataset to collect additional information (e.g., code coverage) about flaky tests. Our findings show that error information helps identify flaky test categories and guide repairs, that unresolved compilation failures highlight challenges in building legacy projects, and knowing typical fix locations can help prioritize repair efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReproFlake数据集，包含1115个可复现的flaky test，是首个提供完整复现环境、失败复现脚本、自动修复脚本和执行日志的数据集，可用于研究flaky test复现挑战、特征分析及修复优先级排序。
AI.motivation: Flaky test指在相同代码版本下非确定性通过或失败的测试，现有的flaky test数据集通常是离散的，每个数据集提供不同信息（如不同类别的flaky test、失败日志、或开发者报告vs自动发现），导致难以系统性研究和复现这些测试。
AI.method: 从开发者issue报告和流行flaky test数据集中收集flaky test，构建可复现环境并提供脚本自动应用修复，通过执行日志分析flaky test特征和复现挑战。
AI.result: 创建了包含1115个可复现flaky test的ReproFlake数据集，跨越4个类别；提供了编译环境、失败复现脚本、自动修复脚本和执行日志；研究发现错误信息有助于识别flaky test类别和指导修复，未解决编译失败揭示构建遗留项目挑战，典型fix位置可帮助优先修复工作。
AI.conclusion: ReproFlake是首个提供完整复现环境的flaky test数据集，包含1115个可复现的flaky test，涵盖4个类别。数据集可帮助研究者理解flaky test复现挑战、特征分析（如fix位置与类别的关联）以及数据收集难点（如代码覆盖率）。研究结果表明错误信息有助于识别flaky test类别并指导修复，未解决的编译失败揭示了构建遗留项目的挑战，了解典型fix位置可帮助优先排序修复工作。

title: Nf-PEAK: Process-Based Energy Attribution for Nextflow Workflows on Kubernetes Clusters
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 19th International Conference on Cloud Computing (CLOUD)
summary: Scientific workflows are pipelines of interdependent tasks. They are increasingly executed on shared Kubernetes clusters via workflow engines such as Nextflow. Their energy consumption matters for both cost and sustainability. It is necessary to examine and optimize workflow tasks individually, because they can be very heterogeneous. However, estimating task-level energy on clusters is difficult: Intel RAPL counters report only node-level energy, access to counters and host process information is typically restricted, and concurrent workloads introduce resource contention and measurement noise. We present Nf-PEAK, a containerized method to attribute CPU-package and DRAM energy to individual processes and Nextflow tasks. Nf-PEAK (i) identifies workflow pods, (ii) maps pods to host processes via cgroup metadata, (iii) samples RAPL and per-process performance counters, and (iv) applies a non-linear energy-credit model before aggregating results at task level. On a Kubernetes cluster, we evaluate three nf-core workflows under controlled co-located CPU load. Nf-PEAK reaches an average Mean Absolute Percentage Error of 6.6% in isolated runs and 10.9% when an unrelated workload saturates 8 of 32 hardware threads per node, and remains stable across 2, 3, 4, and 8 nodes. Compared to the state-of-the-art Kubernetes tool Kepler, Nf-PEAK yields lower error on average, particularly under co-located load.

AI.tldr: Nf-PEAK是一种容器化方法，通过cgroup元数据映射pod到进程，结合RAPL计数器和每进程性能计数器采样，实现Nextflow任务级CPU和DRAM能量归属，解决了Kubernetes集群上任务级能源估计的难题。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流在共享Kubernetes集群上执行，其能源消耗对成本和可持续性至关重要。需要逐个检查和优化工作流任务，因为它们可能非常异构。然而，在集群上估计任务级能源非常困难——Intel RAPL计数器仅报告节点级能源，计数器访问受限，且并发工作负载引入资源竞争和测量噪声。
AI.method: Nf-PEAK采用四步方法：(1)识别工作流pod；(2)通过cgroup元数据将pod映射到主机进程；(3)采样RAPL和每进程性能计数器；(4)应用非线性能量信用模型后在任务级别聚合结果。
AI.result: Nf-PEAK在隔离运行中平均MAPE为6.6%，在8/32硬件线程被无关工作负载占用时MAPE为10.9%，在2、3、4和8节点上表现稳定；与最新工具Kepler相比，平均误差更低，特别是在协同负载条件下。
AI.conclusion: Nf-PEAK provides a practical, containerized solution for accurate task-level energy attribution in Kubernetes-based scientific workflows, demonstrating superior accuracy over state-of-the-art tools especially under concurrent workload conditions.

title: Optimal $e^{(γ+o(1))n}$-Approximation of the Permanent of Positive Semidefinite Matrices
summary:
We determine, up to lower-order terms in the exponent, the best possible deterministic polynomial-time approximation ratio for the permanent of a Hermitian positive semidefinite matrix. If $A\succeq 0$ has no zero diagonal entry, $d=\operatorname{rank}(A)$, $A=VV^\dagger$ with $V\in\mathbb{C}^{n\times d}$ full column rank, and $v_1,\ldots,v_n$ are the rows of $V$, define \[
  Φ(V)=\max_{X\succ 0}
  \left\{\sum_{i=1}^n \log(v_i^\dagger Xv_i)+\log\det X-\operatorname{tr} X+d\right\},
  \qquad
  \widehat P(A)=e^{Φ(V)}. \] We prove the exact sandwich \[
  e^{-γn}\widehat P(A)\le \operatorname{per}(A)\le \widehat P(A). \] Here $γ$ is the Euler--Mascheroni constant. Since the maximization is concave, this gives a deterministic polynomial-time $e^{(γ+\varepsilon)n}$-approximation for every $\varepsilon>0$. Combined with the previous $e^{(γ-\varepsilon)n}$-hardness of approximation for positive semidefinite permanents, this resolves the optimal exponential approximation ratio for deterministic polynomial-time algorithms as $e^{(γ+o(1))n}$, assuming $\mathrm{P}\ne\mathrm{NP}$. The proof is an entropy argument applied to the standard Wick integral formula for $\operatorname{per}(A)$; the loss is exactly $γ$ per factor because $\mathbb{E}[\log T]=-γ$ for $T\sim\operatorname{Exp}(1)$.
  The result was obtained through interactions with GPT 5.5 Pro Extended: the first author's interaction was one-shot, while the second author's was a separate multi-turn interaction with high-level guidance. Both authors verified the theorem and proof. Codex was used to assemble and typeset the manuscript.

AI.tldr: 该论文确定了确定性多项式时间算法下正半定矩阵行列式最优近似比为e^γ≈1.78（每变量），完整解决了这一开放问题。证明使用Wick公式的熵方法，揭示了近似损失恰好源于Exp(1)分布的-γ熵。
AI.motivation: 确定厄米正半定矩阵的行列式（permanent）在密码学、组合优化和量子信息等领域具有重要应用。已有工作证明了e^(γ-ε)n的不可近似性下界，但确定性多项式时间算法的上界（即近似比）一直未能匹配，存在最优比率的悬而未决问题。
AI.method: 作者采用熵方法（entropy argument），将Wick积分公式应用于per(A)的计算。通过定义Φ(V)——一个关于正定矩阵X的最大化凹函数——构造估计量P̂(A)=e^Φ(V)。核心洞察在于：对于T~Exp(1)的指数分布，E[log T] = -γ恰好损失了欧拉-马歇罗尼常数，这解释了近似比中e^γ因子的来源。
AI.result: 论文证明了精确的"夹心"不等式：e^(-γn)·P̂(A) ≤ per(A) ≤ P̂(A)。其中P̂(A)可通过解凹最大化问题计算得多项式时间。这给出了确定性多项式时间下的e^((γ+ε)n)近似算法。结合已有硬度结果，该工作完整刻画了近似比的最优值：e^(γ+o(1))n。
AI.conclusion: 研究解决了确定性多项式时间算法下正定厄米矩阵行列式（permanent）最优指数近似比的悬而未决问题。证明了下界e^(γn)和上界完全匹配（其中γ为欧拉-马歇罗尼常数≈1.78），从而确定最优近似比为e^(γ+o(1))n，假设P≠NP。此外，该工作还展示了GPT等AI工具在数学证明研究中的实际应用价值。

title: Generative Conversational Recommender System
summary: Conversational recommender systems aim to provide personalized recommendations via natural language interactions. However, existing approaches either decouple recommendation from dialog generation or rely on retrieval-based pipelines, limiting the integration between recommendation and response generation and leading to suboptimal modeling of user intent. In this paper, we propose a fully generative conversational recommender system that unifies recommendation and dialog generation within a single autoregressive framework. Our approach represents items as discrete semantic IDs and integrates them directly into the generation process, enabling joint prediction of items and responses via next-token modeling. We further introduce a structured generation paradigm that factorizes conversational recommendation into a sequence of interdependent decisions, where the model first predicts the response intent and the recommendation target, and then generates the response conditioned on them. This design enables end-to-end optimization, enforces a more coherent dependency structure, and supports faithful item generation via constrained decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves recommendation performance, achieving gains of up to 29% on Recall@1 over strong baselines, while maintaining competitive dialog quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GCRS：一个完全生成式的对话推荐系统，将推荐与对话生成统一到单个自回归 LLM 中。核心做法是：(1) 用 RQ-VAE 将物品表示为离散语义 ID（semantic ID），并解决码本冲突；(2) 提出结构化生成范式，将一次推荐回复显式分解为「响应意图 m → 目标物品 i → 自然语言回复 r」三步依赖决策，即 P(u_t|C)=P(m|C)·P(i|m,C)·P(r|i,m,C)。训练时用 MODE 标记（<MODE=REC>/<MODE=CHAT>）、<BOI>SID<EOI> 与 <RESP> 构造目标序列，通过 next-token 目标端到端优化，无需外部检索/重排。在 ReDial 与 Inspired 上，推荐指标全面超越 KGSF/MESE/DCRS/STEP/UniCRS/MSCRS 与 TIGER/LC-Rec，Recall@1 最高提升约 29%（Inspired），同时对话质量（PPL、多样性）保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 对话推荐系统（CRS）的主流做法是模块化管线：先编码对话上下文为 query 表示，再在物品嵌入空间中做最近邻检索，最后把检索到的 top-k 物品以占位符替换（如 <movie>）方式注入生成回复。这种设计存在两大缺陷：(1) 解耦优化——对话模块与推荐模块分别训练，系统复杂且资源消耗大；(2) 知识整合有限——语言模型在生成时无法直接访问协同信号与物品语义，导致回复泛化、个性化不足。近期用 LLM 做重排仍依赖外部候选生成器，且缺乏协同信号；用微调方式把物品写成标题或独立 ID token，则分别面临幻觉、词表爆炸、新物品泛化差等问题。因此需要一个把推荐与生成在同一自回归框架内联合建模的方案。
AI.method: 1) 语义 ID 构建：将物品元数据（title、year、genres、keywords、plot）序列化为文本描述，用固定预训练文本编码器（ReDial 用 Sentence-T5，Inspired 用 BGE）编码为稠密向量，再用 4 层 RQ-VAE 残差量化为 4 位（每层码本大小 64，共 64^4 容量）的离散语义 ID。由于向量量化是多对一，采用按最后层残差距离排序、逐层回溯分配最近可用码字的冲突消解策略，保证每个物品 ID 唯一。2) 结构化生成：将对话中所有物品提及替换为 <BOI>SID(i)<EOI>；引入 MODE 标记 <MODE=REC>（含推荐）与 <MODE=CHAT>（纯对话）。训练样本中，推荐型回复前置 <MODE=REC><BOI>SID(i)<EOI><RESP>（多物品回复拆成多个样本），非推荐型前置 <MODE=CHAT><RESP>。目标序列遵循 (m, i, r) 顺序，用 next-token 损失对 Assistant 前缀后的全部 token 优化。3) 推理：可由模型自主决定 MODE，也可人工指定 MODE 以引导行为，或给定语义 ID 条件生成；推荐评测时在 <BOI> 后对语义 ID 空间做受约束束搜索（beam=50）产生 top-k 候选列表，保证排序指标可计算。4) 实现：Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 主干，QLoRA 微调全部线性层（rank 16），冻结原词表嵌入、仅训练新增 token 嵌入；单张 RTX 6000 Ada 48GB。
AI.result: 推荐性能：ReDial 上 GCRS R@1=6.88（+21.77% vs 最佳基线）、R@20=31.94、N@10=14.55、M@20=12.09；Inspired 上 R@1=14.56（+29.08%）、R@20=35.92、N@10=21.26、M@20=19.16，多数指标相对最优基线具备统计显著性（p<0.05）。对比 TIGER/LC-Rec 显示仅靠协同信号、无对话上下文建模不足。多样性/排序类指标提升尤为明显，说明模型能准确定位最相关物品。消融：仅自然语言监督（RESP）时 R@1 降至 3.39（ReDial）/4.85（Inspired）；加 MODE 提升到 4.06/8.41；仅 SID（不生成回复）为 5.16/11.00；完整模型最优，说明意图建模与联合生成缺一不可；语义 ID 配置（4×64 为默认）性能稳健但过大（4×128）或过小（3×64）会退化；全词表嵌入微调反而损害推荐性能。对话质量：PPL 最优（ReDial 4.37，Inspired 6.36）；BLEU 次优（11.58 / 5.75，KGSF 最高但 PPL/多样性极差，说明 BLEU 偏好模板化回复）；Distinct-n 在 Inspired 上全面最佳，ReDial 上略低于 DCRS/MSCRS。骨干模型与编码器影响有限：Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B、Ministral-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 结果相近，Qwen2.5 综合最均衡；Sentence-T5/BGE/E5/Llama/Mxbai 编码器差异较小。
AI.conclusion: GCRS 通过语义 ID 与结构化生成范式，将对话推荐从"检索后注入"转变为"生成过程中的显式中间决策"，实现了单一自回归模型的端到端优化，无需外部检索或重排模块；其因子化设计分离了高层决策与表层实现，提升了物品预测与语言生成的一致性，受约束解码保证了物品生成的忠实性（避免幻觉），语义 ID 的组合结构也避免了词表爆炸并支持新物品泛化。局限性：依赖规模较小、真实感有限的公开 CRS 数据集做监督微调；效果受底层嵌入与量化质量影响；尚需大规模真实部署下的可扩展性与鲁棒性验证；且训练数据偏差可能被继承放大，推荐与生成深度耦合也带来说服性推荐、隐私推断等风险。

title: Detecting Offensive Cyber Agents: A Detection-in-Depth Approach
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents can now orchestrate cyberattacks. This development is already increasing the speed and scale of cyber attacks, decreasing attack costs, and improving the operational autonomy of cyber capabilities. To defend against these emerging threats, actors must first develop the capability to detect them. This report frames the offensive cyber agent detection challenge by outlining the coming detection gap between offensive cyber agents and traditional cyber capabilities; introducing detection-in-depth, a strategic framework to guide policymakers and defenders responding to this detection gap; and presents five actionable detection mechanisms to support policymakers, industry, and defenders when putting this strategic framework into practice. These include (1) Agent Identifiers for Critical Infrastructure,(2) Agent Honeypots; (3) AI-Automated Alert Analysis and Triage: systems that use AI to filter, prioritize, and interpret the growing volume of detection signals expected from autonomous cyber operations; (4) An Agentic Security Alert Standard: A reporting standard model that providers can use to communicate agentic threats, improving the speed, consistency, and actionability of reports; (5) An Agentic Cybersecurity Exchange (ACE): an institution modeled on the Global Signal Exchange that brings together model and cloud providers to detect offensive cyber agent threats at their origin point and coordinate ecosystem-wide agentic threat disruption.

AI.tldr: This report addresses the detection gap created by AI-driven offensive cyber agents by proposing a detection-in-depth framework and five actionable mechanisms for detecting, identifying, and disrupting AI-orchestrated cyber threats at scale.
AI.motivation: AI agents are now capable of orchestrating cyberattacks, which is increasing attack speed/scale, decreasing attack costs, and improving operational autonomy of cyber capabilities — creating an emerging threat that current cyber defenses cannot adequately detect.
AI.method: The report structures the detection problem through three approaches: (1) framing the offensive cyber agent detection challenge by identifying the coming detection gap; (2) introducing a strategic framework called "detection-in-depth" for policymakers and defenders; (3) presenting five actionable detection mechanisms.
AI.result: Five concrete detection mechanisms: Agent Identifiers for Critical Infrastructure, Agent Honeypots, AI-Automated Alert Analysis and Triage, An Agentic Security Alert Standard, and An Agentic Cybersecurity Exchange (ACE).
AI.conclusion: Detect-in-depth strategic framework with five actionable mechanisms for detecting offensive AI cyber agents.

title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
comment: Work in Progress. Comments: 27 pages, 4 figures, preprint
summary: Although LLMs have made substantial progress in reasoning, systematically producing frontier-level reasoning data remains difficult. Existing synthesis methods often have limited visibility into the structural factors that govern problem difficulty, which can result in narrow diversity and unstable difficulty control. In this work, we view the difficulty of a reasoning problem as arising from the accumulation of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations, which we term thought modes. Building on this perspective, we propose MindLoom, a framework for synthesizing frontier-level reasoning data through compositional thought mode engineering. Given a collection of hard problems with verified solutions, MindLoom first decomposes those solutions into thought mode chains that reveal each problem's construction logic. It then trains a retrieval model that matches problem states to compatible thought modes, providing guidance on which reasoning challenges to introduce during synthesis. New problems are composed by iteratively applying retrieved thought modes to seed questions, with distribution-aligned sampling to encourage diverse reasoning coverage. Finally, a rollout-based judging stage labels generated questions by difficulty and supplies judged-correct responses for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate MindLoom on nine benchmarks covering five STEM disciplines and four mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple model families and sizes. Models fine-tuned on MindLoom-generated data achieves favorable performances over base models, distillation, and external-data baselines across the reported benchmarks. Ablation studies indicate the contribution of each component, and further analysis suggests that MindLoom covers a broad range of reasoning patterns while maintaining useful difficulty control. We have open-sourced our implementation at https://github.com/EachSheep/MindLoom.

AI.tldr: MindLoom是一个基于组合思维模式工程的前沿级推理数据合成框架，通过将难题解决方案分解为思维模式链来理解问题构建逻辑，训练检索模型匹配问题状态与思维模式，从而合成具有可控难度和多样推理覆盖的新问题。
AI.motivation: 现有推理数据合成方法对控制问题难度的结构因素缺乏深入理解，导致生成数据的推理多样性有限且难度控制不稳定，难以系统化地生成前沿级推理数据。
AI.method: MindLoom通过组合思维模式工程合成推理数据：首先将难题的解决方案分解为揭示构建逻辑的思维模式链，然后训练检索模型将问题状态与兼容的思维模式匹配，接着通过迭代应用检索到的思维模式到种子问题来合成新问题，采用分布对齐采样确保推理覆盖多样性，最后通过rollout评判对生成的问题进行难度标注并提供用于监督微调的正确响应。
AI.result: 在5个STEM学科和4个数学推理任务的9个基准测试上，MindLoom生成数据微调的模型在性能上优于基座模型、知识蒸馏和外部数据基线。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: MindLoom covers a broad range of reasoning patterns while maintaining useful difficulty control, and the implementation has been open-sourced.

title: Don't Collapse Your Features: Why CenterLoss Hurts OOD Detection and Multi-Scale Mahalanobis Wins
summary: The ability to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs is fundamental to safe deployment of machine learning systems. Yet, current methods often rely on feature representations that are optimised solely for classification accuracy, neglecting the distinct requirements of epistemic uncertainty. We introduce GOEN (Geometry-Optimised Epistemic Network), a simple pipeline that combines multi-scale features, L2 normalisation, Mahalanobis distance, and a calibration head trained with real hard OOD examples. Through systematic ablation we uncover a counter-intuitive finding: CenterLoss, a popular regulariser for feature compactness, significantly degrades OOD detection performance, reducing average OOD AUROC from 0.9483 to 0.9366 despite improving classification accuracy. The best variant, GOEN-NoCenterLoss, achieves an average OOD AUROC of 0.9483, surpassing all baselines including deep ensembles (0.8827), KNN (0.8967), and ODIN (0.8870) on CIFAR-10 benchmarks, while maintaining competitive in-distribution accuracy. Our results challenge the prevailing assumption that better classification geometry automatically leads to better epistemic uncertainty. Instead, we show that overly tight feature clusters compress inter-class margins and distort the covariance structure needed for effective OOD detection. GOEN is efficient, training in under 20 minutes on a single GPU, and provides a practical blueprint for building AI systems that reliably recognise their own limitations.

AI.tldr: GOEN challenges the assumption that tighter feature clusters improve uncertainty estimation; instead, overly compact features compress inter-class margins and distort covariance structure, harming OOD detection; a simple pipeline without CenterLoss achieves superior results.
AI.motivation: Current OOD detection methods rely on feature representations optimised solely for classification accuracy, which neglects the distinct requirements of epistemic uncertainty; this mismatch leads to sub-optimal uncertainty quantification.
AI.method: GOEN combines multi-scale features, L2 normalisation, Mahalanobis distance, and a calibration head trained with real hard OOD examples; systematic ablation was performed to identify the detrimental effect of CenterLoss on OOD detection.
AI.result: CenterLoss significantly degrades OOD detection (AUROC drops from 0.9483 to 0.9366) despite improving classification accuracy; GOEN-NoCenterLoss outperforms all baselines including deep ensembles (0.8827), KNN (0.8967), and ODIN (0.8870) on CIFAR-10 benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: GOEN-NoCenterLoss achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection (AUROC 0.9483) while maintaining competitive in-distribution accuracy; the method is computationally efficient (<20 min on single GPU) and provides a practical framework for building uncertainty-aware AI systems.

title: Sibyl-AutoResearch: Autonomous Research Needs Self-Evolving Trial-and-Error Harnesses, Not Paper Generators
summary: Autonomous research systems increasingly make the scientific workflow executable: agents can propose ideas, run code, inspect results, and draft papers. But executable workflows do not by themselves produce research judgment. We analyze where current systems lose trial experience: weak evidence becomes prose, pilot signals become broad claims, memory remains textual, and recurring process failures do not change later behavior. We introduce Sibyl-AutoResearch, a self-evolving AutoResearch framework built around Scientific Trial-and-Error Harnesses. A harness lets agents run bounded trials, preserve positive and negative outcomes, and route lessons into later planning, validation, claim scope, scheduling, critique, writing, and harness repair. We formalize this through two auditable conversion units: trial-to-behavior conversion, which links trial signals to later research actions, and trial-to-harness-behavior conversion, which links recurring process failures to system updates. We implement the framework in SIBYL, a file-backed autonomous research system that exposes the state, roles, memory, gates, and artifact traces needed to inspect these conversion paths. A retrospective audit identifies eight high-confidence conversion events, with a median latency of one iteration and a maximum latency of three iterations. A recovered-failure registry further shows how five naturally occurring failure classes, including duplicate results, stale numbers, and unsupported statistics, were blocked, downgraded, or routed into later repair. These traces do not establish a comparative performance claim; they show that the proposed conversion units are recoverable from realistic autonomous-research workspaces. The SIBYL framework and system are available at https://github.com/Sibyl-Research-Team/AutoResearch-SibylSystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sibyl-AutoResearch：一个围绕「科学试错框架」(Scientific Trial-and-Error Harness) 构建的自演化自主研究框架，并以文件可追溯的自主研究系统 SIBYL 作为具体实现。其核心主张是：自主研究系统的问题不在于「能否产出完整论文」，而在于「试错经验是否被转化为后续研究行为」；论文提出两个可审计的转换单元（trial-to-behavior 与 trial-to-harness-behavior 转化），给出 7 项框架承诺 H1–H7 与 6 类失效模式 F1–F6 的映射，并在 11–13 个真实工作区的回溯审计中标记 8 个高置信转换事件（中位延迟 1 轮、最大 3 轮）、登记 5 类被拦截/降级/路由的自然发生失效。论文明确声明其证据不构成任何与既有系统的比较性能主张，只是一个设计框架与「存在性证明」。
AI.motivation: 现有自主研究系统（AI Scientist、Agent Laboratory、AlphaEvolve 类验证器搜索、Reflexion/记忆体等）已能把研究流程「可执行化」：生成想法、写代码、跑实验、解读结果、写草稿。但作者指出，执行完成不等于「研究判断力」的积累，经验在流程中系统性丢失，表现为六类失效：F1 论文完成掩盖证据不成熟（弱证据被写成结论）、F2 试点信号被当作论文级主张、F3 可见指标沦为错误目标（坏指标被继续优化）、F4 记忆停留在文本层而未被路由到需要它的角色、F5 试次数量增加但试次策略（排序、成本、停止规则）不变、F6 过程性失败复发因为框架（harness）本身不修改。作者用 SIBYL 早期工作区的真实轨迹（如稀疏自编码器复现中写作分数升至 8/10 而监督/批判分数降至 4.5/10、证据基础崩塌）作为动机锚点，并类比人类研究者经过大量试错形成「研究直觉」这一可被工程化的机制。
AI.method: 1) 失效分析：归纳 F1–F6 六类「缺失更新路径」（update path），即从试次信号到后续约束（规划、验证、主张边界、资源分配、批评、写作、框架行为）的通路缺失。2) 框架形式化：提出两个可审计转换单元——trial-to-behavior conversion（第 t 轮的信号改变第 t+k 轮的行动，须链接「信号—轨迹路径—后续行为变更」三件工件）与 trial-to-harness-behavior conversion（反复过程失败改变门禁、提示覆盖层、遥测要求、调度策略、修复任务、产物契约或受保护约束）；二者共同构成 agent–harness 协同演化。3) 七项框架承诺 H1–H7（试次编排、证据成熟度、可追溯性、路由研究记忆、视角分离、资源感知试次策略、带受保护约束的框架自演化），每项给出「可观测承诺」，并与 F1–F6 建立一对一映射。4) 系统实现：SIBYL 为文件背书的自主研究系统，将研究状态、计划、角色输出、实验产物、评审、反思、写作产物全部落盘；反思被归一化为问题类别并转为 evolution record，再以角色特定 lesson overlay 注入；写作角色只能消费带成熟度标签、产物链接与验证状态的「已验证主张登记库」，无法仅凭文字把试点信号升级为 paper-ready 主张；多角色（规划、实验、批判、监督、怀疑、方法学、写作、编辑）保持权威分离。5) 评估协议（六个，仅第一个在本文执行）：回溯式转换审计、前瞻定预算研究、注入式失效压力测试、跨项目记忆测试、框架演化测试、视角与效率消融。
AI.result: 回溯审计（非受控对比、非基准测试）：在真实工作区中人工标记 8 个高置信转换事件，从信号到行为更新的中位延迟为 1 轮、最大可见延迟 3 轮；事件涵盖动态权重衰减（控制器不稳定→控制器修复+预算断言+9/9 稳定性测试+分级收窄主张）、扩散语言模型加速（不支持统计与功能空操作加速器→主张重构为「干扰分类学」+全量复现前置条件）、稀疏自编码器吸收（写作停滞→先实验后验证；置信区间倒置与陈旧 4.1× 标题比→修正为 2.7×）、失败的稀疏自编码器复现（重复结果、特征数 1024 vs 16384、缺失稀疏匹配对照→成为前置条件）、图像增强试点（2.68 个百分点差异但全量证据缺失→在试点/全量边界阻断主张）、缓存试点（54 分钟才发现 15.2× 开销→记录 10 分钟吞吐 sanity check 策略）、缺失评审门禁压力测试（硬阻断并回滚）。恢复失效登记（自然发生而非注入）覆盖 5 类：重复结果文件、置信区间倒置、陈旧标题数字、特征数不匹配、不支持统计，各自带审计产物类型、捕获机制与后续更新。聚合「评审→行动」审计：11 个工作区、51 个项目-迭代快照、3 种评审界面（保守/量表/长文本）；三种界面 schema 与校准互不一致（如保守评审 31/35 分为 3，量表评审均值 3.94），内部 SIBYL 评分（39/51 有分，均值 6.13/10）与保守评审更接近（配对差 +0.14）而非量表评审（−0.83），说明评审分数是不良进展指标、反对意见本身更有用；12 条轨迹、37 行可解析行动计划中，评分下降行的高严重度问题数为 8.7/行，上升行为 4.0/行，且评分下降后的下一迭代约 2/3 任务为实验与对照（88 任务中 56 个为实验/对照、17 个验证/产物修复、13 个框架/系统）。框架侧证据：中心 evolution digest 含 416 条复发问题模式（实验 212、写作 89、分析 84、系统 20、构思 4、流水线 3、规划 3、效率 1），按角色显式路由并由提示加载器注入；12/13 工作区有非空结果记录，中心账本 173 条 outcome 记录。阶段转移计数（1,853 条 stage-end，12 条轨迹）显示 writing→writing 自环 405 次、experiment→experiment 271 次，而 review→harness 217、harness→experiment 124、validation→experiment 78，说明写作/实验易自吸而评审与门禁能把工作推回实验。局限：证据为回溯性、单一作者自建框架、框架与系统共同演化故非独立验证集、转换为人工标记、失效为自然发生而非注入、消融为过程诊断而非统计实验、评审类工件为生成评审而非人类同行评审、转移计数可能含断点重放。
AI.conclusion: 自主研究不应主要以「能否生成完整论文」来评判，因为论文只是证据状态的一种表达；真正关键的能力是把试次历史转化为研究判断力——更好的计划、更强的验证、更窄的主张、更安全的资源策略，以及一个随时间变得更难被糊弄的框架。作者主张这需要 Sibyl-AutoResearch 与 Scientific Trial-and-Error Harnesses：框架与系统不可干净分离（更好的轨迹暴露缺失的更新路径，更好的更新路径理论指导后续系统该保留、路由、阻断与审计什么），并强调试错框架的可审计性在于追问「agent 学到了什么、这条教训去了哪里、它如何改变了下一次研究行动」而非「它产出了什么」。作者同时给出治理立场：harness 若被不当优化会变成「更高效地生产似是而非的弱科学」的机器，因此以主张-证据门禁、AI 使用披露、人类问责、负结果报告、隐藏注入失效、受保护完整性约束与记忆覆盖层定期审计作为缓解；人类作者必须能够理解、辩护并重写最终提交，自主系统不应被视为可问责作者。论文反复强调其结论是设计框架与存在性证明，而非对 SIBYL 的比较性能主张，未来工作应在留出框架、独立标注者、前瞻注入失效与公开产物包上检验转换单元。

title: RankJudge: A Multi-Turn LLM-as-a-Judge Synthetic Benchmark Generator
summary: As interactive LLM-based applications are created and refined, model developers need to evaluate the quality of generated text along many possible axes. For simpler systems, human evaluation may be practical, but in complicated systems like conversational chatbots, the amount of generated text can overwhelm human annotation resources. Model developers have begun to rely heavily on auto-evaluation, where LLMs are also used to judge generation quality. However, existing LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks largely focus on simple Q\&A tasks that do not match the complexity of multi-turn conversations. We introduce RankJudge, a benchmark generator for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge on multi-turn conversations grounded in reference documents. RankJudge creates pairs of conversations where one conversation has a single flaw injected into one turn. This construction allows paired conversations to be labeled unambiguously as better or worse, and precisely isolates failure categories to individual turns, enabling a strict joint correctness criterion for judging. We implement RankJudge across the domains of machine learning, biomedicine, and finance, evaluate 21 frontier LLM judges, and rank those judges via the Bradley-Terry model. Our formulation also allows ranking each conversation pair with difficulty ratings, which we use to dynamically curate the evaluation slice to reduce label noise, as confirmed via human annotation. We find that judge rankings are stable under partial observability, coarser correctness criteria, and an alternative random-walk rating algorithm.

AI.tldr: RankJudge is a benchmark generator for evaluating LLM judges on multi-turn conversations. It creates conversation pairs with single injected flaws, enabling strict evaluation criteria. Across ML, biomedicine, and finance domains, 21 frontier LLM judges were evaluated using Bradley-Terry ranking, demonstrating stable judge performance under various conditions.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks focus on simple Q&A tasks that do not match the complexity of multi-turn conversations, yet interactive LLM applications like chatbots generate overwhelming amounts of text that exhaust human annotation resources.
AI.method: RankJudge creates paired conversations where one conversation has a single injected flaw per turn, enabling unambiguous better/worse labeling and precise failure category isolation. Implemented across machine learning, biomedicine, and finance domains, evaluating 21 frontier LLM judges via Bradley-Terry model ranking, with dynamic evaluation slice curation to reduce label noise.
AI.result: Judge rankings remain stable under partial observability, coarser correctness criteria, and an alternative random-walk rating algorithm, confirmed via human annotation.
AI.conclusion: RankJudge provides a strict joint correctness criterion for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge on multi-turn conversations, with stable judge rankings demonstrated across multiple evaluation scenarios.

title: The 2nd Workshop on Agile Practice & Research: A Summary and Call For Research
summary: Agile software development has been shaped by the interplay between academic research and industrial practice for over two decades, yet notable gaps persist between both domains. This paper focuses on three research-practice gaps: the theory gap, the time gap, and the transfer gap. To address these, the 2nd Agile Practice & Research Workshop was held at the International Conference on Agile Software Development (XP) 2026 in São Paulo, Brazil, bringing researchers and practitioners together to identify root causes and develop joint solutions. Building on two preceding sessions in which contributions of participants had been presented, participants engaged in a structured collaborative session, working in small groups on one of the three gaps and reflecting on possible causes and remedies. The organizers synthesized the results into four propositions for improving the research-practice intersection: (1) improving scientific communication, (2) aligning research more closely with emerging industrial needs, (3) creating stronger incentives for sustained collaboration, and (4) integrating educational approaches into research practice. From these, three calls for research were formulated: (a) broader adoption of open science practices for transparency, reproducibility, and cumulative evidence; (b) higher empirical quality standards through stronger theoretical grounding and rigorous design; and (c) more explicit, value-oriented contributions that clearly articulate their practical and scientific relevance. The paper offers both a summary of the workshop and a call to strengthen research-practice collaboration.

AI.tldr: This workshop paper addresses three research-practice gaps in agile software development (theory, time, and transfer gaps) through structured collaborative sessions at XP 2026. The outcomes include four propositions and three research calls aimed at strengthening collaboration between researchers and practitioners.
AI.motivation: Despite two decades of interplay between academia and industry in agile software development, notable gaps persist: the theory gap, the time gap, and the transfer gap. These gaps hinder effective research-practice intersection.
AI.method: Structured collaborative workshop at XP 2026 conference. Participants worked in small groups on one of three gaps, identifying root causes and developing remedies. Organizers synthesized outcomes into propositions and research calls.
AI.result: Four propositions for improving research-practice intersection and three calls for future research were formulated, addressing communication, alignment with industrial needs, collaboration incentives, and educational integration.
AI.conclusion: The workshop produced four actionable propositions: (1) improving scientific communication, (2) aligning research with emerging industrial needs, (3) creating incentives for sustained collaboration, and (4) integrating educational approaches. Three research calls were formulated: (a) adopting open science practices, (b) raising empirical quality standards, and (c) articulating explicit value-oriented contributions. The paper serves as both a workshop summary and a call to action.

title: Exploiting Multicast for Accelerating Collective Communication
summary: Reducing collective communication latency is a critical goal for large model training and inference in both academia and industry. Many-to-many communications, such as AllGather and AlltoAll (dispatch), are core components of modern parallelization strategies. State-of-the-art implementations of these communications rely on unicast-based writes and transmit duplicate copies of the same data across physical links for multiple receivers. This redundant transmission congests network bottlenecks and degrades end-to-end latency. We present MultiWrite, a novel many-to-many transmission semantic that eliminates redundant packets to directly reduce operator latency. MultiWrite adopts multicast principles while addressing critical limitations of traditional multicast for AI workloads. These limitations include heavy management plane overhead and ecosystem compatibility issues. We implement MultiWrite on Ascend NPUs. Long-term stress tests demonstrate that our MultiWrite-based operators achieve up to 33% latency reduction on commercially deployed devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MultiWrite——一种面向集合通信（AllGather / AlltoAll-dispatch）的多写（many-to-many）传输语义：以单份数据注入网络取代基于单播的重复拷贝，由中间节点（而非交换机）在应用层完成复制与转发，从而消除瓶颈链路上的冗余传输。语义定义在应用—事务边界，通过在数据包中携带 64 位 rank 位图元数据（而非预建组播组）规避组播组爆炸问题，并以"增强 write 语义"形式融入现有通信栈，无需改动交换机/固件/框架接口。在昇腾 910B 上实现后，长期压力测试显示 AllGather/AlltoAll 端到端时延降低约 12%–33%。
AI.motivation: 大模型训练/推理中，集合通信（AllGather、AlltoAll）占运行时 20%–30%，是决定可扩展性的核心瓶颈。其现有实现（NCCL/HCCL）基于单播 write，为多个接收者重复发送相同数据，冗余流量压满瓶颈链路；DeepSeek V3 后 MoE/大规模 EP 使 AlltoAll 域扩至 64/128/256 节点，且推理侧要求 TPOT<5ms，问题被进一步放大。已有的组播方案在工业界落地受三重阻碍：(1) 现有研究多只证明"节省源端出口带宽"，而带宽下降并不等价于时延下降——在经典 CLOS 拓扑中组播只减轻上行负载，下行负载不变，整体时延几乎不变，且依赖交换机复制转发能力；(2) MoE dispatch 场景中 top-k 路由运行时动态决定目标，组播组数量呈组合爆炸（EP=64、Top-8 时 C(64,8)>44 亿），而动态加入/退组等控制面操作带来数十微秒时延，无法满足数据面要求；(3) 传统组播（如 IB UD 模式）依赖组播组创建/加入/离开/删除、QP 挂载/解绑等独立控制面与专用硬件组件（Subnet Manager/SMAD），与现有以 write/read 语义构建的算子框架完全不兼容，改造成本极高。此外，现有优化多为"事后救火"式（换算法、调路由权重、开通信计算重叠），跨硬件/模型不可移植。
AI.method:
动机与场景分析：（1）指出带宽降低≠时延降低，以 8 节点 CLOS 拓扑 AllGather 为例说明组播仅缓解上行瓶颈；（2）识别两类真实受益场景——全互联（full-mesh）双 TP 域场景：采用"配对中继"后组播方案端到端有效带宽达 2w、时延 s/(2w)，相对基线降 50%、相对单播多路径降 33%；完整多路径中继方案至少降 16%；以及跨服务器带宽超额订阅场景（EP>8，服务器内 8 卡 HCCS 56GB/s、跨服务器 RoCE 200Gbps）：源节点仅向对端同序号 NPU 发一份，由其在服务器内复制转发，消除跨服务器冗余。（3）提炼第一性原理：只要"源节点→第一个复制节点"的链路是系统瓶颈，即可获得时延收益。

设计：MultiWrite 定义为应用—事务边界的一侧内存语义，MultiWrite(S, M={(D_i,B_i)}, B_S) 原子地将源缓冲区写入所有目的节点的对应缓冲区；采用纯递归执行模型——|M|=1 退化为标准 write，|M|>1 则按下一跳中继拆分为 l 个子集并发起 l 个 MultiWrite，无全局协调、无网络状态。两大关键设计：(a) 消除组播组——源节点把目的 rank 位图元数据编码进数据包（64 位固定长度位图，基于 NPU rank 索引，配合本地的物理地址↔rank 映射表；相比直接嵌入 128bit EID 避免了可变长头部与 128 字节头部开销），中继节点解析元数据后按"唯一出端口集合"决定复制份数并转发，并在转发时更新元数据以避免重复复制/路由环路（在无环路拓扑且接收端去重时可省略）；复用既有单播转发表，无需专用组播转发表。(b) 弥合生态鸿沟——"语义化"组播操作：在 UB 协议中新增 TAOpcode（如 0x3 为 write、0x4 为 write_with_immediate 之后新增 MultiWrite 码），元数据借用 write_with_immediate 的 immediate 字段承载（UB/RDMA 协议原生保留，无额外包头开销）；对上层暴露与 write() 相同风格的接口，仅把单个远端地址替换为地址数组，网络内复制/路由/元数据管理对调用方完全透明。语义性质：单目的原子性、目的间无序、继承底层单播可靠传输、无状态。

实现：在 UB/UMDK 生态的 liburma.so 之上纯软件扩展，含 cs_ini（拓扑加载、启动守护线程）、cs_relay（守护线程，收包/复制/转发）、cs_send（任务分解、生成 WQE）、cs_rcv（收包、重组、交付）。基于该语义实现 MultiWrite 版 AllGather（全互联 8 节点、两个 TP=4 域：数据按实测链路带宽动态切分，一半走域内直连、一半通过跨域 MultiWrite 一次性送达 4 个目的节点，使两路同时到达以最小化整体时延；收包检查与全局 barrier 逻辑不变）与 AlltoAll dispatch。
AI.result:
实验环境：2 台服务器 × 8 个昇腾 910B4（32GB HBM），服务器内 HCCS 全互联、每链路 56GB/s，跨服务器走 RoCE NIC、CLOS 组网、端口出向 200Gbps；基线为官方 HCCL 的 HcclAllGather / HcclAlltoAllV（并额外加入若干内部优化以强化基线），对比项包括单播多路径优化版。

结果：（1）AllGather（每 rank 16MB，近 1000 次长时压力测试）：MultiWrite 版延迟最低且最稳定，相对基线降约 30%，相对单播多路径降 17%；单播多路径因在跨域链路上并发多流、互扰严重，方差大，甚至劣于基线。（2）消息规模敏感性：AllGather 从 256KB 到 200MB，大消息下收益与上述一致；小消息（如 256KB）因切分与额外处理开销反而高于基线，交越点约 2MB；实际 AllGather 每 rank 通常不低于 1MB，仍处优势区间。（3）AlltoAll dispatch（16 NPU、64 专家、top-8、负载均衡）：prefill 阶段 batch 1k/2k 分别降 12% 和 27%；decode 阶段 batch 64 时反而更慢，batch 128 时与基线基本持平——因为小 batch 下跨服务器冗余流量本身很少，节省的跨服务器时间不足以抵消同序号 NPU 复制与服务器内转发的额外开销（实测含冗余的跨服务器传输时延在 64/128/1k/2k batch 下分别为 112.9/210.5/1231.2/2429.7μs，去冗余后降至 43.8/66.6/320.5/622.1μs，Δ 为 69.1/143.9/910.7/1807.6μs）。（4）开销分析：元数据开销几乎为零（64bit 位图借 immediate 字段；128 NPU 需扩位或置入 payload，1024 NPU 域下仅占 3.13%）；AICPU 用量因中继解析/复制/转发而中等上升，但基线本身几乎为 0（高性能数据面走 AICube/AIVector），对共置服务影响可忽略；中继缓冲直接复用算子既有接收缓冲，无显著额外内存开销。总体在商用设备长时压力测试中取得最高 33% 的时延下降。
AI.conclusion: MultiWrite 通过"把组播做成写语义的扩展"这一思路，同时解决了传统组播的三大痛点：明确界定了组播式传输真正带来端到端时延收益的场景（源端到首个复制节点的链路为瓶颈，如全互联双 TP 域、跨服务器带宽超额订阅），以包内位图元数据彻底摆脱组播组爆炸（MoE 动态 top-k 路由不再需要预建组），并以增强 write 语义的方式实现，使其天然兼容现有集合通信框架与上层接口，且不需要交换机/固件改动、可跨加速器平台移植。其核心语义性质（逐目的原子性、目的间无序、端到端可靠、无状态）使其可作为现有多目的通信模式的"即插即用"替代。局限与后续方向：小消息/小 batch 场景收益为负（切分与复制开销 > 带宽收益），需按消息规模自适应选择路径或与多路径策略结合；未来可进一步推广到 combine 之外的场景、更多集合算子与其他互联生态（UALink/UEC/ESUN 等）验证。

title: A Coalgebraic Dijkstra Algorithm
summary: The Dijkstra algorithm is a classical method for solving the shortest path problem on weighted graphs. There are several variations of the Dijkstra algorithm, including algorithms for the widest path problem and for two-player games. In this paper, we introduce the coalgebraic shortest path problem (CSPP), a unifying framework for a broad class of optimization problems on state-transition systems. This framework encompasses not only the aforementioned problems but also new ones such as the shortest binary tree problem. We further present a coalgebraic Dijkstra algorithm for solving the CSPP efficiently under a suitable condition. Our condition is necessary and sufficient for the algorithm to return correct solutions, thereby providing a precise criterion for when Dijkstra-style acceleration is possible. We also show that the proposed algorithm achieves asymptotic complexity comparable to that of the classical Dijkstra algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文引入coalgebraic shortest path problem（CSPP）作为状态转移系统上一大类优化问题的统一框架，涵盖经典最短路径、最大宽度路径、二人博弈等问题以及新的最短二叉树问题等。提出coalgebraic Dijkstra算法，并给出算法能返回正确解的充分必要条件，同时证明该算法具有与经典Dijkstra算法相当的渐近复杂度。
AI.motivation: Dijkstra算法虽然经典，但不同变体（如最大宽度路径问题、二人博弈问题）缺乏统一的抽象框架。该研究旨在用一个统一的co-代数框架整合这些优化问题。
AI.method: 提出coalgebraic shortest path problem（CSPP）统一框架，并开发coalgebraic Dijkstra算法求解该问题。
AI.result: 证明了提出的条件是充分必要的（确保算法返回正确解），且算法渐近复杂度与经典Dijkstra算法相当。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个充分必要条件来判断Dijkstra风格的加速是否可行，并证明了算法具有与经典Dijkstra算法相当的渐近复杂度，为一大类状态转移系统上的优化问题提供了统一的算法框架。

title: Behavior-Guided Candidate Calibration for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Multimodal recommendation benefits from content signals, but the gain depends on how those signals interact with the ranking pipeline. We find that moderate cross-view agreement helps, while stronger agreement suppresses recommendation-specific variation. Spectral analysis shows a clear split: low-frequency components capture shared structure, and higher-frequency components preserve more discriminative signal. Based on this finding, we introduce a behavior-guided candidate calibration model that converts training-only co-user overlap into signed candidate evidence and applies it only to the shortlist produced by the multimodal backbone. The backbone keeps the representation space stable; behavior evidence acts only where ranking is decided. Results on Amazon Baby, Sports, and Electronics show consistent gains over strong multimodal baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/LIZESHENG13/bridge.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态推荐中跨视图一致性的双面效应，通过频谱分析发现低频成分捕获共享结构、高频成分保留判别信号，进而提出仅在排序短列表阶段注入行为校准证据的轻量级方法，实现了稳定性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态推荐系统的性能提升依赖于内容信号与排序流程的交互方式。研究发现跨视图一致性存在最佳阈值：中等一致性有助于推荐，而过强的一致性反而会抑制推荐特有的变异性。
AI.method: 提出行为引导的候选校准模型：将训练阶段仅存在的共用户重叠信号转换为带符号的候选证据，仅对多模态backbone生成的短列表进行校准应用。
AI.result: 在Amazon Baby、Sports和Electronics三个数据集上，该方法相比强基线多模态推荐模型取得了一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过分离表示学习（backbone）和排序决策（calibration），在保持表示空间稳定性的同时，有针对性地注入行为证据，在三个Amazon数据集上取得了稳定的性能提升。

title: Healthcare LLM Benchmarks Are Only as Good as Their Explicit Assumptions
summary: Benchmarks are necessary for healthcare evaluation, but are not sufficient for predicting deployment performance. Our position is that the evaluation--deployment gap arises not because of poorly designed benchmarks, but from implicit assumptions about how users interact with models that cannot be surfaced from benchmarks alone. To make this precise, we propose a classification of assumptions into two categories: task, which can be tested from conversation data alone, and outcome, which requires outcome data and behavioral studies for testing. Critically, outcome assumptions depend on human behavior, something that even well-designed benchmarks cannot directly observe. To demonstrate the operationality of this framework, we retrospectively analyze a healthcare RCT as a case study and find that the gap naturally separates into task and outcome gaps of roughly equal size. To address this, we make two contributions: first, we propose BenchmarkCards, an artifact that documents assumptions, and second, we propose staged evaluation, a procedure that systematically tests assumptions and evaluates performance.

AI.tldr: This paper argues that healthcare benchmarks fail to predict deployment performance due to implicit user interaction assumptions. The authors propose classifying these assumptions into task-based (testable from conversation data) and outcome-based (requiring behavioral studies), finding equal contributions from both in an RCT case study. They offer BenchmarkCards and staged evaluation as practical solutions.
AI.motivation: The evaluation-deployment gap in healthcare models arises from implicit assumptions about user interaction that benchmarks cannot surface, not from poorly designed benchmarks themselves.
AI.method: Proposed a two-category assumption classification framework: task assumptions (testable from conversation data) and outcome assumptions (requiring outcome data and behavioral studies). Retrospectively analyzed a healthcare RCT as case study.
AI.result: In the case study, the gap naturally separated into task and outcome gaps of roughly equal size, demonstrating that both assumption types contribute significantly to the overall gap.
AI.conclusion: The framework is operationalized through two practical contributions: BenchmarkCards (documentation artifact for assumptions) and staged evaluation (systematic testing procedure).

title: Double descent for least-squares interpolation on contaminated data: A simulation study
summary: Overparametrized models can exhibit an excellent generalization performance, although they should be prone to overfitting according to classical statistical theory. The discovery of the "double descent", indicating that the generalization error decreases after a certain model complexity has been reached, opened a new line of research. Robust statistics considers statistical estimation on contaminated data, which, due to assumptions that do not hold on real data, let data points appear as outliers w.r.t. the assumed "ideal" distribution, potentially severely distorting any classical estimator. We address the question whether a double descent phenomenon can be observed in a linear regression setting with contaminated training data. We compare the performance of the highly non-robust least-squares interpolation estimator with several robust alternatives. It turns out that large overparametrization indeed allows for a double descent phenomenon, resulting in a very good generalization performance of the least-squares interpolator, surpassing that of the robust alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了污染数据场景下线性回归中是否存在双下降现象。研究发现，过参数化能使最小二乘插值器在污染训练数据上实现双下降，泛化性能超越鲁棒替代方法。
AI.motivation: 传统统计理论认为过参数化模型易过拟合，但"双下降"现象的发现挑战了这一认知；同时鲁棒统计研究关注污染数据下的估计问题。
AI.method: 将非鲁棒的最小二乘插值估计器与多种鲁棒替代方法进行对比实验。
AI.result: 过参数化确实能够在污染数据条件下产生双下降现象，使得最小二乘插值器获得优异的泛化性能，且超越鲁棒替代方法的表
AI.conclusion: 在污染数据情境下，过参数化仍能实现双下降现象，且最小二乘插值器的泛化性能优于鲁棒替代方法。

title: A Generalized Nash Equilibrium-Seeking Scheme for Trauma Resuscitation
summary: Trauma resuscitation is a clinical process for treating life-threatening physiological disorders in safety-critical environments, driven by the experience of healthcare workers (HCWs). Designing and optimizing quantifiable metrics that accurately capture HCW decisions may augment current resuscitation procedures with the potential to improve patient outcomes. This motivates our socio-technical formulation of trauma resuscitation as a distributed generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE)-seeking game with coupled inequality constraints. This method is optimized over a time-varying communication graph. We introduce novel insights from clinical experience to model HCWs behavior. This work facilitates the best possible resuscitation outcome given HCWs workloads, schedules, competencies, and limited resources.

AI.tldr: 该研究将创伤复苏过程建模为分布式GNE博弈问题，在时变通信图上求解耦合不等式约束，并结合临床经验设计优化指标，旨在提升复苏决策质量和患者预后。
AI.motivation: 创伤复苏是安全关键环境中的临床过程，当前缺乏能够准确量化医护人员决策的指标，亟需设计可量化的优化指标以增强现有复苏流程。
AI.method: 将创伤复苏建模为带耦合不等式约束的分布式广义纳什均衡（GNE）寻求博弈问题，并在时变通信图上进行优化求解，同时融入临床经验建模医护人员行为。
AI.result: 建立了考虑医护人员工作负荷、作息安排、能力水平和有限资源的复苏决策优化框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过将创伤复苏问题建模为分布式GNE寻求博弈，并基于时变通信图进行优化，该框架能够在考虑医护人员工作负荷、排班、能力差异和资源限制的情况下，找到最优复苏决策，为改善患者预后提供决策支持。

title: PromptNCE: Pointwise Mutual Information Predictions Using Only LLMs and Contrastive Estimation Prompts
summary: Estimating mutual information from text usually requires training a task-specific critic, which limits its use in low-data settings. We ask whether large language models can instead estimate pointwise mutual information zero-shot, using only prompts and elicited probabilities. We introduce a benchmark with human-derived ground-truth PMI across three publicly available datasets, and evaluate five information-theoretic prompting-based estimators. Our main method, PromptNCE, frames conditional probability estimation as a contrastive task and augments the candidate set with an explicit OTHER category. We show theoretically that adding OTHER recovers the true conditional P(y | x) rather than just a ranking over listed candidates, turning a contrastive prompt into a general-purpose zero-shot probability estimator. PromptNCE is the best zero-shot method on all three datasets, reaching Spearman correlation up to 0.82 with human-derived PMI. We also present a case study in computer science education showing how these estimators can be used to score student knowledge summaries in a low-data setting.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces PromptNCE, a zero-shot mutual information estimator using large language models that frames conditional probability as a contrastive task with an OTHER category, achieving up to 0.82 Spearman correlation and demonstrating utility in educational knowledge assessment.
AI.motivation: Estimating mutual information from text typically requires training a task-specific critic, which limits its applicability in low-data settings.
AI.method: PromptNCE frames conditional probability estimation as a contrastive task and augments the candidate set with an explicit OTHER category, theoretically recovering true conditional P(y|x) from contrastive prompts to create a general-purpose zero-shot probability estimator.
AI.result: PromptNCE achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, reaching Spearman correlation up to 0.82 with human-derived PMI across three datasets.
AI.conclusion: PromptNCE is the best zero-shot method across all three datasets, achieving Spearman correlation up to 0.82 with human-derived PMI, and demonstrates practical utility in low-data educational settings.

title: PITMuS: A Tool for Automated Bug Dataset Generation via Source-Level Mutant Reconstruction
summary:
LLM-based software engineering increasingly depends on executable, context-rich bug artifacts: paired correct and buggy code, methods under test (MUTs), documentation, and metadata. These artifacts support the training and evaluation of automated bug localization and repair techniques, testing and test oracle generation methods, and documentation-driven automation. Although curated benchmarks (e.g., Defects4J) remain valuable, they are static and increasingly vulnerable to contamination as code models are trained on large public corpora. A complementary strategy is to generate fresh, cutoff-aware datasets by selecting real system versions and injecting controlled bugs at the source level.
  Mutation testing is a natural basis for this strategy: it applies predefined mutation operators to programs and records whether the existing test suite detects each injected change. PIT is a state-of-the-practice mutation testing tool for Java that performs mutation at the bytecode level. This design makes mutation testing fast and practical, but PITMuS reports mutants primarily through XML, making them difficult to inspect, replay, or reuse as structured source-level dataset records. To address this gap, we present PITMuS, which combines PITMuS XML metadata with debug information from compiled Java class files to localize and reconstruct the source edit corresponding to each mutant. PITMuS then automatically produces structured datasets containing source-level buggy and fixed code pairs, documentation context, and metadata for downstream training and evaluation. Although we evaluate PITMuS on eight open-source Java systems, it can be applied to any Java system where PITMuS can be integrated.

AI.tldr: PITMuS is a tool that generates fresh, source-level bug datasets for LLM-based software engineering by combining bytecode-level mutation testing (PIT) with debug information to reconstruct structured code edits, addressing the contamination problem of static benchmarks.
AI.motivation: Existing curated benchmarks (e.g., Defects4J) are static and vulnerable to contamination as code models are trained on large public corpora, necessitating the generation of fresh, cutoff-aware datasets.
AI.method: PITMuS combines PIT's XML metadata with debug information from compiled Java class files to localize and reconstruct source-level edits corresponding to each mutant, automatically producing structured datasets.
AI.result: PITMuS successfully generates structured datasets containing source-level buggy and fixed code pairs, documentation context, and metadata for downstream training and evaluation, demonstrated on eight open-source Java systems.
AI.conclusion: PITMuS addresses the dataset contamination problem by providing an automated pipeline that generates fresh, structured source-level bug datasets, applicable to any Java system where mutation testing can be integrated.

title: Relay-Based Synchronization of Replicated Data Types in Opportunistic Networks
summary: In Opportunistic Networks (OppNets), the dissemination of information can only rely on transient pairwise radio contacts between mobile devices (peers). Designing distributed applications that can run in such conditions is a challenge, but replicated data types, and in particular Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs), can help meet this challenge. A CRDT is inherently replicated data type whose replicas can be updated locally, yet eventually converge thanks to an anti-entropy algorithm that allows all replicas to synchronize in the background. Whether the replicas of a CRDT can actually converge in an OppNet, and how fast they can converge, depend on the occurrence of radio contacts between mobile devices. In this paper we investigate the idea of using mobile relays as a means to boost the convergence of stated-based CRDT replicas in an OppNet. New protocols are presented that allow the synchronization of replicas and relays, and new metrics are defined to observe and characterize the convergence of replicas. Simulation results show that using relays can significantly improve this convergence, and even make it possible in scenarios where the replicas alone would be unable to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"基于中继的同步系统"（RBSS）：在机会网络中让不承载副本的移动节点充当"中继"，携带并转发状态型CRDT的序列化状态快照，从而在不依赖多跳路由的前提下加速副本收敛。作者设计了副本-副本、副本-中继、中继-中继三类同步协议（中继以版本向量聚合状态并用集合覆盖近似算法挑选最少"膨胀状态"），定义了收敛时延与收敛距离两个新指标，并在Östermalm行人轨迹、Vannes公交车网络与灾害救援三个仿真场景中验证：中继能显著降低收敛时延与落后更新数，甚至使原本无法收敛的副本最终收敛，且可扩展到上千副本规模。
AI.motivation: 机会网络（OppNet）中节点仅靠短暂的无线电接触通信，网络高度分区，传统的路由/覆盖层与消息转发（store-carry-and-forward）方案失效。状态型CRDT因merge函数满足交换、结合、幂等，能容忍丢包与分区而适合OppNet，但收敛完全依赖副本之间的直接相遇：当网络中只有少部分节点承载某CRDT副本时（大盘场景常见），副本相遇概率极低，收敛极慢甚至无法收敛。作者观察到传统消息转发只适合传播不可变的"消息载荷"，而副本状态是可变对象，快照会迅速过时，因此需要一种专门面向"状态传播"的中继机制来桥接副本间的空隙。
AI.method: 1）提出RBSS系统，仅依赖CRDT库的三个通用能力：获取序列化状态、合并他人序列化状态、监听本地更新事件，从而可对接Yjs/Automerge/Loro等任意库；要求通信中间件提供邻居发现与邻居间可靠传输，不支持多跳转发。2）三套同步协议：副本-副本通过交换版本向量（VV）判断对方状态是否"over"本地（存在本地未见更新）来决定是否发送状态，减少冗余传输；副本-中继时副本先发VV，中继用selectInflators()挑选可"膨胀"该副本的最小状态子集返回，副本合并后把自己的状态回传给中继并覆盖中继存储；中继-中继时双方交换聚合版本向量（vagg，store中各VV的逐点最大值），各自挑选候选状态发送，并按有序关系(≺)清除被新状态因果支配的旧状态。3）selectInflators()将选择问题化为集合覆盖（NP完全），采用"先选唯一膨胀者single inflators、再用贪心算法"的改进近似，复杂度O(n·m)，实践中m远小于n。4）工程增强：逐条发送状态以对抗接触中断（带"最后贡献"标志）、并发同步时防止中继store回退（把来自副本的状态按VV与vagg的三种关系处理）、状态膨胀后主动通知邻居触发再同步（可在反应性与流量间权衡）。5）新指标：以"全局状态"（理想无延迟集中式状态）为参考，定义收敛时延L_i(t)=t'-t（副本追平V_G(t)的最早时刻差）与收敛距离D_i(t)=ΣV_G-ΣV_i（尚未见到的更新数），并统计中继存储状态数与传输状态数。6）仿真器基于GraphStream时变图，同时驱动"接触场景"（节点角色与接触时间线）与"应用场景"（更新发布时间线）。7）三个场景：Östermalm（CRAWDAD行人轨迹+图游走副本，高churn）、VBN（60辆公交车作中继+10个相距很远的静态副本）、灾害救援（合成场景：1000名使用Levy Walk的救援人员+100架Random Waypoint无人机，10×10km²）。
AI.result: Östermalm（5副本）：无中继时平均收敛时延约26分钟、平均距离约60次更新；100%行人作中继时降至平均7分10秒、18次更新；50%中继已与100%几乎无差别，说明收益很快饱和。VBN（静态副本彼此无法直接相遇）：必须依赖公交车中继，100%时平均时延约30分钟、距离33次更新；仅20%时部分副本始终无法追上全局状态，50%及以上全部收敛。灾害救援（1000副本/100无人机）：25%无人机时平均时延6小时34分、距离12630次更新且19:25后全局状态再未被任何副本看到；100%时降至2小时52分、5122次更新且全部副本最终收敛。开销方面：中继存储中状态数在90%以上的同步时刻仅1个（100%中继时0.1%时刻才达5个），单次同步中继通常不发送任何状态（约53%–59%），副本每次至多发送1个状态，说明"状态选择+及时清理"有效控制了存储与信道开销，方案可扩展至上千副本。
AI.conclusion: 中继节点确实能显著加速状态型CRDT在机会网络中的收敛，甚至在副本无法直接相遇时成为唯一可行路径；RBSS因中继只把状态视为不透明字节串（可加密签名）而具备通用性与机密性，并通过最小化选择与清理实现节俭性，适合在真实CRDT库之上无/极少改动地实现。作者还讨论了可扩展性（版本向量大小只与副本数相关，与中继数无关）、安全性（Byzantine中继可向其他中继注入伪状态造成永久分区，需副本签名+中继验签等缓解）以及向云端/数据中心中继的推广，并提供了演示系统与开源代码。局限：选择算法为集合覆盖近似解而非最优；中继比例的最优选择与选择哪些节点作中继被明确列为未来工作；部分细节（如加密/签名方案、联邦式信任分发）留待后续。

title: The Secretary Problem with a Stochastic Precursor
summary: In learning-augmented online algorithms, predictions are usually valued for what they say: a value estimate, a solution, or an algorithmic recommendation. This paper shows that predictions can also be valuable solely due to their arrival time. We study the fundamental secretary problem augmented with a stochastic precursor: a content-free signal that is guaranteed to arrive no later than the best item, but is otherwise stochastically timed. The signal does not carry any additional information; nevertheless, its timing alone changes the structure of optimal stopping. We characterize optimal policies in the random-order and adversarial-order models. In random order, a single uniformly timed precursor already gives success probability at least $\frac12$, improving on the classic $\frac1e$ benchmark. With increasingly late precursors, the success probability approaches $1$. In adversarial order, for which traditional models do not admit strong guarantees, sufficiently concentrated precursors recover constant success guarantees. Our results show that such novel forms of asynchronous temporal information are a distinct and powerful form of advice in online decision making and may also be effective for other problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经典秘书问题结合随机前驱信号的新范式，发现信号的到达时间本身具有独立价值。随机顺序模型中，单一均匀时序前驱即可将成功率从1/e提升至至少1/2；对抗顺序模型中，集中时序的信号可恢复常数保证，证明异步时序信息是一种有效的新型建议形式。
AI.motivation: 传统预测研究关注预测内容的价值（如数值估计、解决方案），而本文提出预测的到达时间本身也具有独立价值，聚焦于一种新型的异步时序信息。
AI.method: 在随机顺序模型中使用动态规划与阈值策略分析最优策略的结构；对抗顺序模型中分析信号时间分布集中度对成功率的影响。
AI.result: 1) 随机顺序模型下，单个均匀时序的前驱信号即可将成功率从经典1/e提升至至少1/2，且随信号越晚接近，成功率趋近于1。2) 对抗顺序模型下，充分集中的信号可恢复常数级成功保证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了异步时序信息是一种新颖且强大的在线决策辅助形式，可推广至其他问题。

title: Integrating Chain-of-Thought into Generative Retrieval: A Preliminary Study
comment: This work was initially submitted to kdd 2026 in August 2025
summary: While generative retrieval (GR) demonstrates competitive performance on standard retrieval benchmarks, existing approaches directly map queries to document identifiers (docids) without intermediate deliberation, limiting their effectiveness for complex queries that require multi-step reasoning. As a preliminary study on integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) into generative retrieval, we introduce ThinkGR, a unified framework that interleaves CoT with docid generation, enabling iterative thinking and retrieval within a single generative process. To bridge the gap between free-form thought generation and structured retrieval targets, we design (1) a hybrid decoding strategy that dynamically switches between unconstrained thought generation and constrained docid decoding, and (2) a two-phase training approach that first aligns thought-retrieval patterns through supervised fine-tuning, then optimizes thought quality via retrieval-grounded reinforcement learning. Experiments on four multi-hop retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkGR achieves state-of-the-art performance with an average improvement of +6.86\%. Our work opens new avenues for enhancing generative retrieval with explicit deliberation capabilities, with promising implications for retrieval tasks requiring complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: ThinkGR是链式思维(CoT)与生成式检索的首次结合框架，通过混合解码和两阶段训练实现迭代式思考与检索，在多跳检索任务上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索方法直接将查询映射为文档标识符(docid)，缺乏中间推理环节，难以有效处理需要多步推理的复杂查询。
AI.method: (1) 混合解码策略：在非约束性思维生成与约束性docid解码之间动态切换；(2) 两阶段训练：第一阶段通过监督微调对齐思维-检索模式，第二阶段通过检索导向的强化学习优化思维质量。
AI.result: 在4个多跳检索基准上达到SOTA，平均提升6.86%。
AI.conclusion: ThinkGR为生成式检索引入显式推理能力，显著提升复杂查询场景下的检索性能，为需要多步推理的检索任务开辟新方向。

title: The efficiency-gain illusion: People underestimate the rate of AI use and overestimate its benefits on simple tasks
summary: People are increasingly turning to AI assistance for simple tasks, e.g., arithmetic, spell-check, and answering simple questions. But does AI assistance actually save users time and effort? We investigate people's propensity to use AI for cognitively simple tasks and assess whether their reliance is well-calibrated. Across three pre-registered user studies (N = 2691), we find that people frequently choose to use AI even when doing so is inefficient (i.e. provides no meaningful time or effort savings). We identify systematic miscalibration at two levels: (1) a self-estimate miscalibration where people on average believe that they are using AI less than they actually are, and (2) efficiency-gain illusions where people overestimate how much time and effort savings AI use affords. We also identify a session-level carryover effect where a participant's prior AI use leads to further AI adoption and entrenches their miscalibration about time savings. Our results shed light on the mechanisms and biases underlying people's choice of whether to use AI as well as the risk of an overreliance feedback loop.

AI.tldr: 研究通过三项用户实验（N=2691）发现，人们即使在AI使用并不节省时间的情况下也会频繁依赖AI辅助完成简单任务。存在两类系统性校准偏差：低估自身AI使用频率和对效率节省的高估，且早期AI使用会形成"过度依赖反馈循环"。
AI.motivation: 随着AI辅助工具的普及，人们越来越多地依赖AI处理简单任务，但尚不清楚这种依赖是否合理，以及用户对AI使用的校准程度如何。
AI.method: 采用三组预注册用户研究（共N=2691名参与者），通过实验测量参与者使用AI处理简单认知任务的行为模式、自我评估准确性以及对时间/精力节省的预期。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 人们经常选择使用AI处理简单任务，即使这样做并不高效；(2) 存在两层系统性校准偏差：自我估计偏差（人们平均低估自己的AI使用频率）和效率增益幻觉（高估AI使用所节省的时间和精力）；(3) 存在会话级遗留效应，即先前使用AI的经历会促进后续进一步采用AI，并加剧对时间节省的校准偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了AI辅助使用的系统性偏差机制，包括自我评估偏差和效率增益幻觉，并发现使用AI会产生"过度依赖反馈循环"的风险。这些发现对于理解人机协作中的决策偏差具有重要意义，并为设计更合理的人机交互系统提供了实证依据。

title: Investigating Concept Alignment Using Implausible Category Members
summary: Developing AI systems with a human-like understanding of everyday concepts is a key step towards developing safe, reliable systems whose behavior makes sense to humans. When probing concept understanding, asking questions about plausible category members (e.g., "Is a car a vehicle?") is likely to recall patterns in the model's vast training data. We pursue an alternative strategy, characterizing the boundaries of conceptual categories by asking about implausible category members (e.g., "Is an olive a vehicle?") to probe the kind of concept-level knowledge we take for granted in fellow humans. We characterize concept boundaries for a set of fundamental concepts by studying AI systems' assignments of objects to superordinate categories from a classic psychological study by Rosch and Mervis, as well as their assignments of the same objects to mismatched superordinate categories. We compare these assignments to those made by human participants on the full range of within-category and cross-category assignment tasks. Our results reveal a range of concepts for which which models differ in meaningful and surprising ways from humans, including treating "words" as belonging to categories like "vehicles" and "clothing," identifying several "vegetable" category members as "fruit," and assigning exemplars from non-weapon categories to the "weapons" category. We also demonstrate how these instances of concept misalignment translate into problematic downstream behavior with implications for AI safety.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过询问不合理的类别成员问题探测AI系统的概念理解能力，发现AI在多个基本概念上的类别边界与人类存在显著差异，如词汇分类、水果蔬菜区分、武器概念等，这些概念不对齐会影响AI系统的安全性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法通过询问合理的类别成员（如"车是交通工具吗？"）容易召回训练数据中的模式，无法真正探测概念层面的知识。该研究采用询问不合理的类别成员（如"橄榄是交通工具吗？"）来探测概念边界。
AI.method: 使用Rosch和Mervis经典心理学研究中的物体集合，要求AI系统和人类参与者对物体进行超ordinate类别分配（包括匹配和不匹配的类别），比较两者在类别内和跨类别分配任务上的表现差异。
AI.result: 发现多类概念不对齐：1)将"words"归类为"vehicles"和"clothing"；2)将多个"vegetable"成员误判为"fruit"；3)将非武器类物品归入"weapons"类别。这些不对齐导致下游行为出现问题，影响AI安全性。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在概念理解上与人类存在系统性偏差，这些偏差会导致下游安全问题。需要开发更精确的方法来评估AI的概念边界，并在关键应用中验证概念对齐。

title: HealthCraft: A Reinforcement Learning Safety Environment for Emergency Medicine
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code, task suite, and Docker bundle: https://github.com/GOATnote-Inc/healthcraft
summary: Frontier language models are being deployed into clinical workflows faster than the infrastructure to evaluate them safely. Static medical-QA benchmarks miss the failure modes that matter in emergency medicine: trajectory-level safety collapse, tool misuse, and capitulation under sustained clinical pressure. We present HealthCraft, the first public reinforcement-learning environment that rewards trajectory-level safety under realistic emergency-medicine conditions, adapted from Corecraft. It is built on a FHIR R4 world state with 14 entity types and 3,987 seed entities, exposes 24 MCP tools, and defines a dual-layer rubric that zeroes reward whenever any safety-critical criterion is violated. We release 195 tasks across six categories, graded against 2,255 binary criteria (515 safety-critical); a post-hoc 10-task negative-class slate extends this to 205 tasks and 2,337 criteria. V8 results on two frontier models show Claude Opus 4.6 at Pass@1 24.8% [21.5-28.4] and GPT-5.4 at 12.6% [10.2-15.6], with safety-failure rates of 27.5% and 34.0%. On multi-step workflows - the closest proxy to real emergency care - performance collapses to near zero (Claude 1.0%, GPT-5.4 0.0%) despite partial competence on individual steps. Six infrastructure bugs fixed between pilots v2 and v8 re-ordered which model "looks stronger," evidence that infrastructure fidelity is part of the measurement.
