A deterministic LLM-judge overlay bounds evaluator noise, and a 60-run negative-class smoke pilot shows the reward signal is not drop-in training-safe: restraint criteria pass at 0.929 prevalence, a gameability an eval harness can tolerate but a training reward cannot. We scaffold coupling to a Megatron+SGLang+GRPO loop per Corecraft Section 5.2 and leave training-reward ablations as future work. Environment, tasks, rubrics, and harness are released under Apache 2.0.

AI.tldr: HealthCraft是首个用于评估急诊医学场景下语言模型安全性的公开RL环境。基于FHIR R4和Corecraft构建，包含195-205个任务、2255-2337个评估标准。测试表明前沿模型多步工作流性能接近零，安全失败率高达27-34%，且评估基础设施质量直接影响模型排名结论。
AI.motivation: 现有医学QA基准无法捕捉急诊医学中的关键失败模式：轨迹级安全崩塌、工具误用和持续临床压力下的屈服。语言模型进入临床工作流的速度超过安全评估基础设施的发展。
AI.method: 基于Corecraft构建的RL环境，采用FHIR R4世界状态（14类实体、3987个种子实体），暴露24个MCP工具，定义双层评分标准。包含195个任务（6类）、2255个二值标准（515个安全关键），及205个任务的负样本套件。使用确定性LLM法官控制评估噪声。
AI.result: V8版本测试显示Claude Opus 4.6的Pass@1为24.8%（安全失败率27.5%），GPT-5.4为12.6%（安全失败率34.0%）。多步工作流性能几乎为零（Claude 1.0%，GPT-5.4 0.0%）。v2到v8的6个基础设施修复改变了模型强弱排名。
AI.conclusion: HealthCraft提供首个公开的急诊医学安全评估环境，证明了多步工作流下模型性能几乎为零，且基础设施保真度影响模型排名。评估套件可容忍游戏化行为但训练奖励无法，这为安全关键场景下的RL训练留下了重要挑战。

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Decentralized Memory
summary: Self-evolving multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising route to LLM agents that continually improve from experience, with persistent memory at their foundation. However, existing designs almost exclusively adopt a centralized repository shared across agents, incurring communication and coordination overhead, raising privacy concerns, and collapsing agent diversity. We propose DecentMem, a decentralized memory framework in which each agent maintains its own dual-pool memory -- an exploitation pool of consolidated past trajectories and an exploration pool of LLM-generated candidates for unseen contexts. The two pools are reweighted online based on stage-wise feedback from an LLM-as-a-judge. Theoretically, we prove that this design guarantees global reachability of the solution space and achieves $O(\log T)$ cumulative regret, matching the stochastic bandit lower bound up to constants. In practice, across three MAS frameworks (AutoGen, DyLAN, AgentNet), three Qwen3 backbones (4B/8B/14B), two Gemma4 backbones (E2B/E4B) and five benchmarks spanning math, code, QA, and embodied tasks, DecentMem improves average accuracy by up to 23.8% over the strongest centralized memory baseline and by up to 52.5% over the no-memory baseline, while reducing token usage by up to 49%.

AI.tldr: DecentMem提出去中心化双池记忆框架，通过利用池和探索池的在线重加权，实现O(log T)累积遗憾，在多框架、多模型、五大基准上实现显著性能提升和 token 节省。
AI.motivation: Existing centralized memory designs for self-evolving multi-agent systems incur communication/coordination overhead, raise privacy concerns, and collapse agent diversity.
AI.method: Decentralized dual-pool memory: each agent maintains an exploitation pool (consolidated past trajectories) and an exploration pool (LLM-generated candidates), with stage-wise reweighting via LLM-as-a-judge feedback.
AI.result: Achieves O(log T) cumulative regret matching stochastic bandit lower bound; improves accuracy by 23.8% over centralized and 52.5% over no-memory baselines; reduces token usage by 49%.
AI.conclusion: DecentMem significantly outperforms centralized approaches (+23.8% accuracy) and no-memory baselines (+52.5%), while reducing token usage by 49%, demonstrating both theoretical optimality and practical effectiveness across diverse tasks.

title: Reflective Prompt Tuning through Language Model Function-Calling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of following instructions and complex reasoning, making prompting a flexible interface for adapting models without parameter updates. Yet prompt design remains labor-intensive and highly sensitive to formatting, phrasing, and instruction order, motivating automated prompt optimization methods that reduce manual effort while preserving inference-time flexibility. However, existing methods often search over prompt candidates or use fixed critique-refine pipelines driven by individual examples or small batches, limiting their ability to capture systematic error patterns and make targeted edits grounded in failure history. We propose Reflective Prompt Tuning (RPT), a framework that uses LLM function calling to simulate the iterative workflow of human prompt engineers. An LLM optimizer calls a diagnostic function that evaluates the target model over an entire optimization set, summarizes recurring failure modes, and returns a structured diagnostic report. The optimizer uses this report, together with an accumulated memory of prior reports, to revise the prompt for the next iteration. RPT further supports confidence-aware optimization by using calibration signals in diagnostic feedback and final prompt selection. Across three reasoning tasks, RPT improves over initial prompts by up to 12.9 points, remains competitive with state of the art, and improves confidence calibration. Our analyses show that RPT is especially effective on multi-hop and mathematical reasoning, producing targeted prompt revisions that align with diagnosed failure patterns and lead to gains in task performance and calibration.

AI.tldr: RPT是一种新型自动提示优化框架，通过LLM函数调用模拟人类工程师的迭代式提示工程流程，利用诊断函数分析整个优化集上的失败模式并生成结构化报告，优化器结合历史报告记忆进行提示修订和置信度感知选择，在推理任务上展现了显著的性能提升和校准改进。
AI.motivation: 手工提示设计耗时且对格式、措辞和指令顺序高度敏感；现有自动提示优化方法存在局限：通常只搜索候选提示或使用固定 critique-refine 流程，且基于单个或小批量示例，难以捕获系统性错误模式。
AI.method: 提出反射式提示调优(RPT)框架，利用LLM函数调用模拟人类提示工程师的迭代工作流程。该框架包含诊断函数(对整个优化集评估目标模型、总结失败模式、生成结构化诊断报告)和带记忆的优化器(利用历史报告进行提示修订)，并支持置信度感知优化。
AI.result: RPT在三个推理任务上相比初始提示提升最高12.9分，与前沿方法具有竞争力，并改善了置信度校准。在多跳推理和数学推理任务上效果尤为显著，能产生与诊断失败模式一致的有针对性的提示修订。
AI.conclusion: RPT通过迭代式诊断-修订机制和置信度感知优化，有效解决了现有提示优化方法在系统性错误模式捕获方面的局限性，在推理任务上实现了显著性能提升和更好的校准表现。

title: Deterministic vs. Probabilistic Summarisation: An Empirical Trade-off Study in Design Pattern Centric Java Code
summary: Background: Automated code summarisation supports program comprehension and documentation, yet the relative strengths and limitations of deterministic (heuristic-based) and probabilistic (LLM-based) pipelines remain unclear. Aims: This paper presents a controlled empirical comparison of these paradigms for intent-oriented design-pattern code summarisation. Method: Using design-pattern-centric Java code as a structured testbed (150 files from three open-source repositories covering nine patterns), we compare a rule-based natural language generation (NLG) pipeline, a Software Word Usage Model (SWUM)-based approach, and a probabilistic pipeline based on the Mixtral LLM. Summaries are evaluated against human references using BERTScore and cosine similarity, complemented by rubric-based judgements produced by Llama 3 across five dimensions: accuracy, conciseness, adequacy, code-context awareness, and design-pattern fidelity. Statistical analysis includes Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (with effect sizes), Friedman tests with post-hoc corrections, and Spearman correlation for sensitivity analysis of rubric consistency. Results: Probabilistic summaries show stronger semantic alignment and richer contextual coverage, while deterministic approaches produce more concise and fully reproducible outputs. Prompt-sensitivity and multi-run analyses indicate variability in LLM outputs, though relative trends remain stable. Conclusions: A clear trade-off emerges: probabilistic methods favour semantic depth and contextual accuracy, whereas deterministic pipelines are preferable for brevity and reproducibility. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting code summarisation techniques.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过受控实验比较了确定性（规则-based/SWUM）和概率性（Mixtral LLM）代码摘要方法。概率性方法在语义质量和上下文准确性上占优，确定性方法则在简洁性和可复现性上更具优势。
AI.motivation: 自动化代码摘要对程序理解至关重要，但确定性（启发式）和概率性（LLM）方法各自的优劣势尚不明确，需要实证比较。
AI.method: 受控实验：使用150个Java文件（3个开源仓库，9种设计模式）作为测试床。比较三种方法：(1)基于规则的NLG管道；(2)SWUM方法；(3)Mixtral LLM。评估采用BERTScore和余弦相似度，并使用Llama 3生成五维度评分（准确性、简洁性、充分性、代码上下文感知、设计模式保真度）。统计方法包括Wilcoxon符号秩检验（效应量）、Friedman检验（事后校正）和Spearman相关分析。
AI.result: 概率性摘要具有更强的语义对齐和更丰富的上下文覆盖；确定性方法输出更简洁且完全可复现。LLM输出存在提示敏感性和多轮运行变异性，但相对趋势稳定。
AI.conclusion: 确定性方法适合追求简洁性和可复现性的场景，而概率性方法更适合需要语义深度和上下文准确性的任务。研究为代码摘要技术的选择提供了实践指导。

title: AI-Driven Multi-Region Provisioning for Cloud Services Using Spot Fleets
summary: Cloud service platforms increasingly rely on elastic infrastructures to support dynamic workloads. Spot instances provide discounted computing resources but introduce uncertainty due to dynamic pricing, resource availability, and interruption risks that vary across geographical regions. In Amazon Web Services, the EC2 Spot Service simplifies fleet provisioning through allocation strategies, but it cannot estimate fleet costs before deployment and restricts provisioning to a single region. This paper presents an AI-driven provisioning service for multi-region spot fleets. The proposed approach combines monitoring of provisioning plans with predictive models to estimate fleet configurations and prices before launch, enabling cost-aware deployment decisions across regions while preserving the operational behavior of the EC2 Spot Service. The system was validated with fleets of up to 1500 vCPUs. Experimental results show a prediction accuracy of 99.79% compared to the EC2 Spot Service and potential cost savings of up to 64% by exploiting regional price variability.

AI.tldr: 针对云Spot实例的多区域供给问题，提出AI驱动的预测性供给服务，实现成本感知的多区域部署决策。
AI.motivation: 现有EC2 Spot Service存在两大局限：无法在部署前估算成本，且仅限于单区域供给，难以利用区域性价格差异优化成本。
AI.method: 结合供给计划监控与预测模型，在部署前估算成本和配置；跨多区域调度资源；保留EC2 Spot Service的操作行为。
AI.result: 预测精度达99.79%，最高可节省64%的成本。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种跨区域Spot实例供给方案，有效解决了成本预估和地域限制问题。系统可作为EC2 Spot Service的补充工具，支持成本敏感型工作负载的优化部署。

title: Diversed Model Discovery via Structured Table Discovery
summary: Model cards describe model behavior through a mixture of textual descriptions and structured artifacts, including performance, configuration, and dataset tables. Existing model search systems rely predominantly on semantic similarity over text, which can produce homogeneous result sets and limit exploration of alternatives. We argue that model search is inherently comparative: users want models that are task-aligned yet differentiated in measurable ways. We hypothesize that this balance requires retrieval over condensed, high-quality evidence rather than verbose descriptions, and much of that evidence is concentrated in structured tables. We present StructuredSemanticSearch, a table-driven model search framework built on the ModelTables benchmark. Given a query, StructuredSemanticSearch combines a semantic baseline for task alignment with a structure-aware pipeline that discovers query-related model-card tables using table discovery operators such as unionability, joinability, and keyword search. Retrieved tables are mapped back to model cards under a controlled top-k budget, enabling fair comparison between text-based and table-based retrieval. Beyond retrieval, StructuredSemanticSearch adapts table integration to the model-table domain through orientation-aware integration, producing compact integrated views of tables from partially overlapping and sometimes transposed evidence tables. For evaluation, we introduce a nugget-based, auditable protocol that extracts compact evidence items from model cards, matches queries to condition- or intent-specific nuggets, and measures evidence coverage and diversity over retrieved model-card candidate sets. This protocol also provides a scalable path toward approximate, evidence-based labeling in dynamic model lakes. Experiments on 597 model-recommendation queries show improved nugget coverage for the structure-aware pipeline than semantic baseline

AI.tldr: The paper presents StructuredSemanticSearch, a table-driven model search framework that combines semantic baseline with structure-aware table discovery to improve retrieval quality compared to traditional text-based approaches.
AI.motivation: Existing model search systems rely on semantic similarity over text, producing homogeneous results and limiting exploration. The authors argue search should be comparative—finding models that are task-aligned yet differentiated—requiring retrieval over condensed high-quality evidence concentrated in structured tables.
AI.method: StructuredSemanticSearch combines semantic baseline for task alignment with structure-aware pipeline featuring table discovery operators (unionability, joinability, keyword search), orientation-aware table integration, and controlled top-k retrieval. Evaluation uses nugget-based protocol measuring evidence coverage and diversity.
AI.result: Experiments on 597 queries show improved nugget coverage for structure-aware pipeline vs semantic baseline.
AI.conclusion: The structured approach (table-driven) outperforms semantic baseline in nugget coverage, validating the hypothesis that retrieval over condensed, structured evidence yields better results than verbose text descriptions.

title: The Impact of AI Usage and Informativeness on Skill Development in Logical Reasoning
comment: Accepted at Hybrid Human Artificial Intelligence (HHAI) 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is being increasingly integrated into human problem-solving, yet its effects on individual skill development remain unclear. We examine how both AI usage and informativeness can shape learning in the context of a controlled logical reasoning task with on-demand access to AI assistance. We find that greater AI usage is associated with weaker skill development: heavy AI users underperform relative to comparable peers, whereas light AI users perform similarly to matched users who do not use AI. We also find in our study that these patterns are mediated by AI informativeness. Low-information AI neither improves immediate performance nor preserves performance after AI assistance is removed, and is linked to weaker learning overall. On the other hand, high-information AI was found to improve short-run performance without reducing post-AI outcomes on average in our experiments, but with heterogeneous effects. Our findings in general suggest that AI can, depending on context, either complement human skill development by amplifying independent reasoning or can act as a substitute that undermines such reasoning, with the implication that regulating AI access and usage will be important for promoting skill development in the presence of AI assistance.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了AI辅助对人类逻辑推理技能发展的影响，发现重度使用AI会削弱技能发展，而轻度使用则无显著负面影响。AI的信息量是关键调节因素——低信息量AI无益于学习和即时表现，高信息量AI可提升短期表现但效果因人而异。研究强调需要合理监管AI使用以促进技能发展。
AI.motivation: 人工智能正越来越多地被整合到人类问题解决过程中，但其对个体技能发展的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在受控的逻辑推理任务中设置按需AI辅助访问，考察AI使用程度和AI信息量两个维度对学习效果的影响。
AI.result: 重度AI用户表现弱于对照组，轻度AI用户表现与未使用AI的匹配用户相当。低信息量AI既不能改善即时表现，也不能在移除AI后保持表现，且与整体较弱的学习效果相关。高信息量AI可提升短期表现但不平均降低移除AI后的表现，但存在异质性效应。
AI.conclusion: AI对人类技能发展的影响取决于具体情境：可能通过放大独立推理来互补促进技能发展，也可能作为替代品削弱推理能力。研究结果表明，在AI辅助环境下，监管AI访问和使用对促进技能发展至关重要。

title: Predicting Performance of Symbolic and Prompt Programs with Examples
summary: LLM prompting is widely used for naturally stated tasks, yet it is unreliable it may succeed on a few test cases but fail at deployment time. We study performance prediction: given a program, either symbolic (e.g. Python) or a prompt executed on an LLM, and a few in-domain examples, predict its performance on unseen tasks from the same domain. We use a simple coin-flip model, treating each pass/fail program execution as a Bernoulli random variable, whose success probability is the programs unknown performance. In this model, performance depends entirely on: 1) the observed execution outcomes on test cases, and 2) a prior over performances. We compile empirical performance priors from a corpus of diverse programs and tasks, and find that performance for symbolic programs (e.g., Python) are all or nothing, while prompt programs have a diffuse prior with many nearly-correct programs. This difference explains why a few passing tests can certify symbolic programs but not prompt programs. Building on this insight, we develop RAP (Retrieved Approximate Prior), which retrieves similar tasks and prompt programs from an existing corpus to construct a proxy prior, which is then used to predict performance. We show RAP achieves solid performances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"性能预测"问题：给定一个程序（符号程序如 Python 代码，或提示程序即部署时由 LLM 执行的自然语言提示）以及少量同域测试样例，能否预测它在同域未见任务上的真实性能。作者用贝叶斯"抛硬币"（Bernoulli）模型把每条测试的执行结果视为独立 Bernoulli 观测，后验 P(θ|O)∝P(θ)·θ^a(1−θ)^b，核心变量是性能先验 P(θ)。通过从 70 个任务、700 个符号程序与 700 个提示程序中实证编译先验，发现符号程序先验高度"全有或全无"（双峰于 0 与 1），而提示程序先验弥散、大量"接近完美"的程序——这解释了为什么几条通过的测试能"认证"符号程序却不能认证提示程序。为解决提示程序预测问题，作者提出 RAP（Retrieved Approximate Prior，检索式近似先验）：从任意语料库中检索相似任务（文本嵌入 top-n）与行为相似的提示程序（top-K），把它们在检索任务上的经验成功率平滑为 Beta 混合先验，并用基于归一化 EMD 的逐分量先验强度调整（λ_i=1−EMD(P_i,P_obs)，浓度上限 c_max=40）抑制不相关分量，再用观测做共轭更新。实验显示 RAP 在域内/域外两种设定下均优于 no-corpus（Beta(1,1) 均匀先验）与 all-corpus 基线，且随样例数增加收敛到域内后验、随语料规模增大而变好、对超参鲁棒。
AI.motivation: LLM 提示（prompting）虽被广泛使用，但存在"开发时看起来正确、部署时意外失败"的可靠性问题；而符号程序（如 Python 代码）若通过少量代表性测试，通常可被信任在同域新实例上保持正确。为何二者不同？本文提出"性能预测"（performance prediction）任务：给定程序与少量域内样例，输出其真实性能的后验分布，以便判断某提示是否可部署及置信度（例如"部署后约 0.8±0.1"）。既有工作多关注提示脆弱性、敏感性、提示优化，或用小基准排序 LLM 强弱，尚未有人在同一形式化框架下同时刻画符号程序与提示程序。作者以贝叶斯视角把测试结果建模为独立抛硬币，量化这一差异——这也是本文的首要贡献动机：把"几条测试能否保证性能"的直觉转化为可计算的量化结论。
AI.method: 问题形式化：任务 T 为实例 (x,y) 的分布（假设 iid 采样）；程序 f: x→y，由人写或由 LLM 生成（f~P(f|T)）；真实性能 θ_f*=E[1(f(x)=y)]；观测为 K 个指示变量，压缩为 O=(a,b)。模型：Z_i~Bernoulli(θ_f)，似然 ∝θ^a(1−θ)^b，后验 ∝P(θ)θ^a(1−θ)^b；评估指标为后验在真值处的概率密度 SC 与均值绝对误差 AE。先验编译（Part 1）：从 4 个域（Structured Regex、HumanEval、ARC、List，共 70 任务）各采 10 个符号程序与 10 个提示程序（共 700+700），每任务采 100 个实例估计 θ̃，得到 sp 的双峰先验与 pp 的弥散先验；据此在 3 次通过后比较两者的后验形状与随观测数变化的预测质量。RAP（Part 2）：输入目标提示程序、域内样例集 D={x_1..x_k}、任意语料 M=(M_tasks, M_pps)；①用文本嵌入 e(·) 余弦相似度为每个 x'∈D 检索 top-n 任务得 D'（n=100）；②按"在 D' 上与目标程序一致（对或错）的任务数"这一行为相似度检索 top-K 提示程序（K=5）；③把检索到的 pp_i 在 D' 上的成功/失败数 a_i、b_i 置 α_i=a_i+1、β_i=b_i+1，构成等权 Beta 混合先验；④逐分量先验强度调整：与观测诱导的 Beta(a+1,b+1) 计算归一化 EMD，λ_i=1−EMD∈[0,1]，并截断浓度使 λ_i(α_i+β_i)<c_max=40，实现 C_i=(α_i+β_i)/min(λ_i(α_i+β_i),c_max)；⑤以共轭更新得后验 Σ(1/K)Beta(θ|α_i/C_i+a, β_i/C_i+b)。基线：no-corpus（Beta(1,1)）与 all-corpus（全语料先验）。实验：MMLU-PRO 六个域（math/physics/chemistry/economics/law/engineering）、MBPP、HumanEval、ALFWorld 两类任务；60 个提示程序（24 多选 + 24 代码 + 12 具身），两个 LLM（GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5-mini）× 两种提示策略（CoT、vanilla），以 200 个留出任务近似真值性能；域内/域外两种语料设定，逐域 leave-one-out 评估。
AI.result: 1) 实证先验差异显著：符号程序先验尖锐双峰（几乎非 0 即 1），提示程序先验弥散且"接近完美"程序占比高；3 次测试通过后，sp 后验几乎集中于近 100% 性能，pp 后验则无法给出保证——量化了"少量测试可认证符号程序、不可认证提示程序"的直觉。2) 两种程序的可预测性差异（SC 与 AE 随观测数变化）主要归因于先验形状不同。3) RAP 在域内与域外设定下均优于 no-corpus 与 all-corpus 基线；相比 all-corpus（先验对目标域校准差）与 no-corpus（少量观测会过度扭曲后验），RAP 提供了更校准且可被新观测有效更新的起始先验。4) 随域内观测数增加，似然项 a,b 主导更新，RAP 平滑收敛到纯域内经验后验。5) 语料规模越大 RAP 越好（域内提升明显，域外不受损）；检索超参 K、n 与 c_max 消融显示中等取值最佳，RAP 对超参鲁棒。6) LLM 能力影响先验形状：更强模型（GPT-5-mini）的 pp 先验更接近 sp 先验，此时 no-corpus 基线相对变强，而 RAP 在所有设定下仍最优；RAP 对弱模型增益更大。7) 文本相似不蕴含性能先验相似（chemistry–engineering 为"风险区"），该偏差由先验强度归一化缓解。8) 构建全部先验的 API 成本约 300 美元。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是：符号程序与提示程序的性能可预测性差异，其根源在于两者经验性能先验的形状不同——sp 的"全有或全无"先验使少量测试即可给出自信预测，pp 的弥散先验则不能；因此要预测提示程序性能，必须构建更好的（域特定）先验。据此提出的 RAP 通过从任意语料库检索相似任务与行为相似的提示程序构造近似先验，优于不使用语料或全量使用语料的强基线，并具备随证据增加收敛、随语料增大变好、对无关信息鲁棒等理想性质。作者将 RAP 视为性能预测方向的第一条尝试，明确承认其并不完美：主要局限是 top-K 检索与"检索任务×执行提示程序"的成本随语料规模增长而昂贵，未来工作方向包括主动查询最合适的 (任务, 提示程序) 组合，以及对 tasks×pps 语料矩阵做低秩近似以降低检索与执行开销。

title: Memory-R2: Fair Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents enable interactions that extend beyond finite context windows by storing, updating, and reusing information across sessions. However, training such agents with reinforcement learning in multi-session environments is challenging because memory turns the agent's past actions into part of its future environment. Once different rollouts write, update, or delete different memories, they no longer share the same intermediate memory state, making trajectory-level comparisons fundamentally unfair. This violates a key assumption behind group-relative methods such as GRPO, where rollouts are compared as if they were sampled from the same effective environment. Consequently, trajectory-level rewards provide noisy or biased credit signals for long-horizon memory operations. To address this challenge, we introduce Memory-R2, a training framework for long-horizon memory-augmented LLM agents. Its core algorithm, LoGo-GRPO, combines local and global group-relative optimization. The global objective preserves end-to-end learning from long-horizon trajectory-level rewards, while local rerollouts compare different memory-operation outcomes from the same intermediate memory state, yielding fairer group comparisons and more precise supervision for memory construction. Beyond credit assignment, Memory-R2 jointly optimizes memory formation and memory evolution with a shared-parameter co-learning design, where a fact extractor and a memory manager are instantiated from the same LLM backbone through role-specific prompts. To stabilize multi-step RL over long memory horizons, we adopt a progressive curriculum that increases the training horizon from 8 to 16 to 32 sessions. Together, these components provide an effective training paradigm for memory-augmented LLM agents in long-horizon multi-session settings.

AI.tldr: 论文针对多会话环境中memory-augmented LLM agent的RL训练难题，提出Memory-R2框架。其核心LoGo-GRPO算法通过global objective保留端到端学习能力，local rerollouts实现公平比较；同时采用shared-parameter co-learning联合优化memory formation和evolution，并配合progressive curriculum（8→16→32 sessions）稳定训练，为长horizon memory-augmented agent训练提供了有效范式。
AI.motivation: 在多会话环境中训练memory-augmented LLM agent面临关键挑战：memory使得agent的过去动作成为其未来环境的一部分。当不同rollouts写入、更新或删除不同的memory时，它们不再共享相同的中间memory状态，导致trajectory级别的比较从根本上不公平。这违反了GRPO等group-relative方法的核心假设——假设rollouts是从同一effective environment采样的。因此，trajectory-level rewards对长horizon memory操作的credit assignment提供的是噪声或偏倚的信号。
AI.method: 1. **LoGo-GRPO算法**: 结合local和global group-relative优化。Global objective保持从长horizon trajectory-level reward的端到端学习；Local rerollouts从相同中间memory状态比较不同的memory-operation结果，实现更公平的group比较和更精确的memory construction监督。2. **Shared-parameter co-learning**: 通过role-specific prompts从同一LLM backbone实例化fact extractor和memory manager，联合优化memory formation和memory evolution。3. **Progressive curriculum**: 训练horizon从8逐步增加到16再到32 sessions，以稳定长horizon的训练。
AI.result: 通过LoGo-GRPO的local rerollouts机制，从相同中间memory状态出发比较不同memory操作结果，获得更公平的group比较和更精确的memory supervision；shared-parameter co-learning实现memory formation和evolution的联合优化；progressive curriculum有效稳定了长horizon训练。
AI.conclusion: Memory-R2提出了一种有效的训练范式，能够在长horizon多会话环境中训练memory-augmented LLM agents。通过LoGo-GRPO算法结合local和global优化的优势，配合co-learning设计和progressive curriculum，有效解决了memory操作带来的credit assignment问题，为memory-augmented agent的训练提供了新的技术路线。

title: From Patches to Trajectories: Privileged Process Supervision for Software-Engineering Agents
summary:
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on long teacher trajectories is the dominant way to instill investigation and reasoning in open software-engineering (SWE) agents. Since every retained response becomes an imitation target, the student inherits the final outcome and intermediate flaws, including ungrounded leaps and redundant loops. High-quality training data must be effective(each step is grounded and narrows the agent's epistemic gap to the correct fix) and efficient(each step is information-bearing rather than redundant or looping). Existing recipes filter or relabel teacher rollouts using only a binary terminal verifier, which does not directly target these axes and provides no supervision on instances where the teacher fails.
  Most real issue includes a developer-authored reference patch, $p^\star$, revealing the file paths, runtime behaviors, and coding conventions presupposed by the correct fix, yet standard pipelines discard it. We propose Patches-to-Trajectories (P2T), which uses $p^\star$ as privileged information during curation and formulates trajectory construction as bi-objective optimization over per-step effectiveness and trajectory length. A reverse phase distills $p^\star$ into a latent process graph, $G^\star$, of contextual facts and solution milestones. A forward phase curates trajectories from blinded teacher continuations by scoring per-step progress against $G^\star$ under a leakage-blocking groundedness check and retaining the shortest effective segments.
  Using only 1.8k curated SWE-Gym instances, P2T improves effectiveness and efficiency over outcome-filtered SFT and its tool-error-masking variant. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises Pass@1 by up to 10.8 points while reducing per-instance inference cost by ~15%, with consistent gains on SWE-bench Lite. Size-matched ablations and qualitative analysis further isolate trajectory quality from data scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P2T方法，利用软件Issue附带的参考补丁作为特权信息，通过反向蒸馏过程图和前向轨迹筛选两阶段构建高质量训练数据，在仅1.8k样本下实现SWE-bench显著提升，证明了每步有效性和信息密度对训练数据质量的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 现有SFT方法存在三个核心问题：1) 模仿教师轨迹时会同时继承最终结果和中间缺陷（如无根据的跳跃和冗余循环）；2) 仅使用二元终端验证器过滤数据，无法直接优化有效性和效率；3) 丢弃了每个Issue附带的开发者编写的参考补丁p*这一宝贵信息资源。
AI.method: P2T采用两阶段轨迹构建方法：1) 反向阶段：从参考补丁p*蒸馏出隐式过程图G*，包含上下文事实和解决方案里程碑；2) 前向阶段：在泄漏阻塞的接地性检查下，根据G*对教师延续轨迹进行每步评分，保留最短的有效片段。通过对每步有效性和轨迹长度的双目标优化来构建训练数据。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，Pass@1提升最高达10.8个百分点，每实例推理成本降低约15%；在SWE-bench Lite上也有一致性提升。消融实验和质量分析表明，轨迹质量比数据规模更重要。
AI.conclusion: P2T通过将参考补丁作为特权信息融入训练数据构建流程，有效解决了SFT中轨迹质量控制的核心问题。该方法在仅使用1.8k样本的情况下，在SWE-bench Verified上提升Pass@1达10.8个百分点，同时降低推理成本约15%，证明了高质量轨迹数据比大规模低质量数据更具价值。

title: SepsisAI Orchestrator: A Containerized and Scalable Platform for Deploying AI Models and Real-Time Monitoring in Early Sepsis Detection
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to BioCARLA 2025 Workshop
summary: Despite strong predictive results in the clinical machine learning literature, the translation of these models into bedside use remains limited by systems-level barriers: heterogeneous data representations, the absence of standardized deployment workflows, and a mismatch between research prototypes and the concurrency and latency requirements of hospital environments. We present the SepsisAI-Orchestrator, an open-source modular platform that addresses this deployment gap for early sepsis detection. The platform integrates HL7 FHIR-inspired Clinical Document Architecture (CDA) preprocessing, NoSQL storage, a containerized LightGBM classifier served via REST APIs, and a Streamlit clinical dashboard, orchestrated with Docker and Kubernetes. A previously validated LightGBM model (F1 0.87-0.94 on PhysioNet 2019) is reused without modification; the contribution lies in the surrounding infrastructure and its empirical characterization under load. Using k6 with 50-1000 concurrent virtual users, we find that replica count must be matched to the physical CPU thread count of the host: scaling from 3 to 12 replicas on a 12-thread CPU reduces p95 latency from 3.3s to 1.41s (57.3% reduction) and eliminates all request failures, while over-provisioning to 24 or 48 replicas degrades performance due to scheduler contention. To our knowledge this U-shaped scaling behavior has not been quantified previously for clinical AI inference workloads. We do not claim prospective clinical validation. Source code and deployment manifests are available at https://github.com/nucleusai/sepsisai-orchestrator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SepsisAI-Orchestrator开源平台解决临床AI部署难题，通过实验量化发现容器副本数必须与CPU线程数匹配才能最优，过度扩展反而降低性能（U形扩展行为），在50-1000并发负载下验证了该现象。
AI.motivation: 临床机器学习模型虽预测性能优异，但向实际床旁应用转化受限，主要障碍包括：数据表示异构、缺乏标准化部署工作流、研究原型与医院环境的并发/延迟要求不匹配。
AI.method: 提出并实现了SepsisAI-Orchestrator模块化平台，集成了HL7 FHIR-inspired CDA预处理、NoSQL存储、容器化LightGBM分类器（REST API服务）、Streamlit临床仪表盘，并采用Docker和Kubernetes进行编排。使用k6工具进行50-1000并发用户的负载测试。
AI.result: 发现U形扩展规律：在12线程CPU上，从3个副本扩展至12个副本，P95延迟从3.3s降至1.41s（降低57.3%），请求失败率降为0。但过度配置至24或48个副本反而因调度器争用导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: SepsisAI-Orchestrator提供了面向临床AI部署的基础设施解决方案。关键发现：副本数必须与主机CPU线程数匹配才能实现最优性能，过度配置反而导致性能下降。该U形扩展行为此前未被量化。建议：部署时需根据物理硬件配置合理规划副本数，而非盲目扩展。代码已开源。

title: Optimal Testing of Reed-Muller Codes with an Online Adversary
summary:
Motivated by applications to property testing in the online-erasure model of Kalemaj, Raskhodnikova, and Varma (ITCS 2022 and Theory of Computing 2023), we define and analyze {\em semi-sample-based testers} for Reed-Muller codes. The task in Reed-Muller testing is to determine whether an input function $f: \F^n \to \F$ belongs to the Reed-Muller code or is far from it, using as few point queries to $f$ as possible. Reed-Muller testing is a well-studied task with its roots in both the Property Testing and Probabilistically Checkable Proofs literature. The online-erasure model introduces a twist: after each query made, an adversary may erase up to $t$ points of the input function, potentially thwarting any test in which the queries follow a predictable pattern.
  Semi-sample-based testers are a hybrid between sample-based testers -- which can only make uniformly random queries to the input function -- and standard testers, which can choose their queries freely. They are designed with the online-erasure model in mind and operate by first choosing some subset $S$ of the domain and then making their queries uniformly at random inside of $S$. We describe semi-sample-based testers for the Reed-Muller code and give an optimal analysis of their soundness.
  Consequently, we show that semi-sample-based testers are indeed effective in the presence of online erasures, and thereby achieve optimal query complexity for testing the Reed-Muller code in the online-erasure model. This result improves upon prior work of Minzer and Zheng (SODA 2024). As an added bonus, we show that semi-sample-based testers also exist for the lifted affine-invariant codes of Guo, Kopparty, and Sudan (ITCS 2013), thereby providing the first known testers for these codes in the online-erasure model.

AI.tldr: 研究在线擦除模型下的 Reed-Muller 码测试问题，提出半采样测试器框架，通过先选子集再随机采样的方式抵抗在线擦除攻击，实现了该模型下的最优查询复杂度，并扩展至提升的仿射不变码。
AI.motivation: 在线擦除模型（Kalemaj, Raskhodnikova, Varma）中，对手可在每次查询后擦除多达 t 个输入点，这使得依赖可预测查询模式的传统测试器失效。为在此 adversarial 环境下进行 Reed-Muller 码的属性测试，需要设计具有随机化查询模式的测试器。
AI.method: 定义了半采样测试器这一混合测试框架（介于纯采样测试器与标准测试器之间），其核心操作模式为：首先选择域的一个子集 S，随后在 S 内均匀随机进行查询。这一设计使得查询模式具有随机性，从而能够抵抗对手在每次查询后进行的在线擦除攻击。
AI.result: 给出了 Reed-Muller 码的半采样测试器及其最优的 soundness 分析；同时将框架应用于提升的仿射不变码（Guo, Kopparty, Sudan），首次实现在线擦除模型下的测试。
AI.conclusion: 提出了半采样测试器框架，在在线擦除模型中实现了 Reed-Muller 码测试的最优查询复杂度，改进了 Minzer 和 Zheng (SODA 2024) 的结果，并将该框架扩展到提升的仿射不变码，首次为这类码提供了在线擦除模型下的测试器。

title: From TF-IDF to Transformers: A Comparative and Ensemble Approach to Sentiment Classification
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures. This is the author's accepted manuscript, presented at the International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Networks and Security (IC-ICNS 2026), March 26-28, Bhubaneswar, India. Proceedings publication pending
summary: Sentiment analysis, also referred to as opinion mining, primarily tries to extract opinion from any text-based data. In the context of movie reviews and critics, sentimental analysis can be a helpful tool to predict whether a movie review is generally positive or negative. It can be difficult for the ML models to understand the context or metaphysical sentiment accurately, as ML models rely largely on statistical word representations. The objective of this paper is to examine and categorise movie reviews into positive and negative sentiments. Diverse machine learning models are considered in doing so, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) methodologies are employed for data preprocessing and model assessment. The IMDb dataset is used. Specifically, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVM), LightGBM, LSTM, and transformer-based models such as RoBERTa and DistilBERT were evaluated. After a lot of testing with accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC, RoBERTa performed better than all the other models, with an accuracy of 93.02%. A soft voting ensemble that combined all the models also improved classification performance, showing that model ensembling works well for sentiment analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文对IMDb电影评论数据集进行情感分析，比较了传统机器学习（朴素贝叶斯、逻辑回归、SVM、LightGBM）、深度学习（LSTM）和Transformer模型（RoBERTa、DistilBERT），并采用软投票集成策略。实验结果表明，RoBERTa以93.02%的准确率表现最佳，模型集成方法可进一步提升分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型在情感分析中存在局限性，主要依赖于统计词表示，难以准确理解文本上下文或深层情感含义。
AI.method: 采用NLP方法论进行数据预处理，对IMDb数据集进行实验。评估了多种模型：传统机器学习模型（朴素贝叶斯、逻辑回归、SVM、LightGBM）、深度学习模型（LSTM）以及基于Transformer的模型（RoBERTa、DistilBERT）。使用准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和ROC-AUC进行模型评估。
AI.result: RoBERTa模型表现最优，准确率达到93.02%。基于所有模型的软投票集成方法也有效提升了分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 模型集成方法（软投票）在情感分析任务中表现良好，表明结合多个模型可以进一步提升分类性能。RoBERTa作为最佳单模型，为此类任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: AI-Enabled Serious Games: Integrating Intelligence and Adaptivity in Training Systems
comment: Book chapter, 1 figure. To appear in "Advances in Global Applied Artificial Intelligence," G. A. Tsihrintzis, M. Virvou, N. G. Bourbakis, and L. C. Jain (Eds.), Springer, Learning and Analytics in Intelligent Systems book series, 2026
summary: Serious games are widely used for learning and training across domains such as healthcare, defense, and education. Persistent challenges remain, however, including static scenario design, authoring bottlenecks, limited learner modeling, and difficulty implementing meaningful real-time instructional adaptation. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) introduce novel capabilities such as dynamic scenario variation, contextual feedback, adaptive pacing, and learner-state modeling that may help address some of these limitations. At the same time, integrating AI into serious games raises important questions related to validity, transparency, system control, and learner trust. This chapter examines how contemporary AI approaches may support real-time instructional adaptation in serious games. It distinguishes between instructional intelligence, defined as a system's capacity to infer learner knowledge and reason about pedagogically appropriate responses, and adaptivity, defined as the ability to modify instructional actions during interaction. A historical synthesis of adaptive learning systems is presented, tracing developments from early computer-assisted instruction through intelligent tutoring systems (ITS), dynamic difficulty adjustment (DDA), authoring platforms, learning analytics, and recent AI-enabled architectures. Building on this perspective, the chapter discusses how large language models (LLMs), reinforcement learning (RL), and agent-based architectures may contribute to more integrated forms of intelligence and adaptivity in serious games. It also highlights practical and research challenges associated with AI-enabled systems, including explainability, validation, computational cost, and the limited empirical evidence regarding long-term learning outcomes in AI-enabled serious games.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI技术在严肃游戏中实现实时教学适配的潜力与挑战。核心贡献在于区分"教学智能"与"适应性"概念，回顾自适应学习系统从CAI到AI赋能架构的演进，探讨LLM、强化学习和智能体架构的应用前景，并指出可解释性验证和长期学习效果实证研究等开放问题。
AI.motivation: 严肃游戏面临静态场景设计、创作瓶颈、学习者建模不足及实时教学适配困难等持久挑战，AI技术的进展可能提供新的解决路径。
AI.method: 历史综述法，追溯从早期CAI到ITS、DDA、创作平台、学习分析，再到近期AI赋能架构的演进脉络；区分了"教学智能"（推断学习者知识并推理教学响应）与"适应性"（交互中修改教学行为）的概念。
AI.result: 明确了AI赋能严肃游戏的理论基础与技术路径，同时识别出可解释性、验证、计算成本及长期学习效果实证不足等关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: AI技术（LLM、强化学习、基于智能体的架构）有望实现更深度整合的智能与适应性，但需解决可解释性、验证、计算成本及长期学习效果的实证研究不足等挑战。

title: Latent-space Attacks for Refusal Evasion in Language Models
summary: Safety-aligned language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet refusal behavior can be suppressed by steering their internal representations. Existing methods do so by ablating a refusal direction from model activations, aiming to remove refusal from the model's residual stream. Despite their empirical success, these methods lack a principled account of the latent-space transformation they induce and why it suppresses refusal. In this work, we recast refusal suppression as a latent-space evasion attack against linear probes trained to separate refused from answered prompts. Under this view, prior work's difference-in-means direction naturally defines such a probe, and its ablation is exactly a projection onto its decision boundary, i.e., a minimum-confidence evasion attack. This perspective not only explains the empirical success of prior work but also admits a key limitation: evasion stops at the decision boundary, motivating the need to push representations further into the compliant region, i.e., where the model answers. We leverage this by proposing a Controlled Latent-space Evasion attack that projects representations past the boundary with an optimized confidence. We achieve state-of-the-art attack success rate across 15 instruction-tuned, multimodal, and reasoning models, outperforming existing refusal-ablation baselines and specialized jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文将语言模型拒绝行为抑制重新解释为潜在空间规避攻击，提出了可控潜在空间规避攻击(CLE)，通过优化置信度将表示投影到决策边界之外的遵从区域，在15种模型上达到最先进的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏对潜在空间变换的原理性解释及其抑制拒绝行为的机制；同时，规避攻击仅停在决策边界，需要将表示进一步推入遵从区域。
AI.method: 将拒绝抑制重新建模为针对线性探测器的潜在空间规避攻击。传统方法的差异均值方向自然定义了这样的探测器，其消融等同于向决策边界投影，即最小置信度规避攻击。新方法CLE通过优化置信度将表示投影到决策边界之外，进入遵从区域。
AI.result: 在15种指令微调、多模态和推理模型上实现最先进的攻击成功率，优于现有拒绝消融基线和专门的越狱攻击。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的攻击方法CLE，在15种模型上实现了最先进的攻击成功率，超越了现有的拒绝消融基线和专门的越狱攻击。

title: Harnesses for Inference-Time Alignment over Execution Trajectories
summary: Harness engineering has emerged as an important inference-time technique for large language model (LLM) agents, aiming to improve long-term performance through task decomposition and guided execution. However, more elaborate harnesses are not uniformly better: increasing decomposition or guidance can sometimes improve execution, but can also reduce final task success. We study harness design through the lens of inference-time trajectory alignment. This perspective separates harness into two mechanisms: task decomposition, which structures a task into sub-goals, and guided execution, which reshapes local action distributions during execution. This decomposition allows us to quantify how workflow granularity, retry budgets, and guidance-induced action reweighting shape the performance limits of harness design. It further reveals concrete failure modes, including over-decomposition, over-pruning, and hallucinated execution. We validate these predictions through controlled synthetic experiments and real terminal agent benchmarks. Inspired by the theory, we further show that effective harnesses can be partial: specifying only the initial steps and leaving the remaining execution to agent can achieve higher pass rate than fully structured workflows.

AI.tldr: This paper analyzes harness design for LLM agents through trajectory alignment, identifying that elaborate harnesses don't always improve performance. It reveals three failure modes (over-decomposition, over-pruning, hallucinated execution) and demonstrates that partial harnesses specifying only initial steps can outperform fully structured workflows.
AI.motivation: Harness engineering has emerged as an important inference-time technique for LLM agents, but more elaborate harnesses are not uniformly better—increasing decomposition or guidance can sometimes improve but also reduce final task success.
AI.method: The paper studies harness design through the lens of inference-time trajectory alignment, separating harness into task decomposition (structuring tasks into sub-goals) and guided execution (reshaping local action distributions). This decomposition allows quantification of how workflow granularity, retry budgets, and guidance-induced action reweighting shape performance limits.
AI.result: The analysis reveals concrete failure modes: over-decomposition, over-pruning, and hallucinated execution. These predictions are validated through controlled synthetic experiments and real terminal agent benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: Effective harnesses can be partial: specifying only initial steps while leaving remaining execution to the agent achieves higher pass rates than fully structured workflows.

title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
summary: Complex Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) challenge hardware LLM agents because solving them requires localizing verifier-relevant RTL, testbenches, include paths, and build dependencies inside large repository snapshots, making precise edits, and recovering from sparse hidden-verifier failures. We present Trace2Skill, a test-time scaling framework that improves a hardware agent without RTL-specialized model fine-tuning. Rather than training a new model or only sampling more candidate solutions, Trace2Skill treats the agent's natural-language skill as an evolvable policy. It mines repeated rollout traces for success and failure modes, converts them into dense diagnostics and oracle lessons, and uses an oracle, mutator, and selector loop to produce task-specific skills that guide later search, editing, validation, and recovery. Because final pass/fail labels are often too coarse for hard failures, Trace2Skill also supports bounded runtime dense verifier feedback that returns sanitized functional observations while keeping hidden harnesses and reference solutions inaccessible to the agent. This feedback helps guide skill evolution and agent execution by connecting skill text, verifier evidence, and downstream behavior. Across hard CVDP tasks that defeat the seed CVDP agent, including tasks that also defeat frontier coding agents, Trace2Skill with dense verifier feedback substantially improves task pass rates and produces breakthrough passes on previously unsolved tasks, without requiring high-quality fine-tuning data, specialized RTL model training, or model weight updates. The same framework provides a general test-time scaling strategy that can extend beyond digital design to other verifiable EDA tasks.

AI.tldr: Trace2Skill是一个测试时扩展框架，通过挖掘rollout轨迹生成任务特定skills和密集verifier反馈来提升硬件LLM agent，无需模型微调即可在复杂Verilog设计问题中实现突破性性能提升。
AI.motivation: CVDP挑战要求LLM agent在大型代码库中定位verifier相关RTL、testbench、include路径和构建依赖，进行精确编辑，并从稀疏的隐藏verifier失败中恢复——这对现有硬件LLM agent构成重大挑战。
AI.method: 通过oracle、mutator和selector循环，从rollout轨迹中提取成功/失败模式，生成密集诊断和oracle lesson，进而生成任务特定skills来指导搜索、编辑、验证和恢复；同时引入有界运行时密集verifier反馈机制，返回经清理的功能观察而隐藏reference solution和harness。
AI.result: 显著提升了CVDP任务的通过率，包括那些同时击败前沿编码agent的困难任务，无需高质量微调数据、RTL专项模型训练或模型权重更新。
AI.conclusion: Trace2Skill无需模型权重更新或RTL专项微调即可显著提升硬件LLM agent的任务通过率，在CVDP基准测试中实现了突破性进展，并提供了一种可扩展至其他可验证EDA任务的通用测试时扩展策略。

title: When Cases Get Rare: A Retrieval Benchmark for Off-Guideline Clinical Question Answering
summary: Across medical specialties, clinical practice is anchored in evidence-based guidelines that codify best studied diagnostic and treatment pathways. These pathways routinely fall short for the long tail of real-world care not covered by guidelines. Most medical large language models (LLMs), however, are trained to encode common, guideline-focused medical knowledge in their parameters. Current evaluations test models primarily on recalling and reasoning with this memorized content, often in multiple-choice settings. Given the fundamental importance of evidence-based reasoning in medicine, it is neither feasible nor reliable to depend on memorization in practice. To address this gap, we introduce OGCaReBench, a free-form retrieval-focused benchmark aimed at evaluating LLMs at answering clinical questions that require going beyond typical guidelines. Extracted from published medical case reports and validated by medical experts, OGCaReBench contains long-form clinical questions requiring free-text answers, providing a systematic framework for assessing open-ended medical reasoning in rare, case-based scenarios. Our experiments reveal that even the best-performing baseline (GPT-5.2) correctly answers only 56% of our benchmark with specialized models only reaching 42%. Augmenting models with retrieved medical articles improves this performance to up to 82% (using GPT-5.2) highlighting the importance of evidence-grounding for real-world medical reasoning tasks. This work thus establishes a foundation for benchmarking and advancing both general-purpose and medical LLMs to produce reliable answers in challenging clinical contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OGCaReBench 基准，用于评估 LLM 在罕见病例场景下的医学推理能力。实验表明检索增强对医学推理至关重要，现有模型在该基准上仍存在显著提升空间。
AI.motivation: 传统临床指南仅覆盖常见诊疗路径，而现有医学 LLM 评估主要依赖记忆内容的多选题测试，无法可靠评估模型在真实临床场景中的推理能力，存在指南覆盖范围之外的"长尾"问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个从已发表医学病例报告中提取的free-form检索基准，包含需要自由文本回答的临床长问题，并经医学专家验证；实验部分对比了多个基座模型与专用模型，并引入了检索增强方法。
AI.result: GPT-5.2 基线仅达56%，专用模型仅42%；引入医学文献检索增强后，GPT-5.2 性能提升至82%。
AI.conclusion: OGCaReBench 为评估医学 LLM 在罕见病例中的真实推理能力提供了系统性基准，实验表明检索增强可显著提升性能至82%，但现有模型仍存在明显局限。

title: Finding Missing Input Validation in TEEs via LLM-Assisted Symbolic Execution
comment: Accepted by 2026 IEEE/ACM Third International Conference on AI Foundation Models and Software Engineering (FORGE '26)
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation that protects sensitive code and data from untrusted software. Despite their strong security guarantees, analyzing TEE applications remains challenging due to the high cost and complexity of configuring complete TEE build and runtime environments, as well as the limited observability imposed by hardware isolation. This paper presents SymTEE, a novel large language model (LLM)-assisted symbolic execution framework for detecting missing input validation issues in TEE applications without requiring real TEE setups. SymTEE begins by leveraging Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analysis to extract TEE code slices that may lack sufficient input validation, and then employs an LLM (GPT-5 in our case) to automatically convert the extracted slices into KLEE-compatible harness programs containing lightweight mock execution environments for symbolic analysis. Evaluations on 26 vulnerabilities (11 real-world and 15 synthetic) show that SymTEE achieves 100% precision and 92.3% recall in detecting missing input validation vulnerabilities while incurring an average analysis cost of only $0.05. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practicality of SymTEE's pioneering paradigm of LLM-assisted symbolic execution, where LLMs autonomously generate mock environments to enable automated security analysis without complex setup, providing a more accessible and scalable framework for trusted computing systems.

AI.tldr: SymTEE is an LLM-assisted symbolic execution framework that detects missing input validation vulnerabilities in Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) without requiring real TEE hardware. It uses AST analysis to extract vulnerable code slices and GPT-5 to generate KLEE-compatible test harnesses with mock environments. Evaluated on 26 vulnerabilities, it achieves 100% precision and 92.3% recall at an average cost of $0.05 per analysis.
AI.motivation:
Analyzing TEE (Trusted Execution Environments) applications presents significant challenges due to:
1. High cost and complexity of configuring complete TEE build and runtime environments
2. Limited observability imposed by hardware isolation, which restricts traditional testing and analysis approaches
3. Difficulty in detecting missing input validation vulnerabilities without actual TEE setups

These barriers make TEE security analysis inaccessible to many developers and security researchers.
AI.method:
The paper proposes SymTEE, a novel LLM-assisted symbolic execution framework for TEE security analysis. The method consists of two main stages:

1. **Code Slice Extraction**: Uses Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) analysis to identify code slices in TEE applications that may lack sufficient input validation.

2. **LLM-Assisted Harness Generation**: Employs GPT-5 to automatically convert extracted code slices into KLEE-compatible harness programs containing lightweight mock execution environments for symbolic analysis.

The framework enables symbolic execution without requiring real TEE hardware or complex setup configurations.
AI.result:
Evaluation on 26 vulnerabilities (11 real-world + 15 synthetic):
- **Precision**: 100% (no false positives)
- **Recall**: 92.3% (high detection rate)
- **Average analysis cost**: Only $0.05 per analysis

The results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in detecting missing input validation vulnerabilities while being highly cost-effective and practical.
AI.conclusion:
SymTEE demonstrates that LLM-assisted symbolic execution can effectively detect missing input validation vulnerabilities in TEE applications with high precision (100%) and good recall (92.3%). The framework achieves this at minimal cost ($0.05 average), making TEE security analysis more accessible and scalable without requiring complex TEE hardware or software setups.

Key contributions:
1. Pioneering paradigm of LLM-assisted symbolic execution for TEE analysis
2. Novel AST-based code slice extraction for TEE applications
3. Automated generation of KLEE-compatible harness programs with mock environments
4. Practical evaluation on 26 real-world and synthetic vulnerabilities

title: Asymmetric Virtual Memory Paging for Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Inference
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code and reproducibility artifacts at https://github.com/codepawl/cachepawl
summary: Hybrid language models like Jamba mix attention layers with State Space Models (SSMs), creating two memory cache types with opposite profiles: Key-Value (KV) caches grow linearly with sequence length, while SSM states stay fixed per layer. Current inference engines handle this poorly. Unified pools pad SSM states to attention page sizes, wasting up to 7.3x capacity. Static dual pools cannot adapt when prompt distributions shift between requests. We present Asymmetric Virtual Memory Paging (AVMP). The allocator separates the two cache types into physically distinct pools behind a unified virtual address space, and migrates capacity between pools when one runs out. Migration triggers only on allocation failure, keeping behavior deterministic. We evaluate AVMP across 270 synthetic cells plus 60 cells of ShareGPT trace replay on an RTX 3060 12GB. Out-of-Memory events drop 7.6% and request throughput improves 1.83x to 13.3x across synthetic workloads and 2.36x on ShareGPT. All gains hold under paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. A phase-time breakdown reveals two distinct mechanisms: shorter OOM recovery on capacity-pressured workloads, and faster allocation calls on KV-heavy workloads. Implementation is pure Python; Triton integration is future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Asymmetric Virtual Memory Paging (AVMP)：为混合 Mamba-Transformer 模型（Jamba 等）设计一种分页内存分配器，将线性增长的 KV cache 与固定大小的 SSM state 分置于物理分离的两个池中，但通过统一的 32-bit VirtualHandle 虚拟页表暴露为单一虚拟地址空间，并在某池分配失败（CapacityError）时触发确定性的跨池容量迁移。实验（RTX 3060 12GB，180 合成单元 + 60 ShareGPT 回放单元）显示：相对最佳静态基线 fixed_dual_mr05，跨负载 OOM 降低 7.6%（510 vs 552，每单元 delta 95% CI [−5.83, −1.39]），goodput 在 uniform_short 上 13.30×、mixed_long 2.39×、agentic_burst 1.83×，ShareGPT 实测 2.36×。作者亦坦承主要收益来自虚拟句柄层的单次分配延迟降低（而非动态重平衡本身），且原型为纯 Python、需 2× VRAM 预留。
AI.motivation: 混合大模型（如 Jamba，注意力层与 Mamba/SSM 层以 1:7 混合，支持 256K 上下文）同时要求两种缓存：KV cache 随序列长度线性增长 O(n)，SSM state 每层固定大小 O(1) 且不可分页（缺少可淘汰的时间维 token 结构，需按层连续分配）。现有推理引擎的两类设计都失效：vLLM 的统一池把 SSM state 填充到 attention page 粒度，容量估算错误地按 token 数相乘，导致最高约 7.3× 的 KV cache 容量高估（issue #37121，Qwen3.5-4B-AWQ 峰值时有效 VRAM 利用率仅 13.7%）；SGLang 的静态双池（HybridReqToTokenPool / HybridLinearKVPool）依赖启动时固定的 mamba_full_memory_ratio（默认 0.9），无法在提示分布漂移时重新平衡，需重启进程。实测同一负载混合下 mr=0.9 触发 1221 次 OOM，而 mr=0.5 为 552 次——不存在同时具备"非对称双缓存"与"运行时自适应"两属性的系统。
AI.method: 1) Asymmetric Virtual Page Table：物理上划分 KVPagesStore（页大小 = attention_page_tokens × per_token_bytes，默认 16 token/页）与 SSMBlocksStore（块大小 = state_dim × bytes_per_element，逐层连续），由统一的多分辨率页表解析为不透明 32-bit VirtualHandle（pool_id 标签 + page_id 索引），施加 128B slab 全局对齐与 16B 页内对齐；该抽象被证明对容量结果零副作用（与静态双池 OOM 字节级相同，552 次）。2) 动态池重平衡：四状态机 BALANCED / KV_PRESSURED / SSM_PRESSURED / REBALANCING，状态转移严格限定在 allocate() 的 CapacityError 异常处理器内（仅在分配本会失败时触发，避免对瞬时压力做前瞻性采样）；当一侧池耗尽而另一侧自由比例 > threshold_high (0.30) 时启动迁移，通过对供体池调用 resize_capacity() 收缩高地址端、受体池增长；用逻辑操作计数器（min_rebalance_interval_ops=1000）而非墙钟做节流以保证确定性，部分失败时回滚。3) 原型为纯 Python，backing tensor 在初始化时按两池最大可能容量之和超配以实现"零拷贝"迁移（仅改页表项与容量计数），未来以 cuMemMap 实现真实物理页重映射。4) 基线建模为分配器级：padded_unified（复现 vLLM 填充行为）、fixed_dual_mr05 / fixed_dual_mr09（复现 SGLang 双池与 mamba_full_memory_ratio）；avmp_static_mr05 用于隔离虚拟句柄层与动态重平衡的贡献。5) 评测：180 单元（5 变体 × 3 合成负载 × 2 模型规格 jamba_1_5_mini/mamba2_1b3 × 2 池预算 1/4 GiB × 3 种子，16:14）+ 60 单元 ShareGPT-Vicuna 首轮人 prompt 回放（词数×1.3 代理 token 数，clamp [16,4096]；生成长度对数正态、到达确定性错开），配对 bootstrap（B=10000，预注册种子 20260520）95% CI；另做 4 桶墙钟分解（service/OOM-retry/migration/idle）与两阶段敏感性分析（Stage 1 扫 B∈{1..256}；Stage 2 扫 threshold_high∈{0.10,0.20}×threshold_low∈{0.02,0.10}）。
AI.result: 跨负载 OOM：avmp_dynamic_b128 510（总 1567.7 → 510，相对 padded_unified −67.5%），较最佳静态 fixed_dual_mr05 的 552 降低 7.6%，每单元 delta 95% CI [−5.83, −1.39]（3.0%–12.7%）；分负载 mixed_long [−10.3, −1.3]、agentic_burst [−9.25, −1.33] 均显著，uniform_short 为 +0.42（CI [0, +1.25]）不显著。avmp_static_mr05 与 fixed_dual_mr05 完全打平（CI [0,0]），验证虚拟句柄抽象无额外开销。Goodput：uniform_short 434.24 vs 32.65 req/s（13.30×，CI [11.18,16.00]）、mixed_long 65.07 vs 27.25（2.39×，[1.70,3.04]）、agentic_burst 46.91 vs 25.69（1.83×，[1.42,2.60]）；ShareGPT 回放 2.36×（CI [1.33,5.65]），且 OOM 与基线完全一致（delta CI [0,0]），说明该收益不来自 OOM 规避；avmp_static_mr05 在 ShareGPT 上为 2.48×，同样零 OOM delta。机制分解显示两条不同路径：mixed_long 上 OOM-retry 占比由 26.3% 降至 8.5%、agentic_burst 由 10.0% 降至 2.1%（迁移开销 <1% 墙钟）；uniform_short 上 OOM-retry 均≈0%，差异源于 4 GiB/512 请求下分配服务时间 32.2 s（fixed_dual_mr05）对 2.1 s（AVMP）、2.2 s（avmp_static_mr05），即加速主要归因于虚拟地址空间层。effective_batch_size_p50 在所有变体间完全相同（129/132/284），排除持续并发差异解释。敏感性：Stage 1 显示 migration_batch_size 为主导轴，B=128 与 256 差异在噪声内（510.0 vs 509.3）但迁移 churn 少 11.1%（298.67 vs 336.00 MiB），选 b128；Stage 2 四种阈值组合 OOM、重平衡次数与迁移字节完全相同，为严格零结果。代价：AVMP 峰值预留 9216 MiB 对基线 5120 MiB（约 2× VRAM）。失败模式：双池同时饱和时无供体可迁移、AVMP 相对静态无额外容量优势；B=1 迁移过慢、B≥256 churn 过高；threshold_low ≥ threshold_high 语义未定义；单 GPU、单进程（逻辑计数器 64 位无回绕），未评估对抗负载、多租户调度、SLO 准入控制与多 GPU/张量并行。
AI.conclusion: 混合架构的显存管理必须支持物理非对称的缓存类型与动态负载适配，AVMP 以统一虚拟句柄空间 + 由分配异常严格触发的跨池容量迁移实现了这一目标，相对最佳静态基线取得 7.6% 的 OOM 降低与 1.83×–13.3× 的合成 goodput 提升，ShareGPT 真实分布下为 2.36×。作者将生产收益明确表述为"待验证的假设"而非实测结论：13.3× 是针对 KV 压力路径的人造极端上界，2.36× 才是 ShareGPT 形状分布下的中心估计；OOM 降低不直接等价于并发序列容量提升，后者还取决于调度准入、prefill/decode 切分、延迟 SLO、输出长度分布与 kernel 行为。后续工作为 cuMemMap 物理页映射（消除 2× VRAM 开销）、Triton kernel 集成与真实引擎（vLLM/SGLang）落地、基于负载预测的前瞻式重平衡、第三类异构池（专用 KV prefix cache）、以及多 GPU 跨设备虚拟池尺寸同步与 Alpaca/完整 HF 会话流等轨迹的评测。论文中摘要称"270 synthetic cells"而正文与复现说明为 180 单元（另有 60 单元 ShareGPT），存在不一致。

title: Lumberjack: Better Differentially Private Random Forests through Heavy Hitter Detection in Trees
summary: Random forests are widely used in fields involving sensitive tabular data, but existing approaches to enforcing differential privacy (DP) typically degrade performance to the point of impracticality. In this paper, we introduce Lumberjack, a differentially private random forest algorithm that achieves substantially higher utility by constructing large random decision trees and then applying aggressive, privacy-preserving pruning to retain only sufficiently populated nodes. A key component of our approach is a novel $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP heavy hitter detection algorithm for hierarchical data, whose error is $O_{\varepsilon,δ}(\sqrt{\log h})$ for trees of height $h$ and may be of independent interest. This favorable scaling enables the use of significantly deeper trees than in prior work, leading to improved expressiveness under privacy constraints. Our empirical evaluation on benchmark datasets shows that Lumberjack consistently outperforms prior DP random forest methods, establishing a new state of the art. In particular, our approach yields substantial improvements in the privacy-utility trade-off for practical privacy budgets. Our findings suggest that carefully designed DP random forests can close much of the utility gap, highlighting a promising and underexplored direction for future research.

AI.tldr: Lumberjack通过构建大型随机决策树并进行隐私保护的激进剪枝，提出了一种高效的差分隐私随机森林算法。其核心创新是一个针对层级数据的新型(ε,δ)-DP重击者检测算法，误差为O(√log h)。实验表明该方法显著优于现有差分隐私随机森林方法，为隐私保护机器学习开辟了有前景的研究方向。
AI.motivation: Random forests are widely used with sensitive tabular data, but existing differential privacy (DP) approaches degrade performance to the point of impracticality. This utility gap motivates the need for more efficient DP random forest algorithms.
AI.method: Lumberjack constructs large random decision trees followed by aggressive privacy-preserving pruning to retain only sufficiently populated nodes. A novel (ε,δ)-DP heavy hitter detection algorithm for hierarchical data is introduced, achieving O(ε,δ)(√log h) error for trees of height h.
AI.result: Lumberjack consistently outperforms prior DP random forest methods on benchmark datasets, achieving substantially better privacy-utility trade-off for practical privacy budgets. The favorable scaling of the heavy hitter algorithm enables deeper trees and improved expressiveness under privacy constraints.
AI.conclusion: Lumberjack establishes a new state of the art for differentially private random forests, demonstrating that carefully designed DP mechanisms can significantly close the utility gap. The work opens a promising research direction combining aggressive tree construction with privacy-preserving pruning strategies.

title: BeLink: Biomedical Entity Linking Meets Generative Re-Ranking
summary: Despite recent progress, Biomedical Entity Linking (BEL) with large language models (LLMs) remains computationally inefficient and challenging to deploy in practical settings. In this work, we demonstrate that instruction-tuning of open-source generative models can offer an effective solution when applied at the re-ranking stage of the BEL pipeline. We propose a set-wise instruction-tuning formulation that enables fast and accurate candidate selection. Our method demonstrates strong performance on multiple BEL benchmarks, yielding significant improvements in linking accuracy (3%-24%) while reducing inference time compared to the state-of-the-art. We integrate our generative re-ranker into BeLink, a modular, end-to-end system designed for practical real-world BEL applications.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM驱动的生物医学实体链接效率与部署难题，提出基于开源生成模型的指令微调重排序方法，集成于模块化系统BeLink中，实现精度与速度的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的生物医学实体链接（BEL）存在计算效率低下、难以在实际场景中部署的问题。
AI.method: 采用开源生成式模型的指令微调方法，应用于生物医学实体链接管道的重排序阶段。提出了一种集合式指令微调 formulation（set-wise instruction-tuning），实现快速准确的候选选择。
AI.result: 在多个BEL基准测试上表现优异，链接准确率提升3%-24%，推理时间较现有最优方法显著缩短。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种适用于实际生物医学实体链接应用的有效解决方案。通过将生成式重排器集成到模块化端到端系统BeLink中，兼顾了准确性和部署实用性。

title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-facing roles where personality perception is critical, yet existing benchmarks evaluate this capability solely on numerical Big Five score prediction, leaving open whether models truly perceive personality through behavioral understanding or merely prejudge through superficial pattern matching. We address this gap with three contributions. (i) A new task: we formalize Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR), which requires MLLMs to anchor each Big Five rating in observable evidence through a chain of rating, reasoning, and grounding. (ii) A new dataset: we release MM-OCEAN (1,104 videos, 5,320 MCQs), produced by a multi-agent pipeline with human verification, with timestamped behavioral observations, evidence-grounded trait analyses, and seven categories of cue-grounding MCQs. (iii) Benchmark and analysis: we design a three-tier evaluation (rating, reasoning, grounding) plus four sample-level failure-mode metrics: Prejudice Rate (PR), Confabulation Rate (CR), Integration-failure Rate (IR), and Holistic-grounding Rate (HR), and benchmark 27 MLLMs (13 closed, 14 open). The analysis uncovers a striking Prejudice Gap: across the field, 51% of correct ratings are not grounded in retrieved cues, and the Holistic-Grounding Rate spans only 0-33.5%. These findings expose a disconnect between getting the right score and reasoning for the right reason, charting a roadmap for grounded social cognition in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"接地人格推理"（GPR）新任务范式，配套发布MM-OCEAN数据集（含1104视频、5320 MCQ），并通过三层次评估框架和四种失败模式指标揭示了MLLMs在人格感知中的"偏见鸿沟"——模型能给出正确评分却无法提供行为证据支撑，表明当前多模态模型缺乏真正的社会认知推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs人格评估基准仅关注Big Five数值预测，无法区分模型是真正通过行为理解感知人格还是仅依赖表面模式匹配进行预判。这导致即使模型评分准确，其人格推理过程可能缺乏可解释性和可信度。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了三层评估体系（评分→推理→ grounding）和四种失败模式指标（PR、CR、IR、HR），对27个MLLMs进行了系统测评。通过多智能体pipeline生成结合人类验证的数据集，包含带时间戳的行为观察和证据锚定的人格分析。
AI.result: 27个MLLMs（13个闭源+14个开源）评测结果显示：51%的正确评分未被检索到的线索所支撑；整体接地率（Holistic-Grounding Rate）仅为0-33.5%，暴露出模型普遍存在"以正确理由得出正确结论"的能力缺陷。
AI.conclusion: MM-OCEAN benchmark揭示了当前MLLMs在人格感知中存在严重的"偏见鸿沟"——即使给出正确评分，也往往缺乏行为证据支撑。这项研究为MLLMs的社会认知能力评估提供了新范式，强调从单纯的分数预测转向可解释的推理过程，对未来多模态人格推理系统的可信度提升具有重要指导意义。

title: AttuneBench: A Conversation-Based Benchmark for LLM Emotional Intelligence
summary: Emotional intelligence (EI), the ability to perceive, understand, and respond appropriately to others' emotional states, is central to human communication, and increasingly important to assess as LLMs assume conversational roles in everyday life. Existing EI benchmarks rely on synthetic prompts, single-turn cases, or third-party annotation. These approaches do not directly measure how models infer and respond to a participant's emotional state over the course of a real conversation. We introduce AttuneBench, a benchmark grounded in 200 genuine multi-turn human-model conversations in which participants conversed with anonymized LLMs and provided turn-by-turn annotations of their emotional state, the model's behavior, and their preferred responses. Across 11 evaluated models, we find that model rankings on emotion recognition, behavioral classification, preference prediction, and judged response quality are largely independent, indicating that emotionally intelligent behavior decomposes into separable capabilities. Preference alignment and response-quality judgments are substantially more model-discriminating than emotion-label accuracy. These results indicate that emotionally intelligent behavior requires predicting what kind of response a specific user wants in context, a distinction that aggregate scoring can obscure and that single-turn or synthetic formats cannot directly capture across turns. AttuneBench provides a framework for assessing each of these capabilities and for diagnosing model-specific strengths and failure modes in emotionally salient conversation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AttuneBench基准，用于评估大语言模型的情感智能。该基准基于200个真实的多轮人机对话，涵盖11个模型。核心发现是：情感智能行为分解为可分离的能力，且偏好对齐和响应质量判断比情感标签准确率更具模型区分度。
AI.motivation: Existing EI benchmarks rely on synthetic prompts, single-turn cases, or third-party annotation, which do not directly measure how models infer and respond to a participant's emotional state over the course of a real conversation. As LLMs increasingly assume conversational roles in everyday life, accurately assessing their emotional intelligence becomes crucial.
AI.method: The paper introduces AttuneBench, a benchmark grounded in 200 genuine multi-turn human-model conversations where participants conversed with anonymized LLMs and provided turn-by-turn annotations of their emotional state, the model's behavior, and their preferred responses. The authors evaluate 11 models on emotion recognition, behavioral classification, preference prediction, and judged response quality.
AI.result: Across 11 evaluated models, model rankings on emotion recognition, behavioral classification, preference prediction, and judged response quality are largely independent, indicating that emotionally intelligent behavior decomposes into separable capabilities. Preference alignment and response-quality judgments are substantially more model-discriminating than emotion-label accuracy.
AI.conclusion: AttuneBench provides a framework for assessing emotional intelligence capabilities and diagnosing model-specific strengths and failure modes in emotionally salient conversation. The benchmark reveals that emotionally intelligent behavior requires predicting what kind of response a specific user wants in context—a capability that aggregate scoring obscures and single-turn/synthetic formats cannot directly capture across turns.

title: A Reproducible Log-Driven AutoML Framework for Interpretable Pipeline Optimization in Healthcare Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate and reproducible disease risk prediction remains challenging due to heterogeneous features, limited samples, and severe class imbalance. This study introduces yvsoucom-iterkit, a deterministic and log-driven automated machine learning framework that formulates pipeline optimization as a fully reproducible, configuration-level system. Each pipeline is encoded as a traceable log entity, enabling analysis of component attribution, interactions, similarity, and cross-seed robustness. Experiments on the Pima Indians Diabetes and Stroke datasets across more than 18,000 pipeline configurations reveal a structured and partially redundant search space, where performance is governed by a small subset of interacting components. Random Forest importance analysis identifies augmentation (0.454), model choice (0.198), and imbalance handling (0.101) as key drivers on Pima, while imbalance handling dominates Stroke (0.406). Component similarity analysis shows strong redundancy, with feature selection variants (biMax-biMean) exhibiting low RMS distance (0.0252), mixup closely matching no augmentation (0.0279), and TomekLinks aligning with no imbalance handling (0.0325), whereas Gaussian noise shows greater divergence from no augmentation (0.10). The framework achieves strong and stable performance using ensemble models (Weighted-F1 0.89, Macro-F1 0.88 on Pima; Weighted-F1 0.94 on Stroke), while Macro-F1 remains lower on Stroke (0.67) due to class imbalance. Cross-seed analysis reveals a performance-robustness trade-off, with ensembles showing lower variability (0.023-0.026) than SVM. These results indicate that effective AutoML optimization can focus on a reduced set of high-impact components.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出yvsoucom-iterkit框架，通过日志驱动的可重现AutoML系统，在18,000+配置中发现搜索空间结构化且部分冗余，性能主要由augmentation、model choice和imbalance handling三个组件驱动。集成模型表现最优，但Stroke数据集因类别不平衡仍面临挑战。研究表明AutoML可聚焦于少数高影响力组件进行优化。
AI.motivation: 疾病风险预测面临异构特征、样本量有限和严重的类别不平衡三大挑战。传统AutoML方法缺乏可重现性和对组件交互作用的系统分析能力，难以揭示搜索空间的结构化特征和组件冗余性。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了yvsoucom-iterkit框架，这是一个确定性的、日志驱动的AutoML系统。在18,000+管道配置中进行穷举搜索，将每个管道编码为可追溯的日志实体。利用Random Forest进行特征重要性分析，计算组件对的RMS距离评估相似性，并通过跨种子分析评估性能-鲁棒性权衡。在Pima Indians Diabetes和Stroke两个数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在Pima数据集上，augmentation（0.454）、model choice（0.198）和imbalance handling（0.101）是主要性能驱动因素；在Stroke数据集上，imbalance handling（0.406）占主导地位。组件相似性分析显示biMax-biMean（RMS 0.0252）、mixup与no augmentation（0.0279）、TomekLinks与no imbalance handling（0.0325）存在强冗余，而Gaussian noise偏离no augmentation（0.10）。集成模型在Pima上达到Weighted-F1 0.89、Macro-F1 0.88，Stroke上Weighted-F1 0.94。Stroke的Macro-F1（0.67）受类别不平衡影响。集成模型变异性（0.023-0.026）低于SVM，呈现性能-鲁棒性权衡。
AI.conclusion: yvsoucom-iterkit框架证明了AutoML优化可以聚焦于少数高影响力的组件。通过可重现的日志驱动设计、组件冗余性分析和鲁棒性评估，该研究为疾病风险预测中的AutoML应用提供了系统化方法论指导，表明在实际应用中应优先优化augmentation、model choice和imbalance handling这三个关键组件。

title: Does Slightly Mean Somewhat? Measuring Vague Intensity Words in LLM Numeric Actions
summary:
Do language models preserve the ordinal meaning of intensity words when those words must produce numeric actions? I study a researcher-constructed scale of 10 English degree modifiers, from slightly to drastically, informed by the Quirk et al. degree-modifier taxonomy, in a controlled resource-allocation environment where Claude Haiku receives a natural-language instruction, produces a numeric allocation, and a deterministic backend converts that allocation into a measurable outcome. The only variable that changes between runs is the intensity word or the starting system state, isolating their effects on the model's numeric output.
  Across 6,620 runs at T=0.0 and T=0.7, three patterns emerge. First, the model compresses 10 intensity words into 5 distinct median outputs: four lower-tier words all map to the same value, while stronger words break into higher regimes (Spearman rho = 0.845, p < 0.001). Second, when the current system state is supplied as context, separate Kruskal-Wallis tests show that grouping by starting allocation captures far more rank-based variance than grouping by word (epsilon-squared baseline = 0.782 vs. epsilon-squared word = 0.079), and lexical differentiation collapses to zero as the system approaches capacity. Third, near feasibility limits the model exhibits three behavioral modes: weak words hedge with small adjustments, strong words abstain entirely, and the word drastically pushes to the local ceiling. These patterns persist across temperature, with stochastic sampling broadening distributions but not restoring ordinal distinctions between words. In this model and domain, the model's numeric interpretation of vague intensity words is compressed, state-dependent, and discontinuous near operational boundaries.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型Claude Haiku如何将强度词（如"slightly"到"drastically"）转化为数值资源分配行为，发现模型将10个强度词压缩为5个输出级别，且系统当前状态比词汇本身更能预测输出，在接近容量边界时表现出非连续的三段式行为模式。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在必须产生数值动作时，是否仍能保留强度词的序数意义——即强度词从自然语言描述到数值行为的转换保真度问题。
AI.method: 采用研究者构建的10级强度词量表（基于Quirk等分类法），在受控资源分配环境中对Claude Haiku进行6,620次测试（T=0.0和T=0.7），唯一变化的变量是强度词和系统初始状态，通过确定性后端将模型数值输出转换为可测量结果以隔离词汇效应和状态效应。
AI.result: 1）压缩效应：10个强度词被压缩为5个中位输出，较低层级词映射到相同值（Spearman ρ=0.845, p<0.001）；2）状态主导：Kruskal-Wallis检验显示按初始分配分组比按词汇分组能解释更多排名方差（ε²=0.782 vs ε²=0.079）；3）极限行为：接近容量极限时出现三种模式——弱词微调、强词回避、"drastically"推向天花板；4）温度泛化：随机采样展宽分布但不恢复词汇间的序数区分。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型对模糊强度词的数值解释具有压缩性、状态依赖性，并在运行边界附近呈非连续性。具体表现为：10个强度词被压缩为5个中位输出；系统当前状态比词汇选择更能解释输出变化（ε²=0.782 vs 0.079）；接近容量极限时出现三种行为模式（弱词微调、强词回避、"drastically"推向天花板）。

title: Automated Repair of TEE Partitioning Issues via DSL-Guided and LLM-Assisted Patching
comment: Accepted by the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) provide hardware-based isolation to protect sensitive data and computations from potentially compromised operating systems (OS). However, TEE applications inevitably interact with the untrusted OS through SDK interfaces, and improper partitioning can introduce severe vulnerabilities such as data leakage and code injection. While prior work has proposed static analysis tools to detect such issues, automated repair remains largely unexplored. This problem is particularly challenging due to three TEE-specific factors: the lack of standardized secure development guidelines, the difficulty of extracting semantic information from low-level C code, and the absence of mature testing and validation methods. In this work, we present TEERepair, a framework for automatically repairing bad partitioning issues in TEE applications. Our approach tackles the above challenges by introducing a domain-specific language (DSL) to encode repair rules that express and capture common TEE security patterns, which are instantiated as patch templates with placeholders for context-specific variables. We then leverage large language models (LLMs) to reason about code semantics and synthesize context-aware patches, and further generate test clients to validate the repairs. We evaluate TEERepair on the TEE Partitioning Errors Benchmark (PartitioningE-Bench), achieving a significantly higher repair success rate of 87.6% compared to baselines. Furthermore, applying TEERepair to real-world TEE projects, we submitted 5 repair pull requests, 2 of which have been confirmed and merged by project maintainers.

AI.tldr: TEERepair 是一个面向可信执行环境（TEE）应用"错误分区（bad partitioning）"漏洞的自动修复框架。核心思路是用领域特定语言（DSL）把 TEE 安全修复规则编码为带占位符（$xxx）的补丁模板，再由大语言模型（gpt-4.1-mini）根据代码上下文补全占位符生成补丁，并结合静态分析器 DITING 做迭代反馈、自动生成测试客户端在真实硬件上做功能验证。在 PartitioningE-Bench（89 个漏洞）上修复成功率达 87.6%（78/89），显著优于所有基线；在真实 GitHub TEE 项目上提交 5 个修复 PR，其中 2 个已被维护者确认合并。
AI.motivation: TEE 应用必须通过 SDK 接口与不可信 OS 交互，若分区设计不当会引入数据泄露、代码注入等严重漏洞。已有工作（Ma et al., 2025，DITING）能静态检测此类问题，但自动修复基本空白。难点有三：(1) 缺乏标准化的 TEE 安全开发规范，缺少可靠"真值"基准，开发者多为临时设计导致代码风格与错误处理不一致；(2) TEE 代码多为低层 C 语言，缓冲区大小、合法索引范围、整数字段与指针的对应关系等语义信息隐式且难由静态分析获得，而动态分析在 TEE 隔离环境下几乎不可行；(3) TEE 缺少成熟测试与验证手段——调试/追踪受限、绝大多数项目没有单元测试与回归套件、缺乏可信 oracle，且需要交叉编译并部署到安全硬件，使"生成-编译-测试"迭代代价高昂。同时，传统 APR/AVR 工具在此场景失效：sanitizer 无法在 TEE 内部署，错误分区漏洞往往不产生崩溃而只违反机密性/完整性属性。
AI.method: 框架包含 6 步流水线：①由 DSL 规则生成补丁模板；②用 DITING 静态分析器定位问题；③把行号、问题类型、相关代码、模板及完整 TEE 代码与历史问答注入提示词，由 LLM 依据上下文填充以 $ 开头的占位符（缓冲长度、变量名、加密参数等）生成补丁；④用 DITING 重新分析补丁，将检测结果反馈给 LLM 迭代精化（纯源码级快速反馈，无需硬件）；⑤静态分析补丁 diff 与源码元数据（UUID、命令 ID、参数类型），自动生成最小化测试客户端 client.c；⑥在真实 TEE 硬件（Raspberry Pi 3B）上运行 172 个手工构造测试用例做功能与安全语义验证。DSL 语法抽象了 TEE 中的内存与计算操作（COPY、SNPRINT、MALLOC、ENC、ARRAY、SHALLOW、READ/WRITE、HASH、MUTATE）与条件守卫（IF + return ECODE），规则以"触发模式 => 安全变换"形式书写，自动实例化为带 +/- 标记的补丁模板。三条修复规则分别对应：规则 1 加解密（未加密输出→分配密文缓冲并对称加密后再拷贝输出，支持 snprintf 多参数展开）；规则 2 插入守卫（输入长度校验、数组索引上下界校验）；规则 3 共享内存深拷贝+完整性校验（浅拷贝替换为深拷贝，比较安全对象中的原哈希与重算哈希，一致性不符即返回错误码）。评测基于 PartitioningE-Bench（89 个经三位专家校验的漏洞，Kappa=0.86），基线为 TBar、Prophet、VulMaster、ChatRepair、SAN2PATCH，并做 DSL-only / LLM-only 消融；测试客户端生成结合 CodeQL 与 Python 脚本。
AI.result: RQ1 定位精度：TEERepair 精确率 95.29%、召回率 91.01%、F1=0.93，优于纯 LLM 定位（91.53%/60.67%/0.73）；共享内存类问题 LLM 召回率为 0（缺乏 TEE 领域知识且共享内存在 normal side 声明）。RQ2 修复效果：生成/可行/正确补丁为 81/78（87.6%）；其中未加密输出 33/33（94.3%）、输入校验 23/20（67.0%）、共享内存 25/25（100%）。基线远低：TBar 17（19.1%）、ChatRepair 12（13.4%）、Prophet 6、SAN2PATCH 5、VulMaster 1；共享内存类只有 TEERepair 成功。RQ3 消融：DSL-only 20（22.5%）、LLM-only 12（13.4%），说明模板结构知识与 LLM 语义补全缺一不可。RQ4 真实项目：basicAlg_use 与 PPFL 等项目生成补丁，其中 2 个 PR 被维护者确认合并，optee-sdp 的 snprintf 长度校验与日志未加密问题也得到修复。成本：平均每漏洞输入约 16682 tokens、输出约 72 tokens（gpt-4.1-mini，约 0.007+0.0001 美元），单次修复耗时 1.01–5.62 秒，主要为 LLM 等待。
AI.conclusion: DSL 提供结构化的安全修复知识（模板选择与正确 API 用法），LLM 提供上下文语义（缓冲区大小、索引边界、共享内存区域），DITING 提供精确定位，三者协同使 TEERepair 在 PartitioningE-Bench 上达到 87.6% 的修复成功率，并在真实项目中获得维护者认可，具备落地可行性。测试用例仅用于事后验证而非引导补丁生成，因此可避免过拟合；由于规则源自安全规范与真实漏洞分析，补丁针对根因而非特定测试。有效性威胁方面：目前仅在 ARM TrustZone 平台评测，未覆盖 Intel SGX/AMD SEV（DSL 本身平台无关）；测试用例为人工编写（因 TEE 场景 fuzzing 难以覆盖），由三位开发者交叉校验以降低偏差；并支持本地 LLM 部署以满足代码保密需求。后续工作包括扩展 DSL 的安全策略覆盖、在工业级代码库上评估并集成进 TEE 安全开发生命周期。

title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
summary: Post-training has become the dominant recipe for turning a language model into a competent search-augmented reasoning agent. A line of recent work pushes its performance further by adding elaborate machinery on top of this standard pipeline. These augmentations import external supervision from stronger external systems, attach auxiliary modules such as process reward models or retrospective critics, restructure the rollout itself with tree search or multi-stage curricula, or shape the reward with hand-crafted bonuses and penalties. Each addition delivers a measurable gain, but each also inflates the training pipeline and ties the recipe to resources or designs that may not always be available. We take a step back and ask whether any of this machinery is actually necessary, and propose Search-E1, a self-evolution method that lets a search-augmented agent improve through only vanilla GRPO interleaved with offline self-distillation (OFSD). After each GRPO round, the policy rolls out on its own training questions. A token-level forward KL objective then aligns the policy's inference-time distribution to its own distribution under a privileged context that exposes a more efficient sibling trajectory. Despite this simplicity, the procedure naturally provides dense per-step supervision. On seven QA benchmarks, Search-E1 reaches $0.440$ average EM with Qwen2.5-3B, surpassing all open-source baselines at both scales. Code and complete version will be made public soon.

AI.tldr: Search-E1提出了一种简洁的搜索增强推理自进化方法，仅通过vanilla GRPO与离线自蒸馏即可超越需要复杂外部机制的基线，证明复杂增强机制并非必需。
AI.motivation: 当前后训练Pipeline通常需要引入复杂外部机制（更强的外部系统监督、过程奖励模型、回溯评论器、树搜索、多阶段课程、手工设计的奖励等）来提升搜索增强推理Agent的性能。这些增强虽然带来可衡量的提升，但显著增加了训练Pipeline复杂度，并依赖于未必可用的资源或设计。因此有必要探索这些复杂机制是否真正必要。
AI.method: Search-E1采用自进化范式，仅依赖vanilla GRPO与离线自蒸馏(OFSD)的结合。具体流程为：每轮GRPO后，策略在训练问题上进行rollout；然后利用token级前向KL目标，将推理时分布对齐到特权上下文下更高效兄弟轨迹的自身分布。这种方式天然地提供了稀疏的每步监督信号。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准上，Search-E1使用Qwen2.5-3B达到0.440的平均EM，超越了所有同规模的开源基线模型。
AI.conclusion: Search-E1通过极简设计（仅用GRPO+离线自蒸馏）证明了搜索增强推理不需要复杂的外部监督或辅助模块，为构建高效推理Agent提供了一条简洁可行的技术路径。

title: Epicure: Navigating the Emergent Geometry of Food Ingredient Embeddings
summary: We present Epicure, a family of three sibling skip-gram ingredient embeddings retrained from scratch on a multilingual recipe corpus. We aggregate 4.14M recipes from 11 sources spanning seven languages, English, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Turkish, Indonesian, German, and Indian-English, and normalise the raw ingredient strings to 1,790 canonical entries via an LLM-augmented pipeline. A 203,508-edge ingredient-ingredient NPMI graph and an 80,019-edge typed FlavorDB ingredient-compound graph, 2,247 typed compound nodes across 15 categories, seed three Metapath2Vec variants that share architecture and hyperparameters and differ only in the random-walk schema: Cooc walks the co-occurrence graph only, Chem walks the typed compound metapaths only, and Core blends both via injected ingredient-ingredient walks at controlled mixing, placing each model at a distinct point on the chemistry-vs-recipe-context spectrum.

AI.tldr: Epicure是一个多语言食材嵌入模型家族，从头训练于包含7种语言、11个来源、414万菜谱的多语种语料库，通过LLM辅助流程将食材规范化为1,790个标准条目。基于食材共现图（NPMI）和食材-化合物类型图（FlavorDB），训练了三种Metapath2Vec变体，通过不同的随机游走模式在化学特性与烹饪上下文之间取得不同平衡。
AI.motivation: Existing ingredient embeddings lack multilingual scope, unified canonicalization, and fail to balance chemical properties with recipe context. There's a need for embeddings that capture both domain-specific knowledge (chemistry/flavor) and cooking/co-occurrence patterns across diverse culinary traditions.
AI.method: 1) Aggregated 4.14M multilingual recipes (7 languages, 11 sources); 2) LLM-augmented pipeline normalized ingredients to 1,790 canonical entries; 3) Built two graphs: 203,508-edge ingredient-ingredient NPMI co-occurrence graph and 80,019-edge typed ingredient-compound graph; 4) Trained three Metapath2Vec variants (Cooc, Chem, Core) sharing architecture/hyperparameters but differing in random-walk schema—Cooc uses co-occurrence only, Chem uses compound metapaths only, Core blends both via controlled mixing.
AI.result: Developed Epicure, a family of three sibling skip-gram ingredient embeddings retrained on a large multilingual recipe corpus, positioned at different points on the chemistry-vs-recipe-context spectrum.
AI.conclusion: The abstract does not explicitly state a conclusion; however, the paper demonstrates that different random-walk schemas place models at distinct positions on the chemistry-vs-recipe-context spectrum.

title: SMDD-Bench: Can LLMs Solve Real-World Small Molecule Drug Design Tasks?
summary: LLM agents have incredible potential for scientific discovery applications. However, the performance of LLM agents on real-world, small molecule drug design (SMDD) tasks across diverse chemistries and targets is unclear. Current evaluation methods are either ad hoc, too simple for real-world discovery, limited in scale, or restricted to single-turn question answering. In effort to standardize the evaluation of LLM agents on small molecule design, we introduce SMDD-Bench, a challenging, multi-turn, long-horizon agentic benchmark consisting of 502 guaranteed-solvable task instances spanning 5 task types: 2D Pharmacophore Identification, Interaction Point Discovery, Scaffold Hopping, Lead Optimization, and Fragment Assembly. SMDD-Bench tasks span a wide region of chemical space and involve 102 unique protein targets. Completely solving the benchmark would require having strong chemical and biological reasoning and 3D intuition, understanding specialized tool use, and displaying planning expertise over a limited number of oracle calls. We benchmark 7 frontier open and closed source LLMs and find even the most performant LLM, GPT5.4, solves only 40.2\% of tasks.
