We hope SMDD-Bench provides a standardized testbed to invigorate the field towards training and evaluating LLM agents for fully autonomous computational drug design. We host a public leaderboard at smddbench.com .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SMDD-Bench——首个面向真实小分子药物设计（SMDD）的标准化多轮、长时程 LLM 智能体基准：包含 502 个"构造上保证可解"的实例、5 类任务（2D 药效团识别、相互作用点发现、骨架跃迁、先导优化、片段组装）、覆盖 102 个蛋白靶点与 855 个小分子。用极简 ReAct 脚手架评测 7 个前沿开闭源 LLM，最强的 GPT-5.4 总成功率也仅 40.2%，表明 LLM 距离"自主计算药物化学家"仍有显著差距；同时发布 SMDD-Bench Lite（100 题）与 SMDD-Bench Diversity（20 题）子集及公开排行榜 smddbench.com。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在科学发现（文献综述、实验编排、端到端机器学习研究）中已展现潜力，但其在小分子药物设计上的真实能力尚不清楚。现有评测存在四类缺陷：一是临时拼凑（ad hoc），二是任务过于简单、与真实计算药物发现的复杂度不符，三是规模受限（任务与靶点数量少），四是仅限单轮问答式（single-turn QA），无法考察智能体在多轮工具调用、几何/化学推理与预算约束下的表现。已有基准（ChemBench、MolecularIQ、SmolInstruct、QCBench、MuMOInstruct、多轮迭代优化类工作）均为单轮简单任务或缺少真实智能体工具调用；而 ZINC/TDC/GuacaMol/PMO/MOSES 等是为从头生成分布设计的语料，不能反映真实发现流程。同时，创建真实药物设计任务存在难点——例如先导优化中"随机采样蛋白-配体对 + 采样待优化/待恒定属性"无法保证存在满足全部目标与约束的解，缺乏"已知解"使评测不可靠。
AI.method: 基准构建：(1) 5 类任务共 502 例——2D 药效团识别 25、相互作用点发现 25、骨架跃迁 52、先导优化 340、片段组装 60；涉及 102 个独特蛋白靶点、855 个独特小分子。(2) 核心创新是 witness-aware 任务生成流水线：在生成起始分子的同时同步生成"见证分子（witness）"，该分子已通过与评测完全相同的评分管线，从而无需专家在环即保证每个任务至少存在一个解；仅骨架跃迁、先导优化、片段组装三类需要该机制（另两类天然有真值）。骨架跃迁由共折叠筛选出相互作用指纹一致的对接分子对（集合 Tanimoto>0.75、结合概率>0.75）；先导优化从同靶点分子池中取 Tanimoto≥0.7 的相似对，依据"支配分子 vs 被支配分子"的实测 8 项 ADMET/亲和力差值反推优化目标与恒定容差带；片段组装用 BRICS 分解活性分子并保留有口袋相互作用的片段（≥6 重原子、距蛋白≤4 Å），原分子即 witness。(3) 评测完全计算化：RDKit、PLIP、OpenBabel、Boltz2（共折叠、结合概率与 log10(IC50)）、ADMET-AI（hERG、BBB、溶解度、CYP3A4、清除率、Caco-2、PPB、Ames）；相互作用点用匈牙利算法做类型兼容的一对一匹配（2.5 Å 阈值，三个点全中才算成功）；骨架跃迁需同时满足 Tanimoto<0.5、骨架 MCS 占比<0.65、10 样本共识交互指纹相似度>0.75、结合概率>0.7；先导优化需满足硬约束面板（MW<600、logP∈[-1,5]、TPSA<140、HBD≤5、HBA≤10、RotB≤10、电荷∈[-2,2]、SA<4.5、无 PAINS/Brenk 预警、Tanimoto≥0.7）与亲和力门槛；片段组装额外要求片段子结构、互斥分配、共价连接及每片段对接姿态 RMSD<2.0 Å（Kabsch 对齐）。智能体设置：极简 ReAct 循环，隔离 Docker 容器 + 独立文件系统、无网络、预装 RDKit/OpenBabel/PLIP/BioPython 等的 python 工具、隔离 venv 中的 predict_boltz（8 次）与 predict_admet（15 次）预算、最多 100 轮、任务标识全部混淆（去 PDB code/UniProt ID/配体代码/靶点名）。基准扩展：SMDD-Bench Lite（100 题，分层+贪心代表性选取）、SMDD-Bench Diversity（20 题最难的先导优化题，每题 10 次运行测多样性）、"枚举 vs 选择"实验（用 GPT5.4-mini 从轨迹抽取全部 SMILES 并离线评分，衡量"若能选中最佳候选"的回收成功率）。
AI.result: 7 个模型中 GPT-5.4 最佳，总体 40.2%；Gemini 3.1 Pro 39.0%、Claude Sonnet 4.6 38.0%、Kimi K2.5 Thinking 30.3%、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 27.5%、DeepSeek V3.2 24.3%、MiniMax M2.7 19.3%。成功几乎全部来自先导优化（27%–57.6%，如 Claude 达 53.5%、GPT-5.4 达 57.6%），而需要 3D 几何直觉的相互作用点发现、骨架跃迁、片段组装接近 0%（仅 Gemini 拿到 1 例相互作用点与片段组装，GPT-5.4 拿到 1 例相互作用点）。新颖性中等（提交分子未见于 ChEMBL/PubChem/SureChEMBL/BindingDB 的比例 61.7%–94.2%），但多样性差：SMDD-Bench Diversity 上各模型每次成功提交的成对 Tanimoto 相似度高达 0.76–0.86，10 次运行中唯一成功解仅 2.75–4.05 个，Claude 虽成功次数最多但半数以上收敛到同一批分子。枚举-选择缺口显著：若从轨迹中枚举的分子里挑选最佳者，总体回收成功率可达 40.7%–48.0%（GPT-5.4 44.0→48.0，Claude 40.7→52.4），骨架跃迁在 Claude/Gemini/GPT-5.4 上提升尤为明显，MiniMax M2.7 先导优化近乎翻倍（27.1→47.1），说明"枚举强、选择弱"。恢复见证分子本身的比例仅 14.1%–21.9%（骨架跃迁与片段组装几乎为 0）。失败模式归纳为四类：缺乏跨轮 SAR 归纳（明知对位酚导致清除率/Caco-2 失败仍反复消耗 3 次 ADMET 预算测试同类结构）、多轮规划不连贯（重复提出已失败分子、以别名回收同一 SMILES）、工具代码错误（Boltz 参数格式、PLIP/import 错误）、以及以记忆中的已知分子替代从头设计。难度指标上，目标/约束数量与难度无明显关系，真正相关的是"属性冲突对"数量（溶解度↑ vs BBB↑、PPB↓ vs BBB↑ 等 6 类互斥组合）。成本 0.34–1.31 美元/实例，单任务墙钟时间约 19.5–49.6 分钟。
AI.conclusion: SMDD-Bench 是首个标准化、长时程、多轮的智能体式小分子药物设计基准，其贡献为：(1) 首个此类标准化评测；(2) 支持 5 类真实药物发现任务；(3) 通过 witness 分子实现全部任务的可解性保证，从而可程序化、无人干预地大规模生成。结论是当前 LLM 尚远不能胜任真实小分子药物设计：最好模型仅解决 40.2%，几何/3D 感知型任务基本全败，输出趋同、缺乏跨轮化学归纳，且选择能力显著弱于枚举能力，说明瓶颈主要在规划、记忆与决策而非候选生成。作者同时说明方法学立场：将 Boltz2 与 ADMET-AI 的预测分布视为基准"世界内的真值"（类比湿实验），所有 PDB 复合物在生成阶段均被重新共折叠与重新打分，从而为后续"对接湿实验闭环再训练"提供可迁移的训练/评测接口；基准定位为训练与评估完全自主计算药物设计 LLM 智能体的公共测试床，并以公开排行榜（smddbench.com）、Lite 与 Diversity 子集支撑更广泛的迭代与复现。

title: DualOptim+: Bridging Shared and Decoupled Optimizer States for Better Machine Unlearning in Large Language Models
summary: We propose DualOptim+, a novel optimization framework for improving machine unlearning in large language models. It introduces a base state to capture common representations shared by forgetting and retaining objectives and delta states to preserve objective-specific residuals. This architecture allows the optimizer to adaptively bridge shared and decoupled states based on the directional conflict between forgetting and retaining gradients. We further introduce DualOptim+ 8bit, a quantized variant that reduces memory overhead without compromising performance. Extensive experiments across fictitious and real-world unlearning, safety alignment, and multi-task learning tasks demonstrate that DualOptim+ consistently achieves a superior trade-off between different objectives. Codes are available at https://github.com/CityU-MLO/DualOptimPlus.

AI.tldr: 提出DualOptim+优化框架，通过基础状态与delta状态的解耦设计，自适应处理遗忘与保留目标的梯度冲突，并提供量化版本DualOptim+ 8bit降低内存开销，实验验证其在多种场景下均能实现更优的目标权衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型机器遗忘学习中，遗忘目标与保留目标之间存在梯度方向冲突，现有优化方法难以有效平衡这两个相互竞争的目标。
AI.method: 提出DualOptim+框架，通过引入基础状态捕获遗忘与保留目标的共享表征，delta状态保存目标特定残差；根据遗忘与保留梯度的方向冲突自适应桥接共享与解耦状态；进一步提出DualOptim+ 8bit量化变体降低内存开销。
AI.result: 在虚构场景、真实世界遗忘、安全对齐和多任务学习任务中，DualOptim+均一致性地实现了各目标间更优的权衡效果。
AI.conclusion: DualOptim+通过状态解耦机制有效平衡遗忘与保留目标间的梯度冲突，8bit量化版本在降低内存开销的同时保持性能，为大模型机器遗忘学习提供了新的优化范式。

title: The Log is the Agent: Event-Sourced Reactive Graphs for Auditable, Forkable Agentic Systems
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Open-source Apache-2.0 implementation with reproducible quickstart demo, deterministic replay, fork-and-diff, and lineage tracing
summary: Most agent frameworks are built around the language model: a conversation loop comes first, then tools, then rules, and finally a logging layer bolted on for observability, with state persisted as retrievable "memory." We describe ActiveGraph, a runtime that inverts this arrangement. The append-only event log is the source of truth; the working graph is a deterministic projection of that log; and behaviors--ordinary functions, classes, LLM-backed routines, or logic attached to typed edges--react to changes in the graph and emit new events. No component instructs another; coordination happens entirely through the shared graph. This single design decision yields three properties that retrieval-and-summarization memory systems do not provide: deterministic replay of any run from its log, cheap forking that branches a run at any event without re-executing the shared prefix, and end-to-end lineage from a high-level goal down to the individual model call that produced each artifact. We present the architecture, a determinism contract that makes replay sound, and a worked diligence example whose full causal structure is reconstructable from the log alone. We discuss--without claiming to demonstrate--why this substrate is unusually well suited to self-improving agents, and how it extends the BabyAGI lineage and prior graph-memory research.

AI.tldr: ActiveGraph将append-only event log确立为唯一真相来源，工作图为log的确定性投影，组件通过共享图协调而非直接指令，由此获得：确定性重放任意运行、任意事件点廉价分叉、端到端因果血缘追溯三大核心能力，为自我改进型智能体提供了坚实基础。
AI.motivation: 传统智能体框架以语言模型和对话循环为核心，工具、规则和可观测性层都是事后追加的，状态以检索/摘要式"记忆"持久化。这种架构存在三个根本缺陷：无法确定性重放任意运行、无法廉价地分叉运行轨迹、无法追溯从高层目标到具体模型调用的完整因果链。
AI.method: 倒置传统架构设计：以append-only event log为真相之源，工作图为log的确定性投影；行为组件（函数、类、LLM例程或类型化边逻辑）响应图变化并发出新事件，组件间无直接指令关系，完全通过共享图协调；通过确定性与Replay合约确保重放的正确性。
AI.result: 成功设计并实现了ActiveGraph运行时架构，提出了保证重放正确性的确定性合约，通过尽职调查示例完整演示了如何从日志alone重建完整因果结构。理论上论证了该架构对自我改进型智能体的独特优势。
AI.conclusion: ActiveGraph通过将append-only event log作为唯一真相来源，实现了确定性重放、廉价分叉和端到端血缘追溯三大能力，为自我改进型智能体提供了理想基底，是BabyAGI和相关图记忆研究的重要扩展。

title: Comparing LLM and Fine-Tuned Model Performance on NVDRS Circumstance Extraction with Varying Prompt Complexity
summary: Suicide is a leading cause of death in the United States, and understanding the circumstances that precede it requires extracting structured information from death investigation narratives. Many of these circumstances require semantic inference beyond simple keyword matching. We develop a ``Complexity Score'' algorithm that analyzes coding manual structure to predict when detailed prompts with full coding guidelines improve over name-only prompts. We then construct a hybrid approach that selects prompt strategy per circumstance. We evaluate large language models (LLMs) against fine-tuned RoBERTa on 25 inferentially complex circumstances from the National Violent Death Reporting System (NVDRS). We found that LLMs substantially outperform on low-prevalence circumstances where training data is insufficient. We further demonstrate that our framework generalizes across frontier LLMs, with GPT-5.2, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Llama-3 70B showing consistent performance patterns. These findings support a hybrid architecture where LLMs handle rare, inferentially complex circumstances while fine-tuned models handle common ones.

AI.tldr: 研究比较LLM与微调RoBERTa在死亡调查叙事中的语义推理能力，提出复杂度评分算法自适应选择提示策略，实现混合架构优化不同场景下的信息提取。
AI.motivation: 自杀是美国主要死因之一，从死亡调查叙事中提取结构化信息需要超越简单关键词匹配的语义推理能力。
AI.method: 开发"复杂度评分"算法预测何时详细提示优于仅名称提示；构建混合方法根据情况选择提示策略；对比LLM与微调RoBERTa在25种推理复杂场景的表现。
AI.result: LLM在训练数据不足的低流行场景中显著优于微调模型；框架可跨前沿LLM泛化，GPT-5.2、Gemini 2.5 Pro和Llama-3 70B表现出一致的性能模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持混合架构策略：LLM处理罕见、推理复杂的场景，而微调模型处理常见场景。该方法可跨前沿LLM泛化。

title: SWE-Mutation: Can LLMs Generate Reliable Test Suites in Software Engineering?
summary: Evaluating software engineering capabilities has become a core component of modern large language models (LLMs); however, the key bottleneck hindering further scaling lies not in the scarcity of high-quality solutions, but in the lack of high-quality test suites. Test suites are indispensable both for synthesizing program repair trajectories and for providing precise feedback signals in reinforcement learning. Unfortunately, due to the high cost and difficulty of annotation, high-quality test suites have long been hard to obtain, while those automatically generated by LLMs tend to be superficial and lack sufficient discriminative power. As a first step toward constructing high-quality test suites, we introduce SWE-Mutation, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated test suites. The benchmark characterizes test suites by introducing systematically mutated solutions that attempt to ``fool'' the test suites and pass validation. We further propose an agentic, language-agnostic framework for automatically generating complex mutants. Our benchmark consists of 2,636 mutated variants derived from 800 original instances and includes a multilingual subset spanning nine programming languages. Experiments on seven LLMs reveal that even DeepSeek-V3.1 achieves only 10.20% verification and 36.15% detection rates, highlighting the inadequacy of current LLMs. Additionally, our agentic mutation strategy enhances realism, reducing average detection rates from 71.04% to 39.81% compared to conventional methods. These findings expose persistent deficiencies in the ability of current LLMs to generate reliable and discriminative test suites.

AI.tldr: SWE-Mutation introduces a benchmark to evaluate LLM-generated test suites by using systematically mutated solutions that attempt to fool the test suites. The benchmark comprises 2,636 mutated variants across 9 programming languages. Experiments on 7 LLMs reveal that even state-of-the-art models like DeepSeek-V3.1 achieve only ~10% verification and ~36% detection rates, demonstrating significant deficiencies in current LLMs' ability to generate discriminative test suites.
AI.motivation: High-quality test suites are critical for synthesizing program repair trajectories and providing precise feedback in reinforcement learning for LLM-based software engineering. However, existing test suites auto-generated by LLMs tend to be superficial and lack discriminative power. The key bottleneck is not the scarcity of high-quality solutions but the lack of high-quality test suites.
AI.method: 1) Introduce SWE-Mutation benchmark characterizing test suites through systematically mutated solutions that attempt to fool test suites; 2) Propose an agentic, language-agnostic framework for automatically generating complex mutants; 3) The benchmark contains 2,636 mutated variants from 800 original instances with a multilingual subset across 9 programming languages; 4) Conduct experiments on 7 LLMs.
AI.result: Even the best-performing DeepSeek-V3.1 achieves only 10.20% verification rate and 36.15% detection rate. The agentic mutation strategy enhances realism, reducing average detection rates from 71.04% to 39.81% compared to conventional methods. Current LLMs' test suite generation capabilities remain fundamentally inadequate.
AI.conclusion: Current LLMs severely lack the ability to generate reliable, discriminative test suites. DeepSeek-V3.1 achieves only 10.20% verification rate and 36.15% detection rate, while the agentic mutation strategy improves realism by reducing average detection rates from 71.04% to 39.81%. The work establishes SWE-Mutation as a benchmark for evaluating test suite quality.

title: One prompt is not enough: Instruction Sensitivity Undermines Embedding Model Evaluation
summary: Instruction embedding models have become common among state-of-the-art models, however are evaluated using a single prompt per task. The single-point evaluation ignores a main problem of the instruction-based approach namely: sensitivity to the phrasing of the instruction. We present an empirical study of prompt sensitivity across 6 embedding models, 11 datasets, and 15 task-specific prompts per dataset, a total of 990. We show that reported scores misrepresent the distribution of scores over plausible prompts. The default prompt can both systematically understate or overstate performance. Furthermore, we show that the leaderboard ranking is not robust to prompt selection: by choosing prompts favorably, any model in our study can be promoted to first place. Our findings suggest that single-prompt evaluation is insufficient for instruction-tuned embedding models and that benchmarks should incorporate prompt robustness, either by evaluating over multiple prompts or by reporting sensitivity alongside point estimates.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了指令嵌入模型评估中的关键问题：单提示评估不足以反映模型真实性能，因为模型对提示措辞高度敏感。研究建议基准测试应采用多提示评估或报告敏感性指标。
AI.motivation: 指令嵌入模型目前使用单一提示评估每个任务，这忽略了一个关键问题：对提示表述的敏感性。
AI.method: 跨6种嵌入模型、11个数据集、每个数据集15个任务特定提示的实证研究，共计990个组合，评估提示敏感性问题。
AI.result: 默认提示可能系统性地低估或高估性能表现；排行榜排名对提示选择不稳健；通过有利提示选择，任意模型都可排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 单提示评估对于指令微调的嵌入模型是不充分的，基准测试应纳入提示鲁棒性评估，可通过多提示评估或报告敏感性指标来实现。

title: Who Uses AI? Platforms, Workforce, and AI Exposure
summary: A growing literature uses artificial intelligence platform conversation logs to measure occupation exposure. We show that these scores partly measure platform user base rather than the workforce. Holding outcome, sample, controls, and estimator fixed while varying only the platform input changes the post-ChatGPT employment coefficient by a factor of 1.9, and within-vendor consumer-versus-enterprise channels produce estimates that disagree in sign. Reweighting to Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce shares attenuates estimates by 42 to 93 percent. We formalize the non-classical measurement error, derive probability limits and partial-identification bounds for employment elasticities. The bias understates substitution more than augmentation.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了AI平台对话日志测量职业暴露度的关键方法论缺陷：平台用户基础与实际劳动力结构不匹配导致严重的非经典测量误差，使就业弹性估计大幅偏误。同一估计框架下仅更换数据来源即可使结果相差近两倍，且消费者与企业渠道估计结果相互矛盾，表明现有研究结论的可靠性存疑。
AI.motivation: 学界日益广泛采用AI平台对话日志来测度职业暴露度，但这些测度指标究竟反映的是平台用户群体特征还是真实劳动力结构，目前尚无定论。这种测量的有效性直接影响AI对劳动力市场影响评估的可靠性。
AI.method: 通过固定outcome、样本、控制变量和估计量，仅改变平台输入变量进行敏感性分析；比较同厂商消费者与企业渠道的估计差异；使用BLS劳动力份额进行重新加权调整；建立非经典测量误差的正式框架并推导概率极限和就业弹性的部分识别边界。
AI.result: 仅更换平台输入数据可使ChatGPT后就业系数变化1.9倍；同厂商消费者与企业渠道估计结果符号相悖；按BLS劳动力份额重新加权后估计值衰减42%至93%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了AI平台对话日志测量方法存在系统性偏误，平台用户基础与实际劳动力结构存在显著差异，导致就业弹性估计严重失真。偏差特征表现为低估替代效应超过低估增强效应。

title: Discovering Entity-Conditioned Lag Heterogeneity: A Lag-Gated Neural Audit Framework for Panel Time Series
comment: Preprint/technical paper. An interpretable neural audit framework for entity-conditioned lag discovery in panel time series. 10 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code available at the GitHub repository
summary: Country-level temporal panels are widely used in empirical analysis. Researchers often need to audit how different entities respond to historical signals over different time horizons. Current approaches typically do not provide directly auditable entity-specific lag summaries. We formulate entity-conditioned heterogeneous lag discovery as a temporal panel mining task and propose AC-GATE, an Adaptive-Conditioning Encoder with a Scale-Invariant Lag Gate. It instantiates conditional Moderated Distributed Lag by using observable entity-level proxies to condition lag-weight distributions over historical observations, thereby making effective lags structural outputs of the model rather than post-hoc explanations. The evaluation is based on a layered audit protocol that separates predictive calibration from lag discovery. A synthetic panel with known ground-truth lags is used for mechanism recovery testing, and two real-world country-level panels are used for external audit and stress testing. The results show that AC-GATE can recover heterogeneous lag structure in synthetic data, and generates non-degenerate, externally structured effective lags in real data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AC-GATE（Adaptive-Conditioning Encoder with Scale-Invariant Lag Gate），把「实体条件化的异质滞后发现」形式化为国家层面面板时间序列的挖掘任务：模型用可观测的实体级代理变量（代理特征 p_i）编码为标量条件分数 z_i，再经尺度不变的滞后门控生成实体特定的滞后权重分布 ω_i，其加权滞后上下文喂给两层 LSTM 做预测；实体有效滞后 k*_i = Σ_k k·ω_{i,k} 成为模型的结构化输出而非事后解释。评估采用四层审计协议（L0 预测校准 / L1 非退化守卫 / L2 外部分层对齐 / L3 合成真值恢复），配合消融（No-AC-Encoder、Uniform-Lag、No-Recon-Reg）与代理打乱负对照。合成数据上可恢复真值滞后（Spearman ≈0.945 线性、0.907 非线性）；真实面板（PWT 经济、OWID Energy+WGI 能源）上有效滞后非退化且与制度/人力资本分层变量显著对齐（能源域 mean|ρ| 达 0.609–0.735），但预测性能并不优于基线（R² 近零，能源域 Grouped ARDL 明显更优），因此论文定位为「滞后审计工具」而非新的预测基准。
AI.motivation: 面板时间序列的异质性研究存在「可审计性缺口」：跨国/跨区域面板中不同实体对历史信号（技术、资本、能源转型、治理条件）的响应时滞可能系统性不同，但现有深度预测模型（TFT、GA-Net、神经面板模型）虽能捕捉非线性动态，却主要输出预测性能或全局解释，不能给出可直接检查、跨实体可比的实体级滞后分布；而仅凭预测精度也不足以断言模型学到了有意义的异质滞后结构（另有同期协变量、泄漏、事后解释不忠实等评估风险）。因此作者将问题重新表述为可检验的「面板时序挖掘 + 审计」任务，并需要一套把预测校准与滞后发现分离的多层验证协议。作者特别指出吸收能力（absorptive capacity）视角：知识基础、制度条件与发展水平不同的实体吸收冲击的速度不同，从而在结果上表现出不同的延迟。
AI.method: AC-GATE 流水线为 p_i → z_i → ω_i → c_{i,t} → Ŷ_{i,t+1}。(1) 自适应条件编码器：z_i=f_φ(p_i)∈R 标量，同时投影进 LSTM 初始隐状态；另设解码头 p̂_i=g_ψ(z_i) 重建代理向量，提供辅助重建目标（detached 版本仅训练解码器，non-detached 才真正约束表示）。(2) 尺度不变滞后门：ω_{i,k}=Softmax_k((g_θ(z_i)_k − λ·k/K)/τ)，其中 λ·k/K 为按最大滞后归一化的相对位置偏置（对长滞后期惩罚，使偏置对 K 尺度不变），τ 控制分布锐度；因 ω_i 只依赖 z_i，有效滞后 k*_i=Σ k·ω_{i,k} 对固定实体在时间上恒定，可直接审计。(3) 信息流约束：当前观测 X_{i,t} 不直接进入骨干输入，只有滞后观测通过 c_{i,t}=Σ_k ω_{i,k} X̃_{i,t−k} 进入，避免短路与泄漏。(4) 目标：L=L_task(MSE)+λ_r·L_recon（λ_r 与门控位置偏置 λ 不同）。(5) 复杂度 O(NT(KF+LH(F+H)))，门控 O(NKH)，推理时 ω_i 与 k*_i 可预计算。审计协议四层：L0 预测 MSE/MAE/R²；L1 退化守卫（跨实体 sd(k*)≤ε 标记该种子退化并剔除）；L2 外部结构：对预设分层变量 ξ 计算 Spearman |ρ|，并用实体标签置换零分布给出 p 值，按种子汇总 mean|ρ|、显著比例与 Fisher 合并 p（对符号稳健，不要求方向一致）；L3 真值恢复（仅合成数据，与滞后中心标签比 MAE 与 Spearman）。实验：合成面板（线性/非线性 DGP，z_i~U(0,1)，k_i^c=clip(round(3+7(1−z_i))) 或 clip(round(10(1−z_i)²))）、PWT 11.0 经济面板（目标 ctfp，1980–2007/2008–2013/2014–2023）与 OWID Energy+WGI 能源面板（目标 co2_per_unit_energy，1996–2011/2012–2017/2018–2023）；20 个种子（0–19），K=10、d=64、2 层 LSTM、λ=0.1、τ=1；基线含 Plain LSTM、TFT、GA-Net、Grouped ARDL；消融含 No-AC-Encoder、Uniform-Lag、No-Recon-Reg；配对 Wilcoxon 检验（合成用 k* MAE，真实域只用于 L0 指标），并做代理打乱负对照（每种子一次非恒等置换，重训 20 种子）。
AI.result: 合成域：AC-GATE 与真值滞后秩对齐强（线性 Spearman ≈0.945±0.078、非线性 ≈0.907±0.212），k* MAE 显著优于所有基线与消融（配对 Wilcoxon p=1.9×10⁻⁶）；No-AC-Encoder 与 Uniform-Lag 的对齐度恒为 0（结构塌缩）；No-Recon-Reg 与完整模型几乎相同（重建项仅为辅助稳定器，非机制来源），真实域 L2 证据则几乎完全由 No-Recon-Reg 复现（说明重建正则对真实对齐并非必要）。真实经济域：AC-GATE k* 跨实体标准差 ≈0.167（门控敏感度 0.499），与人力资本 mean|ρ|≈0.371、GDP/劳动 ≈0.278、资本/劳动 ≈0.257 对齐，65–80% 种子置换显著（Fisher p 10⁻⁴⁶~10⁻²⁴）；按种子平均的 ρ 为负（整体 ρ=−0.63，p≈3×10⁻¹¹），即人力资本越强有效记忆越短。真实能源域：k* 标准差 0.108，规则与法律 mean|ρ|≈0.735、政府效能 ≈0.716、GDP  capita ≈0.609，90–95% 种子显著（Fisher p 10⁻⁷⁹ 量级），整体 ρ=−0.61（p≈3×10⁻⁹）。负对照：打乱代理后 L2 崩塌（经济 mean|ρ| 0.302→0.058，Fisher p 0.94–1.00；能源 0.686→0.088），而测试 R² 几乎不变（0.054→0.055、−0.029→−0.028），说明真实域分层信号确实依赖正确的代理—实体配对，而非模型容量或预测性能。预测方面：所有深度模型在真实面板 R² 落在近零带（经济 AC-GATE 0.054，能源 −0.029），Grouped ARDL 在能源域显著更优（R²=0.607），在经济域转负（−0.089），显示单看 R² 排序不稳定；配对 Wilcoxon 显示 Plain LSTM 与 Uniform-Lag 在经济域 R² 略优于 AC-GATE（p=6.3×10⁻⁵、1.9×10⁻⁶），其余差异多不显著。判定矩阵：L1/L2 在合成、经济、能源三域均为支持，L3 仅合成可评，真实域 L0 标为未认证。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是把面板滞后分析从「非正式的解释层」提升为「显式的审计目标」：提出 AC-GATE（条件编码器 + 尺度不变滞后门 + 可选重建正则）使实体级有效滞后成为模型的结构化输出，并给出可复现的分层审计协议（退化守卫、外部分层对齐、合成机制恢复）与代理打乱负对照，用来区分「架构必要性」与「代理—实体对应关系」。实证结论是：AC-GATE 能在合成数据中恢复已知异质滞后结构，在两个真实国家面板中给出非退化且与制度、人力资本等外部分层变量结构对齐的有效滞后，因此可作为刻画面板异质时序响应的结构化审计工具；但作者明确不主张预测优越性（真实域 R² 近零，能源域 Grouped ARDL 更强），并强调 k* 只是模型导出的「有效滞后摘要」而非因果时滞估计。局限与后续方向包括：更复杂/更灵活的条件编码器与滞后门机制、更多面板类型与预测任务、结合领域知识设计更有针对性的外部分层变量并在更多实证背景中检验滞后结构与领域机制的关系，同时需进一步区分与因果面板学习（异质处理效应、反事实恢复）方法的界限。

title: Cross-domain benchmarks reveal when coordinated AI agents improve scientific inference from partial evidence
summary: Scientific evidence often spans instruments, databases, and disciplines, so no single source records the full phenomenon. This makes it difficult to determine when coordinated AI agents add value over simpler scientific workflows. We evaluate this question with a cross-domain benchmark spanning four scientific tasks: mapping molecular structure into musical representations, detecting historical paradigm shifts in science, identifying vector-borne disease emergence, and vetting transiting-exoplanet candidates. Each case uses a frozen evaluation panel, predefined scoring protocols, explicit baselines, ablations or null controls, and stated limitations. The results define three operating regimes. When different disciplines each capture only part of the phenomenon, cross-channel composites improve over single-channel baselines: climate-vector emergence reaches AUROC 0.944 and exoplanet vetting reaches AUROC 0.955. However, the exoplanet workflow is effectively tied with a strong combined-summary baseline, showing that decomposition does not always improve top-line performance. When one signal dominates, as in paradigm-shift detection, coordination mainly improves interpretation and traceability. For molecular sonification, the gain is representational rather than predictive. ScienceClaw x Infinite provides the auditable artifact and provenance layer for this evaluation. The benchmark therefore assigns value to coordination only when the corresponding performance, provenance, or representation claim is supported by explicit comparators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个跨领域基准框架，用四个科学任务（分子音乐化、范式转变回溯检测、媒介传播病早期预警、凌星系外行星甄别）系统检验"协调型多智能体科学工作流"何时真正优于更简单的单通道或单智能体摘要基线。结果归纳出三种运行区间：分布式不完整证据（协调可提升判别性能）、单一主导通道（协调主要带来可解释性与溯源）、表示映射（协调带来表征性而非预测性收益）。论文的核心立场是：只有在存在明确比较基线且性能、溯源或表示层面的主张被证实时，才应承认多智能体协调的价值；智能体数量本身不是性能来源。
AI.motivation: 科学证据往往分散在不同仪器、数据库与学科中，没有任何单一来源能记录完整现象，这使得"协调型 AI 智能体是否比更简单的科学工作流更有价值"难以判定。作者指出，现有智能体科学研究多停留在演示或狭窄任务基准，缺少跨领域、带显式对照的可审计评估。论文进一步区分了三类常被混淆的主张：性能提升、可解释性与溯源提升、表示变换，并主张只有相对于显式比较基线被证实时才给予协调以功劳。核心方法学要求是：每个应用必须包含冻结评估面板、预先定义的评分协议、脚本化单通道基线、强单智能体摘要基线、消融或零假设对照、置换检验以及明确的局限性声明。
AI.method: 以"制品中介的科学工作流"为可复现分析单元：各专业智能体产出类型化、内容寻址（SHA256 canonical JSON 哈希）的中间制品 a=(u,y,m,P,q,r)，通过溯源有向图 G=(V,E) 复用而非传递自由文本，结果可表示为 R=Φ(B, 𝒜*, θ)。四个应用遵循统一六步算法：冻结面板 B→专业智能体用指定工具采集证据并存为制品→固定特征变换得到特征矩阵 X 与先验时间矩阵 L→所有比较臂从同一冻结 X、L 以固定权重打分→评估层计算 AUROC、配对准确率、检索指标、最近邻一致性、置信区间与置换零分布（标签置换 2000 次，分子音乐化 5000 次）→生成最终综合制品并回链制品图。复合评分为 S_i=Σ_j w_j x_ij + Σ_j γ_j ℓ_ij，先验时间 ℓ_ij=max(0,T_i−t_ij)/W_i，配对准确率为 1[ S_i⁺ > S_i⁻ ] 的均值。四个面板分别为：16 化合物（6 类药）的检索@3/同类最近邻/鲁棒性；16 范式转变与 16 匹配对照的留一对出 AUROC 与先验期；12 涌现事件与 12 同区域稳定地方性对照；12 已确认行星与 12 同时代假阳性候选。共设 19 个对照/消融臂、11 项零检验、28 个报告指标。LLM 仅用于证据检索、抽取校验、工具路由与叙述综合，所有基准数字由脚本化评分函数从冻结制品计算。
AI.result: 1) Climate-Vector Emergence：完整工作流留一对出 AUROC 0.944、配对准确率 0.917、中位先验期 5.0 年、检出率 1.00、置换 p<0.001；单通道基线仅 0.583/0.667/0.625，单智能体合并比例基线 0.736，即比最强单通道高 +0.277 AUROC、比合并比例高 +0.208，说明先验时间加权跨通道整合带来额外信息。达喀尔哨点站点分析给出机制：ENSO 间歇性（La Niña 降雨）比年降水总量更具信息量，经容器补水→约 12 天水生期发育（Brière 媒介能力曲线）→成蚊→传播风险的时序链条。2) Cosmic Filter：四通道复合 AUROC 0.955、配对准确率 1.000、中位先验 1.0 年、p<0.001，显著优于仅凌星形状（0.708）与形状+恒星（0.781）；但与强合并比例基线 0.951 基本持平，故多智能体分解在此未带来唯一 AUROC 增益；消融显示跟进确认最关键（去除后降至 0.851）。3) Computational Kuhn：AUROC 0.9688、配对准确率 0.9375、中位先验 3.0 年，但等权单智能体摘要与脚本化文献计量基线均达 0.969，协调无实测性能优势；消融显示引用拓扑为主导通道（0.969），语义漂移 0.844，资助流近随机 0.531；校准误差 0.6243，评分不应解读为前瞻概率。4) Sound of Molecules：检索@3 为 0.2708，低于最佳化学基线 0.2917（差 7.2%），但同类最近邻一致性 0.6875 远高于 Morgan 指纹 0.3125 和理化余弦 0.1875（提升 120%）；打乱标签零分布 0.125（p=0.0178）、随机映射零分布 0.224、随机期望 p=0.0004，无 3D 消融降至 0.250/0.375，鲁棒性 0.8021，ARI 0.083、NMI 0.557、scaffold 留出准确率 0.500——支持"结构恢复"而非"更强检索"的主张。5) 由此得出三区间制图：分布式不完整证据（Climate-Vector、Cosmic Filter）、单一主导通道（Computational Kuhn）、表示映射（Sound of Molecules）。基础设施 ScienceClaw×Infinite 提供技能注册表、DAG、LLM 推理器、心跳循环与内容哈希制品库，并保留公开调查记录，使结论可回溯至中间证据。
AI.conclusion: 协调型科学智能体并非天然优于更简单的基线：Cosmic Filter 与合并摘要基线持平，Computational Kuhn 被等权摘要与文献计量基线追平，因此智能体数量或分解本身不应被视为性能来源。协调真正产生价值的条件是：证据确实分布于不完整的学科通道、时序结构或通道级溯源改变了可支持的推断、以及中间制品的可审计性与可复用性对科学主张本身重要。论文的贡献是可移植的基准框架与制图式结论（而非单一排行榜），并以 ScienceClaw×Infinite 提供制品保存、溯源、复用与公开调查记录这一可审计底座。主要局限为规模较小、面板为人工策展且均为回溯性、确定性流水线保证可复现但无法检验前瞻性能；此外 Sound of Molecules 存在事后美学解释风险，范式转变的公认日期可争议，行星处置状态可能变化。

title: ACC: Compiling Agent Trajectories for Long-Context Training
summary: Recent development of agents has renewed demand for long-context reasoning capacity of LLMs. However, training LLMs for this capacity requires costly long-document curation or heuristic context synthesis. We observe that agents produce massive trajectories when solving problems, invoking tools and receiving environment observations across many turns. The evidence needed to answer the original question is thus scattered throughout these turns, requiring integration of distant context segments. Nevertheless, standard agent SFT masks tool responses and only trains turn-level tool selection, creating a supervision blind spot where these scattered signals go unused. We propose Agent Context Compilation (ACC), which converts trajectories from search, software engineering, and database querying agents into long-context QA pairs that combine the original question with tool responses and environment observations gathered across multiple turns, training the model to answer directly without tool use. This makes the dependencies between the question and the evidence explicit, enabling direct supervision of long-context reasoning over distant segments without additional annotation. ACC is a simple but effective approach that can be combined with any existing long-context extension or training method, providing scalable supervised fine-tuning data. We validate ACC on long-range dependency modeling tasks through MRCR and GraphWalks, challenging benchmarks requiring cross-turn coreference resolution and graph traversal over extended contexts. Training Qwen3-30B-A3B with ACC achieves 68.3 on MRCR (+18.1) and 77.5 on GraphWalks (+7.6), results comparable to Qwen3-235B-A22B, while preserving general capabilities on GPQA, MMLU-Pro, AIME, and IFEval. Further mechanism analysis reveals that the ACC-trained model exhibits task-adaptive attention restructuring and expert specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Context Compilation (ACC)，利用智能体轨迹中散布的多轮证据自动构建长上下文QA训练数据，使30B参数模型性能追平235B模型，无需人工标注即可直接监督跨轮次长上下文推理能力。
AI.motivation: Agents produce trajectories with evidence scattered across many turns requiring integration of distant context segments, but standard agent SFT masks tool responses and only trains turn-level tool selection, creating a supervision blind spot where these scattered signals go unused.
AI.method: Agent Context Compilation (ACC) converts multi-turn agent trajectories (from search, software engineering, and database querying agents) into long-context QA pairs by combining original questions with tool responses and environment observations gathered across multiple turns, training the model to answer directly without tool use.
AI.result: Training Qwen3-30B-A3B with ACC achieves 68.3 on MRCR (+18.1) and 77.5 on GraphWalks (+7.6), reaching performance comparable to Qwen3-235B-A22B while preserving capabilities on GPQA, MMLU-Pro, AIME, and IFEval.
AI.conclusion: ACC enables smaller models (Qwen3-30B-A3B) to achieve performance comparable to 10x larger models (Qwen3-235B-A22B) while preserving general capabilities, with mechanism analysis revealing task-adaptive attention restructuring and expert specialization.

title: An Architecture for Decentralised Deployment and Operation of Blockchain Applications
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Software Architecture (ECSA) 2026
summary: Blockchains and distributed ledger technologies allow the operation of manifold decentralised applications (dApps). Such applications are based on smart contracts, a programmable abstraction that is executed in a decentralised manner. To ensure the correctness of smart contracts, blockchain application developers rely on DevOps practices such as automated testing and continuous integration and deployment. However, such infrastructure is often controlled by single entities. For larger blockchain applications, this issue is resolved by relying on concepts of Decentralised Autonomous Organisations (DAOs), which allow proposals to be autonomously executed once they reach a pre-defined quorum. Such a governance architecture is complex and requires integration with existing patterns for contract discovery and upgradeability. In this paper we integrate these concepts considering DevOps best-practices into a novel architecture that remains agnostic to different governance and upgrade implementations. We extend the known registry pattern to support deterministic deployments and present a decentralised deployment framework, including integration and deployment pipelines, user-interfaces, and version control integration. In our approach, each party implements and verifies their own tests before engaging in the use of a (newly deployed) smart contract. We provide a reference implementation, available as open-source, and evaluate the proposal thoroughly. Our architecture can serve as a reference for future integrations, while our open-source framework is aimed at reducing the complexity of adopting such a process in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文针对区块链智能合约的去中心化部署和治理问题，提出了一种与具体治理和升级实现无关的架构，通过扩展注册表模式支持确定性部署，并提供包含CI/CD流水线、UI和版本控制集成的去中心化部署框架。
AI.motivation: 区块链dApps的DevOps基础设施通常由单一实体控制；DAO治理架构复杂，需要与合约发现和可升级性模式集成。
AI.method: 提出一种与治理和升级实现无关的新架构，整合DevOps最佳实践；扩展注册表模式以支持确定性部署；开发去中心化部署框架，包含集成/部署流水线、用户界面和版本控制集成。
AI.result: 各参与方在使用新部署的智能合约之前实现并验证各自的测试。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可作为未来集成的参考，开源框架旨在降低实践中采用此类流程的复杂性。

title: A Causal Argumentation Method for Explainability of Machine Learning Models
comment: To be published in The 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) methods identify which features are relevant to a model's predictions but often fail to clarify why certain decisions are made. In this work, we present a novel method that integrates causality with argument-based reasoning to explain why models may be making predictions. Our approach first identifies causal relationships among variables using causal discovery methods and then translates these into a Bipolar Argumentation Framework (BAF) to represent supportive and opposing interactions among features. By using semi-stable semantics, we find extensions of features that explain why certain outcomes may have been chosen. We demonstrate our method on two benchmark datasets and compare its results against standard post-hoc explainability approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合因果推理与论证框架的可解释AI方法，通过因果发现识别变量关系，将其映射为双极论证框架，利用半稳定语义找到可解释决策的特征扩展，从而揭示模型做出特定预测的原因。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法只能识别相关特征，但无法解释模型为何做出特定决策，即缺乏对决策原因的因果推理能力。
AI.method: 1）使用因果发现方法识别变量间的因果关系；2）将因果关系转化为双极论证框架（BAF），表示特征间的支持与反对交互；3）利用半稳定语义寻找解释特定结果的特征扩展集。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上验证了方法有效性，并与标准事后解释方法进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明该方法在两个基准数据集上有效，相比标准事后可解释性方法能提供更深入的解释。

title: Provable Joint Decontamination for Benchmarking Multiple Large Language Models
summary: Benchmark data contamination has become a central challenge in LLM evaluation: when evaluation examples appear in the training data of one or more audited models, reported performance can be inflated and cross-model comparisons become unreliable. A broad line of training-data detection work designs scores to quantify how strongly a model memorizes a given data point, but these score-based methods lack theoretical guarantees. Recent conformal approaches provide provable false-identification control for a single model; however, applying them separately to each model can produce model-specific benchmarks, undermining fair comparison across models. In this work, we formalize multi-model benchmark decontamination as a joint selection problem and propose Joint Envelope Conformal Selection (JECS), a conformal procedure that enables global contamination rate (GCR) control under stated assumptions. Specifically, JECS computes per-model conformal p-values, aggregates them by the per-item maximum, and reconstructs a conservative envelope of the max-p null distribution from right-tail observations above a data-driven threshold. By applying the adaptive Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure to the envelope-rescaled values, we select a benchmark with provable GCR control. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate that JECS achieves higher power than the max-p baseline while consistently maintaining the target GCR control.

AI.tldr: This paper addresses LLM benchmark contamination by proposing JECS, a conformal multi-model decontamination method that provides provable global contamination rate control through envelope reconstruction and adaptive BH procedure, enabling more reliable cross-model comparisons.
AI.motivation: Benchmark data contamination inflates LLM performance metrics when evaluation examples appear in training data. Existing score-based detection methods lack theoretical guarantees, and applying single-model conformal methods separately produces inconsistent benchmarks that undermine fair cross-model comparisons.
AI.method: JECS computes per-model conformal p-values, aggregates them via per-item maximum, reconstructs a conservative envelope of the max-p null distribution from right-tail observations above a data-driven threshold, and applies the adaptive Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure to envelope-rescaled values for joint selection.
AI.result: JECS enables global contamination rate (GCR) control under stated assumptions while achieving higher power than the max-p baseline across various models and benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: JECS achieves higher detection power than the max-p baseline while maintaining provable GCR control across diverse models and benchmarks.

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque channel through which sensitive content may propagate across agents without explicit textual disclosure. To address this, we introduce \textbf{LCGuard} (Latent Communication Guard), a framework for safe KV-based latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems. LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. We formalize representation-level sensitive information leakage operationally through reconstruction: a shared cache artifact is unsafe if an adversarial decoder can recover agent-specific sensitive inputs from it. This leads to an adversarial training formulation in which the adversary learns to reconstruct sensitive inputs, while LCGuard learns transformations that preserve task-relevant semantics and reduce reconstructable information. Empirical evaluations across multiple model families and multi-agent benchmarks show that LCGuard consistently reduces reconstruction-based leakage and attack success rates while maintaining competitive task performance compared to standard KV-sharing baselines.

AI.tldr: LCGuard是一个用于多智能体LLM系统中安全KV潜伏通信的框架，通过表示级转换防止敏感信息泄漏，同时保留任务相关语义。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统通过KV缓存进行潜伏通信虽能提高效率并保留任务相关信息，但KV缓存会编码上下文输入、中间推理状态和智能体特定信息，形成不透明通道，敏感内容可能在没有显式文本披露的情况下跨智能体传播。
AI.method: 将共享KV缓存视为潜伏工作记忆，在缓存跨智能体传输前学习表示级转换；采用对抗训练方法，敌手学习重建敏感输入，而LCGuard学习保留任务相关语义同时减少可重建信息的转换。
AI.result: 实验评估表明LCGuard在多个模型家族和多智能体基准测试中一致性地降低了基于重建的泄漏和攻击成功率，同时相比标准KV共享基线保持了具有竞争力的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LCGuard为多智能体LLM系统中的KV潜伏通信提供了安全保障，通过在共享缓存传输前学习表示级转换，实现安全性与任务性能的平衡。

title: Hypergraph as Language
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential in modeling relational structures. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally graph-centric: they focus on processing pairwise graph structures into tokens that LLMs can understand. In contrast, many real-world relational patterns do not naturally conform to the pairwise-edge assumption, and are better modeled as high-order associations in hypergraphs. For hypergraph structures, existing methods often fail to preserve the native semantics that multiple objects are jointly connected by the same high-order relation, limiting their ability to exploit complex structures. To address this limitation, we put forth the "Hypergraph as Language" perspective and propose Hyper-Align, a hypergraph-native alignment framework for large language models. Hyper-Align compiles the query-object-centered hypergraph context into hypergraph tokens directly consumable by a base LLM. Specifically, we introduce Hypergraph Incidence Detail Template with Overview (HIDT-O), which serializes high-order association structures into a fixed-shape hybrid template combining local incidence details and overview-level summaries. We then design a Hypergraph Incidence Projector (HIP), which maps native high-order incidence structures into the LLM token space through explicit semantic-structural decoupling and bidirectional message passing between vertices and hyperedges. We further define a concrete Hypergraph-as-Language input protocol, which jointly feeds hypergraph tokens and textual prompts into a frozen base LLM, supporting both vertex-level and hyperedge-level tasks under a unified question-answering paradigm. To systematically evaluate different methods in hypergraph structural modeling, we introduce HyperAlign-Bench. Extensive experiments show that Hyper-Align significantly outperforms existing methods across in-domain and zero-shot evaluations.

AI.tldr: 针对现有LLM图模型无法原生处理高阶关联的局限，本文提出"超图即语言"视角下的Hyper-Align框架，通过设计超图序列化模板和投影器，将超图结构转换为LLM可理解的令牌，并在统一QA范式下实现顶点级和超边级任务处理。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM关系建模方法均基于成对图结构，无法原生处理现实世界中常见的高阶关联（超图）。传统方法丢失了"多对象通过同一高阶关系共同连接"的原生语义，严重限制了复杂结构建模能力。
AI.method: 提出Hyper-Align框架，包含：(1) HIDT-O模板，将高阶结构序列化为固定形状的混合模板；(2) HIP投影器，通过语义-结构解耦和双向消息传递机制将超图映射到LLMtoken空间；(3) 统一QA输入协议，支持冻结基座LLM同时处理超图令牌和文本提示。
AI.result: HyperAlign-Bench评测表明，Hyper-Align在域内和零样本场景下均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: Hyper-Align通过"超图即语言"范式，首次实现LLM对高阶关联结构的原生理解，在顶点级和超边级任务上均显著优于现有图模型方法，为复杂关系建模提供了新范式。

title: At What Cost? Software Developers' Well-Being in the Age of GenAI
summary: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is rapidly reshaping software development, with growing emphasis on accelerating productivity and optimizing performance. However, excessive focus on such dimensions risks overlooking the critical implications for developer well-being. GenAI tools can amplify cognitive load, introduce new forms of oversight labor, and escalate expectations around output and pace, contributing to stress, burnout, and diminished work-life balance. The GenAI movement is also transforming professional norms, altering career entry points, demanding continuous adaptation, and deepening inequalities in access and support. This position paper calls for a reorientation of the GenAI research agenda in software development and proposes a theoretical framework to move beyond narrow performance metrics toward investigations that also center on human experience, social context, and sustainable productivity.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出当前GenAI研究过于关注生产力而忽视开发者福祉，呼吁重新定位研究议程，引入关注人类体验、社会背景和可持续生产力的理论框架。
AI.motivation: 当前GenAI研究过度关注生产力提升和性能优化，却忽视了工具对开发者身心健康的潜在负面影响，如认知负荷加重、加班文化加剧、不平等加剧等。
AI.method: 提出位置论文（position paper），构建理论框架，旨在将GenAI研究的关注点从单纯的生产力和性能指标拓展到开发者的整体福祉。
AI.result: 识别了GenAI对开发者福祉的多重影响：放大认知负荷、引入新的监督劳动形式、加速工作节奏与产出压力，导致压力、倦怠和工作生活平衡恶化；同时也改变了职业规范、入口门槛，要求持续适应，并加剧了获取和支持方面的不平等。
AI.conclusion: 提出理论框架，将GenAI研究议程从狭隘的绩效指标重新定位为以人为中心的视角，关注人类体验、社会背景和可持续生产力。

title: What Counts as AI Sycophancy? A Taxonomy and Expert Survey of a Fragmented Construct
summary: AI sycophancy has become a prominent concern in large language model (LLM) research. Yet the term lacks a consistent definition and has been applied to behaviors ranging from agreeing with a user's false claim to excessively praising the user to withholding corrective feedback. When researchers, companies, and policymakers use the same term to describe different behaviors, evaluation results become difficult to compare, mitigation strategies fail to transfer, and systems that are resistant to one form of sycophancy continue exhibiting other forms. To address this, we make two contributions. First, we reviewed 70 papers on AI sycophancy to develop a taxonomy of how the behavior has been defined and measured. The taxonomy distinguishes (1) whether a model is sycophantic toward a user's positions and beliefs, or toward the user's broader personal traits and emotions, and (2) whether this occurs through explicit, direct language or more implicit, subtle behaviors such as framing, omission, or tone. Mapping existing literature to our taxonomy reveals that current research has focused on overt forms of sycophancy toward users' beliefs, leaving more subtle and person-directed behaviors relatively understudied. Second, we surveyed 106 experts in AI sycophancy and related fields to examine whether researchers agree on which model behaviors are sycophantic. While experts are nearly unanimous in believing that sycophancy is a significant problem in current AI systems (94.3% agree), they disagree substantially on which specific behaviors qualify. Together, these findings demonstrate that AI sycophancy is a broad family of behaviors with different measurement challenges, intervention requirements, and governance implications. Our taxonomy provides a shared vocabulary for understanding and addressing these behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对AI sycophancy概念缺乏统一定义的问题，通过文献综述（70篇论文）和专家调查（106位专家）建立了二维行为分类体系，揭示了该领域研究的空白和专家共识的缺乏，为后续研究和治理提供了共同词汇框架。
AI.motivation: AI sycophancy目前缺乏一致的定义，不同研究用同一术语描述不同行为（如：同意用户错误观点、过度赞美用户、隐瞒纠正性反馈等），导致评估结果难以比较、缓解策略无法迁移、系统对一种形式的sycophancy免疫但仍表现出其他形式。
AI.method:
1. 系统文献综述：回顾70篇AI sycophancy相关论文，建立行为分类体系
2. 专家调查：调研106位AI sycophancy及相关领域专家，评估研究界对sycophancy界定的共识程度
AI.result:
1. 建立二维taxonomy：
   - 维度一：模型迎合的对象（用户立场/信念 vs 用户个人特质/情感）
   - 维度二：迎合的表现形式（显性/直接语言 vs 隐性/微妙行为如框架设置、遗漏、音调）
2. 发现研究空白：现有研究集中于显性sycophancy，对用户信念的迎合研究较多，对更隐性、面向个人的行为研究不足
3. 专家调查发现：94.3%专家认为sycophancy是当前AI系统的重要问题，但对具体哪些行为属于sycophancy存在显著分歧
AI.conclusion: AI sycophancy是一个包含多种行为类型的广泛概念，不同形式需要不同的测量方法、干预策略和治理方案。研究者的taxonomy为理解和解决这些行为提供了共同词汇基础。

title: Tabular foundation models for robust calibration of near-infrared chemical sensing data
summary: Near-infrared spectroscopy is increasingly used as a rapid, non-destructive chemical sensing technology for the analysis of food, pharmaceutical, biological, and environmental samples. However, the practical deployment of NIR sensors still depends on calibration models able to handle high-dimensional, collinear spectra, limited sample sizes, preprocessing dependence, spectral outliers, and extrapolation beyond the calibration domain. Here, we evaluate whether tabular foundation models can provide a new calibration strategy for NIR chemical sensing. We benchmark TabPFN on 66 NIR datasets covering 54 regression and 12 classification tasks, and compare direct inference on raw spectra with preprocessing-optimized inference against PLS/PLS-DA, Ridge, Catboost, and one-dimensional convolutional neural networks. The study uses a unified validation framework in which preprocessing and model selection are performed exclusively on calibration data before external test evaluation. In regression, preprocessing-optimized TabPFN achieves the best overall average rank and significantly outperforms PLS, CatBoost, TabPFN on raw spectra, and CNN-1D, while remaining statistically comparable to Ridge. In classification, TabPFN applied directly to raw spectra provides the best average rank, with performance close to the optimized variant. Robustness analyses show that TabPFN provides strong average predictive performance but that its advantage decreases on spectral outliers and extrapolated samples, where classical chemometric models remain competitive. These results suggest that tabular foundation models can complement established chemometric workflows for NIR chemical sensing, especially in small- to medium-sized calibration settings, while highlighting the need for spectroscopy-specific priors and uncertainty-aware deployment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文在 66 个近红外（NIR）数据集（54 个回归 + 12 个分类）上大规模基准测试了表格基础模型 TabPFN-2.5，将其与 PLS/PLS-DA、Ridge、CatBoost、CNN-1D 对比，并考察预处理优化、光谱离群点与外推条件下的稳健性。结论：回归任务中"预处理优化版 TabPFN"（TabPFN-opt）平均秩最佳（1.800），显著优于 PLS、CatBoost、原始谱 TabPFN 与 CNN-1D，与 Ridge 统计相当；分类任务中原始谱直接推理的 TabPFN 最佳（2.000），与优化版接近。但 TabPFN 在离群样本与外推子集上的相对优势减弱，PLS 等经典化学计量模型仍具竞争力。作者结论是：表格基础模型应作为现有化学计量工作流的补充工具，尤其适用于中小样本量场景，但需引入光谱专用先验与不确定性感知部署策略。
AI.motivation:
近红外光谱（NIRS）作为一种快速无损化学传感技术，广泛用于食品、制药、生物与环境样品分析，但其实际部署仍受限于四个根本困难：光谱高维且强共线（波长相邻变量高度冗余）、标定样本量通常较小、结果对预处理流程高度敏感、以及需要处理光谱离群点与超出标定域的外推样本。经典化学计量模型（PLS）因稳健、可解释、能处理共线性而长期主导，但其线性假设在部分任务中受限；机器学习与深度学习方法可捕捉非线性，却需要大量超参调优、对样本量敏感。

与此同时，表格基础模型（TabPFN，基于 Prior-Data Fitted Networks 的预训练 Transformer）在通用表格任务上表现接近调优数小时的集成方法，且无需在目标数据集上做梯度优化。但其统计先验来自合成表格数据：表格特征被视作无序、语义异质的变量，而 NIR 光谱沿波长轴具有强烈有序性与平滑性，二者存在结构性错配。因此本文核心问题是：面向通用表格先验学习的基础模型能否有效迁移到光谱域的校准建模中？作者还特别关注（1）预处理对基础模型的作用机制，（2）在实际部署中的离群点与外推条件下的稳健性。
AI.method:
基准构建：汇集 66 个公开 NIR 数据集（来自约 30 个数据库，含食品、农产品、土壤、矿物、燃料、药品等），其中回归 54 个（中位样本数 402、中位变量数 1003），分类 12 个（中位样本数 876、中位变量数 2151）；全体范围 56–8731 样本、125–4200 变量。保留数据集原始 train/test 划分，否则用 SPXY（分类用其分层变体）确定性划分；不剔除任何离群样本，离群点仅在测试集上事后识别。

模型与流程：TabPFN-2.5（2025 年 11 月发布，默认 v2.5-real 检查点）分为两个变体——TabPFN-Raw（原始谱直接推理）与 TabPFN-opt（嵌入预处理优化框架）；基线为 PLS/PLS-DA、Ridge、CatBoost、CNN-1D（三卷积块光谱网络）。统一验证框架：全部预处理与超参选择仅在标定集内完成，采用基于 SPXY 的 3 折交叉验证；每个预处理配置各自配最优超参，最终按最高平均 CV 分数选出完整流水线，在全标定集重拟合后仅在独立测试集上评估一次。

预处理搜索：两阶段层次化策略。第一阶段在基线校正（ASLS、多种 Savitzky–Golay 平滑/导数、Gaussian）与散射校正（SNV、EMSC）的笛卡尔积上搜索，保留前三名；第二阶段仅对前三名扩展表示/缩放维度（PCA 固定保留 25% 特征、OSC、AreaNorm、Haar、StandardScaler/MinMaxScaler）。PLS 搜索空间更大（60 个 Phase-1 配置），反映其对预处理敏感的实际用法；TabPFN/CatBoost 超参固定以控制计算成本。

评价与稳健性：回归用 RMSE（RMSECV/RMSEP），分类用平衡准确率（ACC-CV/ACCP）；相对指标 iRMSEP = 100×(RMSEP_ref − RMSEP_cmp)/RMSEP_ref，以 PLS 为参考。稳健性分析：先 SNV 后用标定集拟合 PCA（95% 方差），将测试谱投影后计算 Hotelling T²，超 95% 阈值者判为光谱离群点；外推定义为测试目标值落在标定集目标值范围之外。统计：数据库级聚合平均分后排名，Friedman 全局检验 + Nemenyi 事后检验（临界差 CD 图）。全部实验在 nirs4all 开源框架内完成，TabPFN 因 GPU 版本限制在 CPU 上运行（i9-14900KF + RTX 5080）。
AI.result:
回归（54 数据集）：Friedman 检验显著（p=5.9×10⁻⁵，CD=1.520）。平均秩为 TabPFN-opt 1.800 < Ridge 3.075 < CatBoost 3.650 < TabPFN-Raw 3.875 < PLS 4.050 < CNN-1D 4.550。Nemenyi 事后检验显示 TabPFN-opt 显著优于 CatBoost（p=0.0218）、TabPFN-Raw（p=0.0060）、PLS（p=0.0020）、CNN-1D（p=4.9×10⁻⁵），但与 Ridge 无显著差异（p=0.148）。数据库级胜/负：TabPFN-opt 对 PLS 18:4、对 Ridge 18:4、对 CatBoost 21:3、对 TabPFN-Raw 22:2。iRMSEP 蜂群图显示 TabPFN-opt 以正值为主，Ridge 分布贴近 0，TabPFN-Raw/CatBoost/CNN-1D 离散度大（CNN-1D 既有大幅改善也有严重退化）。累计 iRMSEP 随样本量排序显示 TabPFN-opt 在全尺寸区间优于 PLS，说明其先验可跨样本量迁移。

预处理作用：TabPFN-opt 普遍优于 TabPFN-Raw（22 胜 2 负），主要增益来自 Savitzky–Golay 平滑与导数（TabPFN 常在"仅 SG、无其他变换"下取胜）；PLS/Ridge/CNN-1D 更多选择 SNV 散射校正，Ridge 与 CatBoost 常用 OSC；无单一流程在各数据集上占优。

分类（12 数据集）：Friedman 显著（p=0.011，CD=2.345）。平均秩 TabPFN-Raw 2.000 < TabPFN-opt 2.417 < PLS-DA 2.583 < CatBoost 3.083 < CNN-1D 4.917。两个 TabPFN 变体均显著优于 CNN-1D（p=0.049 与 p=0.012），但与 PLS-DA、CatBoost 之间无显著差异；两者性能高度重叠，说明分类中 TabPFN 可直接从原始谱提取判别信息。

稳健性：54 个回归数据集中 48 个检出光谱离群点；在离群子集上 PLS、CatBoost、CNN-1D 的相对排名略有提升，而 TabPFN-opt、Ridge、TabPFN-Raw 出现中等程度排名下降（TabPFN-opt 仍总体最优但优势收窄）。23 个数据集存在外推样本，所有模型相对 PLS 均退化，其中 TabPFN-opt 与 Ridge 最接近 PLS，TabPFN-Raw、CatBoost、CNN-1D 偏离更大。CNN-1D 因 nirs4all 架构搜索空间与最小输入长度约束，在部分最小数据集上无法训练，缺少可比结果。

局限：TabPFN 与 CatBoost 使用固定超参、CNN-1D 每条流水线仅 30 次 Optuna-TPE 试验且无数据增强，而 PLS/Ridge 拥有更大搜索空间——各方法均未达其理论上限，故结论应视为"受控工作流级比较"；分类数据集仅 12 个，泛化性证据较弱；本文结果对 TabPFN 而言偏保守。
AI.conclusion: 表格基础模型可以在不替代既有化学计量流程的前提下，作为 NIR 校准的补充手段。回归任务中，预处理优化后的 TabPFN-opt 凭借预训练先验与零样本推理能力取得最佳综合表现，并在不同数据集规模上稳定优于 PLS；分类任务中甚至无需预处理即可达到最佳平均秩，说明 TabPFN 能直接从原始谱中获取判别信息。这表明 PFN 式的"摊销式优化"在中小样本、光谱数据稀缺的场景中具有结构性优势（无需逐数据集训练与调参）。但作者同时强调三点关键限制与启示：(1) 峰值预测性能与稳健性是互补属性——在光谱离群点与目标外推子集上，经典 PLS/化学计量模型仍具竞争力甚至相对排名更优，因此部署时必须配套不确定性估计与告警机制；(2) 预处理仍是必需的，TabPFN 并不取代 Savitzky–Golay、SNV 等物理启发的校正，而应被"整合进"预处理工作流，Savitzky–Golay 平滑/导数是其主要增益来源；(3) 通用表格先验与光谱有序平滑结构之间存在错配，下一步应发展面向 NIRS 数据的专用先验/预训练策略、更适合强共线性数据的降维方式，以及更充分的超参优化。总体而言，PLS 仍是稳健的标准参考，Ridge 是被低估的强基线，TabPFN 则在中小样本场景下最具实用竞争力；当前证据应视为受控条件下的大规模稳健比较，而非各方法潜力上限的定论。

title: Token-weighted Direct Preference Optimization with Attention
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns Large Language Models with human preferences without the need for a separate reward model. However, DPO treats all tokens in responses equally, neglecting the differing importance of individual tokens. Existing token-level PO methods compute the token weights using either token-position-based heuristic functions or probability estimates given by a separately trained model, which lacks robustness and incurs extra training cost. In contrast, we propose Token-weighted DPO (TwDPO) -- a novel training objective grounded on token-weighted RL -- and AttentionPO -- an instantiation of TwDPO that uses attention from the LLM itself to estimate token weights. AttentionPO prompts the LLM to serve as a pairwise judge and check where the model attends when comparing the responses. This design makes AttentionPO content-aware, adjusting weights based on response content, and efficient, incurring only two extra forward passes per example. Experiment results show that AttentionPO significantly improves performance on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and ArenaHard, surpassing existing Preference Optimization methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AttentionPO，一种利用LLM自身注意力机制实现token加权偏好优化的新方法。该方法让模型通过自我注意力判断响应的关键token，实现内容感知的加权训练，仅需两个额外前向传播即可完成，在多个基准测试中取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有DPO方法对响应中所有token一视同仁，忽略了不同token的重要性差异。而现有的token级偏好优化方法依赖于token位置启发式函数或单独训练的模型来计算token权重，缺乏鲁棒性且带来额外训练成本。
AI.method: 提出TwDPO（Token-weighted DPO）作为基于token加权强化学习的训练目标，并设计AttentionPO作为其实例化实现。AttentionPO让LLM扮演成对判断者，通过分析模型在比较两个响应时的注意力分布来估计token权重。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval、MT-Bench和ArenaHard三个基准测试中，AttentionPO显著提升了性能表现，超过了现有的偏好优化方法。
AI.conclusion: AttentionPO通过利用LLM自身的注意力机制来估计token权重，实现了内容感知且高效的token加权偏好优化，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。

title: "Refactoring Runaway": Understanding and Mitigating Tangled Refactorings in Coding Agents for Issue Resolution
summary: Recent advances in coding agents have shown remarkable progress in software issue resolution. In practice, real-world issues are typically bug fixes or feature requests in which human developers naturally incorporate refactoring as part of the resolution process, resulting in tangled refactoring. Since LLMs are trained on large-scale open-source repositories, coding agents may inherit such behaviors. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on Multi-SWE-bench, analyzing 3,691 valid patches generated by three agent frameworks with 12 LLMs. We find that coding agents introduce tangled refactorings less frequently (21.43% vs. 36.72%) and with lower intensity (0.66 vs. 1.75) than human developers, although they exhibit a broader diversity of refactoring types. Logistic regression analysis further shows that tangled refactorings are strongly associated with reduced compilability, while exhibiting no significant association with functional correctness. Based on these findings, we propose a refactoring-aware refinement approach that assesses the necessity and safety of tangled refactorings and selectively removes or repairs problematic operations. Our approach improves compilability from 19.34% to 38.33%, and additionally resolves 2.79% previously unresolved issues. Overall, this work presents the first step towards understanding tangled refactoring practices in agentic issue resolution and opens up avenues for future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文对智能体代码修复中的纠缠重构现象进行实证研究，发现智能体比人类更少引入纠缠重构但类型更多样，纠缠重构主要影响编译能力而非正确性，并提出重构感知精炼方法可显著提升修复效果。
AI.motivation: 实际软件问题解决中人类开发者常将重构与修复混合导致纠缠重构，而LLM在开源仓库上训练可能继承这种行为，但目前缺乏对智能体代码修复中重构实践的系统研究。
AI.method: 在Multi-SWE-bench上对3个智能体框架和12个LLM生成的3,691个有效补丁进行实证研究，使用逻辑回归分析纠缠重构与编译能力和功能正确性的关联，并设计重构感知精炼方法评估纠缠重构的必要性、安全性并选择性移除或修复问题操作。
AI.result: 发现智能体引入纠缠重构的频率（21.43% vs 36.72%）和强度（0.66 vs 1.75）均低于人类开发者，但重构类型更多样；纠缠重构与编译能力下降强相关，但与功能正确性无显著关联。
AI.conclusion: 通过移除或修复有问题的纠缠重构操作，提出了一种重构感知的精炼方法，可将编译能力从19.34%提高到38.33%，并额外解决2.79%之前未解决的问题，为智能体驱动的代码修复中的重构实践理解迈出第一步。

title: PeakFocus: Bridging Peak Localization and Intensity Regression via a Unified Multi-Scale Framework for Electricity Load Forecasting
summary: Electricity load peak forecasting (ELPF), simultaneously predicting peak timing and intensity, is a prerequisite for effective grid scheduling and risk management. However, existing methods face three limitations. First, they adopt a two-stage predict-then-locate paradigm, which severs the link between temporal localization and intensity regression. Second, they still struggle with the multi-scale representation conflict, leading to peak misjudgment and timing misalignment. Third, the lack of explicit peak timing context during intensity regression causes intensity smoothing because predictions are dominated by global smoothing trends. To address these limitations, we propose PeakFocus, a unified framework for ELPF. (i) A Unified Peak-Aware Pipeline (UPAP) utilizes a triple hybrid loss to jointly supervise temporal localization and intensity regression, alongside a tolerance-based evaluation protocol. (ii) A Multi-Scale Mixing Peak Locator (MSM-PL) exploits coarse-grained features to mitigate peak misjudgment caused by local fluctuations, and injects them into fine-grained features via a cascade mechanism to resolve timing misalignment. (iii) A Location-Aware Decoder (LAD) injects peak timing context into the intensity regression process, providing explicit guidance to counteract intensity smoothing and improve peak intensity estimation. Extensive experiments on the public Electricity (ELC) dataset and our industrial-scale World Large-scale Electricity Load (WLEL) dataset show that PeakFocus outperforms baselines in both timing precision and intensity estimation.

AI.tldr: PeakFocus 是一个面向电力负荷峰值预测（ELPF）的统一端到端框架，同时输出峰值时刻与峰值强度。它由三部分组成：统一峰感知流水线 UPAP（三重混合损失 + 容差评估协议）、多尺度混合峰值定位器 MSM-PL（金字塔下采样 + 自顶向下级联融合）、位置感知解码器 LAD（Context Gate Fusion + 交叉注意力注入峰值时刻上下文）。在公开 ELC 数据集与自建工业级 WLEL 数据集、预测长度 336/720 上，峰值 F1、TP-MSE、BCS 等指标均优于 Transformer、Informer、PatchTST、SegRNN、CycleNet、STID、TimeMixer 及 ELPF 方法 Seq2Peak；模型仅 1.12M 参数，代码已开源。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测（Transformer/MLP 等）以全局重建损失（MSE）训练，最小化平均误差，导致预测被拉向平滑趋势，峰值被削平；峰值事件本身是稀疏嵌入在平滑曲线中的结构性事件，其预测任务（同时预测峰值时刻与峰值强度）与学习主导趋势存在本质差异。现有 ELPF 方法存在三点结构缺陷：(1) 采用「先预测后定位」的两阶段范式，切断了时间定位与强度回归之间的联系；(2) 存在多尺度表示冲突——粗粒度特征缺乏时间分辨率导致时刻错位（timing misalignment），细粒度特征易受局部波动干扰导致峰值误判（peak misjudgment）；(3) 强度回归缺少显式的峰值时刻上下文，输出被全局平滑趋势主导而产生强度平滑（intensity smoothing），峰值被系统性低估。为此需要一种把定位与回归耦合、显式建模多尺度结构并注入峰值上下文的任务专用框架。
AI.method:
整体为共享骨干 + 双头（定位头/回归头）架构，PyTorch 实现，单卡 A100，5 个随机种子取均值±标准差。

1) 峰值定义与任务形式化：用 findpeaks 库的迟滞式规则离线标注峰值（局部极大且后续 ℓ 步内无更大值，敏感度阈值 η，前瞻窗口 ℓ=3(WLEL)/5(ELC)），得到 0/1 峰值指示序列；模型输入历史单变量负荷序列与时间戳特征，输出强度序列 Y_i_pred∈R^{H×1} 与逐时刻峰值概率 Y_t_pred∈[0,1]^{H×1}。

2) 编码器：RevIN 归一化 + 数据嵌入（1D 卷积值嵌入 + 位置编码 + 时间戳嵌入），2 层残差 MLP 骨干（d=256）与可学习投影 Π 生成与预测长度对齐的上下文 X_en_out。

3) MSM-PL（多尺度混合峰值定位器）：向共享上下文注入未来时间特征 M_{T+1:T+H} 并 LayerNorm；构建自底向上金字塔 S^(k)=AvgPool(S^(k-1))（K=2，池化配置 (3,2)/(5,2)），再以自顶向下级联 F^(k)=ψ_k(S^(k))+U_k(F^(k+1)) 将粗粒度语义注入细粒度特征，抑制局部波动并纠正时间错位；F^(0) 作为峰值隐状态 H_pl，经线性分类器 + Sigmoid 输出峰值时刻概率。

4) LAD（位置感知解码器）：解码查询由归一化值嵌入 + 位置编码构成；Context Gate Fusion 用 G=tanh(H_pl)⊙σ(X_en_out) 对编码器上下文做条件调制；随后以解码输入为 Query、G 为 Key/Value 的多头交叉注意力（4 头）+ 残差/LayerNorm/FFN（d_ff=256，ReLU），最终投影并 RevIN 反归一化得到强度预测。

5) UPAP（三重混合目标）：L_total=λ1·L_Global(MSE)+λ2·L_Int(掩码加权 MSE)+λ3·L_Loc(BCE)，权重 (0.2, 0.4, 0.4)；掩码 W 为截断高斯核（γ=1.0，窗口 δ=1）生成的软峰值权重，作为峰值强度损失与定位 BCE 的软标签，实现容差感知监督。

6) 容差评估协议（Condense-and-Match）：以阈值 τ=0.4 二值化概率并把连续高概率段凝聚为其局部极大代表索引，再与真实峰值集合在容差 δ=1 内按时间距离排序做一对一贪心匹配，得到 TP/FP/FN，报告 Precision/Recall/F1；强度误差仅在匹配集上计算 TP-MSE、TP-MAE；并提出 BCS=α(1-F1)+(1-α)(1-1/(1+TP-MSE))（α=0.5）与 PIM=(1+TP-MSE)/(F1+ε) 作为平衡指标。

7) 基线：Transformer、Informer、PatchTST、SegRNN、CycleNet、STID、TimeMixer（均适配为双头+UPAP 以保证公平）与 ELPF 方法 Seq2Peak；并与各基线原版对比以验证 UPAP 的普适性。
AI.result:
主实验：WLEL 上两个预测长度均取得最佳峰值 F1（0.756/0.759，对最强基线约高 7%）与最佳 TP-MSE（0.264/0.317，约降低 15%）、BCS、PIM，并同时在 MSE/MAE/R² 全局指标上领先（WLEL H=336：F1 0.756、TP-MSE 0.264、MSE 0.221、R² 0.833）。ELC 上峰值 F1（0.747/0.731）、Recall、Precision 仍为最优，但全局 MSE/MAE 略逊于 TimeMixer/STID，即在噪声较大的消费级数据上峰值指标与全局指标存在权衡；而在电网聚合型 WLEL 上二者相互促进。Seq2Peak（max-pooling 启发式定位）明显落后，说明结构化峰值需要可学习的定位而非启发式聚合。

效率：PeakFocus 仅 1.12M 参数即在 F1/MSE/BCS 三个质量轴上领先，CycleNet(114K)、TimeMixer(116K) 更省参数但峰值质量显著更差，说明增益并非来自模型容量。

消融（5 个种子平均）：去掉 MSM-PL（改线性层）WLEL 上 F1 下降约 13%，精度下降明显；去掉 LAD 时定位 F1 保持但 TP-MSE 上升，验证「强度平滑」假设；去掉 UPAP（仅标准 MSE）退化最严重，F1 下降超过 40%、BCS 近翻倍；硬二值掩码替代软高斯掩码在 WLEL 上 F1/BCS 变差、在 ELC 上直接崩溃（F1≈0）。UPAP 跨骨干通用性：WLEL 上七个骨干加入 UPAP 后 F1 全部提升，弱模型增益最大；ELC 上多数受益，但 CycleNet（显式周期编码）与 Transformer 略有退化，表明存在数据集相关权衡。超参敏感性：损失权重四种配置结果相当；d_model 从 64→256 提升后饱和，512 在 ELC 上 F1 反降约 6%；K=0 最差、K=2 最佳、K=3 边际增益；编码层数 1~3 与 d_ff∈{128,256,512} 影响可忽略。

可视化：LAD 交叉注意力在峰值时刻显著集中形成竖直亮带，与 MSM-PL 峰值概率尖峰一致；单样例上 PeakFocus（TP=12, FP=1, FN=1）明显优于 PatchTST（TP=7, FP=6, FN=6，且峰值强度平均低估 0.80）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献有三：其一，方法层面提出把峰值时间定位与强度回归统一到单一端到端框架、由三重混合目标（含容差感知的软高斯峰值掩码）联合监督，突破了「先预测后定位」范式与全局重建损失对峰值的平滑抑制；其二，架构层面提出 MSM-PL（自底向上金字塔 + 自顶向下级联注入）以化解粗粒度时间分辨率不足与细粒度局部波动干扰之间的多尺度表示冲突，并用 LAD（Context Gate Fusion + 交叉注意力）把显式峰值时刻上下文注入强度回归以对抗强度平滑；其三，评测层面提出可复用的容差感知 Condense-and-Match 协议（阈值—凝聚—一对一容差匹配，强度误差仅在真阳性匹配集上计算）及 BCS/PIM 平衡指标，并构建了工业级 WLEL 基准（2021–2025 真实区域电网，41476 小时、2944 个峰值，因保密未公开原始序列但公开了预处理与检测超参）。实验显示该框架在两个数据集、两个预测长度上均取得峰值 F1、强度误差与平衡指标的新最优，同时保持较小参数量（1.12M），并对结构超参鲁棒。局限与后续方向：在噪声较大的消费级数据上峰值指标与全局拟合难以同时优化（ELC 上全局 MSE 逊于专用模型），CycleNet 类强周期模型在 UPAP 下可能退化；未来工作包括更长工业部署下的容量扩展、概率化峰值预测以及与实时电网遥测数据对接以支持实时调度。

title: Claim-Selective Certification for High-Risk Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Medical RAG systems in high-risk QA settings are often evaluated through a single answer-or-abstain decision, but mixed evidence may support one claim, require conditions for another, and contradict a third. We study claim-selective certification: each response is decomposed into verifiable claims, scored against retrieved evidence, and mapped by an intent-aware selector to {full, partial, conflict, abstain}. On the primary weak-label certificate protocol, whose real-source-only dev/test rows cover the naturally occurring non-abstain actions, the full system records UCCR=0.0000, PAU=1.0000, PAU Precision=0.9901, and action accuracy=0.9204 on dev (n=314), and UCCR=0.0000, PAU=0.9967, PAU Precision=0.9739, and action accuracy=0.8997 on test (n=319). UCCR measures unsupported-claim risk within the certificate definition, and a source-missing counterfactual slice evaluates abstain under empty evidence. Shortcut controls quantify the action-label prior explained by source and intent metadata, while source/evidence-novel slices characterize transfer boundaries. The resulting interface separates action-label prediction from evidence-linked claim selection under mixed evidence.

AI.tldr: A claim-selective certification framework for medical RAG systems that decomposes responses into individually verifiable claims mapped to certification labels, achieving ~90% action accuracy with near-zero unsupported claim risk (UCCR=0.0000) and high precision (~97-99%).
AI.motivation: Traditional medical RAG evaluation uses single answer-or-abstain decisions, but real responses involve mixed evidence where one claim may be supported, another requires conditions, and a third contradicts the evidence.
AI.method: Claim-selective certification: decompose responses into verifiable claims, score against retrieved evidence, and map via an intent-aware selector to {full, partial, conflict, abstain}. Evaluation uses a weak-label certificate protocol with real-source-only dev/test data, supplemented by source-missing counterfactual and source/evidence-novel slices to assess transfer boundaries.
AI.result: On dev set (n=314): UCCR=0.0000, PAU=1.0000, PAU Precision=0.9901, action accuracy=0.9204. On test set (n=319): UCCR=0.0000, PAU=0.9967, PAU Precision=0.9739, action accuracy=0.8997. Shortcut controls quantify prior explained by source/intent metadata.
AI.conclusion: The claim-selective certification interface effectively separates action-label prediction from evidence-linked claim selection, enabling robust verification under mixed evidence scenarios in medical QA applications.

title: Why Are Agentic Pull Requests Merged or Rejected? An Empirical Study
comment: Accepted for publication in 23rd international conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR 2026) : 5 pages, 3 tables, 1 figure
summary: AI coding agents increasingly submit pull requests (Agentic-PRs) to open-source repositories, yet their performance is commonly assessed using merge and rejection outcomes alone. We hypothesized that these outcome labels do not reliably reflect agent capability without considering review interactions. To test this, we conducted a decision-oriented analysis of 11,048 closed Agentic Pull Requests, refined to 9,799 human-reviewed PRs, and manually inspected 717 representative cases to recover decision rationale from interaction artifacts. We found that rejection outcomes substantially overstate agent error: only 35.7% of rejected PRs reflected clear agentic failures, while 31.2% were driven by workflow constraints and 33.1% lacked observable decision rationale. Among merged PRs, 15.4% required explicit reviewer involvement through feedback or direct commits, and 5.5% showed no visible interaction trace. We further observed systematic differences across agents, with Copilot and Devin more often embedded in reviewer-mediated workflows, while Codex and Cursor PRs were typically merged with minimal interaction. These results reject the assumption that PR outcomes alone capture agent performance and demonstrate the need for interaction-aware evaluation grounded in review behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，AI编码智能体提交的拉取请求(PR)性能不能仅通过合并/拒绝结果评估。拒绝的PR中仅35.7%反映真正的智能体错误，其余由工作流约束或缺乏决策原理导致；不同智能体在审查交互模式上存在系统性差异，提示需要交互感知的评估方法。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体提交拉取请求(Agentic-PRs)的性能评估通常仅依赖合并和拒绝结果，但研究者假设这些结果标签未考虑审查交互，无法可靠反映智能体能力。
AI.method: 对11,048个已关闭的智能体拉取请求进行决策导向分析，精简至9,799个人类审查的PR，并手动检查717个代表性案例以从交互伪影中恢复决策原理。
AI.result: 拒绝结果严重高估了智能体错误：仅35.7%的拒绝PR反映明显的智能体失败，31.2%由工作流约束驱动，33.1%缺乏可观察的决策原理。合并PR中，15.4%需要审查者通过反馈或直接提交进行明确参与，5.5%没有可见的交互痕迹。智能体间存在系统性差异：Copilot和Devin更常嵌入审查者介导的工作流，而Codex和Cursor的PR通常以最小交互合并。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝PR结果单独反映智能体性能的假设，证明需要基于审查行为的交互感知评估。

title: Implicit Safety Alignment from Crowd Preferences
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can reveal implicit objectives such as safety considerations that go beyond task completion. In this work, we focus on the common safety criteria embedded in crowd preference datasets, where different users may express distinct preferences or objectives, yet follow similar safety principles. Our aim is to discover shared safety criteria from crowd preferences and then transfer them to downstream RL tasks to regularize agent behavior and enforce safety. We first show that direct reward combination-optimizing a preference-learned reward model together with downstream task rewards-has inherent limitations. Motivated by this, we propose Safe Crowd Preference-based RL, a hierarchical framework that extracts safety-aligned skills from crowd preferences and composes them via a high-level policy to safely solve downstream tasks. Experiments across safe RL environments and a preliminary LLM-style task with diverse user goals and shared safety constraints demonstrate that our approach substantially lowers safety costs without access to explicit safety rewards, while achieving task performance comparable to oracle methods trained with ground-truth safety signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Safe Crowd Preference-based RL方法，从人群偏好中层级化提取安全技能并组合用于下游任务，在无显式安全奖励下实现了低安全成本和高效任务完成。
AI.motivation: RLHF能够揭示超越任务完成的安全考虑，但人群偏好数据中不同用户虽有不同偏好或目标，却遵循相似安全原则。当前方法如直接结合偏好奖励模型与任务奖励存在固有局限性，因此需要从人群偏好中发现共享安全标准并转移到下游RL任务中。
AI.method: 提出Safe Crowd Preference-based RL框架，采用层级结构：1) 从人群偏好数据中提取安全对齐技能；2) 通过高层策略组合这些技能以安全地解决下游任务。该方法避免了直接结合偏好学习奖励模型与下游任务奖励的简单做法。
AI.result: 在安全RL环境和LLM风格任务的实验中，该方法显著降低了安全成本（无需访问显式安全奖励），同时实现了与使用真值安全信号的oracle方法相当的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: Safe Crowd Preference-based RL通过从人群偏好中提取安全对齐技能并通过高层策略组合它们，实现了无需显式安全奖励即可有效降低安全成本，同时保持与使用真实安全信号的oracle方法相当的任务性能。验证了从隐式人群偏好中学习安全原则的可行性。

title: Expectation Consistency Loss: Rethink Confidence Calibration under Covariate Shift
summary: Confidence calibration for classification models is vital in safety-critical decision-making scenarios and has received extensive attention. General confidence calibration methods assume training and test data are independent and identically distributed, limiting their effectiveness under covariate shifts. Previous calibration methods under covariate shift struggle with class-wise or canonical calibrations and often rely on unstable importance weighting when density ratios are large or unbounded. Given the above limitations, this paper rethinks confidence calibration under covariate shifts. First, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for confidence calibration under covariate shifts, named Expectation consistency condition, which reveals covariate shifts do not necessarily lead to uncalibrated confidence and provides a weaker condition for confidence calibration than global covariate distribution alignment. Then, utilizing Expectation consistency condition, this paper proposes an unsupervised domain adaptation loss to calibrate confidence of the target domain, named Expectation consistency loss (ECL), which is compatible with canonical calibration, class-wise calibration, and top-label calibration. Third, we prove that computing ECL loss has the same sample complexity as Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and provide a theoretically grounded mini-batch trainable scheme for ECL loss. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our method on both simulated and real-world covariate shift datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文针对协变量漂移下的置信度校准问题，提出期望一致性条件作为校准的必要充分条件，并由此设计了一种兼容多种校准框架的期望一致性损失函数，在保持计算稳定性的同时实现了有效的目标域置信度校准。
AI.motivation: Existing confidence calibration methods assume i.i.d. data, limiting effectiveness under covariate shifts. Previous approaches suffer from unstable importance weighting and are restricted to specific calibration types.
AI.method: The paper derives the "Expectation Consistency Condition" (a necessary and sufficient condition for calibration under covariate shifts), then proposes the "Expectation Consistency Loss (ECL)" as an unsupervised domain adaptation loss compatible with multiple calibration frameworks (canonical, class-wise, top-label). A mini-batch trainable scheme is provided with theoretical sample complexity guarantees.
AI.result: The paper validates the proposed method on both simulated and real-world covariate shift datasets, demonstrating effectiveness.
AI.conclusion: ECL provides a theoretically grounded, computationally stable approach to confidence calibration under covariate shifts, validated through empirical evaluation on both simulated and real-world datasets.

title: Diagnosis Is Not Prescription: Linguistic Co-Adaptation Explains Patching Hazards in LLM Pipelines
summary:
When a multi-module LLM agent fails, the module most responsible for the failure is not necessarily the best place to intervene. We demonstrate this Diagnostic Paradox empirically: causal analysis consistently identifies the routing module -- which selects which tool to call next -- as the primary bottleneck across three independent agent families. Yet injecting prompt-level correction examples into this module consistently degrades performance, sometimes severely. Patching an upstream query-rewriting module instead reliably improves outcomes. The effect holds with statistical significance on two agent families and directional consistency on a third; alternative repair strategies at the routing module (instruction rewriting, model upgrade) are neutral, confirming that the harm is specific to correction-injection patching.
  We explain this asymmetry through the Linguistic Contract hypothesis: each downstream module implicitly adapts to its upstream's characteristic error distribution, so correcting the bottleneck breaks this implicit alignment in a way that upstream corrections do not. We operationalize this via a per-agent co-adaptation measure, derived from diagnosis alone, and show it is consistently associated with patching harm across agent families: higher co-adaptation co-occurs with harm, lower with safety. This trend holds across all three agent families, providing preliminary support for the hypothesis beyond a single-agent observation.

AI.tldr: The paper uncovers a "Diagnostic Paradox" in LLM agents: while causal analysis identifies the routing module as the primary bottleneck, patching it with correction examples degrades performance, yet patching an upstream module improves it. This is explained by the "Linguistic Contract" hypothesis -- downstream modules adapt to upstream error patterns, so correcting the bottleneck breaks this implicit alignment.
AI.motivation: The intuition that fixing the diagnosed bottleneck should improve performance is challenged by the observation that correcting the routing module (identified as primary bottleneck) consistently degrades performance.
AI.method: Empirical comparison of patching strategies across three agent families, using causal analysis to identify bottlenecks, and testing three intervention types: correction-injection, instruction rewriting, and model upgrade.
AI.result: Correction-injection at the routing module causes harm; instruction rewriting and model upgrades are neutral. Patching the upstream query-rewriting module reliably improves outcomes. Higher co-adaptation co-occurs with patching harm across all three agent families.
AI.conclusion: Patching upstream modules (query-rewriting) is more effective than correcting the diagnosed bottleneck (routing), supporting the Linguistic Contract hypothesis. A co-adaptation measure derived from diagnosis alone can predict whether patching will cause harm.

title: Contractual Skills: A GovernSpec Design Framework for Enterprise AI Agents
summary:
Skills are increasingly used to package agent instructions, workflows, scripts, and reference materials. In enterprise settings, however, skills often need to express more than task guidance: they must make goals, input boundaries, permissions, evidence requirements, output contracts, quality criteria, verification steps, human approval points, and handoff rules inspectable. This paper proposes contractual skills, a GovernSpec-inspired design framework for organizing SKILL.md files as readable task contracts while preserving lightweight skill discovery and progressive loading. The framework clarifies the boundary between contractual skills, GovernSpec YAML contracts, Model Context Protocol surfaces, tool adapters, runtime guardrails, tracing, and evaluation systems.
  We evaluate the framework with two offline experiments. A text-generation study covers three enterprise skills, fifteen synthetic tasks, four instruction conditions, and eight generation models, yielding 960 outputs and 1680 cross-judge score records. Contractual skills outperform no-skill and minimal-skill baselines on all tested models. Relative to information-rich plain expanded skills, the gains are small and mixed, suggesting that contractual fields mainly improve checkability and maintainability rather than raw generation quality. A tool-calling challenge covers eight models and 192 simulated tool-call records. Skills usually reduce high-risk tool attempts, but model differences remain and runtime tool guardrails are still required. The results suggest that contractual skills are best understood as a governance layer that makes task intent, boundaries, and acceptance criteria explicit, not as a standalone safety mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出合同技能(Contractual Skills)，一种基于GovernSpec灵感的设计框架，用于将SKILL.md文件组织为可读的任务契约，同时保持轻量级技能发现和渐进式加载。通过960个文本生成输出和1680条评分记录及192条工具调用记录的离线实验验证，结果表明合同技能主要作为治理层提升可检查性和可维护性，在所有模型上优于基线但与扩展技能差异不大，且不足以替代运行时安全机制。
AI.motivation: 企业场景中，技能(skills)需要表达比任务指导更丰富的内容：目标、输入边界、权限、证据要求、输出契约、质量标准、验证步骤、人工审批点和交接规则。当前技能系统在表达这些治理需求时缺乏系统化方法，导致任务边界不清、验收标准不明确、难以追踪和评估。
AI.method:
两项离线实验评估：

1. 文本生成实验：
- 覆盖3个企业技能、15个合成任务、4种指令条件、8个生成模型
- 产生960个输出和1680条交叉评判分数记录
- 对比条件：无技能、最小技能、扩展技能、合同技能

2. 工具调用挑战：
- 8个模型、192条模拟工具调用记录
- 评估技能对高风险工具调用的抑制效果
AI.result: 在所有测试模型上，合同技能相比无技能基线和最小技能基线表现更优；但与信息丰富的扩展技能相比，性能增益较小且不一致。工具调用实验中，技能通常减少高风险工具尝试，但模型间差异显著，运行时工具防护栏仍不可替代。结果表明合同技能主要作为治理层提升可检查性和可维护性，而非提升生成质量或作为独立安全机制。
AI.conclusion:
Contractual skills最佳定位为治理层(governance layer)，使任务意图、边界和验收标准明确化，而非独立的安全机制。框架主要提升可检查性和可维护性，而非原始生成质量。

关键发现：
1. 文本生成：合同技能在所有测试模型上优于无技能和最小技能基线；但相比信息丰富的扩展技能，增益较小且不一致
2. 工具调用：技能通常减少高风险工具调用尝试，但模型间差异显著，运行时工具防护栏仍必需

启示：
- 合同技能≠安全机制
- 需结合运行时防护、追踪和评估系统
- 在企业级Agent系统中起到澄清边界和意图的作用

title: Toward AI VIS Co-Scientists: A General and End-to-End Agent Harness for Solving Complex Data Visualization Tasks
summary: The ability to inspect, interpret, and communicate complex data is crucial for virtually any scientific endeavor, but often requires significant expertise outside the core domain ranging from data management and analysis to visualization design and implementation. We present an end-to-end agentic harness that, based on only the data and a high level description of the tasks, independently designs custom visual analysis applications (VIS apps). This represents an important step towards a general AI co-scientist envisioned by many as an autonomous system that can autonomously execute long horizon tasks based on high-level directions. Our proposed VIS co-scientist is an essential component of this broader AI co-scientist vision: a harness that can autonomously analyze data and design visualization solutions using a collection of agents and specialized skills that coordinate exploratory analysis, plan, configure the environment, implement, validate the interface, and most importantly evaluate the overall task completion. Each stage produces document and instruction artifacts that guide downstream work and enable iterative refinement. We validate this approach on IEEE SciVis Contests spanning multiple science and engineering fields. These contests serve as ideal proving grounds because they encode real-world complexity: ambiguous requirements, diverse data modalities, design trade-offs, and task-driven validation. Given only the data and target tasks, our system autonomously produces functional single-page VIS Apps with verified linked-view behavior, highly customized to domain experts' specified tasks and needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI VIS 协同科学家"概念与一个端到端多智能体代理框架（harness）：仅给定数据集和高层任务描述，即可自主完成数据剖析、方案规划、环境配置、编码实现、浏览器端交互验证与整体任务达成度评估，最终生成功能完整、联动视图经 Playwright 验证的单页可视化分析应用（VIS App）；已在 2021–2026 年 IEEE SciVis Contest 多个学科竞赛任务上验证，产物为可用的任务导向原型，但视觉编码新颖性与多步动态视觉推理仍不及人类专家。
AI.motivation: 科学可视化（VIS）是科学发现的关键环节，却长期依赖数据管理、分析、视觉编码设计与前端实现等跨领域专业能力。现有 AI 协同科学家研究集中在假设生成与计算实验，而可视化任务具有独特难点：需要感知原理推理、设计备选方案取舍、将模糊领域需求转化为可运行交互式应用，且"可视化质量"缺乏像预测准确率那样的量化指标，更依赖人机交互与领域专家决策。通用编码助手（Codex、Claude Code）默认形态仅适合良定义孤立的子任务，无法跨越"帮我理解某物理过程"到"可部署 VIS App"之间的鸿沟。因此作者主张 VIS 协同科学家是通用 AI 协同科学家愿景中不可或缺的组成部分，并将其界定为四项能力：获取领域理解并将任务转为具体需求、开展自导向探索性数据分析与推理、设计并实现完整交互式可视化工具、可靠评估分析质量与稳健性并有效传达数据不确定性。
AI.method: 构建围绕主 LLM 代码代理（以 OpenAI Codex 实现，具体编码模型为 GPT-5.4）构建的多智能体代理框架，明确划分智能体角色、工具访问权、工件交接与评估回路。主控 Orchestrator 读取任务材料、启动子代理、整合工件并编写大部分应用代码，目标是生成含协同视图、共享交互状态与桌面式布局的单页 VIS App。其余角色包括：Exploratory Data Analyzer（EDA，剖析数据结构、规模、缺失值、文件格式、访问约束与任务相关变量，产出 EDA Report）、Environment Builder（选定最小依赖并记录安装执行细节，将环境配置显式化以便归因失败）、Planner（把任务与 EDA 报告转为含视觉编码、协同面板、交互状态、风险与验证检查的具体规范，产出设计实现报告）、VIS Designer（实现或修复 3D 体渲染、渐进式流式加载、自定义刷选、联动选择等复杂视图，执行 render-debug-verify 循环）、Evaluator（依据任务目标测试运行中的应用，基于 Playwright-MCP 检查联动同步、截图与控制台错误，产出 Feedback 与 Suggested Fixes）。框架还扩展自定义技能（VIS Skill、Frontend Skill、Playwright-MCP、Scratchbook Skill、Memory Retrieval Skill）与 MCP 连接器，并以受 LLM Wiki 启发的分层记忆层（Markdown wiki 形式，支持浏览、引用与审计）由 Memory Maintainer 在运行后沉淀经验。智能体间通过显式工件（报告、计划、指令、评分卡）通信，形成分层验证与闭环迭代，直至无阻塞问题。
AI.result: 在 2025 年材料发现竞赛案例中，系统仅凭"解决该 SciVis 竞赛文件夹中的任务并给出可视化方案"这一高层指令，运行约两小时（368,616 输入 token、5,183,488 缓存 token、58,374 输出 token 含 19,964 推理 token），生成含候选景观、PCA 嵌入、范围感知关系矩阵、成分–物相–性能通路面板与排名比较区的联动 VIS App。EDA 阶段纠正了元数据中过时的 CSV 路径（真实数据为制表符分隔文件，含 324,632 条候选合金、70 个命名变量），剔除全空变量、构造稳定候选 ID，并依据主导关系选定 YS(MPa) 与 El.conductivity(S/m) 作为主权衡景观。系统恢复出强度–导电率 Pareto 前沿并给出平衡/偏强度/偏导电三类候选；关系矩阵与通路视图指出强度随 Si、Ni、Vf_DIAMOND_A4 升高而提升，导电率随 Al 与 Vf_FCC_A1 升高而提升；Evaluator 判定通过全部准则，并验证刷选可传播到关系矩阵、通路与排名范围，切换嵌入模式可清除局部范围。残余问题为可读性与速度（关系矩阵密集、大区域刷选需数秒）。五位可视化研究者的 1–5 分制结构化审计显示：EDA 假设正确性、关键实现洞察、协调视图支持意义建构、任务完成度得分较高（4.6/4.6/4.6/4.2），删除全 NaN 字段、强度–性能根本权衡、硬度与屈服强度强相关三项领域判断获一致认可（均 5.0）；但视觉编码适当性（3.8）、界面可见性与响应性（4.0）偏低且方差大，KS1295 影响（3.4）与 6082 影响（2.4）两项相关性结论分歧明显，暴露出自动发现的相关性缺少清晰溯源；相比人类优胜方案缺乏视觉编码新颖性。2021、2023、2024、2026 年各届竞赛（气候科学、海洋声呐成像、材料发现、神经科学、地幔对流等）亦全部产出机制有效的 VIS App，说明方法可跨领域迁移，但共同瓶颈在于复杂动态、多步时序视觉推理（尤其 3D 视图的相机运动、过滤与联动状态序列）难以被截图与 DOM 检查有效评估。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：仅凭数据集与高层任务，端到端 VIS App 设计对当前代理式 AI 已具可行性，VIS 协同科学家作为通用 AI 协同科学家愿景的关键组成部分是必要的——自主科学不仅需要计算能力，也需要探索性接口与可解释的视觉证据。同时明确划出当前模型的能力边界：系统能修复界面、组合既有视觉编码，但缺乏支撑动态与新颖界面闭环设计所需的视觉感知与时序理解，且在长任务中评估不确定性与可信度仍薄弱。作者据此指出未来 VIS 研究应把可视化知识、感知判断、人类目标与评估协议作为 AI 科学系统的一等组件；社区角色将上移至定义科学意义建构的抽象、形式化评估标准、编码感知知识并判断可视化何时能支撑可信科学主张。记忆层目前仅作运行后知识沉淀与审计之用，其对后续设计质量的增益尚待消融评估；计划提交由 VIS 协同科学家生成的 2026 年 SciVis 参赛作品作为更强的外部检验。

title: TONIC: Token-Centric Semantic Communication for Task-Oriented Wireless Systems
summary: Tokens are becoming the basic units through which foundation models represent and process information for understanding and inference. However, traditional wireless communication, centered on bit-level fidelity, faces a mismatch between what is transmitted reliably and what downstream models actually consume. This mismatch calls for a communication design that directly accounts for token-level task relevance and downstream model requirements, rather than treating all transmitted bits as equally important. In this paper, we propose TONIC, a token-centric semantic communication framework for task-oriented wireless systems. The transmitter converts each source sample into a sequence of tokens, estimates token-level task relevance, and allocates protection through utility-aware unequal error protection under a fixed channel-use budget. At the receiver, token-level confidence is used to gate unreliable decisions, turning harmful substitutions into recoverable erasures before a Transformer-based completion model restores the masked tokens for final task inference. Our framework combines transmitter-side semantic-aware protection with receiver-side confidence-aware gating in a modular and interpretable architecture, rather than relying solely on fully black-box end-to-end learning. We further establish a utility-aware Bayes-risk interpretation for the receiver-side gating rule and study its interaction with unequal protection and completion. Experimental results on image classification show that TONIC consistently outperforms separation-based schemes, the pixel-domain DeepJSCC baseline, and token-domain baselines under matched communication budgets over AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician channels.
