AI.result: 理论方面：偏梯度 FHN 系统在稳态下激活子子系统的有效响应矩阵 M^{-1} 严格对称，对任意 FHN 参数与节点成立，故 EqProp/NGRAD 的局部权重更新规则适用；FHN 稳态解存在（空间）哈密顿量 H，沿路径图守恒，等价于离散时间下的耦合非保守振子系统；深 EBM 与深 FHN 残差网络均导出显式逐层哈密顿递推，将 EBM 的两点边值问题转化为给定动量初值的纯初值问题，从而单次前向传播即可精确推断稳态（EBM 形式的等价性体现在边界条件差异）。实验方面：5 层 FHN 网络经 EqProp 训练在 MNIST 上取得 2.8%±0.2% 测试误差；哈密顿空间积分与时间演化稳态在约 30 层以内高度吻合，超过约 30 层后前向积分沿不稳定流形发散（作者建议用更高级积分格式或逐层归一化缓解）。作者还观察到训练中偶发 loss 尖峰，猜测源于权重更新使有效增益增大、模型离开初始的图灵图样动力学区域。
AI.conclusion: 偏梯度（如 FHN）系统在稳态上与 EqProp 兼容，其自伴性来源于对称图拉普拉斯；而借助偏梯度系统的哈密顿结构，可为深 EBM 导出精确的逐层哈密顿递推，在给定动量初始条件时以单次前向传播完成推断——EBM 与哈密顿两种表述仅在边界条件上不同。这为训练激活子-抑制子型神经元网络提供了新工具，并为把依赖哈密顿形式的分析工具（如均匀网络空间轨道的分岔分析）引入深 EBM 打开了通道，也对生物网络中普遍存在的激活子-抑制子结构提供了新的解释视角。局限：深哈密顿推断在层数增加时发散，深度 EBM 的哈密顿推断实验与更实用算法留待后续工作。

title: ArabDiscrim: A Decade-Long Arabic Facebook Corpus on Racism and Discrimination
summary: We present ArabDiscrim, a decade-long lexical resource and corpus of 293K public Arabic Facebook posts (2014--2024) discussing racism and discrimination. Unlike existing Twitter-centric datasets, ArabDiscrim integrates platform-native engagement signals, including reactions, shares, comments, and page metadata, enabling joint analysis of language and audience response. The resource includes 200 curated terms (100 racism-related and 100 discrimination-related) with morphological regex families (13+ inflections per lemma), and 20 discrimination axes capturing identity-based grounds for unequal treatment. It also provides explicit attribution patterns. Released under a restricted research-use license for ethical compliance with platform terms, ArabDiscrim supports weak supervision, axis-aware sampling, and platform ecology research. By bridging lexical depth and ecological validity, it establishes a foundation for fairness-oriented, platform-aware Arabic NLP.

AI.tldr: ArabDiscrim是一个十年的阿拉伯语Facebook帖子语料库（293K条），专门用于研究种族主义和歧视问题，包含200个精选术语及其形态变位、20个歧视轴和平台参与信号，为公平导向的平台感知阿拉伯语NLP研究提供资源基础。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集以Twitter为中心，缺乏平台原生的参与信号，无法进行语言与受众反应的联合分析，且阿拉伯语种族主义和歧视领域的NLP资源严重不足。
AI.method: 该研究构建了一个包含293K阿拉伯语Facebook帖子的语料库，整合了平台原生的参与信号（反应、分享、评论、页面元数据）；设计了200个精选术语（100个种族主义相关和100个歧视相关）及其形态学正则家族（每个词素13+变位形式）；定义了20个歧视轴以捕捉基于身份的不平等待遇理由。
AI.result: 发布了首个为期十年的阿拉伯语Facebook帖子词汇资源和语料库，包含明确归因模式，在伦理合规框架下为公平导向研究提供支持。
AI.conclusion: ArabDiscrim为公平导向的平台感知阿拉伯语NLP奠定了基础，通过将词汇深度与生态有效性相结合，可支持弱监督、轴向感知采样和平台生态研究。

title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced video understanding tasks, yet challenges remain in efficiently compressing visual tokens while preserving spatiotemporal interactions. Existing methods, such as LLaVA family, utilize simplistic pooling or interpolation techniques that overlook the intricate dynamics of visual tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ST-GridPool, a novel training-free visual token enhancement method designed specifically for Video LLMs. Our approach integrates Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG), which captures multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions through hierarchical temporal gridding, and Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP), which preserves high-information visual regions by leveraging the correlation between token norms and semantic richness. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that ST-GridPool consistently enhances performance of Video LLMs without requiring costly retraining. Our method offers an efficient and plug-and-play solution for improving visual token representations. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-GridPool.

AI.tldr: ST-GridPool是一个无需训练的视觉token增强方法，通过金字塔时间网格化(PTG)捕获多粒度时空交互，并利用基于范数的空间池化(NSP)保留高信息量视觉区域，在多个基准测试中一致提升Video LLM性能，且无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: Existing visual token compression methods in MLLMs (such as LLaVA family) use simplistic pooling or interpolation techniques that overlook the intricate dynamics of visual tokens, creating a gap between efficient compression and preservation of spatiotemporal interactions.
AI.method: The method combines two components: Pyramid Temporal Gridding (PTG) for capturing multi-grained spatiotemporal interactions through hierarchical temporal gridding, and Norm-based Spatial Pooling (NSP) for preserving high-information visual regions by leveraging the correlation between token norms and semantic richness.
AI.result: Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate that ST-GridPool consistently enhances performance of Video LLMs without requiring costly retraining.
AI.conclusion: ST-GridPool provides an efficient and plug-and-play solution for improving visual token representations in Video LLMs, offering a training-free approach that can be easily integrated into existing systems without costly retraining.

title: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
summary: Computational antibody CDR design methods condition on antigen structure to generate binding loops, yet existing architectures conflate two fundamentally distinct sub-problems: identifying which CDR positions will contact the antigen, and selecting amino acids at those positions. This conflation forces models to learn contact reasoning implicitly through uniform message passing, diluting antigen signal across all positions equally. We introduce ConTact, a contact-then-act architecture that explicitly decomposes CDR design into three cascaded stages: learning surface complementarity fingerprints, predicting CDR-antigen contacts, and injecting contact-gated antigen features into the sequence head. A distance-biased cross-attention module encodes geometric priors favoring spatial neighbors, while a contact-weighted cross-entropy loss concentrates gradient signal on binding-critical positions. On CHIMERA-Bench dataset, ConTact achieves the best structural quality (7% RMSD improvement over the next-best baseline), best epitope awareness (10% F1 score over GNN baselines), and competitive sequence recovery (AAR 0.38) among several CDR-H3 design baselines.

AI.tldr: ConTact是一种新型计算抗体CDR设计架构，通过"接触后行动"策略将CDR设计显式分解为表面互补学习、接触预测和门控序列生成三个阶段，解决了传统方法中抗原信号分散的问题。在CHIMERA-Bench基准测试中，该方法在结构质量和表位识别方面均达到了最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有计算抗体CDR设计方法将两个根本不同的子问题混为一谈：识别哪些CDR位置将与抗原接触，以及在这些位置选择氨基酸。这种混同迫使模型通过均匀消息传递隐式学习接触推理，将抗原信号平等地分散到所有位置。
AI.method: ConTact采用"接触后行动"(contact-then-act)级联架构，包含三个阶段：1)学习表面互补指纹；2)预测CDR-抗原接触；3)将接触门控的抗原特征注入序列头。使用距离偏差的交叉注意力模块编码几何先验(偏好空间邻居)，并使用接触加权的交叉熵损失将梯度信号集中在结合关键位置。
AI.result: 相比次优基线，RMSD提升7%；相比GNN基线，表位识别F1分数提升10%；序列回收率AAR达0.38。
AI.conclusion: ConTact在CHIMERA-Bench数据集上取得了最佳的结构质量(RMSD提升7%)、最佳的表位识别能力(比GNN基线高10% F1分数)，以及在多个CDR-H3设计基线中具有竞争力的序列回收率(AAR 0.38)。

title: A Comparative Study of Language Models for Khmer Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding large language model (LLM) outputs in retrieved evidence, thereby reducing hallucination and improving factual accuracy. Its efficacy, however, remains largely unexamined for low-resource, non-Latin-script languages such as Khmer. In this paper, we present a RAG-based question answering system for Khmer-language telecom-domain documents. We conduct a two-phase comparative evaluation. First, we benchmark three embedding models: BGE-M3 (567M), Jina-Embeddings-v3 (570M), and Qwen3-Embedding (597M), for dense retrieval over Khmer documents. BGE-M3 consistently performs best, achieving a Hit Rate@3 of 0.285, File Hit Rate@3 of 0.700, MRR@3 of 0.221, and Precision@3 of 0.112, substantially outperforming the other retrievers. Second, using BGE-M3 as the selected retriever, we evaluate five generator backends: Qwen3 (8B), Qwen3.5 (9B), Sailor2-8B-Chat, SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat, and Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT, on a curated golden dataset of 200 Khmer question-answer pairs. To quantify system performance, we apply six RAGAS-inspired metrics: faithfulness, answer relevance, context relevance, factual correctness, answer similarity, and answer correctness. The results show no single model dominates across all metrics: Qwen3.5-9B achieves the highest faithfulness (0.859) and context relevance (0.726), Qwen3-8B attains the highest factual correctness (0.380), and SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat performs best on answer relevance (0.867), answer similarity (0.836), and answer correctness (0.599). These findings highlight that retriever choice remains a major bottleneck for Khmer RAG, while generator strengths vary depending on whether the priority is grounding, factual precision, or semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向高棉语（Khmer）电信/ICT 机构文档的端到端 RAG 问答系统，并在自建的 200 条高棉语问答金标准集上做了两阶段对比评测：先比较三个嵌入模型（BGE-M3、Jina-Embeddings-v3、Qwen3-Embedding）的稠密检索效果，BGE-M3 全面最优（Hit Rate@3=0.285、File Hit Rate@3=0.700、MRR@3=0.221、Precision@3=0.112）；再以 BGE-M3 为检索器评测五个生成模型（Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B、Sailor2-8B-Chat、SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat、Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT）的六项 RAGAS 风格指标。结论：无单一模型全面占优——Qwen3.5-9B 忠实度最高（0.859）且上下文相关性最高（0.726），Qwen3-8B 事实正确性最高（0.380），SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat 在答案相关性（0.867）、答案相似度（0.836）与答案正确度（0.599）上领先；检索质量（最佳 Hit Rate@3 仅 0.285）仍是高棉语 RAG 的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）被广泛用于减少大模型幻觉，但其在低资源、非拉丁文字（如高棉语，属复杂的 Abugida 音节文字，存在分词不标准、OCR 噪声、标注稀缺等问题）上的效果几乎未被系统考察；既有 RAG 评测实践也以英语为中心，未必能迁移到高棉语与机构敏感领域（电信/ICT 政务文件要求答案严格锚定于权威文件以维护公信力）。此外，区域化语言模型（SEA-LION、Sailor2、SeaLLMs）能否真正带来收益、以及自动化评测指标在非主流语言中是否可靠，均缺乏实证依据。作者因此希望明确三件事：哪种检索器、哪种可本地部署的生成器、哪类自动评测信号最适合高棉语 RAG，并构建隐私保护（本地部署、数据主权）的可落地系统。
AI.method: 采用“检索器 + 生成器”的标准两阶段 RAG 流水线。数据集：从发布官方 ICT 文件的网站采集开放语料（通知、指南、法律、公告、法令、新闻稿、问答文件等），预处理为 Markdown 并递归分块，保留语义连贯性，每个 chunk 带文档 ID 与 chunk ID 元数据，共 7000+ chunks；另由领域专家构建 200 条高棉语问答对金标准集（含问题、目标答案、领域元数据）。检索器：BGE-M3(567M)、Jina-Embeddings-v3(570M)、Qwen3-Embedding(597M)，经 Ollama 服务化，离线批量嵌入并序列化向量库，查询时余弦相似度取 top-k（默认 k=3）拼接为结构化上下文；以 Hit Rate@k、File Hit Rate@k、MRR@k、Precision@k 评测。生成器：Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-9B（Ollama），Sailor2-8B-Chat、SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat、Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT（HuggingFace Transformers），系统提示强制仅使用检索上下文；单机单张 NVIDIA H200 本地推理。评测：以 RAGAS 为基础的六项指标，使用 GPT-4o-mini 作 LLM 裁判、BGE-M3 作语义嵌入——Faithfulness（原子语句判定比率）、Answer Relevance（由答案反向生成 N=3 个问题后与原问题的平均余弦相似度）、Context Relevance（问题与拼接上下文的 BGE-M3 余弦相似度）、Factual Correctness（TP/FP/FN 加权 F1）、Answer Similarity（答案与参考答案嵌入相似度）、Answer Correctness（0.5×FacCor + 0.5×AnsSim）；附录给出单样本完整计算追踪。
AI.result: 检索阶段：BGE-M3 在所有指标上领先，Hit Rate@3=0.285（vs Jina v3 0.135、Qwen3-Emb 0.175，约为 Jina 的两倍），File Hit Rate@3=0.700（vs 0.485/0.525），MRR@3=0.221，Precision@3=0.112；有趣的是 Jina v3 的 top-1 平均余弦相似度最高（0.759）但检索准确率最差，说明原始余弦相似度不可直接作为检索质量信号。生成阶段：Qwen3.5-9B 忠实度 0.859、上下文相关性 0.726 最高；Qwen3-8B 事实正确性 0.380 最高（SeaLLMs 0.352 次之）；SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat 在答案相关性 0.867、答案相似度 0.836、答案正确度 0.599 上最佳；Llama-SEA-LION-v2-8B-IT 在忠实度（0.556）与事实正确性（0.217）上明显垫底，Sailor2-8B 整体中偏下。五个模型的上下文相关性极度接近（0.717–0.726），表明检索质量是系统级瓶颈而非生成器差异；所有模型事实正确性绝对值都很低（0.217–0.380），因文档含电话号码、URL、法律条款号等高度特异信息。区域化 specialization 并不一致地带来收益，效果高度依赖具体模型（数据量与质量、受约束提示下的指令遵循能力、分词器与 chat 模板、推理框架差异）。指标层面，判定式指标（Faithfulness、FacCor）比相似度式指标（AnsRel、AnsSim、ConRel）更接近专家判断，与电信领域既有结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论为高棉语 RAG 提供了语言感知的评测与选型证据：检索器需按任务实测选择（BGE-M3 明显优于 Jina v3 与 Qwen3-Embedding），且高余弦相似度不代表高检索准确率；生成器不存在“通用 vs 区域化”的简单优劣序，需按目标取舍——重视上下文锚定选 Qwen3.5-9B，重视事实精确复现选 Qwen3-8B，重视整体语义贴合与综合正确度选 SeaLLMs-v3-7B-Chat。评测层面应优先采用 faithfulness 与 factual correctness 等判定式信号，对相似度类指标保持谨慎。方法论上的主要局限为：仅使用固定 k=3 的单轮稠密检索、无自适应/迭代精排与查询扩展；评测完全自动化（英语中心的 LLM 裁判与嵌入模型）可能带入系统性偏差；200 条金标准覆盖有限；缺少人工/专家评估验证指标效度；Sailor2 与 Qwen 系列推理框架不一致（HF vs Ollama）构成混杂因素。未来工作方向为：混合稠密+稀疏检索与查询扩展、引入高棉语专用分词与嵌入模型、开展面向公民的人工评测、在高棉语数据上对小型模型做指令微调、以及扩展到跨语言问答场景。

title: A Camera-Cooperative ISAC Framework for Multimodal Non-Cooperative UAVs Sensing
summary: The detection of non-cooperative unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) presents significant challenges for Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) systems due to the inherent limitations of single-modal perception and the competition for shared communication and sensing resources. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel Camera-Cooperative ISAC (CC-ISAC) framework that employs multimodal sensing to enable efficient UAV beam steering and tracking. The proposed framework employs cameras for coarse-grained airspace monitoring and utilizes ISAC for fine-grained, high-precision sensing, forming a complementary perception loop that enhances both sensing accuracy and resource efficiency. Within this framework, two key modules are developed: (1) a Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA) model that aligns visual and echo-domain features through cross-attention mechanisms, and (2) a Multimodal Fusion-Based Estimation (MMFE) model that integrates historical multimodal data with current observations for robust state estimation. Extensive evaluations conducted on the DeepSense 6G dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an average reduction of 71% in beam steering overhead and 1.69-11.15% in tracking overhead while maintaining high angular estimation accuracy. The CC-ISAC framework effectively mitigates resource contention between sensing and communication, enabling reliable UAV surveillance while freeing substantial system resources for additional communication tasks, thereby representing a practical advancement in ISAC system design.

AI.tldr: 针对非合作无人机检测的资源竞争与感知精度问题，提出CC-ISAC多模态感知框架，通过V2EDA和MMFE两个模块实现视觉与回波域特征对齐及多模态融合估计，在降低波束导向和跟踪开销方面效果显著。
AI.motivation: 非合作式无人机检测对集成感知与通信(ISAC)系统构成重大挑战，主要源于单模态感知的固有局限性以及感知与通信资源之间的竞争关系。
AI.method: 提出Camera-Cooperative ISAC (CC-ISAC)框架，采用多模态感知策略。框架包含两个关键模块：(1) Vision-to-Echo Data Alignment (V2EDA)模型，通过交叉注意力机制对齐视觉和回波域特征；(2) Multimodal Fusion-Based Estimation (MMFE)模型，融合历史多模态数据与当前观测进行鲁棒状态估计。该框架利用摄像头进行粗粒度空域监控，ISAC进行细粒度高精度感知，形成互补感知环路。
AI.result: 在DeepSense 6G数据集上的评估表明，该框架实现平均71%的波束导向开销降低和1.69-11.15%的跟踪开销降低，同时保持高角度估计精度，有效缓解了感知与通信间的资源竞争。
AI.conclusion: CC-ISAC框架有效缓解了感知与通信之间的资源竞争，在释放系统资源用于额外通信任务的同时，实现了可靠的无人机监控，代表了ISAC系统设计中的实用进展。

title: When Are Teacher Tokens Reliable? Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
comment: Pre-print. Code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/PW-OPSD
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student on its own rollouts using a privileged teacher, but its standard objective weights all generated tokens equally, implicitly treating the privileged teacher target as equally reliable at every student-visited prefix. Existing entropy-based OPD methods relax this uniformity by modulating token-level supervision with teacher entropy, but high teacher entropy in reasoning has an ambiguous reliability meaning: it can reflect either non-viable uncertainty or benign solution diversity. To identify this phenomenon, we introduce a branch-viability diagnostic. Specifically, we record next-token alternatives from the privileged-answer teacher prompt, force each alternative after the student prompt plus its on-policy spine prefix, and test whether the resulting student-template continuation recovers the correct answer. On Qwen3-4B, we find that an oriented within-sequence position score is the strongest tested predictor of teacher-token reliability, reaching an area-under-ROC-curve (AUROC) of 0.83; local uncertainty scores are at most 0.57. Motivated by this trajectory-level structure, we propose Position-Weighted On-Policy Self-Distillation (PW-OPSD), which applies an increasing position weight while keeping the same student rollout, privileged teacher pass, and clipped forward-KL target as OPSD. In our comprehensive evaluations with different random seeds, the diagnostic-derived PW-OPSD improves AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 Avg@12 by +1.0 and +1.1 points, and a generalization evaluation on two larger-scale models from different families, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B and Olmo-3-7B-Think, also demonstrates consistent aggregate Avg@12 improvements. These results show that teacher-token reliability in reasoning distillation is trajectory-structured and can be utilized without additional teacher computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了位置加权在线自蒸馏(PW-OPSD)方法，通过位置权重而非熵来衡量教师token的可靠性，在数学推理任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: Standard OPSD treats all generated tokens equally as reliable, ignoring that teacher-token reliability varies across positions. Existing entropy-based OPD methods have ambiguous reliability interpretation in reasoning tasks where high entropy can indicate either non-viable uncertainty or benign solution diversity.
AI.method: Branch-viability diagnostic tests whether alternatives at each position recover the correct answer; PW-OPSD applies an increasing position weight to token-level supervision while keeping the same training setup as OPSD.
AI.result: Position score (AUROC 0.83) outperforms local uncertainty scores (≤0.57) as token reliability predictor. PW-OPSD improves AIME 2024 Avg@12 by +1.0 and AIME 2025 Avg@12 by +1.1 points, with consistent improvements on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B and Olmo-3-7B-Think.
AI.conclusion: PW-OPSD achieves consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks without additional teacher computation, demonstrating that token reliability in reasoning distillation is trajectory-structured rather than uniform.

title: Cross-Lingual Consensus: Aligning Multilingual Cultural Knowledge via Multilingual Self-Consistency
comment: Accepted to The 1st Workshop on Multilinguality in the Era of Large Language Models
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong capabilities across various tasks, they exhibit significant performance discrepancies across languages. While prompting LLMs in English typically yields the highest general performance, it often induces a Western-centric bias, hindering the model's ability to accurately reflect diverse cultural knowledge. We hypothesize that LLMs already possess rich cultural knowledge embedded within local-language representations, but fail to retrieve it when prompted in English. To bridge this cross-lingual knowledge gap, we propose a novel self-supervised framework. Our method leverages multilingual self-consistency to identify the most reliable cultural responses across languages, combined with a self-critique mechanism to transfer this knowledge to the weaker language. Evaluations on the BLEnD benchmark demonstrate that our approach significantly improves cultural alignment-boosting performance on English queries by an average of 5.03%-relying entirely on self-generated data. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that latent cultural knowledge can be successfully surfaced and propagated across languages, enabling more culturally equitable and consistent LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM跨语言文化知识缺失问题，提出利用多语言自一致性识别可靠文化响应并通过自批评机制实现跨语言知识迁移的自监督框架，显著提升了模型的文化对齐能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在不同语言间存在显著性能差异，英文提示虽性能最佳但会引入西方中心主义偏见，阻碍模型准确反映多元文化知识。
AI.method: 提出基于多语言自一致性的自监督框架，识别跨语言最可靠的文化响应，并结合自批评机制将知识迁移至较弱语言。
AI.result: 在BLEnD基准上，英文查询的文化对齐性能平均提升5.03%，完全依赖自生成数据。
AI.conclusion: 通过自监督方法成功激活并跨语言传播LLM中的隐性文化知识，使模型更加文化公平和一致。

title: Knowledge Graph Re-engineering Along the Ontological Continuum (extended version)
summary: Knowledge graphs have become the primary vehicle for data integration and are critical to the success of modern AI, but the diversity of KG modelling practices, from lightweight vocabularies to richly axiomatised ontologies, makes integration and reuse expensive and brittle. This challenge is particularly acute in neuro-symbolic AI, where bridging neural and symbolic components depends on the ability to reengineer KGs to fit new requirements; GenAI now offers unprecedented automation capability, but without a principled understanding of the KG space, such automation remains conceptually ungrounded. We introduce the ontological continuum as that missing conceptualisation, a theoretical construct a theoretical construct whose characterisation framework is defined by two orthogonal distinctions: semantics vs pragmatics, and properties vs affordances; together these define a vocabulary to describe, compare, navigate, and transform KGs across the full range of modelling practices. The methodological stance is empirical: rather than prescribing how KGs should be modelled, the continuum aims to define a theory of the existent, derived from observation of real-world KG engineering practices and whose structure can be made formally explicit, for example, through Formal Concept Analysis (FCA). We ground the vision through a case study on provenance knowledge, showing how a single concern manifests differently across the continuum. We articulate five open research challenges and invite the community to develop the ontological continuum as a shared research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"本体论连续体"(ontological continuum)作为知识图谱(KG)领域的缺失概念框架。该框架基于两个正交维度——语义vs.语用、属性vs.功能——来描述、比较、导航和转换不同建模实践的知识图谱。采用经验主义方法论，通过形式概念分析(FCA)提供形式化结构，并通过溯源知识案例研究验证其实用性。文章最终提出五个开放研究挑战，呼吁学界将本体论连续体发展为共享研究议程。
AI.motivation: The diversity of KG modeling practices (from lightweight vocabularies to richly axiomatized ontologies) makes integration and reuse expensive and brittle. This challenge is acute in neuro-symbolic AI where bridging neural and symbolic components requires reengineering KGs for new requirements. GenAI offers unprecedented automation but lacks principled understanding of the KG space.
AI.method: Introduces the "ontological continuum" theoretical construct with a characterization framework based on two orthogonal distinctions: (1) semantics vs. pragmatics, and (2) properties vs. affordances. Uses an empirical methodology derived from observing real-world KG engineering practices. Employs Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) for formal explicit structure. Demonstrated through a case study on provenance knowledge.
AI.result: Provides a vocabulary to describe, compare, navigate, and transform KGs across the full range of modeling practices. Demonstrates through a provenance knowledge case study how a single concern manifests differently across the continuum.
AI.conclusion: The ontological continuum offers a unifying conceptual framework with practical applications (demonstrated through provenance case study) and five open research challenges, positioning itself as a community research agenda for advancing KG engineering practices.

title: AgForce Enables Antigen-conditioned Generative Antibody Design
summary: Antibody design methods condition on antigen structure to generate complementarity-determining regions (CDR), yet a systematic evaluation of baseline methods reveals that they largely ignore the antigen input. We identify three failure modes that explain this behavior. Antigen blindness arises because models derive predictions from antibody framework context rather than antigen information, producing nearly identical CDRs regardless of the target. Vocabulary collapse reduces predicted amino acids to three to five per position, far below the ground truth distribution in native sequences. Moreover, any model trained with standard per-position cross-entropy converges to the positional marginal distribution, making it provably unable to produce antigen-specific sequence predictions. We propose a novel encoder-decoder architecture called AgForce, that uses a graph neural network (GNN) as the encoder and specialized decoders for sequence-structure co-design. Specifically, we apply framework dropout, gated bottlenecks, and hyperbolic cross attention that prevent the antibody shortcut path. In the decoder, a Mixture Density Network (MDN) sequence head with Potts-like pairwise coupling and annealed Multiple Choice Learning (aMCL) replaces the cross-entropy objective with a multi-component distribution whose optimal solution differs from the positional marginal. An antigen cycle consistency head routes gradients through the sequence decoder, forcing predicted distributions to encode antigen identity. AgForce achieves the best binding quality and sequence recovery simultaneously on the CHIMERA-Bench dataset, improving amino acid recovery by 8% over the strongest sequence baseline while surpassing the baselines across all interface metrics, and nearly doubling the effective vocabulary of GNN methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/ag-force.git

AI.tldr: This paper identifies three critical failure modes in antigen-conditioned antibody design (antigen blindness, vocabulary collapse, and cross-entropy limitations) and proposes AgForce, a novel encoder-decoder architecture that uses GNN-based antigen encoding with specialized decoders incorporating MDN, pairwise coupling, and aMCL, plus cycle consistency to ensure antigen-specific predictions. The method achieves the best performance on CHIMERA-Bench, significantly improving sequence recovery and vocabulary diversity.
AI.motivation: Current antibody design methods that condition on antigen structure suffer from three critical failure modes: (1) antigen blindness due to models relying on antibody framework context instead of antigen information, (2) vocabulary collapse restricting predictions to only 3-5 amino acids per position, and (3) standard cross-entropy training that converges to positional marginal distributions, making antigen-specific predictions impossible.
AI.method: AgForce uses a GNN encoder with framework dropout, gated bottlenecks, and hyperbolic cross attention to prevent antibody shortcut paths. The decoder employs a Mixture Density Network (MDN) sequence head with Potts-like pairwise coupling and annealed Multiple Choice Learning (aMCL) to replace cross-entropy, along with an antigen cycle consistency head to force antigen-encoded predictions.
AI.result: AgForce achieves both superior binding quality and sequence recovery on CHIMERA-Bench. It improves amino acid recovery by 8% over the best sequence baseline while surpassing baselines across all interface metrics, and nearly doubles the effective vocabulary of GNN methods.
AI.conclusion: AgForce achieves state-of-the-art performance on CHIMERA-Bench, improving amino acid recovery by 8% over the strongest sequence baseline, surpassing all baselines across interface metrics, and nearly doubling the effective vocabulary of GNN methods.

title: Psy-Chronicle:A Structured Pipeline for Synthesizing Long-Horizon Campus Psychological Counseling Dialogues
summary: In recent years, large language models have shown substantial potential in psychological support tasks. However, existing psychological counseling data mostly rely on single-turn question answering or short multi-turn dialogues, making it difficult to characterize how college students' psychological distress accumulates, interacts, and gradually evolves over long periods within campus life events. To address this issue, this paper proposes Psy-Chronicle, a structured data-generation framework for synthesizing long-horizon campus psychological counseling dialogues. We generate a semester-spanning temporal stress event graph to model the chronological order and evolutionary dependencies among campus stress events. Through interactive simulation between a student agent and a counselor agent, together with a structured memory integration mechanism, Psy-Chronicle generates long-horizon dialogues with continuity across counseling sessions. Based on Psy-Chronicle, we construct and open-source CPCD, a Chinese long-horizon dialogue dataset for college psychological counseling, containing 100 student profiles, 90,000 counseling dialogues. We further build CPCD-Bench to evaluate models' long-horizon campus counseling capabilities from three dimensions: session-level response, long-horizon memory recall, and temporal-causal reasoning. Experimental results show that CPCD effectively improves session-level response generation and long-horizon memory recall for models with the same base architecture. Meanwhile, improvements in temporal-causal reasoning remain limited, indicating that event-chain organization and causal explanation are key challenges in long-horizon psychological counseling modeling. The related code and data are available at: https://github.com/EdwinUSTB/Psy-Chronicle

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件驱动的多会话心理咨询对话合成框架 Psy-Chronicle：先为每个模拟学生生成画像与一学期（16周）的时间压力事件图，再沿该时间线由"学生代理/咨询师代理"逐事件生成跨会话连贯的咨询对话，并通过结构化记忆在会话间传递上下文。基于此构建并开源首个中文校园多会话咨询数据集 CPCD（100名学生、1,248次会话、54,176轮话语、约425万字，90.1%事件带前驱依赖，中位依赖链长9）及其评测基准，并以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct+LoRA 训练出 CPCD-Chat。结论是：把合成语料"锚定"在学生真实生活时间线上，能有效提升模型的会话级质量、长程记忆回溯与压力适配能力；而事件链组织与因果解释仍是长程咨询建模的难点。注意：摘要中"90,000条咨询对话"与正文"1,248次会话/54,176轮"存在明显口径不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有合成心理咨询语料绝大多数是单轮问答或单次会话（PsychQA、SMILE、CPsyCoun、CACTUS、PsyDial、TuDialCorpus 等），近期多会话工作（MusPsy、DiaCBT、DMT-CBT、LongCounsel-8、Graph2Counsel）虽跨会话推进，但沿"治疗方案/临床状态"组织，并未把来访者在两次会谈之间的生活建模为带日期与因果依赖的时间线。而现实中来访者"因为生活继续才回来"：一次期中考挂科可能在数周后以失眠或宿舍冲突的形式重现。校园场景尤为典型：压力沿学业日历（适应期—期中考—期末—求职）演进，中国大学生抑郁患病率报道为28.4%、约三分之一新生筛查阳性，但校园咨询资源有限且缺乏可开源的中文多会话校园语料（已有中文语料多为通用领域，唯一的高校语料TuDialCorpus仅覆盖单次谈话）。因此作者希望把多会话咨询合成"落地"到学生的一学期生活时间线上，以刻画心理困扰的累积、交互与演化。
AI.method: 框架分三步（全部生成用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash）：(1) 学生画像——按性别×年级×五个压力域（学业/人际/职业/家庭经济/身心健康）2×4×5=40 格全因子分配100份画像，覆盖28个专业与16种MBTI，姓名与MBTI程序化控制以避免集中，背景+核心冲突用字符4-gram Jaccard>0.30 重生成（最终最大相似度0.062）；(2) 时间压力事件图——先采样结构规格（事件数n∈[10,15]、首末周、领域配额、五种压力轨迹原型之一：Escalating/Spike–relief/Oscillating/Late onset/Early crisis），再由LLM生成带周次、领域、1–10压力级、心理影响与 depends_on 前驱的事件；结构用12条谓词校验（schema/结构/依赖无环且指向更早周/轨迹约束），违规以自然语言反馈最多修订3轮，再做机械修复（排序、重编号、剔除无效引用）；100张图全部通过谓词，1,735条依赖边、90.1%事件有前驱、最长依赖链均值8.6，且自发贴合校历（提及期中考的111事件中58.6%落在第7–9周、提及期末的129事件中76%落在13–16周）；(3) 多会话咨询——每个事件对应一次会谈，学生代理可见完整画像、当前事件及其前驱与记忆，咨询师代理只见人口学信息、记忆与由事件图导出的会话目标（不可见核心冲突/背景/人格，须在对话中浮现），会谈遵循CBT标准结构与跨会话6阶段（建信任与评估→识别负性认知→挑战信念→重构认知模式→行为技能→巩固终止），阶段按事件压力级启发式推进（s≥8保持、s≤4加速、末次必巩固），会话内按固定相位表（议程回顾/设定→建立与探索→深度探索→CBT干预→收尾），长度 T=16+round(0.9s)+u∈[14,30]，每次会谈后由记忆整合模块写出结构化JSON摘要（情绪状态、关键话题、干预、进展、目标、作业、200字摘要）供后续双方读取。评测：沿用Wang et al.(2026)协议、GPT-4o作裁判（与生成器不同模型族），4项基本维度（帮助性/共情/指导性/连贯性）+12题WAI-SR（目标/任务/情感联结），CTRS（11项0–6）由LLM评分，MusPsy上复现原论文分数（基本项±0.01、WAI均值±0.05）；训练统一 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct+LoRA（r=32, α=16, lr=2e-4, 2轮，LlamaFactory），以"记忆更新/下一次会谈计划/下一句回应"三任务训练（输入目标仅限咨询师当时可知信息，且屏蔽41%会谈中咨询师先说出本周事件的轮次）；消融三档（w/o dependencies 仅删依赖边、w/o timeline 再随机重排周次、w/o profile 仅留人口学）；动态协议用50名留出学生×10周×每模型500次会谈，客户端生活持续变化，咨询师只见去标识入档记录+记忆+计划，以D1依赖回溯、D2压力适配为主指标，D3跟访、D4捏造、D5情感变化、D6质量为次指标；静态协议6次会谈且事件不变，报告PANAS情感变化；统计用按客户配对、95% bootstrap CI、TOST等价检验（±0.15）、Holm校正。
AI.result: (RQ1)对话忠实于时间线：依赖边相连的会话对前事件锚词回溯率3.53%，未相连1.10%，跨学生0.69%（分层置换p=0.001，8个会话间隔全为正，+2.22pp→+6.79pp）；91.8%的非首访会谈含回指，3,674条被归于来访者的引述中92.4%与原话匹配，109条"来自早期会谈"的引述中18条无匹配但均未虚构轨迹外情节；1,248次会谈中咨询师话语从不含核心冲突子串；会话长度与压力级r=0.668，来访者痛苦/绝对化标记密度与压力级仅弱相关r=0.153（说明压力条件化只是宽松遵循）。(RQ2)CPCD基本维度均值4.95，与MusPsy(4.99)持平并高于所有单会话语料(4.25–4.76)；WAI 4.22，高于全部单会话语料(≤3.95)但低于MusPsy(4.36)，差距在目标(3.95 vs 4.05)与任务(3.90 vs 4.04)一致；两位心理学专家盲评保持该排序（基本4.74 vs 4.80，WAI 4.15 vs 4.31），与GPT-4o单会话级相关仅中等(ρ=0.48/0.57)。(RQ3)消融显示各组件作用于不同属性：基本分几乎不变(4.92–4.94)；仅删依赖边即使依赖回溯优势跌至随机水平(+0.3pp，n.s.)，删全部时间线亦仅+0.1pp，说明"跨会话承接前事"来自显式依赖而非事件顺序；目标/任务一致性在删依赖时各降0.09/0.07，事件乱序后各降0.25(p<0.01)，说明以周为单位的议程依赖有序时间轴；删画像则使情感联结降0.20(p<0.01)、跨学生相似度升为0.015(对0.011)，而依赖回溯保留(+2.2pp)。(RQ4)动态协议下CPCD-Chat依赖回溯D1=+1.1pp，显著高于无依赖(+0.6)、无时间线(+0.5)、外部语料(+0.3~+0.5)、Base(+0.4)；压力适配D2=0.31（Base 0.10、外部基线≤0.12）；无提示主动询问本周情况66%（Base 34%）；捏造率2.9%为训练模型最低；高压力周情绪改善0.15–0.25，低压力周几乎无差；端到端自维护记忆时D1差距由0.5pp扩大到0.9pp（+1.6 vs +0.7）。MusPsy模型会跟访本周事件(0.86)且少捏造(3.9%)，但D1(+0.5)、D2(0.17)仍低，说明仅有跨会话记忆与计划而无事件依赖不足以获得该能力。(RQ5)静态协议下CPCD-Chat基本4.72、WAI 4.02，与MusPsy(4.06)差距0.04在±0.15等价界内；依赖边在静态下对基本分与WAI均等价(+0.00/+0.01)，仅在动态下显现(+0.5pp)，而画像对情感联结的效应在两种协议下均在(+0.12/+0.14)；换用另一LLM客户端后依赖回溯差距缩小但仍存(+0.4pp)；专家对50对动态会话的盲评显示CPCD-Chat正确连接本周事件与前事58%(对34%)、由咨询师先提出34%(对12%)、44对非平局中胜出31对(p=0.01)。
AI.conclusion: 把多会话咨询合成的"骨架"从治疗方案换成来访者的生活时间线（带日期、带因果依赖的压力事件图），并以结构化记忆贯穿会话，能产出质量可比肩现有最佳多会话语料、且在依赖传播、跨会话回指、信息不对称（咨询师不见核心冲突）与压力条件化上可验证地"忠于设定"的数据；以此训练的模型在"来访者生活持续变化"的动态协议下显著更善于把本周事件与既往事件连接、按来访者压力调节节奏、且几乎不捏造既往内容，而在"来访者处境不变"的静态协议下不损失通用咨询质量（TOST等价），说明长程能力可以专门化而无需通用能力代价。作者明确界定该工作为研究资源而非临床工具：合成数据难以复现沉默、阻抗与非线性变化；WAI/PANAS/CTRS均由LLM或模拟来访者代答，仅作代理指标；模拟评测天然偏向在CPCD上训练的模型，故关于时间线的因果主张主要依赖CPCD内部各消融版本对比；事件图在咨询开始前即固定，故咨询无法改变后续轨迹（只能"跟随变化"而非"改变人生"）；单一生成器同时扮演双方，可能使两侧表述趋同（最常见咨询师话术占8.5%）；不涉及危机评估与转介，部分健康事件（饮食障碍、自伤/被动死亡意念表达，已在发布版本中标注）已逼近该边界；且全程遵循CBT结构，未必适配所有来访者。此外摘要与正文在数据规模上口径不一致（摘要"90,000条对话"vs正文"1,248次会话、54,176轮话语"），且表1所列CPCD会话数10–15与"首个中文校园多会话数据集"的定位表述宜谨慎看待。

title: MPDocBench-Parse: Benchmarking Practical Multi-page Document Parsing
summary: Document parsing converts visually rich documents into machine-readable structured representations, forming a crucial foundation for information systems. Although many benchmarks have been proposed for document parsing, they remain inadequate for realistic scenarios. Existing benchmarks either focus on specific tasks or assess only single-page, text-centric settings, making them insufficient for practical multi-page parsing. Moreover, they lack fine-grained evaluation of semantic continuity, hierarchical structure recovery, and visual content preservation. To address these gaps, we propose MPDocBench-Parse, a benchmark for multi-page document parsing in real-world applications. It contains 433 manually annotated documents with 3,246 pages, covering 15 document types in English and Chinese, with diverse layout styles, and supports document-level end-to-end evaluation. We further design a comprehensive protocol for content fidelity and logical structure, covering text, table, and formula recognition, truncated text and table merging, figure extraction, reading order, and heading hierarchy recovery. Experiments show that, while existing models perform well on basic text extraction, they still suffer clear limitations in semantic continuity integration, visual content parsing, and hierarchical structure recovery. MPDocBench-Parse provides a unified foundation for advancing document parsing toward more realistic scenarios.

AI.tldr: MPDocBench-Parse是一个面向真实场景的多页文档解析基准测试，包含433份标注文档(3246页)，覆盖15种中英文文档类型，支持文档级端到端评估及文本/表格/公式/图表等内容的细粒度评估，为推动文档解析技术向实际应用迈进提供统一基准。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析基准测试存在三大不足：(1)仅聚焦特定任务或单页文本场景，缺乏多页文档评估；(2)缺乏语义连续性、层次结构恢复和视觉内容保留的细粒度评估；(3)难以支撑真实应用场景。
AI.method: 构建了包含433份文档、3246页的大型基准数据集，覆盖15种文档类型（中英文），支持文档级端到端评估；设计了全面的内容保真度和逻辑结构评估协议，涵盖文本/表格/公式识别、截断内容合并、图表提取、阅读顺序和标题层次结构恢复等任务。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有模型在基础文本提取上表现良好，但在语义连续性整合、视觉内容解析和层次结构恢复方面存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: MPDocBench-Parse为推进文档解析向更真实场景发展提供了统一的基础，有望促进语义连续性集成、视觉内容解析和层次结构恢复等关键技术的研究突破。

title: $\textit{BlockFormer}$ : Transformer-based inference from interaction maps
summary: Inference from interaction maps, such as centromere identification from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture techniques -- notably Hi-C -- can be formulated as a generic inverse problem: infer a set of parameters given a map summarizing pairwise interactions between entities through blocks of variable numbers and sizes. In this work, we introduce a data-driven approach that leverages shared structure between these maps, such as global alignment between localized patterns, while handling the variability in number and size of entities arising in real-world data. Our approach relies on a transformer architecture capable of handling such variability and a custom simulator to generate abundant, yet computationally cheap synthetic data for training. Applied to the problem of centromere localization, the method accurately recovers their genomic positions across a wide range of species of various genome sizes.

AI.tldr: A transformer-based data-driven approach is introduced to infer parameters (specifically centromere positions) from interaction maps like Hi-C data. The method handles entity variability through a custom simulator generating synthetic training data and demonstrates accurate localization across diverse species.
AI.motivation: Inference tasks from interaction maps (e.g., centromere identification from Hi-C data) face challenges due to variability in the number and size of entities across different datasets. Existing methods may not adequately capture the shared structural patterns that exist between these maps, necessitating a more flexible and generalizable approach.
AI.method: The authors propose a data-driven approach using a transformer architecture designed to handle variable numbers and sizes of entities. A custom simulator generates abundant, computationally cheap synthetic data for training, enabling the model to learn shared structures and global alignment patterns between interaction maps.
AI.result: The method successfully and accurately recovers centromere genomic positions across a wide range of species with varying genome sizes.
AI.conclusion: The method demonstrates robust performance in centromere localization across diverse species with varying genome sizes, showing the versatility of the transformer-based approach for analyzing interaction maps.

title: Do Factual Recall Mechanisms Carry over from Text to Speech in Multimodal Language Models?
comment: In *SEM 2026, the 15th Joint Conference on Lexical and Computational Semantics
summary:
In recent years, several Speech Language Models (SLMs) that represent speech and written text jointly have been presented. The question then emerges about how model-internal mechanisms are similar and different when operating in the two modalities. We focus on how these systems encode, store, and retrieve factual knowledge, which has previously been investigated for text-only models. To investigate mechanisms behind the storage and recall of factual association in SLMs, we leverage Causal Mediation Analysis, a technique previously applied to text-based models.
  Initial results using SpiritLM, a multimodal model integrating discrete speech tokens reveal discrepancies between text-to-text and speech-to-text results, suggesting that the emergent mechanisms for factual recall are only partially carried over from the text to the speech modality. These results advance our understanding of how internal mechanisms encode factual associations in SLMs while contributing insights for improving speech-enabled AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果中介分析研究语音语言模型（SLM）在文本和语音两种模态下编码、存储和检索事实知识的内部机制差异。研究使用SpiritLM模型，发现文本到文本和语音到文本任务的结果存在不一致，证实了fact recall机制在两种模态间仅部分共享，为语音AI系统的改进提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 随着语音语言模型（SLM）的发展，需要理解模型内部机制在处理语音和文本两种模态时的异同，尤其是事实知识的编码、存储和检索机制。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析（Causal Mediation Analysis），对比了SpiritLM（整合离散语音Token的多模态模型）在文本到文本和语音到文本任务中的表现。
AI.result: 实验发现文本到文本和语音到文本的结果存在差异，表明事实回忆的emergent机制仅部分从文本模态迁移到语音模态。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，文本模态中的机制仅部分迁移到语音模态，这为理解SLM如何编码事实关联提供了重要见解，并为改进语音AI系统提供了方向。

title: ExComm: Exploration-Stage Communication for Error-Resilient Agentic Test-Time Scaling
summary: A common failure mode in long-horizon agentic test-time scaling is error propagation, where factual errors or invalid deductions introduced at intermediate steps persist in the agent's belief state and contaminate later reasoning. Existing test-time scaling methods provide limited control over this process, as they often rely on agents to detect their own mistakes, select among flawed trajectories, or refine solutions only after errors have already shaped the reasoning path. We propose ExComm, a communication protocol for exploration-stage agentic test-time scaling. ExComm is motivated by the empirical observation that the majority of intermediate errors in parallel agentic reasoning produce detectable cross-agent factual conflicts. Leveraging the iterative structure of agentic workflows, ExComm periodically audits agent belief states to detect such conflicts, resolves them through a dedicated tool-based verification loop, and returns concise, targeted feedback to the involved agents. Corrections are incorporated through soft belief updates, which append verified feedback rather than overwriting existing beliefs. Furthermore, to prevent collapsing trajectory diversity due to communication, ExComm further introduces a trajectory diversification module that redirects redundant trajectories toward orthogonal strategies. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GAIA with Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite and Qwen3.5-4B show that ExComm consistently outperforms strong test-time scaling baselines, achieving average performance gains of 5.7% and 5.0% over the best-performing baselines, respectively. Further analyses demonstrate improved error recovery, favorable scaling behavior, stronger diversity than adapted communication baselines, and the best performance-cost trade-off among the evaluated methods.

AI.tldr: ExComm通过检测跨智能体事实冲突并使用软信念更新进行反馈来解决长时域推理中的错误传播问题，同时保留轨迹多样性。
AI.motivation: 长时域智能体测试时扩展的一个常见失败模式是错误传播：中间步骤中引入的事实错误或无效推论会持续存在于智能体信念状态中并污染后续推理。现有测试时扩展方法对此过程的控制有限，因为它们依赖智能体自我检测错误、在有缺陷的轨迹中选择，或仅在错误已影响推理路径后才进行修正。
AI.method: ExComm是一种用于探索阶段智能体测试时扩展的通信协议。其核心机制包括：1) 周期性审计智能体信念状态以检测跨智能体事实冲突；2) 通过专用工具验证循环解决冲突；3) 向涉事智能体返回简洁、有针对性的反馈；4) 采用软信念更新——仅追加已验证反馈而非覆盖现有信念；5) 引入轨迹多样化模块，将冗余轨迹重定向至正交策略以防止通信导致的轨迹多样性崩溃。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和GAIA上使用Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite和Qwen3.5-4B进行的实验表明，ExComm始终优于强测试时扩展基准方法，分别实现5.7%和5.0%的平均性能提升。进一步分析表明其具有改进的错误恢复能力、良好的扩展行为、强于适应版通信基准的多样性，以及评估方法中最佳的性能-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ExComm在多个基准测试中实现了最佳的性能-成本权衡，显著改善了错误恢复能力，表现出良好的扩展行为，并有效维持了轨迹多样性。

title: Alike Parts: A Feature-Informed Approach to Local and Global Prototype Explanations
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science (IJAMCS)
summary: Prototype-based explanations offer an intuitive, example-based approach to support the interpretability of machine learning black box classifiers but often lack feature-level granularity. We introduce a framework that integrates feature importance at two levels to address this gap. First, for local explanations, we propose \textit{alike parts}: a method that uses feature importance scores to highlight the most relevant, shared feature subsets between a classified instance and its nearest prototype, guiding user attention. Second, we augment the global prototype selection objective function with a feature importance term to actively promote diversity in the feature attributions of the selected prototypes. Experiments on six benchmark datasets show that this augmented selection process maintains or, in some cases, increases the prediction fidelity of the surrogate model, suggesting that feature diversity does not compromise model fidelity.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes a two-level feature importance framework for prototype-based interpretability: a local "alike parts" method highlights shared features between instances and prototypes, while an augmented global selection promotes feature attribution diversity without sacrificing model fidelity.
AI.motivation: Prototype-based explanations provide intuitive example-based interpretability but lack feature-level granularity, limiting their effectiveness for understanding classifier decisions.
AI.method: (1) Alike parts: local explanation method using feature importance scores to identify shared relevant feature subsets between a classified instance and its nearest prototype. (2) Augmented global prototype selection objective function incorporating a feature importance term to promote diversity in feature attributions of selected prototypes.
AI.result: Experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that the augmented prototype selection maintains or improves prediction fidelity of the surrogate model.
AI.conclusion: Feature diversity in prototype selection does not compromise model fidelity; the approach successfully integrates feature importance at both local and global levels for enhanced interpretability.

title: Structure Retention in Embedding Spaces as a Predictor of Benchmark Performance
summary: In this paper, we show that high-performing embedding models organize their embedding spaces in a consistent way. We evaluate 25 contemporary embedding models on five MTEB tasks spanning four diverse task categories (retrieval, bitext mining, pair classification, and summarization) in both English and multilingual settings, and reveal that nearest-neighbor overlap and magnitude differences in independent component analysis (ICA) between paired text instances strongly correlate (even up to 0.97) with performance on the given task. Ultimately, we show that embedding tasks display varying degrees of linearity and reliance on retention of local information. Our results further the understanding of embeddings, their relation to model performance, and shed light on possible future training objectives and optimizing conditional embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过评估25个嵌入模型在5个MTEB任务上的表现，揭示了嵌入空间的组织结构与任务性能之间存在强相关性（最高达0.97），并发现不同任务对线性和局部信息保留的依赖程度不同，为优化训练目标提供了理论依据。
AI.motivation: 理解高性能嵌入模型的嵌入空间组织方式，以及嵌入特性与具体任务性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 在英语和多语言环境下，评估25个当代嵌入模型在5个MTEB任务上的表现；利用最近邻重叠度和独立成分分析(ICA)的幅度差异进行量化分析。
AI.result: 最近邻重叠度和ICA幅度差异与任务性能高度相关（相关系数高达0.97），且不同任务类别对这些特性的依赖程度存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入任务表现出不同程度的线性和局部信息保留依赖性；研究结果为未来训练目标的改进和条件嵌入优化提供了方向。

title: ArborKV: Structure-Aware KV Cache Management for Scaling Tree-based LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in LLM reasoning has increasingly shifted from single-pass generation to explicit search over intermediate reasoning states. Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) organizes inference to tree-structured search with branching and backtracking, but it substantially amplifies the Key--Value (KV) cache: retaining KV states for a frontier of partial trajectories quickly becomes a memory bottleneck that limits throughput and constrains search depth and width under fixed hardware budgets. We address this challenge by observing that KV reuse in ToT-style inference is governed by search dynamics: near-term decoding depends primarily on the active branch and its ancestors, whereas inactive subtrees have low short-term reuse probability yet must remain recoverable for backtracking. Motivated by this, we propose ArborKV, a structure-aware eviction framework that couples a lightweight value estimator with a tree-aware allocation policy, and performs purely token-extractive eviction with lazy rehydration to support revisits. Experiments on ToT-style reasoning benchmarks show that ArborKV achieves up to ~4x peak KV-memory reduction while preserving near-full-retention accuracy, enabling larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory.

AI.tldr: ArborKV addresses memory bottlenecks in Tree-of-Thoughts LLM reasoning by using a structure-aware eviction framework with value estimation and lazy rehydration, achieving ~4x KV-memory reduction while maintaining accuracy.
AI.motivation: Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) reasoning amplifies KV cache memory usage, causing memory bottlenecks that limit throughput, search depth, and width under fixed hardware budgets.
AI.method: ArborKV employs a lightweight value estimator, tree-aware allocation policy, token-extractive eviction, and lazy rehydration to support revisits.
AI.result: Up to ~4x peak KV-memory reduction while preserving near-full-retention accuracy.
AI.conclusion: ArborKV enables larger search configurations under fixed device budgets that would otherwise run out of memory.

title: Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 36 pages, 11 figures
summary: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos. Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, ReLU-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength. The distinction traces to the analytic structure of the correlation map: smooth activations admit a Taylor expansion near perfect alignment, while kinked activations develop a branch point with universal non-analyticity. As a corollary, the framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; a rank-flow tie-breaker then selects front-loaded schedules, substantially reducing held-out test loss at no extra computational cost, with accuracy gains as a consistent secondary effect. We test the predictions in MLPs and Vision Transformers and discuss CNN/ResNet extensions.

AI.tldr: A mean-field theory establishes dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation, revealing that smooth vs. kinked activations form distinct universality classes, with practical front-loaded dropout scheduling reducing test loss at no extra cost.
AI.motivation: Dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization, requiring theoretical understanding of its mechanism.
AI.method: Mean-field theory treating dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos; derives critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay.
AI.result: Smooth activations (Taylor-expansible) and kinked/ReLU activations (branch-point non-analyticity) constitute distinct universality classes with different critical exponents and universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength.
AI.conclusion: Framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; rank-flow tie-breaker selects front-loaded schedules, substantially reducing test loss at no extra computational cost, with accuracy gains. Verified in MLPs and Vision Transformers, with CNN/ResNet extensions discussed.

title: Evaluation of Chunking Strategies for Effective Text Embedding in Low-Resource Language on Agricultural Documents
summary: In this study, we compare the performance of four text chunking approaches: Recursive, Khmer-Aware, Sentence-Based, and LLM-Based within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework applied to Khmer agricultural documents. The document chunks are encoded using the BGE-M3 multilingual embedding model and retrieved using the FAISS library. Performance is evaluated using four metrics: Average Retrieval Score (L2 distance), Answer Relevance, Khmer Coverage, and Khmer Intersection over Union, all measured against ground-truth question-answer pairs. For evaluation, we perform 5-fold cross-validation over 18 question-answer pairs. We observe the best performance for the character-based Recursive chunking method with a chunk size of 300 characters, achieving the lowest L2 distance (0.4295 +- 0.0461), highest Answer Relevance (0.8663 +- 0.0199), and highest Khmer IoU (0.6441 +- 0.0347). A paired t-test shows a statistically significant improvement over the Sentence-Based chunking method in L2 distance (p = 0.0121). These results highlight the importance of segmentation granularity and structural preservation for optimizing dense retrieval in morphologically complex, low-resource languages such as Khmer.

AI.tldr: This paper evaluates four chunking strategies for Khmer agricultural documents in a RAG system. Character-based Recursive chunking with 300-character segments outperforms sentence-based and LLM-based approaches, achieving the best retrieval accuracy and answer relevance. The findings emphasize that finer segmentation granularity and structural preservation are essential for dense retrieval in morphologically complex, low-resource languages like Khmer.
AI.motivation: Optimizing document chunking strategies for low-resource, morphologically complex languages like Khmer in RAG systems, where standard approaches may not account for language-specific structural and linguistic characteristics.
AI.method: Four text chunking methods (Recursive, Khmer-Aware, Sentence-Based, LLM-Based) were evaluated within a RAG framework using BGE-M3 multilingual embeddings and FAISS retrieval. Performance was measured using four metrics: Average Retrieval Score (L2 distance), Answer Relevance, Khmer Coverage, and Khmer IoU, with 5-fold cross-validation over 18 Q&A pairs. Statistical significance was assessed via paired t-test.
AI.result: Best performance achieved by character-based Recursive chunking at 300 characters: lowest L2 distance (0.4295 ± 0.0461), highest Answer Relevance (0.8663 ± 0.0199), and highest Khmer IoU (0.6441 ± 0.0347). Paired t-test confirms statistically significant improvement in L2 distance over Sentence-Based method (p = 0.0121).
AI.conclusion: Recursive chunking with 300 characters achieves optimal performance for Khmer RAG, outperforming sentence-based and LLM-based approaches. Segmentation granularity and structural preservation are critical for dense retrieval in morphologically complex, low-resource languages like Khmer. The character-based recursive method provides the best balance across retrieval accuracy, answer relevance, and Khmer-specific metrics.

title: EntmaxKV: Support-Aware Decoding for Entmax Attention
summary: Long-context decoding is increasingly limited by KV-cache memory traffic since each generated token attends over a cache whose size grows linearly with context length. Existing sparse decoding methods reduce this cost by selecting subsets of tokens or pages, but are designed for softmax attention, whose dense tails make any truncation discard nonzero probability mass. In contrast, $α$-entmax produces exact zeros, turning sparse decoding from dense-tail approximation into support recovery: if the selected candidates contain the entmax support, sparse decoding remains exact. While recent entmax kernels enable efficient training, they do not address the autoregressive decoding bottleneck, where dense inference still streams the full KV cache before sparsity is known. In this work, we introduce EntmaxKV, an entmax-native sparse decoding framework that exploits sparsity before KV pages are loaded. EntmaxKV combines query-aware page scoring, support-aware candidate selection, and sparse entmax attention. We analyze truncation error through the dropped probability mass $δ$, showing that output error is controlled by $δ$ and vanishes when the entmax support is recovered. We further introduce a Gaussian-aware entmax selector that estimates the entmax threshold from lightweight page statistics, adapting the selected budget to the score distribution. Empirically, EntmaxKV drops less probability mass, retains more support tokens, and achieves lower output error than softmax-based sparse decoding at matched KV budgets. On long-context and language modeling benchmarks, it closely matches full-cache entmax while using a small fraction of the KV cache, achieving up to $3.36\times$ (softmax) and $5.43\times$ (entmax) speedup over full attention baselines at 1M context length. Code available at: https://github.com/deep-spin/entmaxkv.

AI.tldr: 针对长上下文解码中KV-cache内存瓶颈问题，提出基于α-entmax稀疏性的EntmaxKV框架，通过查询感知页面评分和支持感知候选选择实现解码阶段的精确稀疏注意力计算，相比全注意力基线在1M上下文长度下实现最高5.43倍加速。
AI.motivation: 当前长上下文解码受KV-cache内存带宽限制严重。现有稀疏解码方法专为softmax注意力设计，但softmax的密集尾部特性使得任何截断都会丢失非零概率质量，导致近似误差累积。
AI.method: 提出EntmaxKV框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)查询感知的页面评分机制，(2)支持感知的候选token选择策略，(3)稀疏entmax注意力计算。引入高斯感知的entmax选择器，通过轻量级页面统计信息估计entmax阈值，自适应调整选择预算。
AI.result: EntmaxKV在丢弃更少概率质量的同时保留更多支持token，在相同KV预算下实现更低输出误差。在长上下文和语言建模基准测试中，使用KV缓存的一小部分即达到接近全缓存entmax的性能，在1M上下文长度下实现最高3.36倍(softmax)和5.43倍(entmax)加速。
AI.conclusion: EntmaxKV通过利用α-entmax的稀疏性实现精确支持恢复，在1M上下文长度下相比全注意力基线实现最高5.43倍加速，同时保持接近全缓存entmax的性能。

title: Audience Engagement with Arabic Women's Social Empowerment and Wellbeing: A Decadal Corpus
summary: This paper presents the Arabic Women and Society Corpus, a ten year collection of 252,487 public Arabic Facebook posts related to women's empowerment and social wellbeing. The corpus was collected from 51,660 pages across 77 countries between 2013 and 2024, resulting in more than 267 million user interactions. Each post includes engagement metrics such as shares, comments, and emotional reactions, providing a unique view of audience sentiment and social attention. The data were processed using an automated pipeline with language identification, normalization, and metadata cleaning to ensure reliability and reproducibility. The corpus enables large scale analysis of gender discourse, social reform, and emotional engagement across Arabic dialects. It supports research in Arabic natural language processing, computational social science, and digital communication studies. The dataset and accompanying documentation will be released under request for research use.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个跨越10年、涵盖77国的阿拉伯语Facebook女性赋权语料库（252,487条帖子，2.67亿+互动），通过自动化管道处理确保数据可靠性，旨在支持性别话语分析、阿拉伯语NLP及数字传播研究。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语社交媒体领域缺乏大规模、高质量的性别与女性赋权相关数据集，限制了性别话语、社会改革及跨方言情感参与的系统性研究。
AI.method: 通过自动化管道收集2013-2024年间77个国家51,660个Facebook页面的252,487条公开帖子，进行语言识别、标准化和元数据清洗，并提取分享、评论和情感反应等参与度指标。
AI.result: 构建了包含2.67亿+用户互动、覆盖阿拉伯语各地方言的大规模语料库，具备完整的参与度指标和可靠的质量保证。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库为阿拉伯语NLP、计算社会科学和数字传播研究提供了重要的数据基础设施，将公开发布供研究使用。

title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
comment: Code and model artifacts are available at https://github.com/sailing-lab/sr2am
summary: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three systems: simulative reasoning (System II) grounding deliberation in future-state prediction via a world model; self-regulation (System III) deciding when and how deeply to plan via a learned configurator; and reactive execution (System I) handling fine-grained action. Simulative reasoning provides unified planning across diverse tasks without per-domain engineering, while self-regulation ensures the planner is invoked only when needed. To test this, we develop SR$^2$AM (Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM), realizing both as distinct stages within an LLM's chain-of-thought, with the LLM as world model. We explore two instantiations: recording decisions from a prompted multi-module system (v0.1) and reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs (v1.0), trained via supervised then reinforcement learning (RL). Across math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking, v0.1-8B and v1.0-30B achieve Pass@1 competitive with 120-355B and 685B-1T parameter systems respectively, while v1.0-30B uses 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than comparable agentic LLMs. RL increases average planning horizon by 22.8% while planning frequency grows only 2.0%, showing it learns to plan further ahead rather than more often. More broadly, learned self-regulation instantiates a principle we expect to extend beyond planning to how agents govern their own learning and adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SR²AM（Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM）：把智能体的决策分解为三个相互作用系统——System I 反应式执行、System II 模拟式推理（基于世界模型预测未来状态）、System III 自我调节（学习到的 configurator 决定何时以及多深地规划）。两个实例 v0.1-8B 与 v1.0-30B 经 SFT+RL 训练后，在 11 个数学/科学/表格/网页检索基准上以 Pass@1 57.0 与 71.3 达到与 120–355B、685B–1T 参数系统相当的水平，同时比同规模 agentic LLM 少用 25.8%–95.3% 的推理 token；RL 使平均规划时域提升 22.8% 而规划频率仅增 2.0 个百分点，说明学到的是"规划得更远"而非"规划得更频繁"。
AI.motivation: 当前主流 agentic LLM 把智能体实现为带自适应计算的反应式策略（如自由链式思维），期待规划从端到端训练中自发涌现。这种做法既无显式规划结构可分析、可调控，也缺少决定"何时规划、规划多深"的机制，导致训练中推理长度急剧膨胀、token 浪费，而准确率提升并不可靠。作者主张把决策分解为三个相互作用的系统：System I 反应式执行（细粒度推理与动作）、System II 模拟式推理（通过世界模型预测未来状态，为决策提供统一且可验证的规划结构）、System III 自我调节（用学习到的 configurator 决定是否规划、规划多深）。此前工作各覆盖其中一部分——effort-adaptive 只调节推理"量"、mode routing 仅在任务开始时路由一次、workflow distillation 固化规则化流程、世界模型规划则是强制调用模拟——尚无统一架构把三者统一，且不需要按领域手工设计流程。
AI.method: 形式化部分：给出代理—环境模型下的价值函数与信念状态定义，写出基于世界模型的最优策略（最大化模拟轨迹上的期望目标进展）与模拟规划器输出的计划 c_t = (ŝ_t, a'_t, ŝ_{t+1}, ..., ŝ_{T'})；把主流做法写成"不受调节的深思" p_π(a_t|ŝ_t)=Σ_z p_π(a_t|ŝ_t,z)p_π(z_t|ŝ_t)，再给出三阶段分解 p_π(a_t|ŝ_t)=Σ_{u_t,c_t} p_α(a_t|ŝ_t,c_t)·p_{π_f}(c_t|ŝ_t,u_t)·p_κ(u_t|ŝ_t)，其中 u_t 为 configurator 决策、c_t 为结构化计划、α 为 actor；并据此将各类先前范式定位为该分解的子集。实现部分：SR²AM 将 configurator 与 simulative planner 实现在同一 LLM 链式思维中的不同阶段，LLM 本身充当语言空间的世界模型；环境提供 web_search、visit_tool、python_repl_tool 三个工具。监督数据两条路线：v0.1 多模块提示推理（configurator 可自由调用 user_intent/planning/reflection/summary 子模块，o4-mini 采集，保留正确且复杂度足够轨迹，得 4,845 条 / 20.7M tokens）；v1.0 计划重建（用 DeepSeek-V3.2 thinking 模式采集交互轨迹，再由标注模型 ψ 从轨迹反推每步的规划决策 û_t∈{0,1} 与状态-动作-未来状态计划，追加到原思维轨迹之后以保留 System I，对高不确定网页任务把计划截断至 ≤2 步，得 10,787 条 / 39.5M tokens）。训练：先 SFT（Qwen3-8B / Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507），再 RL；奖励为答案正确性、结构合规、答案可提取三信号的分段函数（1/0.8/0.2/0.1/0），采用带非对称裁剪的 GRPO，30B 及以上过滤被截断轨迹以防格式崩塌；RL 数据经难度过滤（v0.1: K=16, [1/16,15/16]；v1.0: K=8, [1/8,6/8]）。评测：11 个基准（AIME-24/25、MATH-500、GPQA-D、SuperGPQA、HLE、FinQA、MultiHier、BrowseComp、GAIA-103、XBench-DeepSearch），指标为 overall Pass@K 与每条轨迹平均推理 token 数；基线分三类：参考系统（推理 LLM、预训练 LLM+工具）、不受调节深思（Tongyi-DeepResearch、MiroThinker、WebSailor、SimpleTIR、WebExplorer、ASearcher 等）、部分调节（A²FM 模式路由、AFM 工作流蒸馏）。分析含组件消融、RL 前后规划时域分布对比、与同基座"不受调节"RL 训练曲线对比、以及同教师不同数据构造管线的 SFT 数据量消融。
AI.result: SR²AM-v0.1-8B overall Pass@1 = 57.0，平均推理 token 3,698（同规模基线 601–11,206），优于同参数规模系统，可比 120–355B 的"预训练 LLM+工具"；SR²AM-v1.0-30B Pass@1 = 71.3、5,518 token，与同工具链的 DeepSeek-V3.2（685B, 73.2）、Kimi-K2.5（1.0T, 70.9）相当，超过纯文本 GPT-5.4-xhigh（68.4）、接近其带工具版本（78.3），在 30–32B agentic LLM 中优于不受调节与部分调节基线、与 MiroThinker-v1.5-30B（74.2）相当但少用 51.2% token；对 Pass@1≥60 的强 30–32B 系统少用 25.8%–95.3% 推理 token。消融（v1.0 SFT 基线 4,925 token / 66.6）：去掉自由思维（System I）准确率跌至 46.8 且 token 降至 1,188；去掉选择性规划（System III）token 升至 5,451 且准确率降至 65.2；去掉模拟规划结构（System II）65.2；去掉规划时域控制（System III）65.3；直接 SFT 教师 CoT 为 3,844 token / 65.3；SFT+RL 达 5,414 token / 72.8（Pass@3 82.4）。RL 使 2 步与 3+ 步计划占比由 5.3% 升至 14.9%，无规划步比例 15.6%→13.6%，平均规划时域 +22.8%（科学 +32.7%、网页 +20.9%），规划频率仅 +2.0 个百分点。v0.1 与同基座 Qwen3-8B 的 RL 对照中，不受调节模型 token 由 ~4,100 持续上升而通过率在第 200 步后回落、上下文溢出 22.4%，v0.1 则 token ~2,100→3,600、通过率稳定上升、溢出可忽略，第 400 步 token 少 34.1%、通过率 56.2 vs 47.6。相同教师（o4-mini）下，结构化管线在 800–3,200 样本各规模上均优于不受调节思维重建（Pass@1 +1.2–3.5%，Pass@3 +1.5–3.4%）；换用更强教师 Qwen3-Coder-480B 后数据从 1,600 扩到 3,200 时 Pass@1 由 60.9 升至 72.9。案例分析显示 RL 后模型产生含兜底策略的"前瞻式"计划并能捕获错误，但也出现简单任务上的过度验证（例 3 反复交叉验证 60+ 轮后因格式错误失分），表明 configurator 的"何时停止规划"校准仍主要来自 SFT、尚未被 RL 充分优化。
AI.conclusion: 自调节模拟式规划通过学习到的 configurator 实现了比"不受调节"或"部分调节"范式更好的准确率—效率权衡：单一模拟规划框架无需按领域工程即可在数学、科学、表格分析、网页检索四类交互推理任务上取得强性能，说明模拟式推理可作为通用规划机制；三个系统经消融证实互补（自由思维保证细粒度推理、模拟结构提供状态预测支撑、选择性规划与时域控制保证效率）；RL 带来的改进是质变而非量增——更长时域的计划而非更频繁的计划、受控的 token 增长。作者认为当前 agentic 模型对超长推理链的需求可能源于"无差别反应式策略"这一设计缺陷，缺少对自身规划的真实自主控制；configurator 作为"自主调节推理过程"的学习机制，原则上可推广到推理之外的场景（如决定何时更新世界模型、何时通过心理模拟进行学习、何时修正自我认知、重新分解长期目标），迈向能自主组织自身行为的智能体。局限：仅在语言交互推理设定下验证；语言空间 LLM 作为简化世界模型预测力有限；缺少对 configurator 与世界模型自身精度的独立诊断评估；上下文保留全部历史、缺少上下文管理与针对性合成数据、工具接口可更丰富；训练结束时指标仍在提升，模型可能欠训练。

title: Amplifying, Not Learning: Fine-Tuned AI Text Detectors Amplify a Pretrained Direction
summary: AI text detectors amplify a pretrained typicality axis; they do not construct an AI-vs-human boundary. On raw encoders before any task supervision, projecting onto centroid(AI)-centroid(HC3) achieves NYT-vs-HC3 AUROC 0.806/0.944/0.834 across three architectures (86-106% of the fine-tuned discrimination ceiling: on RoBERTa-base, raw projection exceeds fine-tuning); on RoBERTa-base, full fine-tuning reduces discrimination below raw on both fluent-formal populations tested. The same axis inverts on non-native ESL writing (AUROC 0.06-0.20) -- a falsifiable prediction unique to the typicality reading. A 24-example frozen probe matches full fine-tuning (0.900 vs 0.895). A closed-form Jacobian predictor parameterises axis-manipulating interventions with R^2 = 1.000 universal, lifts ELECTRA-CE deployment TPR from 0.000 to 0.904 at FPR = 1%, and transfers to three independently-trained third-party RoBERTa detectors at 16/16 oracle-equivalence (57% NYT-FPR reduction on the OpenAI detector). Scope: encoder family; mechanism magnitude HC3-anchored; population-level shared axis with per-text mechanisms varying across architectures. Three operationally distinct probes -- text-surface caps_rate residualisation, geometric signed-epsilon ablation, closed-form text-pair predictor -- agree at cos 0.74/0.81/1.00 across three architectures, confirming observer-invariance. Under matched-TPR-0.90 evaluation, the published intervention zoo (CC, dealign-f2c) is calibration-equivalent across 27 cells (|Delta AUROC| <= 0.0081), and >= 97% of the LoRA->full-FT bias gap on ELECTRA is calibration shift, not learned representation -- the central claim's prediction confirmed.

AI.tldr: AI text detectors do not construct AI-vs-human boundaries; instead, they amplify a pretrained typicality axis. Raw encoder projection onto centroid differences achieves competitive or superior performance to fine-tuning, and the axis inverts on non-native ESL writing. The bias gap between LoRA and full fine-tuning is primarily calibration shift (~97%), not learned representation.
AI.motivation: Challenge the prevailing assumption that AI text detectors construct meaningful AI-vs-human boundaries. Current detectors are assumed to learn task-specific representations, but this paper investigates whether they merely amplify a pretrained typicality axis.
AI.method: Project raw encoder outputs onto centroid(AI)-centroid(HC3) axis without task supervision; employ three operationally distinct probes (text-surface caps_rate residualisation, geometric signed-epsilon ablation, closed-form text-pair predictor); test across encoder family with closed-form Jacobian predictor for axis-manipulating interventions; evaluate under matched-TPR-0.90 conditions.
AI.result: Raw projection achieves AUROC 0.806/0.944/0.834 (86-106% of fine-tuned ceiling, exceeding fine-tuning on RoBERTa-base). The typicality axis inverts on non-native ESL writing (AUROC 0.06-0.20). A 24-example frozen probe matches full fine-tuning (0.900 vs 0.895). Closed-form Jacobian predictor achieves R²=1.000 universal, lifting ELECTRA-CE TPR from 0.000 to 0.904 at FPR=1%. Three probes agree at cos 0.74/0.81/1.00 confirming observer-invariance. Published interventions (CC, dealign-f2c) are calibration-equivalent across 27 cells.
AI.conclusion: AI text detectors amplify a pretrained typicality axis rather than constructing an AI-vs-human boundary. The mechanism is HC3-anchored with a population-level shared axis, while per-text mechanisms vary across architectures. Notably, ≥97% of the LoRA→full-FT bias gap is calibration shift, not learned representation, confirming the central prediction.

title: GHI: Graphormer over Conditioned Hypergraph Incidence for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
summary: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) requires models to bind sentiment evidence to the correct aspect, making it a natural testbed for fine-grained structural reasoning. We introduce GHI, a Graphormer-over-Conditioned-Hypergraph-Incidence framework that is designed as an incidence-based structural reasoning layer built on a bipartite topology. GHI represents diverse linguistic and semantic evidence as token--hyperedge incidence relations, allowing different structural signals to be incorporated through a unified interface. Extensive experiments on six standard ABSA benchmarks show that GHI outperforms all baselines on the SemEval domains, and multi-seed evaluations show stable improvements over strong DeBERTa. Further experiments show that with only 247M parameters, GHI approaches the performance of 11B Flan-T5 based methods on the ISE benchmark. Moreover, it demonstrates strong robustness on the challenging ARTS datasets, maintaining highly competitive performance where traditional models degrade. These results demonstrate that compact structural reasoning remains a valuable alternative to scale-driven approaches for fine-grained tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GHI框架用于ABSA任务，通过超图incidence结构建模实现统一的多样化结构信号整合。实验表明仅247M参数即可达到接近11B模型性能，且在多个基准上超越最强基线，证明了结构化推理是小模型实现精细粒度任务的有效途径。
AI.motivation: ABSA任务要求模型将情感证据绑定到正确方面，需要细粒度的结构推理能力。现有方法缺乏统一的方式整合多样化的语言和语义结构信号。
AI.method: GHI框架：基于二分拓扑的incidence-based结构推理层。将语言和语义证据表示为token-hyperedge incidence关系，通过统一接口整合不同结构信号。核心是超图（Hypergraph）的incidence结构建模。
AI.result: 在6个标准ABSA基准上超越所有基线；多种子实验显示相比DeBERTa有稳定提升；247M参数接近11B Flan-T5在ISE基准上的性能；在具有挑战性的ARTS数据集上保持高度竞争力，传统模型则表现退化。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的结构化推理方法是有价值的替代方案，可与大规模预训练模型相媲美，同时参数效率更高（247M vs 11B），证明了在小模型上实现精细粒度任务的高性能是可行的。

title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Extends arXiv:2605.19576 with the SWE-bench Verified evaluation and a non-divergence analysis (Proposition 1)
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20 rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together prevent expected performance from drifting below the no-skills floor.

AI.tldr: Ratchet通过单一LLM智能体循环（编写、检索、整理、退休技能）解决自进化技能库的生命周期管理问题，核心创新是outcome-driven retirement和meta-skill authoring。在MBPP+和SWE-bench上显著超越基线和消融变体，并从理论上证明了有界容量与退休阈值防止性能低于无技能基线。
AI.motivation: 发现LLM编写的技能相比无技能基线无提升（+0.0pp），而人类策划的技能提升+16.2pp。这表明瓶颈不在于技能编写，而在于技能的全生命周期管理（创建、检索、整理、退休）。现有系统在技能管理机制上存在缺陷。
AI.method: Ratchet采用单一智能体循环架构，集成四种候选 hygiene 机制：(1) outcome-driven retirement 结果驱动退休机制，(2) bounded active-cap 有界活跃技能上限，(3) meta-skill authoring guidance 元技能编写指导，(4) pattern canonicalisation 模式规范化。在MBPP+ hard-100（Claude Opus 4.7）上评估，使用100轮3个随机种子的实验设置。
AI.result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上，Ratchet将pass@1从0.258±0.047基线提升至晚期滚动均值0.584（峰值0.658±0.042），滚动均值增益+0.328±0.018，而无技能对照组仅+0.002±0.005。在SWE-bench Verified上，20轮内峰值提升+0.22。8个消融实验(A1-A8)表明：退休机制和元技能编写先验是核心必要组件，显式去重机制可被元技能机制替代。
AI.conclusion: Ratchet通过单一智能体循环管理技能生命周期，在MBPP+上实现+32.8pp提升，在SWE-bench上实现+22pp提升。最小有效配方为：技能退休机制+元技能编写先验。去重和覆盖守卫等显式去重机制可被元技能机制替代。理论上证明了有界容量和退休阈值共同防止性能漂移低于无技能基线。

title: Value-Gradient Hypothesis of RL for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning substantially improves pretrained language models, but it remains understudied why critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO work as well as they do, and when they should provide the largest gains. We develop a value-gradient perspective of critic-free RL for LLM post-training. First, under a differentiable rollout and additive-noise parameterization, we show that the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation: the backward pass propagates costates whose conditional expectation equals the value gradient. Second, for discrete transformer policies, we show that autodifferentiation through attention produces empirical costates that approximate this value signal, with an error controlled by the sampling gap and policy entropy. These results motivate a decomposition of RL impact into value gradient signal and reachable reward headroom, yielding a criterion for when RL should be most effective along a pretraining trajectory.

AI.tldr: 从价值梯度理论视角分析无评论家RL方法在LLM后训练中的有效性条件，证明演员更新等价于价值梯度传播，误差受采样间隔和政策熵控制，并提出RL何时最有效的判据
AI.motivation: 强化学习能显著提升预训练语言模型，但缺乏对无评论家方法（如PPO、GRPO）工作原理的理论理解，以及对其何时能产生最大收益的理解
AI.method: 建立无评论家RL的价值梯度视角。1）在可微分rollout和加性噪声参数化下，证明演员更新期望上等价于价值梯度反向传播；2）对于离散Transformer策略，证明通过注意力机制的自微分产生的经验协态可近似价值信号，误差由采样间隔和政策熵控制
AI.result: 推导出RL影响可分解为价值梯度信号与可达奖励提升空间两部分，并由此获得RL有效性判据
AI.conclusion: 提出RL有效性的判断标准：沿着预训练轨迹，RL何时能产生最大收益

title: IdioLink: Retrieving Meaning Beyond Words Across Idiomatic and Literal Expressions
summary: Idioms pose a fundamental challenge for language models, as their meaning cannot be inferred from surface form alone. Understanding such expressions, therefore, requires semantic abstraction beyond lexical overlap. We introduce IdioLink, a retrieval benchmark designed to test whether models can link idiomatic expressions to conceptually equivalent meanings expressed in literal or paraphrased forms. IdioLink comprises 10,700 documents and 2,140 queries, spanning 107 idioms with both literal and figurative uses. Each document and query is annotated with spans that convey the core meaning. Evaluating strong embedding baselines (e.g., BGE, E5, Contriever, and Qwen), we show that current models struggle to retrieve equivalent meanings across divergent surface realizations, relying instead on topical and shallow semantic cues. IdioLink exposes key gaps in idiom-aware semantic retrieval and provides a challenging testbed for future models.

AI.tldr: IdioLink是一个用于测试语言模型能否将习语表达与其概念等价的字面或释义形式相链接的检索基准，数据集包含10,700个文档、2,140个查询和107个习语，评估显示BGE、E5、Contriever、Qwen等当前模型在此任务上表现挣扎，暴露了模型在习语感知语义检索方面的关键能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 习语是语言模型面临的基础性挑战，其含义无法仅从表面形式推断，理解这类表达需要超越词汇重叠的语义抽象能力。
AI.method: 构建了IdioLink检索基准数据集，包含10,700个文档和2,140个查询，涵盖107个习语（含字面和比喻用法），每个文档和查询都标注了传达核心含义的跨度；对BGE、E5、Contriever和Qwen等强嵌入基线模型进行评估。
AI.result: 当前模型在检索具有不同表面形式但意义等价的表达时表现不佳，倾向于依赖主题和浅层语义线索。
AI.conclusion: IdioLink提供了一个具有挑战性的测试平台，揭示了当前模型在习语感知语义检索方面的关键差距，为未来模型的改进提供了方向。

title: IdleSpec: Exploiting Idle Time via Speculative Planning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents solve complex tasks by leveraging multi-step reasoning with iterative tool calls and environment interactions, which incur idle time while waiting for observations. Despite the prevalence of idle time in most agentic scenarios, existing works treat it as an unavoidable overhead or propose restricted solutions that overlook varying computational budgets across different tool calls and future observation uncertainty, thereby leading to suboptimal utilization of idle time. In this paper, we introduce IdleSpec, a scalable and generic inference approach that leverages idle-time computation to improve agent performance while minimizing latency overhead. Specifically, IdleSpec iteratively generates plan candidates during idle periods and, once observations become available, aggregates them to guide the next reasoning step. For effective plan generation under observation uncertainty, IdleSpec samples between complementary drafting strategies (i.e., progressive and recovery) from a learned distribution that is updated via posterior feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that IdleSpec significantly improves agent performance in various agentic scenarios by effectively utilizing idle time. In particular, on the GAIA and FRAMES, IdleSpec achieves 55.6% average accuracy with Gemini-2.5-Flash, surpassing the vanilla baseline without idle-time usage by 5.1%. Furthermore, for MLE-Bench, which involves substantial delay from code executions, IdleSpec achieves performance gains of up to 9.1% on the Any Medal rate, highlighting its generalizability to long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: IdleSpec 是一种可扩展、通用的推理时框架，把 LLM 智能体在等待工具返回期间的“空闲时间”用于推测式规划：在空闲期迭代生成 Progressive（假设观察成功）与 Recovery（假设观察失败）两类候选计划，观察到达后聚合这些候选以引导下一步推理，并通过基于 Beta 后验的 Thompson 采样在线调整两种策略的采样分布。在 GAIA/FRAMES 上以 Gemini-2.5-Flash 达到 55.6% 平均准确率（较 vanilla +5.1%），在 MLE-Bench 上 Any Medal 率由 36.4% 提升至 45.5%（+9.1%），同时延迟几乎与 vanilla 持平。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在“推理—调用工具—接收观察”的多步循环中，工具执行与环境响应时间往往远超 LLM 推理时间（如 MLE-Bench 中工具执行是推理耗时的 12.5 倍以上），产生大量空闲时间。既有工作要么把空闲时间视为不可避免的延迟开销（异步调用、缓存感知调度等系统效率优化），要么仅给出受限方案（如 Sleep-time Compute 假设未来查询可预测，忽略各次工具调用间差异极大的计算预算，在 GAIA 上仅利用了 13.7% 的空闲时间，且在 Qwen3.5-4B 等小模型上反而退化）。作者的实证分析给出两个关键观察：(1) 空闲期的推理预算可观但在不同工具调用间高度异质（长尾调用可支持多轮推测计算）；(2) 在摘要、反思、规划三类空闲期策略中，只有“规划”因采用对未来观察的条件化表述而能稳健处理观察不确定性，其余两者因过早对未完整轨迹做出判断而常有负增益。核心问题即：如何以通用、可扩展的方式利用空闲时间来提升智能体性能，而非摊薄必需计算。
AI.method: 两阶段设计。（1）空闲期起草（Idle-aware Iterative Drafting）：与工具执行并行地反复生成候选计划，观察一到达立即停止并定稿，累积集合 D_final = D_prog ∪ D_rec；每轮把已生成草稿回填到提示中以实现对先前计划的条件化，从而在长尾空闲期生成多样候选、在短空闲期减少浪费成本。Progressive 提示假定观察将成功并有助任务、专注向前推进；Recovery 提示假定当前步骤无进展（空结果或偏离目标），提出恰好一个与已尝试方案不同的替代路径。（2）观察到达后的聚合（Aggregation）：把全部候选以“Plan 1..N”形式放入下一步推理提示，作为参考起点而非强制遵循，允许模型综合或另生成更优步骤——因草稿在观察不确定下生成，强行执行反而次优。（3）策略采样与后验更新：每步结束后模型给出二元 forecast 信号 ℓ∈{Prog, Rec}；对 p=Pr(ℓ=Prog) 置 Beta(α,β) 先验（初始 α=β=1），每收到信号即按对应计数 +1 更新后验；每次起草迭代从 Beta(α,β) 采样 p̂，若 p̂>0.5 选 Progressive 否则选 Recovery，后验在随后的空闲期固定，收到下一个观察后再更新。该 Thompson 采样机制既把更多算力偏向被预测偏好的策略，又保留随机探索以应对偏好漂移。
AI.result: GAIA（165 题验证集）与 FRAMES（50 题）：IdleSpec 在三种骨干上均取得最高平均准确率——Gemma4-E4B 30.9→35.5（+4.6%）、Qwen3.5-4B 33.2→40.0（+6.8%）、Gemini-2.5-Flash 50.5→55.6（+5.1%），增益在更难的 Level 2/3 尤为明显；Sleep-time Compute 增益有限甚至在小模型上显著退化（Qwen3.5-4B 上 33.2→29.4）。MLE-Bench Lite（每任务 24 小时预算）：提交率 86.4%→95.5%、有效提交 77.3%→86.4%、Any Medal 36.4%→45.5%（+9.1%），Bronze/Silver/Gold 各档一致提升；而 Sleep-time Compute 的 Gold 率反降至 13.6%（vanilla 为 18.2%）。效率上（GAIA L2，Qwen3.5-4B）：IdleSpec 准确率 31.8%，空闲期 token 5284、测试期 token 5966（低于 vanilla 的 7126），而 Sequential Revision 与 Planning 分别以 1.30×/1.33× 延迟换取增益，IdleSpec 实现延迟近似 vanilla 的帕累托改进。与测试时扩展方法可组合：Sequential Revision 27.9→32.2、Planning 32.2→35.3。空闲时长分析：按 ultra-short ratio 分箱，高空闲组与 vanilla 持平（50.0），中/低空闲组分别 +6.0%/+7.0%。消融：仅 Progressive（44.7）或仅 Recovery（44.0）均劣于两者并用（48.2）；聚合方式上 Best-of-N 59.3、强制采用 57.3 均低于本文的参考式聚合 65.3；策略选择上随机 63.3、直接用 forecast 60.7 均低于自适应后验采样 65.3。
AI.conclusion: 空闲时间是 LLM 智能体中被普遍忽视但规模可观的计算资源；将其用于推测式规划而非盲目预生成辅助上下文，可在几乎不增加延迟的前提下稳定提升任务成功率。IdleSpec 通过“观察不确定下的双策略（Progressive/Recovery）草稿 + 参考式聚合 + Beta 后验自适应采样”这一通用推理框架，覆盖工具增强推理、多跳搜索与执行密集型长程任务三类场景，并可与既有测试时扩展方法正交叠加、兼容各类骨干模型。论文强调该方法与系统级效率优化（异步工具调用、缓存感知调度）及单模式推测（快模型起草、慢模型验证）互补：后者以摊薄必需计算为目标并假设当前轨迹必然成功，而 IdleSpec 显式建模未来观察的不确定性以提升性能。

title: Hierarchical Variational Policies for Reward-Guided Diffusion
summary: Adapting pretrained diffusion models to downstream objectives such as inverse problems often requires expensive test-time guidance or optimization. We propose a principled framework for generating high-quality reward-aligned samples at substantially reduced inference cost. Our approach formulates test-time adaptation as a hierarchical variational model, where control is amortized into a lightweight yet expressive stochastic policy. This formulation naturally supports few-step diffusion sampling: large step sizes enable fast inference, while the learned policy maintains sample quality by providing structured per-step control. The resulting fully amortized sampler achieves a strong quality--speed tradeoff, matching or exceeding recent test-time scaling baselines while requiring significantly less compute. For example, on 4x super-resolution, our method achieves better perceptual quality with more than 5x faster inference compared to the best-performing baseline. We further extend our approach to a semi-amortized regime that combines cheap amortized proposals with limited test-time optimization, achieving state-of-the-art perceptual quality across several challenging inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出分层变分框架将测试时适配成本amortized到轻量随机策略，实现少步快速扩散采样，在保持质量的同时显著降低计算开销，适用于超分辨率等多种逆问题。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练扩散模型的下游任务适配需昂贵测试时指导或优化，计算成本过高，限制实际应用。
AI.method: 提出分层变分模型框架，将控制策略 amortized 为轻量级随机策略，支持大步数少步采样，辅以半amortized混合方案。
AI.result: 在4x超分辨率等任务上实现更好感知质量，推理速度比最佳基线快5倍以上；在多个挑战性逆问题中达到SOTA感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在保持高质量采样的同时大幅降低推理成本，在多个逆问题任务上达到最优感知质量，且计算效率提升超过5倍。

title: Harder to Defend: Towards Chinese Toxicity Attacks via Implicit Enhancement and Obfuscation Rewriting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) require robust toxicity evaluation beyond explicit wording. This setting remains underexplored in Chinese, where toxicity may combine semantic indirectness with surface obfuscation. We introduce Chinese Implicit Toxicity Attack (CITA), a controlled red-team evaluation and defense-data generation framework, not a deployable evasion tool.
