To operationalize this finding, we build the \textbf{Cognitive User Simulator}, which models each user as a stratified persona comprising observable external traits and hidden internal concerns. The simulator produces faithful and diverse interactions, while emitting per-turn state dynamics that track persuasion progress. We then introduce \textbf{Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization}, which converts the modeled concerns and the simulation state transition into complementary training objectives: (1) \emph{Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation} that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of the same policy into its deployable, conversation-only view; and (2) \emph{State-Transition Policy Refinement} ...

AI.tldr: 本文针对后训练 LLM 在主动任务导向对话中表现保守的问题，提出用户潜在顾虑是关键训练信号。通过构建 Cognitive User Simulator 模拟用户分层特征，并引入 Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization 方法（包含 ASDP 和 STPR 两个目标），实现担忧感知行为的跨视角迁移和状态转移优化，从而解锁 LLM 的主动说服能力。
AI.motivation: 主动任务导向对话（如主动销售）需要具有说服力的智能体，但后训练的 LLM 本质上保守；基于奖励塑形的 RL（如 GRPO）仅重新加权已被动策略采样的内容，难以激发主动能力。
AI.method: 构建 Cognitive User Simulator（认知用户模拟器）：将用户建模为分层 persona，包含可观察外部特征和隐藏内部顾虑；模拟器生成忠实且多样的交互，同时输出跟踪说服进度的每轮状态动态。引入 Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization 方法，包含两个训练目标：(1) Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation (ASDP)：将同一策略的特权视角（可访问用户顾虑）的担忧感知行为迁移到可部署的仅对话视角；(2) State-Transition Policy Refinement (STPR)：利用模拟器状态转移优化策略。
AI.result: 用户潜在顾虑作为关键训练信号，可解锁主动能力；Cognitive User Simulator 可产生忠实且多样的交互并跟踪说服进度；ASDP 实现跨视角行为迁移，STPR 实现状态转移策略优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过用户潜在顾虑的条件化实现主动 persuasion；在模拟器上进行训练，避免采样破坏策略；ASDP 和 STPR 两个互补目标实现担忧感知行为的跨视角迁移和状态转移策略优化。

title: On the Sample Complexity of Discounted Reinforcement Learning with Optimized Certainty Equivalents
comment: Accepted to RLC 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2506.00286
summary: We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted MDPs, where a generative model of the MDP is assumed to be available. We consider a family or risk measures called the optimized certainty equivalent (OCE), which includes important risk measures such as entropic risk, CVaR, and mean-variance. Our focus is on the sample complexities of learning the optimal state-action value function (value learning) and an optimal policy (policy learning) under recursive OCE. We provide an exact characterization of utility functions $u$ for which the corresponding OCE defines an objective that is PAC-learnable. We analyze a simple model-based approach and derive PAC sample complexity bounds. We establish that whenever $u$ does not have full domain $\text{dom}(u)\neq \mathbb{R}$, the corresponding problem is not PAC-learnable. Finally, we establish corresponding lower bounds for both value and policy learning, demonstrating tightness in the size $SA$ of state-action space, and for a more restricted class of utilities, we derive lower bounds that makes the dependence on the effective horizon $\frac{1}{1-γ}$ explicit. Specifically, for $\text{CVaR}_τ$ we show that the correct dependence on $τ$ is $\frac{1}{τ^2}$, thus improving by a factor of $\frac{1}τ$ over state-of-the-art although our bound has a suboptimal dependence on $\frac{1}{1-γ}$.

AI.tldr: 研究在有限折扣MDP中，基于生成模型，使用优化确定性等效(OCE)作为风险度量时的风险敏感强化学习样本复杂度。证明PAC可学习性取决于效用函数定义域是否覆盖整个实数轴，并给出CVaR_τ的最优τ依赖为1/τ²。
AI.motivation: 探索风险敏感强化学习中，优化确定性等效(OCE)这一类风险度量下样本复杂度的精确刻画。核心问题：当采用哪些效用函数时，风险敏感的MDP问题是可有效学习的？现有文献对风险敏感RL的样本复杂度分析尚不完整，尤其缺乏对PAC可学习性边界的精确刻画。
AI.method: 采用模型驱动方法，基于生成模型分析PAC样本复杂度界限。通过构造反例证明dom(u)≠ℝ时问题不可PAC学习，并利用信息论技术建立价值学习和策略学习的下界。特别针对CVaR_τ类效用函数，利用CVaR的尾部特性推导其最优τ依赖关系。
AI.result: 1. 完全刻画了OCE目标PAC可学习性的充要条件（需dom(u)=ℝ）；2. 提供了模型驱动方法的PAC样本复杂度上界；3. 建立了价值学习和策略学习的一般下界；4. 对CVaR_τ，推导出最优τ依赖为1/τ²，相比最新工作改进了1/τ因子，但对折扣因子的依赖欠最优。
AI.conclusion: 证明了风险敏感RL中OCE目标PAC可学习性的精确条件：当且仅当效用函数定义域为整个实数域dom(u)=ℝ时问题才是PAC可学习的。CVaR_τ的样本复杂度最优依赖为1/τ²，在τ依赖上改进了现有结果。整体上建立了有限折扣MDP下风险敏感RL样本复杂度的理论下界。

title: In Silico Modeling of the RAMPHO Buffer: Dissociating Informational and Energetic Masking via Phonetic Entropy in Deep Neural Networks
summary: The fundamental challenge of listening in multi-talker environments is a cognitive bottleneck, defined by the Ease of Language Understanding (ELU) model as a failure within the RAMPHO episodic buffer. Current deep neural networks for speech enhancement optimize purely for physical acoustics, failing to account for the cognitive penalty of informational masking. Here, we present an in silico simulation of the RAMPHO buffer using the frame-by-frame phonetic entropy of a self-supervised acoustic model (wav2vec 2.0). By contrasting a semantically intact distractor with a phase-decorrelated distractor (the Concentration Shield) across a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) sweep, we successfully dissociate the cognitive penalty of informational distraction from the physical penalty of energetic decay. The simulation reveals a cognitive-acoustic Pareto optimization problem: destroying a distractor's semantic payload provides a release from informational masking at high SNRs, but fundamentally degrades temporal glimpsing cues at low SNRs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"计算机内(in silico)"的 RAMPHO 情景记忆缓冲模型，用自监督声学模型 wav2vec 2.0 的 CTC 投影头逐帧输出分布的香农熵（音素熵 H）作为"隐式语音处理负荷"的客观代理，从而定量分离信息掩蔽(IM)与能量掩蔽(EM)。通过在 0/5/10/15/20 dB 及 100 dB 基线上对比三种掩蔽体（可懂英语干扰者 ENG、相位去相关的"专注盾"CS、语音谱噪声 SSN），结果出现交叉反转：高 SNR 时 ENG 熵显著高于 SSN（0.16 vs 0.11，纯信息掩蔽），CS 因摧毁语义载荷而与 SSN 曲线重合（完全释放 IM）；低 SNR 时关系反转，ENG(≈0.67) 优于 CS(≈0.85)，因相位随机化摧毁了用于"听觉瞬现"的时间调制与时间线索。结论表明降噪存在认知—声学的帕累托权衡，未来的"认知助听/认知 ASR"需按 SNR 动态调整 DSP 策略并显式模拟回声记忆衰减与工作记忆容量限制。
AI.motivation: 多说话者环境（鸡尾酒会问题）的核心困难不仅是声学可懂度不足，更是认知瓶颈：依据 ELU 模型（Rönnberg 等，2013），正常语音理解依赖 RAMPHO 快速自动多模态音韵情景缓冲对声学特征到次词汇表征的自动绑定；一旦信号退化或语义竞争打断该绑定，听者必须动用有限的自上而下工作记忆去"修复"语音流，产生可测量的听觉努力与认知耗竭。现行工程与客观指标（SII、PESQ）仅评估声学保真度，完全对语义干扰的认知代价"盲视"；同时现有深度神经网络降噪以纯物理声学为目标、拥有近乎无限的上下文与完美工作记忆，其副作用是可能无意中提升背景说话者的可懂度，等于把可管理的能量负荷换成破坏性的信息负荷。因此需要一个能够分离 IM 认知代价与 EM 物理代价的 in silico RAMPHO 代理，用以标定人类大脑计算的"临界翻转点"。
AI.method: (1) 刺激构建：英语目标叙事 + 三种掩蔽体在 0、5、10、15、20 dB 及 100 dB 纯信号基线上混合，活跃语音电平按 ITU-T P.56 活跃 RMS 归一化。ENG 为可懂男声英语干扰者；CS（Concentration Shield）对同一说话者的语音关键频带 1–4 kHz 经 FFT 分离后完全随机化相位，并在 1 kHz 与 4 kHz 交界施加 Hann 窗锥度以避免对抗性时间拖尾伪影，从而摧毁语言载荷与 STI，同时保持全局 RMS 能量与 <1 kHz 空间锚定线索，兼具零 IM 与高连续 EM；SSN 为匹配语音长期平均谱的稳态噪声，作为无时间调制的纯 EM 对照。(2) in silico RAMPHO 代理：使用预训练 facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h，音频重采样至 16 kHz 并归一化，逐 20 ms 帧前向推理取原始 logits，经 Softmax 得到词表概率分布，利用 CTC 线性头获取次词汇表征（作者承认双向 Transformer 使用非因果未来上下文，超越人类实时约束，故仅作为理想化上界代理）。(3) 指标：逐帧香农熵 H[n] = −Σ_{i=1..31} P'(x_i) log2(P'(x_i)+ε)，其中 P' 为剔除 CTC "blank" 令牌后重归一化（K=31）以确保低熵反映真正的音位绑定而非静音；低熵代表自动、无努力的音位解析，高熵代表分布平坦的音素歧义，模拟 RAMPHO 失效并需征用工作记忆。(4) 未来扩展设计：在自注意力矩阵上施加 2–4 秒指数时间衰减惩罚以模拟回声记忆衰减，并通过严格限制束搜索宽度模拟工作记忆容量，同时逐帧滑动目标与掩蔽体以测量造成解码器崩溃的时间重叠 Δt。
AI.result: 音素熵曲线在 SNR 扫描上出现清晰的非线性交叉。高 SNR（15–20 dB）下，ENG 保持显著抬升的熵（20 dB 时 H≈0.16）高于稳态 SSN（H≈0.11）；因目标此时几乎完全可听，该差距被解释为纯信息掩蔽造成的语义竞争。对 ENG 施加相位随机化的 CS 后，熵曲线与 SSN 基线完全收敛，网络将语义流直接判为不可解析噪声，获得对信息掩蔽的完全释放并回到低努力的自动处理状态。低 SNR（0–5 dB）下关系反转：ENG（H≈0.67 @0 dB）反而低于 CS（H≈0.85 @0 dB），即携带更大语义载荷的原始干扰者"表现更优"。解释为时间线索/听觉瞬现边界：未经改动的英语干扰者具有自然幅度调制，网络可在噪声的时间凹陷期提取目标特征；而 CS 的相位随机化摧毁了这些时间间隙，将干扰者变为致密的对抗性能量掩蔽体，使音素歧义急升。由此经验性地标定出结构拖尾的能量惩罚压倒语义破坏的认知收益的确切阈值（结果以 Figure 1 的 SNR–熵曲线呈现）。
AI.conclusion: 该模拟表明在可听性边界上，认知负荷是零和权衡：摧毁干扰者的语义轨道（降低 IM）必然同时破坏时间地标（升高 EM）。因此单纯最大化客观 SNR 的降噪范式具有认知层面风险，下一代"认知助听器"不能依赖静态空间滤波，而必须动态求解认知—声学帕累托优化问题，依据即时环境 SNR 与用户个体工作记忆容量切换 DSP 策略。同时作者自陈局限：wav2vec 2.0 拥有近无限上下文，无法建模人类显式记忆约束，故本文仅为理想化的隐式特征抽取上界代理；后续需通过引入回声记忆衰减惩罚、束搜索宽度约束与目标—掩蔽体逐帧滑动等"人为致残"手段，构建面向临床 DSP 算法的严格 in silico 测试平台，并进一步研究干扰语义竞争淹没受限解码器的时间重叠 Δt 阈值。

title: SciCore-Mol: Augmenting Large Language Models with Pluggable Molecular Cognition Modules
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are central to the one-for-all intelligent paradigm, but they face a fundamental challenge when dealing with heterogeneous scientific data such as molecules: the inherent gap between discrete linguistic symbols and topological molecular or continuous reaction data leads to significant information loss and semantic noise in text-based reasoning. We propose SciCore-Mol, a modular framework that bridges this gap through three deeply integrated pluggable cognitive modules: a topology-aware perception module, a latent diffusion-based molecular generation module, and a reaction-aware reasoning module. Each module is coupled to the LLM backbone through learned representation interfaces, enabling richer information exchange than is possible with text-only tool feedback. Our experiments on diverse chemical tasks demonstrate that SciCore-Mol achieves strong comprehensive performance across molecular understanding, generation, reaction prediction, and general chemistry knowledge, with an 8B-parameter open-source system that is competitive with and in several dimensions surpasses proprietary large models. This work provides a systematic blueprint for equipping LLMs with scientific expertise through decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modules, with direct implications for drug design, chemical synthesis, and broader scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SciCore-Mol是一个模块化框架，通过三个可插拔认知模块（拓扑感知、分子生成、反应推理）弥合LLM与分子科学数据之间的语义鸿沟，使8B开源模型在多项化学任务中达到与专有模型相当甚至更优的水平。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)在处理异构科学数据（如分子）时面临根本性挑战：离散语言符号与拓扑分子数据或连续反应数据之间存在固有鸿沟，导致基于文本的推理过程中信息损失严重、语义噪声显著。
AI.method: SciCore-Mol框架通过三个深度集成的可插拔认知模块解决LLM处理科学数据的挑战：拓扑感知模块、基于潜在扩散的分子生成模块、以及反应感知推理模块。各模块通过学习到的表示接口与LLM主干耦合，实现比纯文本工具反馈更丰富的信息交换。
AI.result: SciCore-Mol在分子理解、生成、反式预测和通用化学知识的综合任务上展现出优异性能。8B参数开源系统在与专有大型模型的比较中具有竞争力，并在多个维度实现超越。
AI.conclusion: SciCore-Mol provides a systematic blueprint for equipping LLMs with scientific expertise through decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modules, with implications for drug design, chemical synthesis, and broader scientific discovery.

title: Position: The Time for Sampling Is Now! Charting a New Course for Bayesian Deep Learning
comment: In Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306, 2026
summary: The practical adoption of sampling-based inference (SAI) in Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) remains limited, partly due to persistent misconceptions about the feasibility and efficiency of sampling. This position paper argues that SAI has achieved computational parity with optimization-based methods and is at the verge of superseding such methods for effective and efficient inference in BNNs. This development should be in the interest of the whole community, promoting BNNs as a principled paradigm with its long-standing yet unfulfilled promise of providing principled uncertainty quantification for neural networks. SAI can even do more -- yielding superior prediction performance through model averaging, serving as the foundation for a plethora of possible downstream tasks, and providing crucial insights into the landscape of BNNs. In order to make such a change happen and unfold the potential of sampling, overcoming current misconceptions is a necessary first step. The next step is to realign research efforts toward addressing remaining challenges in SAI. In particular, the community must focus on two core problems: sufficient exploration of the posterior landscape and high-fidelity distillation of posterior samples for efficient downstream inference. By addressing conceptual and practical obstacles, we can unlock the full potential of SAI and establish it as a central tool in Bayesian deep learning.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张采样式推断（SAI）在贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）中的实践采用已到达临界点：SAI 在计算复杂度上已与基于优化的近似推断（如 VI、Laplace、Deep Ensemble）持平甚至超越，并且能通过模型平均获得更好的预测性能与校准，论文呼吁社区摆脱对采样"慢、不可扩展、先验选择不当、必须做 MH 调整"等过时误解，把研究重心转向两大核心问题——充分探索后验景观（并行化 + 优化引导的探索）以及对后验样本进行高保真蒸馏以实现高效下游推断，并配套建设软件、诊断工具与样本共享标准。
AI.motivation: 深度学习系统在科学与工业中广泛应用，对模型认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）的量化需求不断上升。贝叶斯深度学习（BDL）承诺提供有原则的不确定性量化，但其两条主流路线各有短板：采样式推断（SAI）有渐近保证、不依赖简化分布假设，却长期受限于小规模问题与"采样极慢"的社区印象；优化式近似推断（VI、Laplace、子空间推断、SWA、Deep Ensemble）可扩展但依赖刚性近似，且多在特例下才等价于后验近似。论文认为近年来采样算法（如 pSMILE、SMS-UBU、SGHMC 等）与高效实现库（blackjax、posteriors、Fortuna、JaxSGMCJax 等）已经消除了大部分障碍，SAI 在时间复杂度与可扩展性上达到与优化方法持平（airfoil 实验中 BDE 单链即可超过 35 成员 DE 的 LPPD 且更快），并在中大规模模型（ResNet-18、ViT、宽 CNN、Llama 3 适配器）上稳定优于 DE/SWA/SGD 等基线（Table 1）。因此需要一场范式转向：摒弃经典 MCMC 语境下的过时假设，重新对齐研究重点到端到端的可落地工作流上。
AI.method: 论文为纯立场论证，无新算法与统一实验框架，方法上以文献综述+概念框架+汇总实证证据（meta-study）支撑论点：（1）背景梳理——BNN 后验与后验预测密度的不可解性，ABI 方法（MFVI、Laplace、子空间推断、SWA、DE）的近似机制与局限，SAI 基于未归一化后验构建 MCMC 链并以 S 个样本做贝叶斯模型平均；（2）逐条驳斥五类持续存在的误解——时间复杂度（确定良好初值后采样耗时约与初始优化步相当）、可扩展性（高维 BNN 中多采样器有效，百万级参数已可行）、先验选择（各向同性高斯先验在过参数化区可能具正则化与隐式偏置效应且 SOTA 表现）、Metropolis-Hastings 调整（在高维下接受率极低、Monte Carlo 误差占主导，离散化偏差为次要来源）、设计要素交互（"冷后验效应"多源于与数据增强、似然选择的交互，而非目标分布本身有误）；（3）提出设计原则与开放挑战——灵活探索优于刚性近似（中规模模型作为评测"中间地带"）、并行化+优化引导的探索（温启动、并链数降低对局部近似误差的敏感性）、SG-MCMC 潜力待挖掘（需大规模经验研究与配置经验共享）、"先存储后优化"（默认保存全部样本而非法向 thinning）、后验样本蒸馏（数据压缩、序贯检验、权重空间生成式代理、子集/重要性采样、贝叶斯核心集与数据集蒸馏）、更聪明的模型平均与样本加权、软件与工具链（异步回调落盘、扩展 ArviZ 至 BNN、类 HuggingFace 的样本共享接口、标准化样本基准库）；（4）回应替代观点——近似推断更贴近 DL 工作流、无法保证收敛、可扩展性优势、理论保证依赖不现实假设、基础模型存储与开销、语义 vs 认知不确定性、仅对低秩适配器或子网络采样等。附录给出 airfoil 运行时间对比的实验细节（3 层 16 单元 MLP、10 核 CPU、3 个随机种子）并澄清 SAI 与基于模拟的推断（SBI/无似然推断）的术语差异。
AI.result: 核心结论：SAI 已成为 BDL 的新未来，但需重构研究焦点与推断工作流。要点包括：（1）SAI 已达到计算对等，且在同等或更大计算预算下 LPPD/准确率/校准（ACE）持续优于 DE、SWA、SGD、VI、Laplace（ResNet-18: LPPD −0.26 vs DE −0.30；73M 宽 CNN: NLL 0.31 vs 0.56、ACE 0.005 vs 0.014；Llama 3 适配器 AUROC 0.95 vs 0.80）。（2）逐条消解五类误解：采样时间≈一次优化；高维可扩展；标准高斯先验合理且可能有益；高维下严格 MH 调整性价比极低、离散化误差次要；"冷后验效应"源于先验/数据增强/似然的交互。（3）两大核心方向：后验景观的充分探索（并行化、优化引导探索、SG-MCMC 调参经验共享）与后验样本的高保真管理与蒸馏（先存后压缩、模型平均、工具链与标准）。（4）强调推理期成本是真正瓶颈——现代采样 BNN 单批前向传播开销可达普通 DNN 的 1000 倍，即使 10 核并行亦然，需通过蒸馏、线性化、coreset/数据集蒸馏等解决。（5）面向基础模型主张混合路径：固定预训练权重为特征提取器，仅对低秩适配器或子网络采样，以实现可负担的认知不确定性量化，尤其在判别式/结构化生成场景。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张社区应把 SAI 从"理论理想"变为"实用现实"：核心瓶颈已从采样算法本身转移到端到端流程——高效生成与管理后验样本（而非视采样阶段为固有高成本）以及开发后验样本蒸馏方法以实现快速推理；并需通过协同投入、共享调参与失败模式经验、构建标准化样本基准与工具生态，纠正过时误解，从而确立 SAI 作为贝叶斯深度学习的核心工具，使 BNN 的不确定性量化承诺真正兑现。

title: Polite on the Surface, Wrong in Practice: A Curated Dataset for Fixing Honorific Failures in Multilingual Bangla Generation
summary: Recent advances in Multilingual Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly enhanced cross-lingual conversational capabilities, yet modeling culturally nuanced and context-dependent communication remains a critical bottleneck. Specifically, existing state-of-the-art models exhibit a severe pragmatic gap when handling structural variations, regional idioms, and honorific consistencies in low-resource contexts like Bangla. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel, culturally aligned instruction-tuning dataset for \textbf{BangLa Application and DialoguE generation - BLADE} and benchmarking framework comprising $4,196$ meticulously curated interaction pairs. We leverage this resource to systematically fine-tune and evaluate leading open-weight architectures, including DeepSeek-8B and LLaMA-3.2-3B, utilizing parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA adapters in a 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) quantization framework. Our empirical evaluations demonstrate that models fine-tuned on our dataset yield substantial improvements in structural fidelity and honorific alignment, providing a rigorous benchmark for bridging pragmatic disparities in low-resource multilingual text generation. Code and dataset: https://github.com/ashuvo25/Bangla_Application_LLM/tree/main

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLADE——一个面向孟加拉语的文化对齐指令微调数据集和基准框架，包含4,196个交互对。研究者使用LoRA+4-bit NF4量化方法微调了DeepSeek-8B和LLaMA-3.2-3B模型，有效提升了模型在低资源语言场景下的结构保真度和敬语对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的模型在处理低资源语言（如孟加拉语）的结构变体、区域习语和敬语一致性时存在严重的语用差距，这是多语言大语言模型建模文化细微差别和上下文相关通信的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 使用LoRA适配器在4-bit NormalFloat(NF4)量化框架下对DeepSeek-8B和LLaMA-3.2-3B进行参数高效微调；构建包含4,196个精心策划的交互对数据集。
AI.result: 经过微调的模型在结构保真度和敬语一致性方面取得了实质性改进。
AI.conclusion: BLADE数据集和评估框架为弥合低资源多语言文本生成中的语用差异提供了严格基准，证明了文化对齐微调策略的有效性。

title: Manifold-Guided Attention Steering
summary: Large language models frequently produce errors in reasoning tasks despite possessing the underlying knowledge required for correct reasoning. One possible approach to improve reasoning consistency is through activation steering. However, existing activation steering approaches apply fixed, pre-computed correction vectors, ignoring where the model currently sits along its generation trajectory; the result is indiscriminate perturbation that disrupts already-correct steps as freely as erroneous ones. We propose Manifold-Guided Attention Steering (MAGS), a trajectory-aware inference-time intervention grounded in a geometric observation: the output activations of specific attention heads diverge from a low-dimensional correctness manifold at the point of error, and this deviation compounds through subsequent steps. For each identified attention head, we learn a low-dimensional subspace from contrastive pairs of correct and incorrect traces that capture the directions along which error behavior deviates from correct behavior. During inference, we monitor each head's proximity to this manifold and apply a targeted projection correction when deviation exceeds a learned threshold, steering the attention output back toward the correct subspace before the error propagates. MAGS consistently outperforms both unsteered baselines and static steering approaches across benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning (MATH-500, GSM8K), code generation (HumanEval, MBPP), and molecular generation (SMILES), suggesting that correctness manifolds are a general feature of LLM attention geometry.

AI.tldr: 《Manifold-Guided Attention Steering (MAGS)》：一种基于注意力头输出激活几何结构的推理时干预方法。针对大模型多步推理中的错误，作者发现特定注意力头的输出激活在出错时刻会偏离一个低维“正确性流形”，并会沿后续步骤放大。MAGS对每个关键头用正确/错误对比轨迹的差分向量做PCA学习低秩误差子空间，推理时监控当前激活在该子空间上的投影（接近度分数），仅当超过阈值时才做定向投影修正，把头输出拉回正确子空间。相对静态steering（ITI、Angular Steering、Contrastive Decoding）在数学推理（MATH-500、GSM8K）、代码生成（HumanEval、MBPP）和分子生成（SMILES）上一致提升，最高约10.8%，且困惑度基本不变。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在多步推理任务中频繁出错，但重复采样时同一模型同一提示常常能给出正确答案，说明能力存在而表达不稳定；过程级标注显示多数错误出现在中间推理步骤而非知识缺失。现有激活steering方法（Activation Addition、CAA、RepE、Angular Steering、ITI、CREST）在生成全程施加固定的修正向量，无法感知模型当前处于生成轨迹的哪个位置，因此会同样地破坏已经正确的步骤，同时不保证能拦截局部化的错误。此外，多目标steering中直接合并不同方向的修正向量会产生相互冲突的纠正。作者因此希望：先检测“何时出错”，再按状态自适应地纠正；并希望把修正限制在真正与错误相关的低维方向上，避免破坏其他信息。作者假设推理错误表现为个别注意力头输出空间中沿结构化低维方向的漂移，与mechanistic interpretability中注意力头功能特化的结论及线性表示假说一致。
AI.method: 方法分三部分：(1) 对比误差流形构建——对每个问题采样多条推理轨迹，按最终答案对错分成正确集与错误集；对每个头(l,h)计算正确/错误轨迹输出的逐token均值 μ_c,i 与 μ_e,i，取差分 δ_i = μ_e,i − μ_c,i（该构造抵消了与问题内容普遍相关的方向，只保留错误特异信号）；将各问题的 δ_i 堆叠为 D，做SVD取top-k右奇异向量作为误差子空间基 B（k×d_h，行正交），并用所有正确轨迹计算全局正确状态质心 μ_c 作为推理时的中心参考。(2) 基于接近度的错误检测——每个解码步计算 d_t = ‖B(a_t − μ_c)‖²（中心化激活在误差子空间上的投影平方范数）；用正确轨迹上该分数的q分位数作为逐头阈值 τ，超过阈值才触发。诊断实验在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的Math-Instruct轨迹上按问题级70/30划分，监控第8/16/24/31层，用max聚合逐轨迹分数、以训练集平衡准确率校准阈值，得到逐头轨迹级AUROC（信号稀疏集中于少数头）。(3) 纠错组件修正——触发时用 ã = a − α BᵀB(a − μ_c) 就地替换该头输出（在W_O输出投影之前），α∈(0,1]为steering强度；等价形式 ã = μ_c + P_⊥(a − μ_c) 表明只丢弃误差子空间分量、完全保留d_h−k维补空间信息（Proposition 1的信息保持性，由Bᵀv=0证明）。通过在W_O上挂pre-hook采集头输出，并用top-K（按留出AUROC选取）头降低每步开销至O(K·k·d_h)。多目标情形用MAGSᵘ：对每个目标独立学习流形并独立选头，推理时对所选头的并集各用自己的流形施加修正，避免方向冲突。
AI.result: 实验覆盖Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-4-E4b-it（推理与代码）和GPT-OSS-20B（分子）。MAGS在两个模型、四个基准上一致优于未steering基线及ITI、Angular Steering、Contrastive Decoding：MATH-500上Llama从0.478提升到0.530（+5.2点）、Gemma从0.614到0.648（+3.4点）；GSM8K上Llama 0.860→0.867、Gemma 0.899→0.913；HumanEval pass@1约提升4点（Llama 0.561→0.604，Gemma 0.560→0.604），且三种静态基线在Gemma上反而低于未steering模型；MBPP 0.562→0.574、0.587→0.604。困惑度上MAGS与未steering基本持平，而ITI/AS普遍抬高PPL。超参敏感性上MAGS准确率仅在0.492–0.530间波动，ITI为0.214–0.498、AS为0.206–0.506，静态方法更脆弱。分子生成中MAGS/MAGSᵘ把SMILES有效率从50.4%提升到54.8%，结合亲和力从−7.36改善到−7.54/−7.56；ITI虽有效率更高(57.8%)但亲和力劣化(−7.20)，显示MAGSᵘ避免了目标间干扰。潜在空间轨迹可视化显示：未steered轨迹持续漂离正确分布且无法恢复，MAGS在触发步后立即回到高密度正确区域并保持，ITI干预后仍继续发散。Bootstrap 95% CI表明多数差距的显著性有限（如HumanEval上MAGS与未steered区间重叠），需谨慎解读。附录C的注意力图分析显示干预后的KV-cache条目被后续步骤持续关注，形成“注意力锚定”效应。
AI.conclusion: MAGS把steering重新表述为“漂移检测”问题：低秩基B标识出最预示错误发生的子空间，配合逐头阈值触发实现状态自适应的条件纠正，在数学推理、代码生成与分子生成三个领域、三个模型族上一致优于ITI、Angular Steering与Contrastive Decoding，且几乎不损害输出流畅度，说明“正确性流形”可能是LLM注意力几何的普遍特征。局限与未来工作：需要对比轨迹数据来拟合流形（低资源领域难获取）；头集合为离线固定选择，可改为按生成上下文动态选头；各头独立处理，联合建模头间交互或可更高效更强；流形在同域内跨任务（如算术到符号推理）的迁移性仍是开放问题；此外，评测样本量较小、部分置信区间重叠，实验仅三个模型族，结论的普适性仍需更多验证。

title: Scene Abstraction for Lexical Semantics: Structured Representations of Situated Meaning
summary: Coffee and tea share many properties, yet they evoke strikingly different situations, atmospheres, and affective associations. These situated dimensions of word meaning are real and systematic, but they remain implicit in most computational representations of lexical meaning. We propose Scene Abstraction, a framework for constructing structured representations of the interpretive scenes that words participate in across usage contexts. Each scene consists of a Contextual Scene (Events, Entities, Setting) and an expression-centered Expression Profile (Engaged events, Generalizable properties, Evoked emotions), operationalized through few-shot prompting of a large language model. Our contributions are three-fold: (1) a structured representation framework for situated lexical meaning; (2) COCA-Scenes, a dataset of 520 usage instances across 26 keywords for distinct scene identification; and (3) empirical evidence from two experiments suggesting that scenes are reliably identifiable across human observers (82.4% accuracy, +11.8 pp over text-only embeddings) and that our scene profiles more closely align with human interpretation of words in context than ATOMIC-based alternatives (86.4% preference across three semantic dimensions).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Scene Abstraction 框架，用结构化表示捕获词汇使用的情境化解释场景。COCA-Scenes 数据集包含 520 个实例。研究通过人类实验证明该框架能可靠识别场景（82.4% 准确率），且在语义契合度上优于现有方法（86.4% 偏好率）。
AI.motivation: 咖啡和茶虽然共享许多属性，但唤起的情境、氛围和情感联想截然不同。这种情境化的词义维度是真实且系统性的，但在大多数词汇语义计算表示中仍是隐含的，未被显式建模。
AI.method: 提出 Scene Abstraction 框架，通过 few-shot prompting 的大型语言模型构建结构化表示。每个场景包含两个核心组件：(1) Contextual Scene（事件、实体、场景设定）；(2) Expression Profile（参与事件、可泛化属性、唤起情感）。数据集 COCA-Scenes 包含 520 个使用实例，覆盖 26 个关键词。
AI.result: 两个实验验证：(1) 场景识别的人类一致性达 82.4%，比纯文本嵌入基线提升 11.8 个百分点；(2) 场景画像在三个语义维度上获得 86.4% 的偏好，显著优于 ATOMIC 基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Scene Abstraction 提供了一种有效的词汇情境化意义表示框架，超越传统嵌入方法。研究通过人类实验验证了场景的可辨识性，并证明其与人类解释的契合度显著优于 ATOMIC 基线方法。该框架为词义的情境化理解提供了新的研究方向。

title: Meta-Soft: Leveraging Composable Meta-Tokens for Context-Preserving KV Cache Compression
summary: The KV cache used in large language models has linearly growing time complexity, so LLMs face memory blow-up and reduced decoding efficiency when they process long contexts.Current KV Cache eviction has become an important research direction; however, existing methods based on fixed Soft Tokens (e.g., Judge Q) rely on a static parameter set as the query to evaluate the importance of KV pairs, so they cannot adapt dynamically to different input prompts, and they cannot precisely capture complex and changing task relevance.Also, evicted KV pairs are discarded permanently, so this causes irreversible information loss and context breaks. To address this problem, we propose Meta-Soft, a dynamic compression framework based on probe-driven context integration. Specifically, we build a meta-library with a learnable orthogonal basis matrix $\mathcal{L}$, and we use a selector network with Gumbel-Softmax to produce differentiable sparse combination weights, so we dynamically synthesize the most targeted $k$ Soft Tokens from the input prompt features.We append these Soft Tokens to the end of the input sequence to probe key information. We also introduce an attention-flow based integration mechanism, which redistributes the semantic information of removed tokens into retained tokens, and this keeps the dropped context information effectively.Experiments on multiple datasets show that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art eviction methods and provides a new solution for KV Cache compression.

AI.tldr: Meta-Soft 是一种"动态探测 + 信息补偿"式的 KV Cache 压缩框架：用可学习的正交元基（Meta-Library）配合 Gumbel-Softmax 选择器，按输入 prompt 动态合成 k 个 Soft Token 作为探针，一次注意力前向即完成全局 KV 重要性评估；被驱逐的 KV 不再直接丢弃，而是通过带负载均衡的稀疏"注意力流"路由把语义信息归并到保留 token 上。全部操作只在 prefill 阶段完成，decoding 无额外开销。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 上的 PG19/OpenWebText2（困惑度）、LongBench、RULER 评测中优于 H2O/SnapKV/StreamingLLM/LAQ/Judge Q/CaM/ZeroMerge/AnDPro 等基线，并保持极低额外时延。
AI.motivation: LLM 长上下文推理时 KV Cache 随长度线性增长，导致显存溢出与解码吞吐下降。现有的 KV 驱逐方法存在两类关键缺陷：(1) 重要性评估依赖静态查询——H2O/StreamingLLM 用局部窗口注意力（局部短视），SnapKV/RoCo 指出其无法捕捉长程回溯依赖，LAQ 用伪查询预测未来分布，Judge Q 虽训练了可学习"判官 token"但仍是一组静态参数，无法针对不同 prompt 动态适配，难以精确刻画任务相关性；(2) 被判为不重要的 KV 被永久硬驱逐（Scissorhands、FastGen 的 Top-K 淘汰），造成不可逆信息丢失与上下文断裂，引发幻觉；CaM、ZipCache、ZeroMerge 等合并方法虽保留信息，但盲目平均/聚类导致语义混淆（semantic aliasing），在需要精确查询时精度下降。作者的目标是同时实现"动态适配"与"信息保全"的平衡。
AI.method:
**问题形式化**：给定长度 L 的 prompt，投影得到 K、V∈R^{L×(H·d_k)}；目标是在预算 B 下选保留集 I_keep，并构造增广缓存 (K̂_keep, V̂_keep) 使 P(y|K̂,V̂) ≈ P(y|K,V)，而非直接丢弃 I_drop。

**(1) Meta-Library 与两阶段离线训练**
- 元库 L∈R^{M×d}（M=512）提供"通用正交语义原子"，选择器 f_θ 依据 prompt 的全局语义特征输出稀疏组合权重，E_soft = Σ w_i ℒ_i（k=32 个 Soft Token）。
- 监督信号 A_gold：冻结 LLM 骨干，抽取响应 token 对 prompt token 的注意力 Attn^{(h)}_{i,j}，按头数 H 与响应长度 L_res 平均，得到 R^L 的金标准注意力分布（式1）。
- 损失 J = L_MSE(A_soft, A_gold) + λ_div‖L L^T − I‖_F²（式2）：第一项让探针模仿真实注意力行为，第二项正交正则防止基向量冗余、覆盖更广表示空间。
- Stage I 联合优化 ℒ 与 f_θ（梯度经 Gumbel-Softmax 组合回传），在 SlimPajama 40k 样本上训 5 epoch；Stage II 冻结 ℒ 与骨干，仅微调选择器，在 ShareGPT 10k 样本上训 3 epoch；AdamW、lr=1e-4、Gumbel 温度 1.0→0.1、3×A100 80GB、总耗时约 5.5 小时。

**(2) Soft Token 探针与缓存划分**
- 预填充时将 E_soft 拼接到 embedding 序列末尾：X_input=[X_emb; E_soft] ∈ R^{(L+k)×d}。
- 探针注意力得分 S = E_soft W_Q (X_emb W_K)^T / √d_k，α_i = Softmax(S_{i,:})，A_soft = (1/k)Σα_i（式4-5），即用软 token 作为"查询"一次性扫描全上下文 KV，得到全局重要性分布。
- 按预算 B 做 TopK 划分：I_keep = TopK(A_soft, B)，其余为 I_drop（式6）。

**(3) 基于注意力流的上下文整合（Contextual Consolidation）**
- 直接用 Softmax(K_drop K_keep^T) 会让大量被驱逐 token 塌缩到少数高度相似的保留 token 上造成覆写，故引入负载均衡的稀疏路由。
- 相似度 S_sim = K_drop K_keep^T/√d_k；对每个被驱逐 token 仅取 Top-m 邻居 N_m(i)，用温度 τ 做行随机稀疏分配 A_ij（式8）。
- 统计各保留 token 承载的总质量 ℓ_j=ΣA_ij，列重加权 b_j=1/(ℓ_j+ε)（式9-10）抑制过载，再逐行归一化得 W_flow（式11）。
- 聚合：ΔV = W_flow^T V_drop；用负载自适应门控 g_j=clip(α/(ℓ_j+ε),0,1)（α=|I_drop|/|I_keep|）更新 V̂_keep = V_keep + γ(g_j ΔV_j)（式13）；K_keep 保持不变以保留位置信息。

**(4) 推理集成**：Soft Token 生成、探针、整合全部在 prefill 阶段完成，之后删除软 token 与被驱逐集合，decoding 用标准注意力访问压缩缓存，无逐步额外开销。
AI.result:
**语言建模（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，B=256）**：PG19 上 4k/16k PPL 为 7.05/7.49，OpenWebText2 为 5.68/5.87，均优于 H2O、SnapKV、Judge Q、ZeroMerge（Full KV 分别为 6.81/7.23 与 5.45/5.72）。

**LongBench（B=128/256，两个骨干）**：Meta-Soft 平均分在所有设置下最高。Llama-3.1-8B：B=128 为 46.21（AnDPro 46.17、Judge Q 45.16、SnapKV 43.00），B=256 为 47.19（AnDPro 46.98、Judge Q 46.27）；较 SnapKV 提升 1.7–3.2 分，较 Judge Q 提升 0.9–1.1 分，保留 Full-KV 平均性能的 92.9%–97.2%。Mistral-7B 同趋势（45.77 / 47.15 为最佳）。注意其相对最强基线 AnDPro 的优势非常小（≤0.3 分）。

**RULER（Mistral，cache=1024，4K–128K）**：13 任务平均 75.72，为所有驱逐方法最优（AnDPro 74.85、Judge Q 73.96、ZeroMerge 72.81、SnapKV 66.92、StreamingLLM 16.80），各长度段均排名第一，但与 Full-KV 的 92.92 仍有约 17 分差距。

**消融（cache=1024，16K）**：基线（用 prompt 末 32 token 代替软 token）RULER 68.43 / LongBench 46.84；仅 DST 为 73.65 / 47.17（+5.22 / +0.33）；仅 AFA 为 74.73 / 47.32（+6.30 / +0.48）；两者结合 79.67 / 48.35，显示互补性，AFA 贡献更大。

**效率**：软 token 生成延迟 0.32–2.34 ms，占 prefill 时间 <0.3%，prefill/TTFT 仅增加 0.02–0.12 s 与 0.02–0.14 s；端到端延迟较 Full KV 加速 1.2×–10.5×（8K→256K），与 SnapKV/Judge Q 等强基线相差仅约 3–5%；长生成（10K tokens）时最大 batch 80（Full cache 28，2.86×），吞吐 390.17 vs 180.49 tokens/s（2.16×），与 SnapKV/Judge Q 差距在 5.6%/2.0% 以内。
AI.conclusion:
Meta-Soft 以"可组合元 token"替代固定查询，把 KV 压缩从静态启发式转为输入自适应的动态探测，并以注意力流整合机制替代硬驱逐/盲目合并，在紧内存预算下同时提升了长文本困惑度、LongBench 与 RULER 精度，且几乎不增加推理时延，是即插即用的长上下文部署方案。

需要指出的局限（论文未充分讨论）：(1) 与最强基线 AnDPro 的 LongBench 差距仅 0.03–0.3 分，RULER 亦仅约 0.9 分，方法优越性主要体现在设计理念而非大幅指标领先；(2) 关键实现细节缺失——是否每个骨干/每层独立训练元库与选择器、软 token 探针在多层 KV 上如何逐层应用、γ/τ/m/λ_div 的取值、合并是否需额外显存，均未交代；(3) 多层 KV 的独立 TopK 划分与合并可能重复计算开销，论文只给出端到端时延而未给出显存占用实测；(4) 声称"lossless compression"表述过强，A_gold 仅由响应 token 的注意力监督，prompt 内部结构信息（多跳推理、实体关系）的保留程度有待验证；(5) 训练成本（5.5 小时、3×A100）与新增元库/选择器参数、每个骨干需重训的可扩展性是部署侧的实际负担；(6) RULER 上与 Full-KV 差距明显，说明极端长度下压缩仍会显著损失检索精度。

title: Provable Robustness against Backdoor Attacks via the Primal-Dual Perspective on Differential Privacy
summary: Randomized smoothing is a powerful tool for certifying robustness to adversarial perturbations, including poisoning attacks via randomized training and evasion attacks via randomized inference. Extending these guarantees to backdoor attacks, where training and test data are jointly perturbed, remains challenging because training- and test-time randomized mechanisms must be analyzed within a single robustness certificate. We address this by connecting randomized smoothing to the dual view of differential privacy through privacy profiles, which provide a numerical procedure for composing heterogeneous mechanisms. The resulting framework enables tight, modular, end-to-end certification of complex, composed mechanisms while leveraging existing analyses of differentially private mechanisms. We instantiate the framework for DP-SGD and Deep Partition Aggregation with inference-time smoothing, deriving joint robustness guarantees against both training-time and inference-time attacks. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Overall, we provide a principled and general framework for using composite mechanisms to certify robustness under complex threat models that better capture the capabilities of real-world adversaries.

AI.tldr: 通过隐私配置连接随机平滑与差分隐私，实现端到端的后门攻击鲁棒性认证框架，支持训练时和推理时攻击的联合分析。
AI.motivation: 现有随机平滑方法难以同时应对训练时和测试时的攻击，尤其是后门攻击（训练和测试数据同时受到扰动）。需要统一的框架在单一鲁棒性证书中分析训练时和测试时的随机化机制。
AI.method: 将随机平滑与差分隐私的对偶视图通过隐私配置(privacy profiles)相连接，提供数值化程序以组合异构机制。针对DP-SGD和Deep Partition Aggregation两种机制推导出联合鲁棒性保证。
AI.result: 提出首个可同时认证训练时和推理时攻击的联合鲁棒性保证框架，并成功将差分隐私机制分析应用于随机平滑的组合认证中。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种基于隐私配置的通用框架，通过组合异构机制实现对复杂威胁模型下后门攻击的端到端鲁棒性认证。实验在MNIST和CIFAR-10上验证了框架有效性。

title: Scaling Observation-aware Planning in Uncertain Domains
summary: Deciding which sensing capabilities to deploy on an agent in uncertain domains is a fundamental engineering challenge, in which one balances task achievability against the high costs of hardware and processing. This problem has previously been formalized as the Optimal Observability Problem (OOP), based on the well-known Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) model for decision-making. This work studies (sub-)symbolic techniques to scale solving of decidable fragments of the OOP, namely the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP) and the Positional Observability Problem (POP). Besides improving the original approach based on parameter synthesis, we develop a new solving method that identifies sensible observation functions via decomposition of POMDPs, improving performance by 3 and 5 orders of magnitude for instance size and runtime, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 POMDP 上的最优可观测性问题（OOP）中可判定的两个片段——传感器选择问题（SSP）与位置可观测性问题（POP），提出并实验验证了一套“符号 + 子符号”混合的可扩展求解方案：(1) 改进基于类型化参数化马尔可夫链（tpMC）的 SMT 编码（原生布尔编码、伪布尔基数约束、预算松弛与“修复”、Bellman 不等式不变上界松弛）；(2) 引入 POMDP 评估“预言机”（SMT 预言机 + Storm 的信念探索/有限状态控制器合成）；(3) 提出基于 POMDP 分解的启发式枚举算法 A_G，利用最优签名的强/弱动作等价类（原子可区分组）缩减观测函数搜索空间。相比原始方法，实例规模提升约 10^3 倍、运行时间提升约 10^5 倍（相对本文第 3 节的增强再提升 10^3 倍时间、10^2 倍规模）。
AI.motivation: 在不确定环境中为智能体配置感知能力（传感器/观测）需要在“任务可达性”与“硬件与处理成本”之间权衡。Konsta 等人将这一问题形式化为 POMDP 上的最优可观测性问题 OOP，并证明其一般情形不可判定，但对位置策略、位置+确定性策略、位置+随机策略等片段是可判定的（SSP、PDOOP、POP，复杂度分别落在 ETR/PSPACE）。已有判定过程依赖 tpMC 参数合成 + SMT（z3）求解，实际只能处理中等规模实例：许多基准在 180 秒超时内无法求解，且求解时间受 SMT 断言顺序等启发式因素高度扰动（不稳定性问题，波动超过 25%）。因此需要能规模化的（子）符号技术来求解 OOP 的可判定片段。
AI.method: 1) SMT 编码增强（第 3 节）：对约束按语义角色分四组做排列实验，确认原顺序最优（并发现求解器对断言顺序高度敏感，>25% 波动，而反例判定时间不受影响）；将原实现中用 0/1 实数表示的观测分配变量 y_{s,o}、传感器开关 y_s、确定性策略变量 x_{o,a} 改为原生布尔变量，利用 SAT 传播降低非线性算术开销，并将类型/基数约束改写为逻辑基数子句与伪布尔基数约束（预算约束 ∑y_s = B）；两种松弛：(a) 多趟“松弛-修复”增量求解（先忽略预算求可行解，再压入预算约束局部修复），在原实数编码上约 15 倍加速、但在布尔编码上失效；(b) 奖励不变上界松弛，把 Bellman 等式换成不等式 v_s ≥ Bellman(v_s)，并把预算约束放宽为“至多 k”，借助“信息量↑ ⇒ 最小期望回报↓”的单调性，在阈值高于最优值时给出一致的上界（原实数编码上 6/18 实例最多 8 倍加速）。2) 预言机集成（第 4 节）：SMT 预言机——固定 y_{s,o} 取值把 tpMC 化为具体 POMDP 的 ETR 查询（可附带从底层 MDP 推断的最优策略约束以进一步简化编码）；PMC 路线——评估 PAYNT（抽象-精化、有限状态控制器）因确定性策略 SMT 已足够而未集成；对参数化马尔可夫链做基于梯度的优化（momentum/Adam/RMSprop，配合 storm-pars 符号导数）因参数景观非凸、梯度稀疏而效果不佳；最终采用 Storm 的 storm-pomdp/stormpy + Belief Exploration，以有界记忆的有限状态控制器给出期望回报的上界/下界界。3) 分解式启发式（第 5 节）：定义状态的最优签名 α*(s)（所有最优位置确定性策略中出现过的动作集合），据此定义强动作等价（同签名）与弱动作等价（签名相交），得到原子可区分组 G(M) 的划分；A_G 算法：把 n=|G(M)| 个组标签划分为 k=min(B,n) 个观测类（第二类斯特林数 S(n,k) 个候选），按等价分数 eq(obs)（各观测类内最优动作集交集非空者计 1）与可推断策略约束数排序，逐个用 SMT 预言机评估，sat 即返回，unsat 且 k≥B*_M 时提前终止。附录给出由 A_G 求解最小位置预算（MPBP）、为 POP/SSP 构造初始猜测（由 POP 观测类大小排序映射为 SSP 传感器开关）的方法，并给出反例 MDP M_trap 说明 A_G 在 B≤B* 时不完备。实验基准为 Line、Grid、Maze 三类拓扑（Line(k)、G(k)、M(k)），区分确定性/随机策略，阈值取 ≤2·MinExpRew、≤MinExpRew、<MinExpRew 三档，预算取等于 MPB；运行环境为 Apple M2、8GB RAM、z3 4.13.0，容器化并多次重复以确认 CPU 时间变异系数可忽略。
AI.result: 第 3 节（SMT 增强）：相比原始实现求解时间提升约 10^3 倍，最大可解实例规模提升 1～~77 倍；确定性策略收益尤为显著（布尔编码可大幅削减约束），随机策略对阈值更敏感。代表性结果：POP/PDOOP 确定性 Line 可解 10,001 状态（原来 377）、Grid 1,296（原来 96）、Maze 846（原来 576）；SSP 确定性 Line 15,001（原来 193）、Grid 10,000（原来 225）、Maze 2,621（原来 36）。仅 G(20) 阈值 7600/399 一例比原始更慢，归因于 z3 的固有不稳定性。第 5 节（A_G 分解）：相对本文第 3 节再提升 10^3 倍（时间）与 10^2 倍（规模）；确定性 PDOOP：Line 200,001、Grid 160,801、Maze 200,011 状态；随机 POP（B=B*）：Line 100,001、Grid 100,489、Maze 100,001 状态；并首次求解了此前全部超时的 B=B*-1 类实例（G(7)、M(25)）。候选空间分析：候选数从 B^{|S\G|} 降为 S(n,k)（n≤min(|S\G|, 2^{|Act|}），在所测 Line/Maze/Grid 实例上最多 966 次 POMDP 评估。正确性：算法可靠（sat 即为合法解）、在 B≥B*_M 时提前终止正确且能首个命中最优观测函数、在所有测试拓扑上与弱动作等价猜想相容；但在一般情形（不拆分原子可区分组）不完备（M_trap 反例），实现中附加了对完整 tpMC 编码的回退求解以增强鲁棒性。总体结论：实例规模提升约 3 个数量级、运行时间提升约 5 个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将符号技术（SMT 参数合成、tpMC 编码、概率模型检查）与子符号/启发式技术（POMDP 分解、基于等价类的候选生成与排序、有限状态控制器合成）结合，可显著扩展 OOP 可判定片段（POP/SSP）的可解规模：SMT 层面靠原生布尔编码、伪布尔基数约束与两类松弛（预算松弛-修复、Bellman 不等式不变上界）获得约 10^3 倍加速与最高 ~77 倍规模提升；分解层面靠“原子可区分组 + 弱动作等价 + 等价分数排序”的启发式枚举 A_G 再获 10^3 倍加速与 100 倍以上规模，并覆盖了此前不可解的预算低于最小位置预算的实例类别。方法可靠但一般情形不完备，未来方向包括：进一步用 z3 tactics 将查询分解为预处理流水线以提升可预测性；扩展参数合成工具与 POMDP 控制器合成（如记忆/ FSC 界、梯度优化改进）；引入强化学习/信息引导搜索，并复用本文的启发式分量作为观测函数与传感器布局的初始化（附录已给出 POP→SSP 初始映射与方向对立等域特定启发式）。

title: MMD-Balls as Credal Sets: A PAC-Bayesian Framework for Epistemic Uncertainty in Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 15 pages, 0 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Epistemic Intelligence in Machine Learning (EIML@ICML 2026)
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) methods improve model performance under distribution shift but lack formal guarantees connecting shift magnitude to prediction reliability. We develop a PAC-Bayesian framework yielding generalization bounds explicitly parameterized by the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between source and target distributions. Our principal contribution is interpreting MMD-balls around the source distribution as credal sets in Walley's imprecise probability theory, yielding natural epistemic uncertainty quantification. We establish: (i) a PAC-Bayesian bound with an MMD-dependent shift penalty under an RKHS-Lipschitz loss assumption; (ii) a finite-sample version via MMD concentration; (iii) a uniform worst-case risk bound over all distributions in the credal set, with a lower-upper risk decomposition; and (iv) geodesic preservation bounds explaining why kernel-guided adaptation protects local feature geometry. The credal set interpretation separates epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty and provides a principled decision criterion for when adaptation is warranted.

AI.tldr: This paper bridges test-time adaptation and imprecise probability theory by interpreting MMD-balls as credal sets, providing formal generalization bounds parameterized by distribution shift magnitude and separation of epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty.
AI.motivation: Current test-time adaptation methods lack formal theoretical guarantees connecting distribution shift magnitude to prediction reliability.
AI.method: PAC-Bayesian framework with MMD-balls interpreted as Walley's credal sets; RKHS-Lipschitz loss assumption; MMD concentration for finite-sample bounds; geodesic analysis for feature geometry preservation.
AI.result: Four theoretical contributions: (i) PAC-Bayesian bound with MMD-dependent shift penalty; (ii) finite-sample version via MMD concentration; (iii) uniform worst-case risk bound over credal set with lower-upper risk decomposition; (iv) geodesic preservation bounds for kernel-guided adaptation.
AI.conclusion: Credal set interpretation enables principled separation of epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty and provides formal decision criteria for when adaptation is warranted.

title: Three Costs of Amortizing Gaussian Process Inference with Neural Processes
summary: Neural processes amortize Gaussian process inference, replacing the exact $O(n^3)$ posterior with a learned $O(n)$ map from context sets to predictive distributions. For a class of latent neural processes, we bound the Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence between the GP and LNP predictives, decomposing it into three interpretable sources, namely label contamination as the neural process uses label values to estimate a quantity that is label-independent in the exact GP, an information bottleneck because the finite-dimensional representation cannot resolve the full context geometry, and amortization error from a single encoder network shared across all contexts. The bottleneck truncation term decays in the representation dimension $d$ as $O(e^{-cd^{2/d_x}})$ for squared-exponential kernels on $\mathbb{R}^{d_x}$ where $c > 0$ is a kernel-dependent constant and as $O(d^{-2ν/d_x})$ for Matérn-$ν$ kernels, directly linking architecture sizing to kernel smoothness and input dimension. The label contamination term is $O(1)$ in general, with only the observation-noise component decaying as $O(1/n)$, identifying a persistent cost of routing uncertainty estimation through a label-dependent representation. These results characterize the costs of amortization within the analyzed class and yield architectural recommendations to predict variance from context locations alone in the GP-amortization regime, and replace mean aggregation with second-order pooling to close the dominant amortization gap.

AI.tldr: 该论文从信息论角度分析了神经过程近似高斯过程的理论误差边界，揭示了误差来源于标签污染、信息瓶颈和摊销三个机制，并建立了核函数平滑性与架构维度需求之间的定量关系，为神经过程的架构设计提供理论指导。
AI.motivation: 神经过程通过学习从上下文集到预测分布的映射来近似高斯过程推理，旨在将精确的$O(n^3)$后验计算替换为学习的$O(n)$映射，但需理解由此产生的近似误差。
AI.method: 对LNP预测器与精确GP预测器之间的KL散度进行理论分解，识别三个误差源并建立维度相关收敛率。
AI.result: 推导KL散度的三个可解释项：(1)标签污染项$O(1)$，(2)信息瓶颈项随表示维度$d$衰减，(3)摊销误差项源于共享编码器；确定瓶颈项对SE核呈$O(e^{-cd^{2/d_x}})$衰减，对Matérn核呈$O(d^{-2ν/d_x})$衰减。
AI.conclusion: 提出神经过程近似的成本特征，给出架构设计建议：通过有限维表示预测方差需权衡瓶颈与污染误差；使用二阶池化可弥合主要摊销差距。

title: LANG: Reinforcement Learning for Multilingual Reasoning with Language-Adaptive Hint Guidance
summary: Reinforcement learning has proven effective for enhancing multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet its benefits have not fully translated to multilingual contexts. Existing methods struggle with a fundamental trade-off: prioritizing input-language consistency severely hampers reasoning quality, while prioritizing reasoning often leads to unintended language drift toward English. We address this challenge with LANG, a novel framework that leverages language-conditioned hints to guide exploration in non-English reasoning tasks. Our method incorporates two key mechanisms to prevent dependency on these hints: a progressive decay schedule that gradually withdraws scaffolding, and a language-adaptive switch that tailors learning horizons to specific language difficulties. Empirical results on challenging multilingual mathematical benchmarks reveal that LANG substantially enhances reasoning performance without compromising language consistency. Moreover, we show that our framework generalizes beyond mathematics, fostering more consistent language alignment across model layers

AI.tldr: 本文提出LANG框架，通过语言条件提示解决强化学习在多语言推理任务中的语言一致性与推理质量的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在多语言场景中面临根本性权衡：优先保证输入语言一致性会损害推理质量，而优先保证推理能力则会导致语言漂移至英语。
AI.method: 提出LANG框架，包含两个关键机制：1）渐进衰减调度，逐步撤回语言条件提示的脚手架；2）语言自适应开关，根据特定语言难度定制学习视野。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的多语言数学基准测试上，LANG显著提升推理性能，同时不损害语言一致性。
AI.conclusion: LANG框架可泛化至数学之外，促进模型各层更一致的语言对齐。

title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by IEEE ICME 2026
summary: Multi-frame story illustration requires long-horizon coherence beyond single-image text-to-image generation, including narrative decomposition and persistent character identity, layout, and affect across frames. We propose Story-to-Executable Descriptions (S2ED), a training-free, model-agnostic, prompt-layer framework that converts a full story into a sequence of explicit, editable executable descriptions for more consistent rendering. S2ED coordinates three agents to segment the narrative, ground canonical character attributes, and enrich spatial and affective cues, enabling interpretable prompt-carried state propagation and local edits to repair drift without retraining the generator. Experiments on Flintstones and Shakoo Maku show that S2ED improves sequence-level consistency and character fidelity over strong prompting, large-model planning, and a reference training-based method, under both automatic metrics and human judgments. We also deploy S2ED in an end-to-end story-to-storybook system for children's illustrated stories, with a supplementary video.

AI.tldr: S2ED: A training-free framework converting stories into executable descriptions for consistent multi-frame story illustration. Uses three coordinated agents for narrative segmentation, character grounding, and spatial/affective enrichment. Achieves superior consistency and character fidelity without retraining.
AI.motivation: Multi-frame story illustration requires long-horizon coherence beyond single-image generation, including narrative decomposition, persistent character identity, layout consistency, and affect preservation across frames. Existing text-to-image models struggle with these multi-frame consistency challenges.
AI.method: S2ED is a training-free, model-agnostic prompt-layer framework that coordinates three agents to: (1) segment narrative into frames, (2) ground canonical character attributes, and (3) enrich spatial and affective cues. It enables interpretable prompt-carried state propagation and allows local edits to repair drift without retraining the generator.
AI.result: Experiments on Flintstones and Shakoo Maku datasets show S2ED improves sequence-level consistency and character fidelity over strong prompting, large-model planning, and reference training-based methods, validated by both automatic metrics and human judgments.
AI.conclusion: S2ED provides an effective training-free, model-agnostic solution for multi-frame story illustration. The framework significantly improves sequence-level consistency and character fidelity compared to strong prompting, large-model planning, and reference training-based methods. Successfully deployed in an end-to-end story-to-storybook system for children's illustrated stories.

title: stable-worldmodel: A Platform for Reproducible World Modeling Research and Evaluation
summary: World models are central to building agents that can reason, plan, and generalize beyond their training data. However, research on world models is currently fragmented, with disparate codebases, data pipelines, and evaluation protocols hindering reproducibility and fair comparison. Current practice is further limited by three key bottlenecks: fragile one-off codebases, slow video data loading, and the lack of standardized generalization benchmarks. We present stable-worldmodel (swm), an open-source platform for standardized and reproducible world modeling research and evaluation. It delivers (1) a high-performance Lance-based data layer with native support and conversion tools for MP4, HDF5, and LeRobot datasets, (2) clean, well-tested implementations of modern world model baselines and planning solvers, and (3) a broad suite of environments and tasks extended with controllable visual, geometric, and physical factors of variation for systematic in-silico evaluation of dynamics understanding, control performance, representation quality, and out-of-distribution generalization. By unifying the full pipeline under a single, scalable framework, \texttt{swm} dramatically reduces research overhead and accelerates trustworthy progress toward reliable world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出swm，一个用于世界建模研究和评估的开源平台，旨在解决当前研究碎片化问题，包含高性能数据层、标准化基线实现和泛化评估套件三大组件。
AI.motivation: 当前世界模型研究面临三个关键瓶颈：(1)脆弱的一次性代码库；(2)视频数据加载缓慢；(3)缺乏标准化泛化基准。这导致研究碎片化，严重影响可复现性和公平比较。
AI.method: 提出了stable-worldmodel(swm)开源平台，包含三个核心组件：(1)基于Lance的高性能数据层，支持MP4、HDF5和LeRobot数据集的原生接入及转换工具；(2)经过良好测试的现代世界模型基线和规划求解器实现；(3)包含可控视觉、几何和物理因素变体的广泛环境与任务套件，用于系统化评估动态理解、控制性能、表征质量和分布外泛化能力。
AI.result: swm实现了标准化、可复现的世界建模研究和评估平台，显著降低了研究开销。
AI.conclusion: swm通过在统一、可扩展的框架下整合完整流程，显著降低了研究开销，加速了迈向可靠世界模型的可信研究进展。

title: Beyond Temperature: Hyperfitting as a Late-Stage Geometric Expansion
summary: Recent work has identified a counterintuitive phenomenon termed "Hyperfitting", where fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to near-zero training loss on small datasets surprisingly enhances open-ended generation quality and mitigates repetition in greedy decoding. While effective, the underlying mechanism remains poorly understood, with the extremely low-entropy output distributions suggesting a potential equivalence to simple temperature scaling. In this work, we demonstrate that this phenomenon is fundamentally distinct from distribution sharpening; entropy-matched control experiments reveal that temperature scaling fails to replicate the diversity gains of hyperfitting. Furthermore, we falsify the hypothesis of static vocabulary reweighting, showing through ablation studies that hyperfitting relies on a dynamic, context-dependent rank reordering mechanism. Layer-wise analysis localizes this effect to a "Terminal Expansion" in the final transformer block, where a substantial geometric expansion of the feature space (Delta Dim approx +80.8) facilitates the promotion of deep-tail tokens. Additionally, we introduce Late-Stage LoRA, a targeted fine-tuning strategy that updates only the final 5 layers, yielding robust generation with minimal parameter updates

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了"过度拟合"现象并非简单的分布锐化，而是通过Transformer最终层的动态维度扩展实现深层尾token的上下文依赖激活，从而提升生成多样性，并提出高效的Late-Stage LoRA微调策略。
AI.motivation: 解释"过度拟合"（Hyperfitting）现象的底层机制——为何LLM在小数据集上训练至近零损失反而能提升开放域生成质量并缓解贪婪解码中的重复问题，其极低熵输出分布是否等同于简单的温度缩放尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过熵匹配对照实验否定温度缩放假说；消融实验验证动态上下文依赖的排名重排序机制；层级分析定位到最终Transformer块中的"终端扩展"现象（维度扩展约+80.8）；提出并验证Late-Stage LoRA靶向微调策略。
AI.result: ① 否定温度缩放假说：熵匹配实验表明温度缩放无法复现hyperfitting的多样性收益；② 否定静态词汇重加权：hyperfitting依赖动态上下文依赖的排名重排序机制；③ 定位关键区域：最终Transformer块的"终端扩展"（特征空间几何扩展约Δdim≈+80.8）促进深度尾 token 的涌现；④ Late-Stage LoRA：仅更新最后5层即可实现稳健生成，以最小参数更新代价达成效果。
AI.conclusion: Late-Stage LoRA策略通过仅更新最后5层实现了高效微调，为理解Transformer架构深层机制提供了实证基础，暗示模型后层可能专门负责语言生成的质量控制。

title: KAPPS: A knowledge-based CPPS Architecture for the Circular Factory
comment: Submitted to Journal of Manufacturing Systems (JMS)
summary: While linear manufacturing relies on homogeneous materials and predefined process sequences, circular manufacturing reintroduces used products with heterogeneous and uncertain conditions. This shift demands manufacturing systems capable of handling variable product states, dynamically reconfigurable processes, and the integration of human and machine knowledge. Conventional manufacturing IT architectures, designed for stable structures and deterministic execution, are unable to meet these requirements, as they cannot adequately represent and manage the uniqueness of individual components at runtime. Following a design science methodology for developing a Cyber Physical Production System for circular manufacturing, we derive 14 requirements from five complementary perspectives. Based on these requirements, we design KAPPS, a knowledge-based architecture that uses an ontology-grounded knowledge graph as a unifying data backbone, combined with a semantic interface layer to enable consistent data and information integration, reasoning, and communication across heterogeneous systems and services, turning the knowledge graph from an integration layer into the factories authoritative write-time state. KAPPS incorporates modules for constraint enforcement and event-driven planning, enabling incremental adaptation of execution plans under uncertainty and human-machine knowledge exchange. The applicability of KAPPS is demonstrated through two implemented use cases: (i) Anomaly detection and learning through knowledge graph mediated services and (ii) runtime constraint enforcement in a modular conveyor system. Subsequently, the architecture is evaluated against the 14 requirements (ed. abstract shortened)

AI.tldr: 针对循环制造中产品状态异构、不确定的特点，提出传统制造IT架构难以胜任的问题，论文采用设计科学研究方法，从五个视角推导出14项需求，设计了基于本体的知识图谱架构KAPPS作为统一数据骨干，配合语义接口层实现异构系统集成与推理，并具备约束执行与事件驱动规划模块，通过两个用例验证了架构的适用性。
AI.motivation: Circular manufacturing introduces used products with heterogeneous/uncertain conditions requiring systems that handle variable product states, dynamically reconfigurable processes, and human-machine knowledge integration—capabilities that conventional IT architectures (designed for stable structures and deterministic execution) cannot provide.
AI.method: Design science methodology to develop a Cyber Physical Production System for circular manufacturing; requirements derived from five complementary perspectives; architecture design centered on ontology-grounded knowledge graph as unifying data backbone with semantic interface layer.
AI.result: KAPPS architecture: knowledge graph as authoritative write-time state enabling consistent data/information integration, reasoning, and cross-system communication; modules for constraint enforcement and event-driven planning supporting incremental execution plan adaptation under uncertainty and human-machine knowledge exchange.
AI.conclusion: KAPPS demonstrated via two use cases (anomaly detection via knowledge graph services; runtime constraint enforcement in modular conveyor system) and evaluated against all 14 requirements.

title: Why Semantic Entropy Fails: Geometry-Aware and Calibrated Uncertainty for Policy Optimization
summary: Post-training has become central to improving reasoning and alignment in large language models, where critic-free models enable scalable learning from model-generated outputs but lack principled mechanisms to distinguish informative from noisy signals. Recent approaches leverage response-level measures as uncertainty signals to regulate group-based optimization methods such as GRPO. Yet their empirical success remains unstable and unclear in how they influence optimization dynamics. In this paper, we provide, to our knowledge, the first principled formulation that interprets uncertainty signals as mechanisms for characterizing and regulating gradient variance and learning signal quality. Based on both empirical and theoretical analysis, we identify two critical gaps of current entropy-based estimators: The anisotropic gap and The calibration gap. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Geometric-aware Calibrated Policy Optimization (GCPO), a novel framework integrating geometry-aware measures to capture semantic disagreement with reward-based calibration to align uncertainty with learning signal strength. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our approach more faithfully tracks gradient variability and consistently improves post-training performance. Our results highlight the importance of designing uncertainty signals that are aligned with optimization dynamics, offering a principled perspective for robust post-training.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次从原则性角度分析了不确定性信号在语言模型后训练中的作用机制，识别出现有熵估计器的两大关键缺陷，并提出GCPO框架通过几何感知测量与奖励校准相结合来改进优化动态。
AI.motivation: 当前后训练方法缺乏区分信息信号与噪声信号的原则性机制，现有基于熵的不确定性估计器存在各向异性差距和校准差距，导致梯度方差和学习信号质量的调控不稳定。
AI.method: 提出GCPO框架，通过几何感知测量捕获语义分歧，并结合基于奖励的校准机制，将不确定性信号与学习信号强度对齐，以更准确地追踪梯度变异性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，GCPO方法能更准确地追踪梯度变异性，显著提升了后训练性能。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性信号需要与优化动态对齐，才能实现稳健的后训练。该研究为设计更有效的学习信号提供了原则性视角，填补了当前熵估计器的理论与实践空白。

title: Agentic CLEAR: Automating Multi-Level Evaluation of LLM Agents
summary: Agentic systems are becoming more capable: agents define strategies, take actions, and interact with different environments. This autonomy poses serious challenges for overseeing and assessing agent behavior. Most current tools are limited, focusing on observability with basic evaluation capabilities or imposing static, hand-crafted error taxonomies that cannot adapt to new domains. To address this gap, we present Agentic CLEAR, an automatic, dynamic, and easy-to-use evaluation framework. It produces textual insights into the agent behavior on three levels of granularity: system, trace, and node. Agentic CLEAR operates above the observability layer, enabling seamless integration and featuring an intuitive UI that makes agent evaluation highly accessible. In our experiments on four benchmarks, seven agentic settings, and tens of thousands of LLM calls, we show that Agentic CLEAR produces high-quality, data-driven, insightful feedback. Our analysis shows strong alignment with human-annotated errors and the ability to predict task success rate.

AI.tldr: Agentic CLEAR 是一个自动化、动态、无需预定义错误分类体系的 LLM 智能体多层级评估框架。它在可观测性层之上，对执行轨迹（trace）进行逐步、整体轨迹和动态生成评分标准（rubric）三种 LLM 评审，再用 CLEAR 聚类聚合为系统级、节点级和轨迹级文本洞察，并在四个基准、七种智能体配置、数万次 LLM 调用上验证了与人工标注错误的一致性及对任务成功率的预测能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体已能自主制定策略、调用工具、与环境交互，广泛应用于软件工程、开放式网页浏览、科学发现及个人日常自动化，但其失败模式（循环、幻觉、子智能体错位、错误传播）难以从最终输出察觉。现有可观测性平台（LangSmith、LangFuse）仅提供日志与粗粒度的整轨迹 LLM-as-a-judge 汇总，开发者仍需人工逐条排查轨迹；学术界提出的错误分类体系（TRAIL 等）虽精细但静态僵化，需要大量人工工程且无法适配新领域与定制化任务。因此需要一个自动、动态、易用且能给出"为什么失败"的多层级评估工具。
AI.method: 形式化：数据集 D={x_n}，智能体 A 由若干节点 a_k 组成，执行产生轨迹 t_n={(i_k,o_k,a_k)}（每次 LLM 调用的输入、输出及所属节点）。两阶段流水线（Algorithm 1）：阶段一逐轨迹评估——(1) 步骤级 J_s 对每个 (i_k,o_k) 打分并给自然语言批注，按节点 a_k 分组；(2) 轨迹级 J_t 对整条轨迹评估执行质量与最终交付物；(3) Rubric 评估——J_r 仅依据任务描述自动生成任务特定评判标准，J_v 再依据这些标准核查轨迹是否满足；各提示均先输出文本推理再给分（CoT），量化分数也呈现在 UI 中。阶段二聚合——用 CLEAR 聚类摘要：对每个节点的步骤反馈聚类得到 I_node，对轨迹级与 rubric 级反馈聚类得到 I_sys，并将每条洞察回链到触发它的具体步骤/轨迹。工程实现：pip 可安装的 Apache-2.0 Python 包（clear-eval），采用 OpenTelemetry/LangFuse 轨迹格式并转换为统一中间表示，仅需最小预处理；单条 CLI 命令配 YAML 运行，结果存为 ZIP 供 App 载入；提供 System View（自动重建多智能体拓扑、全局性能、系统级复发问题）、Node View（按问题类型与分数过滤、按实例打分与错误分布）、Trace View（轨迹总评、逐步维度分、逐 rubric 评估与评审推理）三层交互 UI；各评估层级可单独或组合使用，用户可改维度、覆写提示或替换评审实现。
AI.result: 1) 通用错误模式：全部配置共生成 195 条轨迹级问题，归纳为四类——冗余低效的工具调用、错误处理与恢复不足、工作流未完成、输出格式与 schema 不合规。2) 领域特异问题：无需任何基准特定提示即可发现——GAIA 出现来源与交叉验证缺失，AppWorld 出现购物车污染/邮件附件丢失等编排失误，SWE-bench 出现 monkey-patching、diff 格式错误，τ²-Bench 出现未授权支付、编造成本等策略违规。3) 节点级差异：CUGA 中 JSON 畸形普遍存在，但规划节点集中于任务分解与 API 选择问题，执行节点集中于功能缺陷（如分页处理缺失）；幻觉主要发生在规划阶段而非执行阶段。4) 骨干/架构影响：同数据下数据集对错误类型的影响大于智能体架构；GPT-4.1 与 Claude 4.5 Sonnet 共享大部分失败画像但各有独特倾向。5) 评审选择有实质影响：OSS-120B 产出更短（67 vs 130 字符）更泛化的运营类问题，GPT-5 更长、更细致、偏验证与逻辑正确性。6) 与人工错误分类对齐（TRAIL 12 个非执行类，覆盖 94% 标注）：GPT-5 的 15 条问题全部可映射、覆盖 12 类，OSS-120B 的 12 条覆盖 10 类；实例级传播后 full+partial 匹配下 GPT-5 取得 Micro F1 0.497 / Macro Cat F1 0.459，OSS-120B 0.427/0.374，均优于频率随机基线（0.342/0.288）与 top-4 多数基线（0.459/0.199）。7) 成功率预测 AUC：GPT-5 普遍优于 OSS-120B，轨迹级方法整体最强；AppWorld 全部 >0.75（GPT-5 三法均 ≥0.82），τ²-Bench 最高仅 0.62，GAIA 与 SWE-bench 随方法/架构波动明显。8) Rubric 分析：仅凭任务描述生成的 rubric 在 AppWorld 能定性捕捉流程但弱于程序化断言；在 τ²-Bench 的对抗性任务上因看不到"应拒绝"的意图而错误地奖励任务完成。
AI.conclusion: Agentic CLEAR 证明无需预定义错误分类法或人工编写的 rubric，也能规模化产出高质量、多层级的文本诊断：与人工标注错误分类具有较强一致性（最高 Macro F1 0.459 / Micro F1 0.497），并能预测任务成功率。它以开源 Python 包与交互式 UI 的形式降低了智能体评估门槛，支持更快的迭代与更可靠的系统理解。局限与未来方向：当前主要覆盖 LLM 推理与规划层面而未纳入系统执行；评审在不同智能体设置下的可靠性与能力仍需提升（τ²-Bench 等隐式策略场景预测偏弱，rubric 生成缺乏任务元数据）；尚需支持跨配置的系统性对比；结论亦表明轨迹级、rubric 级与步骤级三种信号在不同领域与架构下互补，应按目标场景选择组合。

title: Compiling Agentic Workflows into LLM Weights: Near-Frontier Quality at Two Orders of Magnitude Less Cost
summary: Agent orchestration frameworks have proliferated, collectively exceeding 290,000 GitHub stars across LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Strands, and LlamaIndex. All follow the same pattern: an external orchestrator above the LLM, injecting instructions and routing decisions every turn. Recent work has shown this architecture is dominated for procedural tasks by simply providing the procedure in a frontier model's system prompt [Dennis et al., 2026a], at the cost of consuming the context window, requiring a frontier model for every conversation, and exposing proprietary procedures to third-party providers. Compiling the procedure into the weights of a small fine-tuned model -- creating a subterranean agent -- should resolve all of these concerns, and prior work (SimpleTOD, FireAct, SynTOD, WorkflowLLM, Agent Lumos) has shown the technique works. Yet developer adoption has overwhelmingly favored orchestration. We identify three perceived barriers and address each empirically across travel booking (14 nodes), Zoom support (14 nodes, product-specific knowledge), and insurance claims (55 nodes, 6 decision hubs).

AI.tldr: This paper investigates why developers prefer external orchestration frameworks over fine-tuned "subterranean agents" for procedural tasks, identifies three perceived barriers, and empirically demonstrates that fine-tuned small models can match orchestration performance while eliminating context window overhead, frontier model dependency, and proprietary procedure exposure.
AI.motivation: Despite evidence that compiling procedures into fine-tuned small models works for procedural tasks, developer adoption has overwhelmingly favored orchestration frameworks, raising the question of why this adoption gap exists.
AI.method: Comparative evaluation across three complex procedural domains (travel booking, Zoom support, insurance claims) to empirically address three perceived barriers against fine-tuned approaches.
AI.result: Fine-tuned models achieve comparable performance to orchestration approaches on complex multi-step procedures across different scales (14-55 nodes).
AI.conclusion: Fine-tuned subterranean agents can match or exceed orchestration frameworks for procedural tasks while addressing context window consumption, frontier model dependency, and proprietary procedure exposure.

title: Same Architecture, Different Capacity: Optimizer-Induced Spectral Scaling Laws
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures, 30 tables. Project page: https://optimizer-scaling-laws.github.io
summary: Scaling laws have made language-model performance predictable from model size, data, and compute, but they typically treat the optimizer as a fixed training detail. We show that this assumption misses a fundamental axis of representation scaling: how effectively the optimizer converts added FFN width into utilized spectral capacity. Using eigenspectra of feed-forward network representations, measured through soft and hard spectral-ranks, we find that \emph{the same Transformer architecture realizes markedly different spectral scaling laws when trained with different optimizers}. Holding architecture and width schedule fixed, AdamW exhibits weak hard-rank scaling ($β$=0.44) on rare-token (TAIL) representations where learning is known to be hardest, whereas Muon achieves linear scaling ($β$=1.02) in the same regimes, a $2.3\times$ increase in the scaling exponent. This difference is not reducible to validation loss: AdamW configurations can match low-rank Dion variants in perplexity, under extended training, while exhibiting sharply different spectral geometry, demonstrating that matched loss does not imply matched representation structure. Hard--soft rank asymmetry further reveals that optimizers differ not only in how much capacity is realized, but also in how that capacity is structured across eigenmodes. To disentangle optimizer effects from architectural ones, we compare against architectural interventions (e.g., attention rank and positional encoding), and find that optimizer-induced spectral shifts often exceed the architectural effects. These results suggest optimization as a first-class axis of representation scaling, motivating optimizer--architecture co-design.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：同一 Transformer 架构在不同优化器下会呈现完全不同的 FFN 谱（spectral）缩放律。AdamW 的硬谱秩（participation ratio）随 FFN 宽度仅次线性增长（TAIL token 上 β_hard=0.44），而 Muon/NorMuon 达到近线性（β_hard=1.02/1.04，2.3 倍差距）；且这种差异无法用验证困惑度、学习率或训练时长解释（匹配 loss ≠ 匹配表征几何）。优化器诱导的谱偏移通常大于注意力秩、位置编码等架构干预，提示优化器应作为表征缩放的一等设计轴，与架构协同设计。
AI.motivation: 经典缩放律（Kaplan/Hoffmann 等）以模型规模、数据量、算力为核心变量，并把优化器视为固定的训练细节；近期工作（optimizer-aware loss scaling）虽把优化器建模为 loss 上的乘性效率因子，但仍停留在 loss 层面。作者提出的关键未解问题：若两个优化器的 loss 缩放相近，它们学到的内部表征几何是否也相似？若相同 loss 可来自不同的表征几何，则优化器就不只是"效率旋钮"，而是决定模型容量如何在特征模态间分配、在 token 频率区间间分配的设计轴。FFN 占标准 Transformer 约三分之二参数，其 expand–非线性–compress 结构暴露出可谱度量的隐空间，天然适合作为"新增 FFN 宽度被转化为可用谱容量的效率"的探针。
AI.method:
【模型与训练】modded-nanoGPT 风格的 GPT 式 decoder-only Transformer（Pre-RMSNorm、RoPE、squared-ReLU FFN、无 bias、QK-norm），FineWeb-Edu 数据；160M（12 层/12 头/d_model=768）与 350M（24 层/32 头/d_model=1024）两档基座，FFN 隐藏维 D=m·d_model（160M: m=1..8；350M: m=1..4），160M 训 6K 步/3.15B token、350M 训 8K 步/4.19B token，seq 512、batch 1024，常数 LR + 20% 线性衰减，BF16。优化器：AdamW、Muon、NorMuon、Dion（rank fraction r∈{1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16}），矩阵类优化器遵循 Dion 的更新配方（非矩阵参数用 Lion，逐参数 LR 按 spectral-condition 缩放）。共 40 次 160M + 20 次 350M 主扫描 + 若干消融（LR、归一化位置、位置编码、延长训练）。
【谱度量】在 FFN 前激活 z=W_in x 与后激活 a=φ(z) 两处探针，取经验协方差并做 trace 归一化得 p_i=λ_i/Σλ_j；用 Rényi 熵族定义有效秩 R_α=exp(H_α)，以 α=1（soft rank，熵加权谱弥散）与 α=2（hard rank，participation ratio，凸二次/集中敏感）为主锚点，附录扫 α∈{0.5,1,1.5,2,3,5}；定义秩级不对称 A_{1,2}=log R_1−log R_2 与指数级 Δ_{1,2}=β_soft−β_hard；再定义非线性重注入比 ρ_α=R_α^post/R_α^pre 区分"优化器塑造的线性几何"与"非线性后实际可用容量"。
【频率分层】按 token type 频次（FineWeb-Edu 直方图，GPT-2 BPE）以累计出现质量三分位划 HEAD/MID/TAIL（30 / 1,215 / 49,059 类型，各覆盖约 1/3 出现质量），在每个分层内独立计算谱与秩。
【缩放拟合】log R(D)=β log D+c，逐层拟合后再层平均；同时报告 R²、逐层 β_ℓ 分布与深度剖面。
【控制实验与架构干预】(a) 匹配 loss 控制：AdamW 训 12K 步 vs Dion(1/16) 6K 步；(b) 学习率扫描 AdamW {1,3,6}e-3、Muon {1,2,4}e-2；(c) 注意力秩干预：12 头→6 头（总参数不变，每头秩增大），比较 Δβ_opt* 与 |β_6h−β_12h| 及交互项 I*；(d) RoPE 移除（NoPE，350M）；(e) 部分 PostLN 可训练性压力测试（postln_frac）；(f) 位置依赖分析（ANOVA 式 η² 与对称比 SR=1−η²，Δ_SR=SR_post−SR_pre）。
【计算】4×RTX 3090（160M）、8×RTX 3090（350M）。
AI.result:
1) 谱缩放强烈依赖优化器：soft-rank 指数 β_soft∈[0.66,1.01]（优化器间差异小），hard-rank β_hard∈[0.29,0.82]（差异大）。聚合口径 AdamW β_hard=0.29，Muon=0.82；TAIL 上 AdamW 0.44 vs Muon 1.02（2.3×）、NorMuon 1.04；MID 上 0.24 vs 0.93/0.95；HEAD 分离较弱且拟合较差。AdamW→Muon 增益 Δβ：MID +0.69（最大）、TAIL +0.58、HEAD +0.33。
2) hard–soft 不对称本身是优化器属性：AdamW 全频段 Δ_{1,2}≈+0.18~+0.21（聚合 +0.37），Muon/NorMuon 在 MID/TAIL 几乎归零（+0.01/0.00），Dion(1/2) 与 Muon 同为 ≈0.14。这说明先前工作把该不对称视为 Pre-LN 架构的稳定性质是错的。
3) 更新秩是控制旋钮：Dion 的 r 从 1/2 降到 1/16 时 TAIL β_hard 由 0.88 掉到 0.40（Δ 由 +0.07 升到 +0.31，趋近 AdamW），而 β_soft 仅由 0.95 缓降至 0.72，说明仅正交化不足，低秩更新主要"卡住"稀有 token 的主模态硬容量。
4) 匹配 loss ≠ 匹配几何：AdamW 12K 与 Dion(1/16) 6K 困惑度相当（如 8d 宽 28.29 vs 29.23），但 AdamW 聚合 β_hard 由 0.29 崩到 0.03（R²=0.01）、不对称升至 +0.55，且 hard-rank 的"宽度—容量"单调序被破坏（8d 训练后低于 2d/4d，如 TAIL 8d 从 278→394→228）；TAIL 硬秩指数在 ~4K 步见顶后衰减，soft-rank 则稳定，说明这不是收敛瞬态。LR 扫描也不能弥合差距（AdamW 最优 TAIL 0.44 < Muon 最差 0.80）。
5) 规模可复现：350M 上 Muon 1.13、NorMuon 0.88、AdamW 0.39、Dion(1/16) 0.48，排序一致；Muon 在 350M 聚合/TAIL 上不对称转为轻微负值（−0.16/−0.13）。
6) 优化器效应大于架构干预：优化器带来的谱指数增益在 30 组比较中的 28 组超过注意力秩干预（唯一例外是 HEAD hard-rank）；且 12 头→6 头会翻转"最优优化器"（由 NorMuon 变为 Muon 全部六项），说明架构干预不产生与优化器无关的固定偏移。
7) NoPE 产生优化器依赖的再分配：Muon HEAD β_hard 1.083→1.286 而 MID/TAIL 下降（1.127→0.836）；NorMuon 三个频段全面下降（HEAD −0.367），且 Muon/NorMuon 的 HEAD–TAIL 硬秩间隔在 NoPE 下 HEAD 显著扩大（0.06→0.63）而 MID/TAIL 收窄。效果量合成：AdamW→Muon 的 TAIL 硬秩差 0.74，约为注意力秩效应（0.37）的 2×、NoPE 效应的 2.5–5.2×。
8) 位置依赖分析给出机制线索：TAIL 硬秩越强的优化器（NorMuon/Muon/Dion(1/2)）其 FFN 位置放大越强；NoPE 下 Muon/NorMuon 的 TAIL 位置处理约增至 3×，峰值从深层前移至最初层，并把位置偏置从 HEAD 偏置反转为 TAIL 偏置，而 AdamW 不发生该反转。
9) Rényi 族与重注入：前激活谱的层级为 NorMuon>Muon>Dion(1/2)>Dion(1/16)>AdamW（α=1 时 411.3 vs 126.0；α=2 时 177.4 vs 28.0），说明优化器几何在非线性之前就已成形；AdamW 的重注入比 ρ_2=51.9 远高于 Muon 4.8/NorMuon 4.3（约 10.8×/12.1×），是"补偿性"而非更优；后激活排序还会翻转（Dion(1/2) 在 α≥1 最高），说明后激活容量不能由前激活秩单独决定。位置归一化方面，Muon 家族能在部分 PostLN 下训到可用困惑度（PostLN-25/50/75 分别约 28.7/30.1/40.9 与 28.7/29.9/32.8），而 AdamW 在 lr=3e-4 时 PostLN-50 即发散、lr=1e-4 时 PostLN-75 仅 106.7；全 PostLN 所有优化器均不稳定。
AI.conclusion:
表征的有效容量由"架构—优化器"对共同决定，而非架构单独决定。核心信息是：优化器之间的差别不在于谱秩是否随宽度增长，而在于增长的是哪一类容量——AdamW 下新增 FFN 宽度主要流向弥散的低方差方向（主模态硬容量次线性），Muon 类正交更新优化器则把宽度更高效地转为主模态容量，且增益集中在 MID/TAIL 频率段；Dion 的更新秩是这一转换效率的连续旋钮，单纯正交化并不足够。该效应不能被训练时长、学习率或最终验证 loss 解释，并可迁移到更大规模（350M 复现）。架构侧干预（提高每头注意力秩、移除 RoPE）并不产生与优化器无关的固定谱偏移，其效应由优化器几何中介，甚至会改变"哪个优化器与该架构最匹配"（12 头→6 头时最优者由 NorMuon 换成 Muon）；优化器还决定哪些架构可训练（部分 PostLN 的可训练边界）。因此结论是：优化器应与模型规模、数据、算力、架构并列，作为表征缩放的一等设计轴，推动优化器—架构协同设计。
局限：实验仅限 160M/350M 的 GPT 式 dense-FFN、FineWeb-Edu 单一数据配方与 modded-nanoGPT 配方；每个 (优化器×宽度) 组合仅单种子；部分 hard-rank 拟合 R² 偏低、需作方向性解读；单次扫描需最多 8 个模型×多优化器，计算昂贵，未在 1B+ 规模验证；谱秩/Rényi 度量未直接关联下游任务行为，且尚未证明对更新几何或谱集中度的定向干预能因果地控制表征容量。

title: Chinese sensorimotor and embodiment norms for 3,000 lexicalized concepts
summary: Understanding how conceptual knowledge is grounded in bodily experience, and to what extent machine systems can acquire such knowledge without direct sensorimotor experience, are central questions in both cognitive science and embodied artificial intelligence research. Large-scale normative resources are essential for investigating these questions empirically, yet such resources remain sparse for non-Indo-European languages. We present a novel normative database for 3,000 lexicalized concepts in Mandarin Chinese, comprising 11-dimensional sensorimotor ratings and unidimensional embodiment ratings collected from 378 native Mandarin speakers. The ratings demonstrate high reliability and strong cross-norm validity with existing Chinese resources, each of which covers fewer words and a subset of the 11 sensorimotor dimensions. In a validation study, we tested new variables derived from a theoretically motivated metric, Perceptual Strength of Embodiment (PSE) (Huang et al., 2025), together with seven common composite variables, on lexical decision tasks. The results suggest that PSE-Sensorimotor and Minkowski-3 are the strongest composite predictors of lexical decision performance, capturing the facilitatory effects of sensorimotor information on lexical processing. A further exploratory study showed that sensorimotor ratings are substantially recoverable from purely linguistic representations using simple regression models (mean Spearman r = .62 across dimensions), though recovery varied markedly: visual and auditory dimensions yielded higher correspondence than chemosensory ones. Representational similarity analysis further showed that the relational geometry of the sensorimotor space is also partially recoverable (r = .540), consistent with the view that distributional language use encodes aspects of embodied conceptual structure.

AI.tldr: 本论文构建了包含3,000个汉语词汇概念的11维感觉运动规范数据库，通过378名母语者完成 rating；验证了具身化感知强度(PSE)等复合指标的预测效力；证明了感觉运动特征可从纯语言表征中部分恢复，支持语言使用编码具身概念结构的观点。
AI.motivation: Investigation of embodied conceptual knowledge requires large-scale normative resources, yet such resources are sparse for non-Indo-European languages like Mandarin Chinese, limiting cross-linguistic research in cognitive science and embodied AI.
AI.method: Developed a normative database of 3,000 Mandarin Chinese lexicalized concepts with 11-dimensional sensorimotor ratings from 378 native speakers; validated predictive power of PSE and composite variables using lexical decision tasks; tested recovery of sensorimotor ratings from linguistic representations via regression models and representational similarity analysis.
AI.result: High reliability and cross-norm validity of ratings; PSE-Sensorimotor and Minkowski-3 emerged as the strongest predictors of lexical decision performance; sensorimotor ratings were substantially recoverable from linguistic representations (mean Spearman r = .62), with visual/auditory dimensions more recoverable than chemosensory ones; relational geometry of sensorimotor space was partially recoverable (r = .540).
AI.conclusion: The findings support the view that distributional language use encodes aspects of embodied conceptual structure. Sensorimotor information facilitates lexical processing, and such information is partially recoverable from purely linguistic representations, suggesting that language may serve as a proxy for embodied knowledge in non-Indo-European languages.

title: LACO: Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving
summary: Collaborative driving aims to improve safety and efficiency by enabling connected vehicles to coordinate under partial observability. Recent approaches have evolved from sharing visual features for perception to exchanging language-based reasoning through foundation models for behavioral coordination. Though communicating in language provides intuitive information, it introduces two challenges: high latency caused by autoregressive decoding and information loss caused by compressing rich internal representations into discrete tokens. To address these challenges, we analyze latent communication in collaborative driving under inherent limitations of multi-agent settings. Our analysis reveals agent identity confusion, where direct fusion of latent states entangles decision representations across vehicles. Motivated by this, we propose LACO, a training-free \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{CO}mmunication paradigm that seamlessly adapts pretrained driving models to collaborative settings. LACO introduces Iterative Latent Deliberation (ILD) for latent reasoning, Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution (CHSA) for communication-efficient information selection, and Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SSKD) to stabilize ego-centric decision making. Closed-loop experiments in CARLA show that LACO notably reduces communication and inference latency while maintaining strong collaborative driving performance.

AI.tldr: LACO proposes a training-free latent communication paradigm for collaborative driving, using Iterative Latent Deliberation, Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution, and Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation to reduce latency and information loss while maintaining collaborative performance.
AI.motivation: Language-based communication in collaborative driving introduces two key challenges: high latency from autoregressive decoding and information loss from compressing internal representations into discrete tokens.
AI.method: Three technical components: Iterative Latent Deliberation (ILD) for latent reasoning, Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution (CHSA) for communication-efficient information selection, and Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SSKD) to stabilize ego-centric decision making.
AI.result: The proposed training-free LACO paradigm effectively addresses latent communication challenges while notably reducing communication and inference latency while maintaining strong collaborative driving performance.
AI.conclusion: LACO notably reduces communication and inference latency while maintaining strong collaborative driving performance, validated through closed-loop experiments in CARLA.

title: Symbolic Density Estimation for Discrete Distributions
summary: Discrete probability laws underpin statistical modeling, yet the catalog of interpretable distributions has expanded only gradually through centuries of case-by-case mathematical derivations. We introduce symbolic density estimation (SDE), an unsupervised framework that automatically recovers closed-form probability mass functions by composing elementary analytic operations within a structured search space. Our method integrates domain-specific structural priors with evolutionary search and a validity-aware inference stage, and it extends to richer distribution families such as zero inflation and finite mixtures. To support systematic evaluation and future research, we contribute a benchmark dataset spanning a broad collection of commonly used discrete distributions. The proposed algorithm recovers all benchmark families with accurate parameter estimates. A real data application shows that it identifies concise and interpretable mixture models that improve goodness-of-fit over standard models.

AI.tldr: An unsupervised framework for automatically discovering closed-form discrete probability distributions by composing elementary analytic operations, combining evolutionary search with structural priors and validity-aware inference.
AI.motivation: The catalog of interpretable discrete distributions has expanded only gradually through centuries of case-by-case mathematical derivations, lacking systematic methods for automated discovery of closed-form probability mass functions.
AI.method: Integrates domain-specific structural priors with evolutionary search and a validity-aware inference stage, operating within a structured search space of elementary analytic operations. Extended to zero-inflation and finite mixture families.
AI.result: Recovers all benchmark families with accurate parameter estimates; identifies concise and interpretable mixture models on real data that improve goodness-of-fit over standard models.
AI.conclusion: SDE successfully automates the discovery of interpretable discrete probability distributions, offering a systematic alternative to traditional case-by-case derivations.

title: More Context, Larger Models, or Moral Knowledge? A Systematic Study of Schwartz Value Detection in Political Texts
summary: Detecting Schwartz values in political text is difficult because implicit cues often depend on surrounding arguments and fine-grained distinctions between neighboring values. We study when context and explicit moral knowledge help sentence-level value detection. Using the ValuesML/Touch{é} ValueEval format, we compare sentence, window, and full-document inputs; no-RAG and retrieval-augmented settings with a curated moral knowledge base; supervised DeBERTa-v3-base/large encoders; and zero-shot LLMs from 12B to 123B parameters. The results show that more context is not uniformly better: full-document context improves supervised DeBERTa encoders by 3.8--4.8 macro-F1 points over sentence-only input, but does not consistently help zero-shot LLMs. Retrieved moral knowledge is more consistently useful in matched comparisons, improving each tested model family and context condition under early fusion. However, scaling from DeBERTa-v3-base to large and from 12B to larger LLMs does not guarantee gains, and simple early fusion outperforms the tested late-fusion and cross-attention RAG variants for encoders. Per-value analyses show that context and retrieval help most for socially situated or conceptually confusable values. These findings suggest that value-sensitive NLP should evaluate context, knowledge, and model family jointly rather than treating longer inputs or larger models as universal improvements.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了政治文本中Schwartz价值观的检测，对比了不同上下文输入方式、有无检索增强、不同规模模型的效果。研究发现：更多上下文并非总是有益（仅对有监督DeBERTa有效）；检索道德知识库则稳定提升所有模型性能；模型规模放大不保证效果提升；早期融合优于其他RAG变体；评估应综合考虑上下文、知识和模型家族，而非单纯追求更长输入或更大模型。
AI.motivation: Detecting Schwartz values in political text is challenging due to implicit cues depending on surrounding arguments and fine-grained distinctions between neighboring values.
AI.method: Compared sentence/window/full-document inputs; no-RAG vs RAG with moral knowledge base; supervised DeBERTa-v3-base/large encoders; zero-shot LLMs from 12B to 123B parameters.
AI.result: Full-document context improves DeBERTa by 3.8-4.8 macro-F1 but not consistently for LLMs; retrieved moral knowledge improves all tested models under early fusion; scaling model size doesn't guarantee gains; context and retrieval help most for socially situated or conceptually confusable values.
AI.conclusion: more context doesn't uniformly help; knowledge retrieval consistently helps; scaling models doesn't guarantee gains; early fusion outperforms other RAG variants; evaluations should consider context, knowledge, and model family jointly.

title: Towards Direct Evaluation of Harness Optimizers via Priority Ranking
summary: Harness optimization enables automated agent creation by having an optimizer agent iteratively update the harness of target agents. Despite its success, current studies evaluate optimizers solely by observing target agents' performance gains. This indirect end-improvement evaluation neglects optimizers' actions at intermediate steps, which are often erroneous and hinder agent performance. Therefore, it is unclear whether harness optimization is driven by optimizers' informed update actions or simply trial-and-error. This necessitates direct evaluation of harness optimizers. However, evaluating harness optimizers directly is non-trivial and costly due to the lack of oracle harnesses. To address this, we present a simple, low-cost design to directly evaluate them, namely priority ranking. By asking harness optimizers to rank components (e.g., tools) in a given harness by their potential to improve/hinder agent performance when updated, our design quantifies optimizer ability at the step level without expensive rollouts or manual examination. More importantly, optimizers' ranking performance correlates with their ability to improve agents in actual multi-step harness optimization, establishing priority ranking as a reliable predictor of optimization ability. Priority ranking is enabled by Shor, a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios spanning across domains, designs, and time stages. Codes and data can be found at https://github.com/k59118/Harness_Optimizer_Evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对harness优化器的直接评估问题，提出了一种低成本设计——priority ranking，通过让优化器对组件进行优先级排序来量化其优化能力，无需昂贵的rollout或人工检查；在包含182个场景的Shor数据集上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅通过观察目标agent的性能提升来评估优化器，这种间接的终态评估忽略了优化器在中间步骤的actions——这些actions往往充满错误且阻碍agent性能；因此无法判断harness优化是得益于优化器的明智更新还是简单的试错
AI.method: 通过让优化器对给定harness中的组件（如工具）按其对agent性能的潜在改善/阻碍程度排序，直接量化优化器在步骤级别的能力
AI.result: 优化器的排序表现与其在实际多步harness优化中提升agent的能力相关，验证了priority ranking可作为优化能力的可靠预测指标
AI.conclusion: priority ranking能可靠预测优化器能力；Shor数据集包含182个人类验证的优化场景

title: Beyond Scalar Objectives: Expert-Feedback-Driven Autonomous Experimentation for Scientific Discovery at the Nanoscale
summary: Self-driving laboratories or autonomous experimentation are emerging as transformative platforms for accelerating scientific discovery. Bayesian optimization (BO) is among the most widely used machine learning frameworks for these purposes, but these BO-based frameworks rely on predefined scalar descriptors to guide experimentation. In many situations, the determination of an appropriate scalar descriptor can be challenging, and may fail to capture subtle yet scientifically important phenomena apparent to experts with interdisciplinary insight. To overcome this limitation, here we develop deep-kernel pairwise learning (DKPL), an approach for autonomous microscopy experiments which incorporates human expertise and interdisciplinary scientific knowledge into an active learning loop. Instead of relying on explicit scalar objectives, DKPL enables experts to directly evaluate which experimental output is more promising using interdisciplinary knowledge. DKPL then learns a latent utility function from these expert judgements to guide subsequent autonomous microscopy experiments. We demonstrate DKPL's performance in learning physically meaningful nanoscale structures while effectively prioritizing high-information measurement regions using an experimental model dataset with known ground truth. We further apply DKPL to analyze the character of ferroelectric domain walls, where we find DKPL capable of distinguishing between high and low characteristic domain-wall angles in bismuth ferrite, and able to discover both head-to-head and tail-to-tail domain-wall character in erbium manganite. This development establishes an approach to integrate expert knowledge into autonomous microscopy experiments and demonstrates a pathway toward expert-guided self-driving laboratories capable of addressing scientific problems beyond the limits of scalar-metrics-driven learning.

AI.tldr: DKPL通过将专家成对判断融入主动学习环来解决自驱动实验室中标量目标函数定义困难的问题，使专家可直接评估实验输出的相对优劣，让机器从专家判断中学习隐式效用函数，突破了传统方法依赖预定义标量指标的局限。
AI.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化(Bay优化的自驱动实验室)依赖预定义标量描述符指导实验，但在许多科学场景中难以确定合适的标量目标，且可能遗漏领域专家凭借跨学科洞察力才能识别的细微但重要的科学现象。这种局限性制约了自驱动实验室处理复杂科学问题的能力。
AI.method: 提出深度核成对学习(DKPL)方法，采用主动学习框架，将人类专家的直接评估融入实验决策。DKPL从专家的成对比较判断中学习隐式效用函数，而非依赖预定义的标量目标函数。方法结合深度学习表示能力与核方法的优势，实现专家领域知识与机器学习的协同。
AI.result: 在已知真值的实验模型数据集上验证了DKPL学习物理意义纳米结构的能力；在铁电材料中成功区分高/低特征畴壁角度；发现铒锰氧化物中head-to-head和tail-to-tail两种畴壁构型。
AI.conclusion: DKPL成功整合专家知识到自主显微镜实验中，为专家引导的自驱动实验室提供了新路径。该方法能学习物理意义的纳米结构，有效区分铁电畴壁特征角度，并发现多种畴壁构型。研究表明基于专家判断的成对学习可突破传统标量指标驱动学习的局限。

title: Boiling the Frog: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Agentic Safety
