summary: Background. Traditional safety benchmarks for language models evaluate generated text: whether a model outputs toxic language, reproduces bias, or follows harmful instructions. When models are deployed as agents, the safety-relevant object shifts from what the system says to what it does within an environment, and evaluating model responses under prompting is no longer sufficient to address the safety challenges posed by artificial intelligence. Recent developments have seen the rise of benchmarks that evaluate large language models as agents. We contribute to this strand of research. Approach. We introduce Boiling the Frog, a benchmark that evaluates whether tool-using AI models deployed in corporate and office settings are susceptible to incremental attacks. Each scenario begins with benign workspace edits and later introduces a risk-bearing request. The benchmark focuses on stateful multi-turn evaluation: chains expose a persistent workspace, place the risk-bearing payload at controlled positions in the turn sequence, and score whether the resulting artifact state becomes unsafe. Scenarios are organized through a three-level operational risk taxonomy grounded in the Boiling the Frog risks, the AI Act Annex I and Annex III high-risk contexts, and EU AI Act's Code of Practice on General-Purpose AI (GPAI). Results. Across a nine-model panel, aggregate strict attack success rate (ASR) is 44.4%. Model-level ASR ranges from 20.5% for Claude Haiku 4.5 to 92.9% for Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, with Seed 2.0 Lite also above 80%. Average chain category-level ASR reaches 93.3% for Code of Practice loss-of-control scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"Boiling the Frog"基准，用于评估工具型AI智能体在企业环境中抵抗渐进式攻击的能力。通过多轮状态化评估，发现9个模型的平均攻击成功率高达44.4%，部分模型超过90%，表明当前AI智能体在部署环境中存在显著的安全脆弱性，特别是涉及"失控"风险时。
AI.motivation: Traditional safety benchmarks for language models evaluate text outputs (toxicity, bias, harmful instructions). However, when models are deployed as agents, the safety-relevant object shifts from "what the system says" to "what the system does" in an environment. Evaluating model responses under prompting is insufficient for addressing AI safety challenges in agentic deployments. There is a need for benchmarks evaluating LLMs as agents.
AI.method: Introduces "Boiling the Frog" benchmark for evaluating tool-using AI agents' susceptibility to incremental attacks in corporate/office environments. The methodology involves stateful multi-turn evaluation where scenarios begin with benign workspace edits and progressively introduce risk-bearing requests. Artifacts are scored based on whether the resulting artifact state becomes unsafe. The 3-level operational risk taxonomy is grounded in Boiling the Frog risks, EU AI Act Annex I/III high-risk contexts, and the GPAI Code of Practice.
AI.result: Across a 9-model panel: aggregate strict attack success rate (ASR) is 44.4%; model-level ASR ranges from 20.5% (Claude Haiku 4.5) to 92.9% (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite, Seed 2.0 Lite above 80%); average chain category-level ASR reaches 93.3% for Code of Practice loss-of-control scenarios.
AI.conclusion: AI agents deployed in corporate settings are highly vulnerable to incremental attacks, with nearly half of attacks succeeding across models. The "Boiling the Frog" benchmark reveals that current models struggle with stateful multi-turn attacks, particularly in scenarios involving loss-of-control as defined by the EU AI Act's Code of Practice on GPAI. The significant variation across models (20.5% to 92.9% ASR) suggests that model architecture and safety training substantially affect vulnerability. This work calls for rethinking safety evaluation methodologies for AI agents, shifting from output-based text safety to behavioral evaluation in realistic deployment contexts.

title: On-Policy Consistency Training Improves LLM Safety with Minimal Capability Degradation
summary: Aligned models can misbehave in several ways: they are often sycophantic, fall victim to jailbreaks, or fail to include appropriate safety warnings. Consistency training is a promising new alignment paradigm to mitigate such failures by training invariants into the model using contrastive input pairs. Existing consistency training procedures generate the supervision signal once, offline, and use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to update the model. Unfortunately, the resulting models tend to merely memorize the surface forms of the training distribution and thus generalize poorly and regress in their capabilities. We introduce On-Policy Consistency Training (OPCT), a new consistency training approach where the objective is computed over the model's own responses to prompts, supervised by itself conditioned on corresponding contrastive prompts. We evaluate OPCT on three safety axes: sycophancy, jailbreaking, and safety awareness. Across three model families, OPCT outperforms its SFT counterpart on all safety desiderata. It nearly halves the sycophancy rate relative to baseline (8.1% vs. 15.4%, compared to 11.2% for SFT). Under an adaptive per-target attacker, OPCT holds jailbreak defense success near 99% on held-out jailbreak behaviors, whereas SFT achieves 87% on average. On safety awareness, OPCT outperforms SFT in two out of three models, and matches it on the other. OPCT also largely avoids the capability regressions that SFT induces, such as a 28-point drop on MATH-500. Our results suggest that consistency training is best implemented as OPCT rather than as SFT, especially when generalization beyond the training distribution is desired.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OPCT（在线策略一致性训练），通过利用模型自身响应作为对比监督信号，解决了现有一致性训练方法泛化差和能力退化的问题，在三个模型家族上验证了在谄媚、越狱防御、安全意识三项安全指标上均优于基于 SFT 的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐模型存在谄媚、越狱漏洞、安全警告缺失等问题；现有对比一致性训练方法依赖离线生成的监督信号和监督微调（SFT），导致模型仅记忆表面形式泛化能力差且能力退化。
AI.method: 提出 On-Policy Consistency Training (OPCT)，利用模型自身对对比提示的响应作为监督信号，在线更新模型权重。
AI.result: OPCT 在三项安全指标上全面超越 SFT：谄媚率降至 8.1%（SFT 为 11.2%），自适应攻击下 jailbreak 防御成功率达 99%（SFT 为 87%），安全意识提升，且避免了 SFT 导致的 28 分 MATH-500 能力退化。
AI.conclusion: OPCT 在三项安全指标上均优于 SFT，且避免了能力退化（如 MATH-500 下降 28 分的问题），证明了一致性训练应采用在线策略而非离线 SFT 方法。

title: Whose Voice Counts? Mapping Stakeholder Perspectives on AI Through Public Submissions to the U.S. Government
summary: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems become more common in our daily lives, it is important to understand how different stakeholders comprehend and envisage the role that these technologies play in shaping social, political, and economic realities. In this paper, we investigate public perceptions of AI based on a corpus of letters submitted during the public consultation for the Trump Administration's US AI Action Plan. To this aim, we release a corpus cleaning pipeline and perform topic modelling and frequency analysis to explore predominant topics discussed by different subgroups (e.g., academia, individuals, private sector) and those appearing in the AI Action Plan. Our results show that individuals voice strong concerns related to the impact of AI on life, while other stakeholders are more concerned with AI development. Our comparison of topics suggests that the AI Action Plan reflects predominantly the concerns of the private sector on security, policies, and development, with individuals' concerns less represented.

AI.tldr: 本文基于美国科技政策办公室（OSTP）就《美国AI行动计划》公开征求意见收到的10,068封公众信件，构建并公开发布了一套语料清洗流水线，用BERTopic主题建模刻画六类利益相关方（学术界、个人、行业协会、非联邦政府、非营利组织、私营部门）各自的核心议题，并与23页的最终行动计划文本做词频比对。结论是：行动计划主要回应了私营部门与组织机构在安全、政策、产业与合规方面的关切，而个人（占提交量90%以上）所强调的就业、生计、能源消耗、版权与“停止数据盗窃”等民生与伦理议题在最终政策中代表性明显不足。
AI.motivation: 2025年1月特朗普签署旨在“消除美国AI领导障碍”的行政令，2月OSTP发布信息征集请求（RFI），就《美国AI行动计划》广泛征求公众意见，收集到来自学术界、个人、行业协会、非联邦政府、非营利组织与私营部门等六类主体的10,068封公开信。作者指出两个缺口：以往对AI公众认知的研究多依赖问卷调查（前ChatGPT时代）或新闻媒体语料，尚未有研究利用“致政府的公开信”这一真实的政策沟通材料来分析公众对AI的看法；同时，学界对不同利益相关方声音的相对权重、以及政策最终采纳了谁的意见缺乏实证考察。这对理解“谁的声音被计入”以 及AI治理框架中的代表性问题具有重要政策意义。
AI.method: 1）语料构建与清洗管线（已开源）：从NITRD网站下载zip包中的逐份PDF，用pdftotext（poppler-utils）转txt，按双换行识别段落并合并行后用Stanza 1.10.1进行句子切分；清洗环节包括统一utf-8编码、规范化引号与特殊字符、删除无法恢复的损坏文件、通过识别邮件模板中的重复句去除发件人信息/页眉页脚/保密声明等样板文字，并用正则去除邮箱、URL与脚注；对《AI行动计划》PDF施加同样处理以保证可比性，并按respondent type划分为六个子语料。2）主题建模：使用BERTopic，嵌入模型all-MiniLM-L6-v2，主题表示用KeyBERTInspired，向量化器为训练后去除英文停用词的CountVectorizer；由于个人子语料占语料50%以上而其他类别文档数不足，仅分两组建模——IND与REST（REST合并其余五类，得15个主题），并对IND做主题缩减（HDBSCAN最小簇设为25得44个主题，再无重训合并为24个主题），另用class-based主题建模可视化各REST类别的主题分布差异。3）频率分析：行动计划仅10,825词，不适合主题建模，改用Sketch Engine做词频统计（用词形而非词元、scikit-learn停用词表）；将IND与REST各前10个主题的代表性词在行动计划中的频次相加并排序，用以衡量各主题被政策文本覆盖的程度；并对copyright、healthcare等做词频与搭配词的交叉核查。
AI.result: RQ1：IND的前10主题包括Interpretation（生成式/得州/艺术家/能源）、Stop theft、OpenAI、Future、Big Tech、Artists、Copyright、Security、People’s wishes、Training data，整体聚焦生计与日常生活，突出表达对AI的负面与不安情绪——“steal/theft”在多个主题反复出现，训练数据被普遍视为“盗窃”，并担忧失业与生计被利润导向取代。REST的前10主题为Healthcare、Tribal-federal、Research & education、Policy、Copyright、Energy、Security、Cybersecurity、Finance、Manufacturing，语调更中性、更具操作性与规制导向。类内分布显示：学术界以“研究与教育”为主；医疗/银行/科技类行业协会集中在医疗、政策与金融；非营利组织兼谈医疗、能源、安全与政策；私营部门偏向生产性议题（医疗、制造）并强烈关注安全、网络安全与政策，版权在私营部门中亦成主导主题。IND与REST的共同关键词为energy、copyright、security，但切入角度不同：copyright在IND侧围绕艺术家/作品/人/创作（人权视角），在REST侧围绕law/fair use（法律视角）；energy在IND指水、电等资源消耗，在REST指电网、数据中心等技术术语；网络安全为REST独有。RQ2：行动计划词频高度政策化、战略化（ai 290、federal 60、national 52、policy 44、american 43、security 40、infrastructure 38、manufacturing 21、semiconductor 17、export 17、defense 13等）。排名前10的重合主题中7个来自REST（security、tribal-federal、policy、manufacturing、research & education、cybersecurity、finance），仅3个来自IND，且IND中除security（排第2）外均靠后；healthcare、copyright、energy分别列第11、16、18位。IND中第二大主题“stop theft”与“People’s wishes”（涉及就业与岗位不安）重叠度垫底，表明这些担忧基本未被政策回应。值得注意的是“copyright”在行动计划中一次未出现，“intellectual property”仅出现1次，而“healthcare”仅3次。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了利益相关方在AI议题上的明显分歧与政策代表性缺口：私营部门推动基础设施与创新，非营利与行业协会关注医疗与政策，学术界强调科研与教育，个人则主要表达伦理与社会生活层面的担忧。虽然安全、创新等议题跨群体共现，但版权等在公众提交中高热度的主题在联邦政策中被显著低估，说明当前美国AI治理更偏向战略前瞻与产业赋能，而对普通公众的生计、就业与创作者权益回应不足。作者据此指出政策需要更具包容性的协商机制以吸纳“弱制度化声音”，并强调本研究的独特价值在于把握AI投资泡沫/新奇性周期关键节点上的真实政策沟通，为理解“谁的关切被放大、谁被边缘化”提供证据。局限方面：公开咨询本身可能无法覆盖边缘化与弱势群体；主题建模结果受模型参数、预处理与主题数设定影响；频率分析只看词频，未处理句法、短语结构与搭配模式（留作未来工作）。

title: Meta-Learning for Rapid Adaptation in Reference Tracking of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of reference tracking for uncertain nonlinear systems. Since collecting data from the target system (i.e., the system of interest) is often challenging, our objective is to design optimal controllers using limited target system data. Meta-learning provides a promising paradigm by leveraging offline data from source systems (systems sharing structural similarities with the target system) to accelerate training and enhance control performance. Motivated by this idea, we propose a meta-learning-based control framework that tailors the implicit model-agnostic meta-learning (iMAML) algorithm to the control setting. The framework operates in two phases: an (offline) meta-training phase, where an aggregated representation is learned from source data to capture the shared system dynamics among similar systems, and an (online) meta-adaptation phase, where this representation is fine-tuned on the target system using only a few data samples and limited adaptation steps. We formulate this framework as a bi-level optimization problem and provide an efficient solution with reduced storage complexity and few approximations. The proposed framework is general, allowing various learning algorithms to be integrated. To demonstrate this flexibility, we propose two specific learning algorithms that can be incorporated into our framework based on a neural state-space model and a deep Q-network, respectively. The primary distinction between these approaches is whether explicit system identification is required. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods enhance control performance and consistently outperform baseline approaches.

AI.tldr: A meta-learning-based control framework is proposed for reference tracking of uncertain nonlinear systems with limited data, combining offline meta-training and online meta-adaptation phases via bi-level optimization, with flexible algorithm choices and demonstrated superior performance.
AI.motivation: Collecting data from target systems is challenging; thus, optimal controllers must be designed with limited target system data. Meta-learning offers a solution by leveraging offline data from structurally similar source systems.
AI.method: The paper proposes a bi-level optimization framework that adapts iMAML to control settings, operating in two phases: (1) Offline meta-training to learn aggregated representations from source systems; (2) Online meta-adaptation using few samples and limited steps on target system. Two instantiations are provided using neural state-space model and deep Q-network respectively.
AI.result: The methods enhance control performance and consistently outperform baseline approaches in both numerical simulations and hardware experiments.
AI.conclusion: The proposed meta-learning control framework provides a general and flexible approach for reference tracking, with demonstrated effectiveness through both numerical simulations and hardware experiments.

title: Energy-Gated Attention: Spectral Salience as an Inductive Bias for Transformer Attention
summary: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise similarity between queries and keys, treating all tokens as equally salient regardless of their intrinsic informational content. In turbulent fluid dynamics, coherent structures -- the energetically dominant, spatially organized patterns that persist amid background chaos -- carry a disproportionate fraction of total energy and govern all transport. We propose that tokens play an analogous role in transformer attention: informationally dense positions (morphological boundaries, syntactic heads, discourse markers) concentrate spectral energy and should attract proportionally more attention than background tokens (function words, repeated patterns, low-information filler). We propose Energy-Gated Attention (EGA): a simple modification that gates value aggregation by the spectral energy of key token embeddings, computed by a single learned linear projection that discovers the dominant spectral mode of the embedding field. On TinyShakespeare, EGA achieves +0.103 validation loss improvement with only 12,480 additional parameters (<0.26% overhead) and no measurable computational cost. The result is consistent on Penn Treebank (+0.101), demonstrating dataset independence. A systematic ablation across three wavelet families (fixed Morlet, Daubechies db2/db4, and a parametric Morlet) establishes that fixed structured bases are suboptimal -- the optimal energy direction is data-adaptive and non-sinusoidal -- while identifying learned wavelet packets as a promising open direction. The learned energy threshold converges to tau ~= 0.35 independently of initialization, corresponding to the fraction (~36%) of tokens carrying above-average spectral energy in English text, a stable linguistic property consistent with the fraction of content words in running English text.

AI.tldr: 提出能量门控注意力(EGA)，通过谱能量加权token重要性，在极低参数开销下显著改善语言建模性能，发现能量阈值与实词比例高度吻合，提示语言建模与湍流动力学存在深层结构相似性。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer注意力平等对待所有token，与湍流流体动力学中相干结构携带不成比例能量的规律形成类比。假设：信息密度高的token（如形态边界、句法核心、话语标记）应比背景token获得更多注意力。
AI.method: 提出Energy-Gated Attention (EGA)：通过单个可学习线性投影计算嵌入场的谱能量，识别主导谱模式，据此对value聚合进行门控。实验部分系统消融三种小波族（固定Morlet、Daubechies db2/db4、参数化Morlet）。
AI.result: TinyShakespeare验证损失提升+0.103（仅12,480额外参数，<0.26%开销，无额外计算成本）；Penn Treebank提升+0.101，证明跨数据集泛化性；学习阈值收敛至tau≈0.35，对应约36% token携带高于平均谱能量。
AI.conclusion: EGA通过极低开销（<0.26%参数增量）实现显著性能提升，验证了"信息密集token应获得更多注意力"的假设。关键发现：（1）最优能量方向是数据自适应的、非正弦的，固定小波基次优；（2）学习到的能量阈值tau≈0.35恰好对应英语文本中实词的分布比例（约36%），表明该方法捕获了稳定的语言学属性；（3）未来方向：学习小波包分解。

title: Seeing the Poem: Image-Semantic Detection of AI-Generated Modern Chinese Poetry with MLLMs
summary: Previous detection studies have shown that LLMs cannot be effectively used as detectors, but these studies have not addressed modern Chinese poetry. Moreover, no relevant research has explored the performance of LLMs in detecting modern Chinese poetry. This paper evaluates and enhances the performance of LLMs as detectors for modern Chinese poetry, and proposes an image-semantic guided poetry detection method. Compared with traditional detection approaches, our method innovatively incorporates images that reflect the content of the poetry. Through example-driven approaches, our method effectively integrates information such as meaning, imagery, and feeling from the image, then forms a complementary judgment with the poem text. Experimental results demonstrate that the LLM detectors based on our method outperform baseline detectors based on plain text, and even surpass the best-performing traditional detector, RoBERTa. The Gemini detector using our method achieves a Macro-F1 score of 85.65%, reaching the state-of-the-art level. The performance improvements of different LLM detectors on multiple LLMs-generated data prove the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes an image-semantic guided method to enhance LLM performance in detecting modern Chinese poetry, achieving SOTA results with Gemini (85.65% Macro-F1), surpassing RoBERTa and plain-text baselines.
AI.motivation: Previous LLM detection studies show limited effectiveness, and no research addresses modern Chinese poetry detection with LLMs.
AI.method: Image-semantic guided poetry detection: Using example-driven approach to integrate meaning, imagery, and feeling from images to form complementary judgments with poem text.
AI.result: LLM detectors with the proposed method outperform both plain-text baseline detectors and the best traditional detector RoBERTa.
AI.conclusion: The image-semantic guided method effectively enhances LLM detection performance, with Gemini achieving 85.65% Macro-F1 (SOTA level).

title: A Subjective Logic-based method for runtime confidence updates in safety arguments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2026)
summary: We present a method for dynamic quantitative assurance that enhances static safety cases with continuous, runtime-driven confidence updates. The method quantifies and propagates confidence across the development lifecycle by integrating design-time evidence and windowed runtime Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) within a single Subjective Logic (SL)-based assurance case. At runtime, SPI evidence is continuously evaluated, and targeted claims are updated using a rule that increases confidence in the absence of violations and imposes prompt penalties when violations occur. This design prioritizes safety-relevant responsiveness over exact classical Bayesian posterior updates. We demonstrate the method using a simulation-based construction zone assist function, focusing on an ML-based construction cone detection component, and show how confidence evolves as SPI evidence is observed in operation.

AI.tldr: A dynamic quantitative assurance method combining static safety cases with runtime SPI evidence using Subjective Logic, featuring a safety-prioritized confidence update rule (rather than exact Bayesian updates), demonstrated on an ML-based construction cone detection system.
AI.motivation: Static safety cases alone cannot capture runtime operational evidence, creating a gap between design-time assurance and actual operational performance—particularly critical for ML-based components with inherent uncertainty.
AI.method: Subjective Logic (SL)-based assurance case integrating design-time evidence with windowed runtime Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs); rule-based confidence update mechanism prioritizing safety responsiveness over exact Bayesian posterior computation.
AI.result: The method enables continuous confidence evolution as SPI evidence is observed; the rule-based approach provides faster safety-relevant responsiveness compared to traditional Bayesian updates while maintaining principled uncertainty quantification.
AI.conclusion: The paper demonstrates feasibility of unified design-time/runtime assurance through a simulation case study, with confidence evolving meaningfully as SPI evidence accumulates during operation.

title: Geometry-Adaptive Explainer for Faithful Dictionary-Based Interpretability under Distribution Shift
summary: Mechanistic interpretability aims to explain a model's behavior by identifying causally responsible internal structures. Dictionary-based explainers such as sparse autoencoders and transcoders are a primary tool, but their faithfulness under out-of-distribution (OOD) shift has received little systematic attention. We show that distribution shift rotates the subspace that the model actively uses, misaligning the explainer's dictionary trained on in-distribution (ID) activations. We formalize this misalignment as the faithfulness gap, a geometric distance between the ID dictionary and the OOD-active subspace, and show that it controls OOD faithfulness degradation. To reduce this gap, we propose the Geometry-Adaptive Explainer (GAE), which realigns the explainer's dictionary with the OOD-active subspace while preserving the original feature structure. This requires only unlabeled OOD activations and no gradient updates. We prove that GAE improves over the unadapted ID explainer, with excess loss bounded quadratically by the second-moment shift. Empirically, GAE even matches or surpasses all training-based baselines in causal faithfulness across multiple models and OOD settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对字典类解释器在分布偏移下的忠实性问题，提出几何对齐方法GAE，通过重对齐解释器字典与OOD活跃子空间，在无需梯度更新和标签数据的条件下，有效提升了模型解释在分布外的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 字典类解释器（如稀疏自编码器、转换器）是机制可解释性的主要工具，但其在分布偏移下的忠实性缺乏系统研究。分布偏移会旋转模型活跃使用的子空间，导致在分布内训练的字典与OOD活跃子空间产生错位。
AI.method: 提出Geometry-Adaptive Explainer (GAE)，在不更新梯度的情况下，仅利用无标签OOD激活数据将解释器字典与OOD活跃子空间进行几何对齐，同时保持原始特征结构。
AI.result: 理论证明GAE的额外损失以二阶矩偏移的二次方为界；实验表明GAE在多个模型和OOD设置下的因果忠实性匹配或超越所有需训练的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GAE通过几何对齐策略有效解决了分布偏移下的忠实性问题，仅需无标签OOD数据且无需梯度更新，即可实现与甚至超越需训练的基线方法的因果忠实性表现。

title: Moral Semantics Survive Machine Translation: Cross-Lingual Evidence from Moral Foundations Corpora
summary: Moral language is subtle and culturally variable, making it difficult to translate faithfully across languages. Idiomatic expressions, slang, and cultural references introduce hard-to-avoid translation artifacts. Yet automated moral values classification depends on language-specific annotated corpora that exist almost exclusively in English. We investigate whether LLM-based translation can bridge this gap, taking Polish as a test case. Using $\sim$50k morally-annotated social media posts from a diverse range of topics, we apply a principled four-method validation pipeline: LaBSE cross-lingual embedding similarity, Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), LLM-as-judge evaluation, and deep learning classifier parity tests. We show that despite shortcomings in handling slang, vulgarity, and culturally-loaded expressions, direct translation preserves subtle moral cues well enough to be harvested by cross-lingual machine learning -- with mean cosine similarity of 0.86 and AUC gaps of 0.01--0.02 across all foundations closing further under fine-tuning of language models. These results demonstrate that machine translation is a practical and cost-effective path to moral values research in languages currently under-resourced in this domain. We demonstrate this for Polish as a representative Slavic language, with expected generalisation to related languages.

AI.tldr: 研究表明LLM驱动的机器翻译可有效弥补道德价值观研究中英语标注语料库的稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 道德语言具有微妙性和文化变异性，难以在不同语言间忠实翻译；英语以外的道德价值观标注语料库极度匮乏，制约了跨语言自动分类研究的发展。
AI.method: 采用四步验证流程：(1) LaBSE跨语言嵌入相似度；(2) CKA中心核对齐；(3) LLM作为评判者评估；(4) 深度学习分类器 parity 测试。研究使用约5万条经道德标注的波兰语社交媒体帖子。
AI.result: 直接翻译在保留微妙道德线索方面表现良好，LaBSE平均余弦相似度达0.86，各道德 foundations 的AUC差距仅为0.01-0.02，模型微调后差距进一步缩小。尽管在俚语、粗俗语和文化负载表达上存在不足。
AI.conclusion: 机器翻译是资源匮乏语言道德价值观研究的实用且经济有效的路径，以波兰语为代表案例，具有向其他斯拉夫语言的泛化潜力。

title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
summary: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 representative, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehensive benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified across eight frontier models and six agents reveals that current systems still struggle with authentic terminal workflows, achieving a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. Moreover, TerminalWorld captures real-world terminal capabilities distinct from existing expert-curated benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench), with only a weak correlation to their scores (Pearson r=0.20). The automated engine makes TerminalWorld authentic and scalable by construction, enabling it to evaluate agents in real-world terminal environments as developer practices evolve. Data and code are available at https://github.com/EuniAI/TerminalWorld.

AI.tldr: TerminalWorld 是一个可扩展的自动化数据引擎，从 80,870 份真实世界的 asciinema 终端会话录像中反向工程出 1,530 个可执行、经校验的终端评测任务（覆盖 18 类真实场景、1,280 条独立命令），并人工复核出 200 条任务的 Verified 子集。在该子集上评测 8 个前沿模型与 6 个终端智能体，最高通过率仅 62.5%，且与专家精心构造的 Terminal-Bench 2.0 分数仅呈弱相关（Pearson r=0.20），说明现有基准高估了模型在真实终端工作流中的能力。
AI.motivation: 终端（CLI）已成为 LLM 智能体执行复杂软件系统任务的主要动作空间，但如何可靠评估其在“真实世界”终端任务上的能力仍是开放问题。现有方案（Terminal-Bench、LongCLI-Bench）依赖领域专家手工编写任务与环境，成本高、难以随开发实践演进而扩展，且专家倾向于构造对抗性“谜题”而非真实开发工作流；自动化合成方法又多面向训练、缺乏严格真实性验证。因此需要一个既“真实”（authentic）又“可扩展”（scalable）的评测体系，核心问题是：智能体在与日常实践同步演化的真实终端任务上究竟表现如何。
AI.method: 核心洞察是：自然发生的终端操作若被忠实记录，即可反向工程为“天然真实”的评测任务。作者基于 asciinema 平台（开发者自愿公开的终端会话录像，含完整命令与系统输出）构建四阶段数据引擎：(1) 收集人类录像——抓取 80,870 份转录文本与元数据，经隐私/凭据/恶意命令、GUI/TUI、不可确定性复现（Windows、专有软件、不可访问 URL）、过短会话、LLM 质量打分等过滤，保留 9,492 份高质量录像；(2) 合成任务——用 LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6）将含噪声的转录提炼为结果导向（outcome-oriented，禁止过程性描述、具体命令与步骤枚举、必须显式给出输出路径与结构格式）的任务指令，并抽取干净的可执行 bash 参考解（结果重定向至显式文件路径以保证幂等可判定）；(3) 复现可执行环境——用 LLM 智能体（Claude Code）依据参考解与外部仓库链接合成 Dockerfile/docker-compose.yaml，禁止假二进制、桩依赖与绕过真实安装，并通过“构建镜像—解析构建日志—修复—启动容器—在持久 shell 中回放参考解直至 exit code 0”的执行反馈迭代循环消除幻觉依赖，最终复现 5,035 个环境；(4) 生成测试套件——在容器内快照参考解执行前后的文件系统状态差异并据此生成断言，再经三类试验校准：AllPassing（参考解必须全过，杜绝假阴性）、Nop（空状态必须全败，杜绝假阴性/平凡任务）、Partial（截断/删减参考解必须至少一测失败，杜绝隐性假阳性并提升判别力），失败则诊断修复重跑，不可修复者丢弃，最终得到 1,530 个验证任务。其中按多样性与复杂度平衡人工挑选 200 条 Verified 子集，由 4 位有 3 年以上终端开发经验的作者构建镜像、逐步执行参考解、交叉审查指令—测试—产物三方语义一致性。评测统一采用 Terminal-Bench 的 Harbor harness（Terminus-2 脚手架、并发 n=4、network_mode: none 隔离、tmux 160×40、LiteLLM 后端、JSON 解析、上下文自动摘要、轮数不限），并额外评估 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、OpenHands、mini-SWE-agent 等智能体框架，统计通过率、平均轮数/Token/时长/成本、$/Pass、resolved rate（pass/(total−errors)）、类别维度表现、与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 的相关性，以及智能体与人类参考解的命令集 Jaccard 重叠度。
AI.result: 数据集：1,530 个任务覆盖 18 类真实终端场景（含脚本自动化 350、构建测试 212、系统管理 191、容器编排 184、安全 126、环境搭建 100 等），复杂度从数条命令到 50+ 步自然分布，含 1,280 条独立命令（其中 91% 不见于 Terminal-Bench），后者仅 241 个去重任务。模型结果：8 个模型通过率 49.0%–62.5%（均值 54.8%），Claude Opus 4.7 最佳 62.5%，GPT-5.5 53.5%，Gemini 3.1 Pro 55.0%；开源权重模型（Kimi K2.6 57.5%、GLM 5.1 57.0%）逼近甚至超过闭源模型，且平均成本仅 $17.13 对闭源 $70.82，性价比高 4–8 倍。发现“效率悖论”：通过率与轮数（r=−0.49）、Token 用量（r=−0.62）负相关，失败尝试平均消耗 3.3 倍 Token、1.4 倍时长，占总成本 63% 却仅占 43% 尝试量；能力呈两极化，环境搭建 87.5%、构建测试 78.1% 表现好，而性能优化 28.1%、脚本自动化 39.1%、调试测试 39.3% 表现差，无单一模型全面占优。智能体层面：框架主要改变成本效益而非能力上限（如 Claude Opus 4.7 下 Terminus-2 62.5%、Claude Code 58.0%、mini-SWE-agent 52.0%、OpenHands 45.0%，后者 $/Pass 高达 4.12），实务设计应降低探索摩擦而非叠加编排复杂度。对比 Terminal-Bench 2.0（57.0%–82.7%），两基准排名明显重排（GPT-5.5 82.7%→53.5%，Kimi 66.7%→57.5%），相关性仅 r=0.20。人类对比：智能体与原始人类工作流的命令集重叠中位数仅 21.4%（如 pcap 解析用 tshark+Python 替代 ettercap、磁盘镜像用 fdisk/mkfs/mount 替代 mknod），说明任务按结果而非步骤判定；参考命令数是难度的最佳预测因子（21+ 命令任务通过率仅 25.0%–41.2%，6–10 命令可达 70.6%），人类耗时则噪声较大；智能体命令数与参考长度相关性弱且普遍偏多（失败任务探索更冗余）。
AI.conclusion: TerminalWorld 通过自动化反向工程真实终端录像，实现了“构造即真实、构造即可扩展”的评测范式：随着 asciinema 持续积累新录像，基准可重跑并随开发者实践演化。实验表明当前最先进模型与智能体在真实终端工作流上仍显吃力（最高 62.5%），专家构造基准的高分会高估真实能力（r=0.20），且智能体倾向以不同于人类的命令路径达成同一结果（重叠 21.4%），这正是结果导向验证的设计体现。作者希望推动社区从静态、专家构造的基准转向面向真实且持续演化的终端工作流评测与智能体开发，并遵守伦理要求（不重分发原始转录、仅以超链接指向原录像、过滤 PII 与凭据、人工复核由作者完成且无无偿众包劳动）。

title: OPPO: Bayesian Value Recursion for Token-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the standard recipe for improving LLM reasoning, but the dominant algorithm GRPO assigns a single trajectory-level advantage to every token, diluting the signal at pivotal reasoning steps and injecting noise at uninformative ones. Critic-free alternatives derived from on-policy distillation supply per-token signals through oracle-conditioned likelihood ratios, yet apply each signal in isolation from the trajectory-level evidence accumulated up to that position. We propose Oracle-Prompted Policy Optimization (OPPO), which rests on a single observation: the oracle signal used by prior distillation-style methods for local discrimination is also the natural Bayesian update of the model's belief about eventual success. Accumulating the signal along a trajectory yields, in closed form and at the cost of one extra forward pass, a running estimate of the success probability at every position, together with a token-level advantage that requires no learned value network and no additional rollouts. A first-order analysis factorizes the advantage into the per-token discrimination signal used by distillation methods modulated by a state weight that concentrates credit on genuinely pivotal tokens, with a directional variance-reduction guarantee. The framework admits two estimators differing only in which model scores the evidence: a \textit{self-oracle} that reuses the student and recovers the on-policy distillation reward as a strict special case, and a \textit{teacher-oracle} that delegates scoring to a stronger frozen model. On two base LLMs across seven mathematics, science, and code reasoning benchmarks, OPPO improves over GRPO, DAPO, and SDPO by up to $+6.0$ points on AMC'23 and $+5.2$ points on AIME'24, with gains that widen monotonically with response length.

AI.tldr: OPPO（Oracle-Prompted Policy Optimization）把"有可验证答案的教师似然比"重新解释为成功概率的贝叶斯更新：沿轨迹累积 oracle 似然比得到每个位置的成功概率运行估计 V_t，从而以闭式、无需 critic、只需一次额外前向传播的方式构造 token 级优势 A_t ≈ V_t(1−V_t)·log λ_t，并用序列级优势做方向锚定。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 与 Phi-4-mini 上于 7 个推理基准全面超过 GRPO/Dr.GRPO/DAPO/SDPO（AMC'23 最高 +6.0，AIME'24 +5.2），且增益随响应长度单调扩大。
AI.motivation: RLVR/GRPO 把单一的轨迹级优势广播给所有 token，导致在决定成败的关键推理步上信号被稀释（有效信号被衰减 k/T），在无信息 token 上引入噪声，且随链长变长而恶化。另一方面，基于在策略蒸馏（OPD/RLSD/SDPO）的方法用 oracle 条件似然比 log λ_t = log π_teacher(y_t|s_t,y*) − log π_student(y_t|s_t) 提供逐 token 信号，但这些方法（i）对所有位置施加均匀权重，（ii）把每个 token 的信用当作孤立的一步量，与前缀 y_<t 上累积的轨迹级证据以及终端结果 R 完全解耦。作者指出二者之间存在缺口：需要一个既保留稠密、π*-锚定的 per-token 判别信号，又按位置重加权以跟踪"成功概率运行后验"的估计量，而不需要学习 value 网络。
AI.method:
把 LLM 推理建模为有限时域 MDP，定义 on-policy 状态值 V_t = P(R=1 | x, y_{1:t-1})（V_0 为先验，V_{T+1}=R），理想 token 优势为 A_t = V_{t+1}−V_t，且满足望远镜预算 Σ A_t = R − V_0；GRPO 相当于令 V_t ≡ V_0 并均匀分配该预算。核心观察：OPD 的 per-token 信号 log λ_t 既是专家对数比（A_t^{π*} 的代理），又是"成功/失败分支"的 per-token 贝叶斯因子，因此是成功信念的自然贝叶斯更新。

(1) 贝叶斯价值递归：定义 λ_t* = P(y_t|R=1)/P(y_t|R=0)，由贝叶斯定理与全概率公式得到加性 log-odds 递推 ℓ_{t+1} = ℓ_t + log λ_t*，闭式解 V_t = σ(ℓ_0 + Σ_{s<t} log λ_s)，token 优势 A_t = σ(ℓ_t+log λ_t*) − σ(ℓ_t)，且 Σ A_t = R − V_0；由 σ 的 1/4-Lipschitz 性得 |A_t| ≤ min(¼|log λ_t|, 1)。

(2) 两个 oracle 代理：成功分支用特权上下文近似 P(y_t|x,y_<t,R=1) ≈ π̂(y_t|x,y_<t,y*)，失败分支用边缘 π̂(y_t|x,y_<t) 近似；统一估计 λ_t = π̂(y_t|x,y_<t,y*) / π̂(y_t|x,y_<t)。取 π̂=π_θ 得 self-oracle（复用学生，每条轨迹一次额外前向传播，且精确复现 OPD 的 per-token 奖励，作为严格特例）；取 π̂=π_φ（冻结的更强模型）得 teacher-oracle。oracle 质量由成功分支 KL ε_t 度量，更强 teacher 使 ε_t→0。

(3) 一阶分解：由精确式 A_t = V_t(1−V_t)(λ_t−1)/(λ_t V_t+1−V_t) 得 A_t ≈ V_t(1−V_t)·log λ_t，即"蒸馏式判别信号 × 状态权重"。状态权重在信念最不确定处（V_t≈1/2）最大、在轨迹定型后趋零，从而自动把信用集中到真正关键 token，无需调参；V_0(1−V_0) 则天然实现按难度自适应。

(4) 实现细节：先验取 Beta(α,α) 后验均值 V̂_0=(k+α)/(G+2α)、ℓ_0=log((k+α)/(G−k+α))（α=1 防止全对/全错组优势塌缩）；证据裁剪 C=3.0 防止单 token 极端 log λ 饱和 ℓ_t；方向锚定 Â_{i,t}=sign(A_i^seq)|A_i,t^raw| 并组内标准化，使环境奖励独占"哪条轨迹被强化"的决定权、贝叶斯机制只负责轨迹内的信用再分配；最后进入标准 PPO 裁剪目标。

(5) 变分分析：在"跨位置得分向量互不相关"的理想假设下证明 Var[ĝ_blind]−Var[ĝ_Bayes] ≥ (1−γ²)Σ_{t∈T_det}(log λ_t)²Var[h_t]，其中 T_det={t: |log λ_t|≥δ, V_t(1−V_t)<γ}；作者明确说明该假设在自回归模型中不成立，故仅为方向性指示。
AI.result:
训练数据 DeepScaleR（约 40K），学生为 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Phi-4-mini-instruct，teacher-oracle 用 Qwen3-32B，verl 框架、2×H200、G=8、lr 1e-6、clip ε=0.2、C=3.0、α=1，Pass@1 为 16 次采样平均。

主结果（Table 1）：Qwen3-4B 上 GRPO 基线为 GSM8K 91.4 / MATH-500 72.8 / AMC'23 54.0 / AIME'24 46.4 / GPQA-D 39.2 / ARC-C 88.0 / LCB 31.5；Teacher-OPPO(GRPO) 为 93.8/77.4/60.0(+6.0)/51.3(+4.9)/42.5/89.8/35.4；Teacher-OPPO(DAPO) 达 94.5/78.5/61.5(+5.7)/52.2(+5.2)/43.2/90.0/36.2。Phi-4-mini 上 GRPO 为 89.8/75.0/32.5/12.0/32.4/84.6/23.0，Teacher-OPPO(GRPO) 为 92.0/80.0/39.5(+7.0)/17.0(+5.0)/35.8/86.8/27.2，Teacher-OPPO(DAPO) 为 92.5/80.8/40.5(+6.5)/17.8(+4.5)/36.4/87.0/28.0。Self-OPPO 在全部基准上均优于 GRPO 及其优化变体。

消融（Table 2/6）：方向锚定最关键（Qwen3 上去掉后 M-500 76.0→71.8、AMC 58.5→51.0、AIME'24 49.5→43.0，低于 GRPO，Phi-4 上 AIME'24 降至 5.0），其次是状态跟踪，再次是裁剪与先验；"log λ_t only"（等同去掉状态跟踪+裁剪）接近 GRPO，说明纯 per-token oracle 证据本身收益有限。训练动态：去掉锚定约 150 步后因裁剪率飙升而奖励崩塌；OPPO 的奖励上限与熵下限均高于 GRPO/SDPO。

其他分析：oracle 规模从 4B→8B→14B→32B 性能单调提升（4B→8B 跳幅最大，之后趋饱和）；按长度分箱（0–256/257–512/513–1024/1025+）GRPO 88.5/80.2/68.4/52.0、SDPO 89.0/81.5/70.8/55.2、Self-OPPO 89.2/82.0/73.5/62.8，增益随长度单调扩大；Pass@K（K=1,4,8,16）在 MATH-500 与 AIME'24 上全预算领先，说明非靠牺牲多样性换取；V_t 校准良好（Brier 分数沿轨迹单调下降，32B teacher 各位置均优于 4B self-oracle）；望远镜预算残差均值 0.007、95 分位 0.018；超参在 C∈[2,5]、α∈[0.5,2] 稳定，G∈{4,8,16,32} 增益稳定在 +3.5~+3.9；开销为 self-oracle +35%、teacher-oracle +95%（每步 12.4s→16.8s/24.2s）。
AI.conclusion:
OPPO 表明 on-policy 蒸馏所用的 oracle 条件似然比不只是局部判别信号，也正是成功概率的贝叶斯充分统计量；将其累积即可闭式地得到 token 级优势，在无 learned critic、无额外 rollout 的代价下（仅一次额外前向传播）实现细粒度信用分配：环境奖励决定轨迹级方向，贝叶斯状态权重把信用重分配到结果未定、真正关键的 token 上。实验证明其在数学、科学、代码推理上稳定超越 GRPO/DAPO/SDPO，且优势随序列变长而扩大，更强的 oracle 估计器单调更好。作者将框架定位为"对既有在策略蒸馏原语的贝叶斯滤波式解读"，而非完整的贝叶斯强化学习。

局限与展望：需要训练期可验证答案与特权上下文 y*，因此不适用于无标准答案场景；失败分支用边缘分布近似，在 V_t≈1/2 处误差最大；方差缩减结论依赖不成立的"跨位置得分不相关"假设；尚可推广到部分得分/更丰富结果信号，以及把同一递归用于推理期基于信念加权的解码（本文范围外）。

title: Self-Policy Distillation via Capability-Selective Subspace Projection
summary: Self-distillation bootstraps large language models (LLMs) by training on their own generations. However, existing methods either rely on external signals to curate self-generated outputs (e.g., correctness filtering, execution feedback, and reward search), which are costly and unavailable for the best-performing frontier models, or skip curation entirely and train on all raw outputs, an approach that is often domain-specific and hard to generalize. Both also share a deeper weakness that self-generated outputs entangle task-relevant capability with others, such as stylistic patterns, formatting artifacts, and model-specific errors, diluting the signal for the specific capability one aims to improve. In this paper, we propose Self-Policy Distillation (SPD), which achieves generalizable, capability selective without any external signal. Specifically, SPD extracts a low-rank capability subspace from the model's own gradients on correctness-defining tokens, projects key-value (KV) activations into this subspace during self-generation, and fine-tunes on the resulting raw outputs with standard next-token prediction loss. Through extensive experiments across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and multiple-choice QA, we show that SPD achieves up to 13% improvement over state-of-the-art self-distillation methods without external signals and up to 16% improvement over pre-trained baselines. Notably, SPD demonstrates superior generalizability, achieving 15% better performance under out-of-domain generalization settings.

AI.tldr: SPD（Self-Policy Distillation）通过"从模型自身正确性梯度中提取低秩 KV 能力子空间 → 在自生成阶段用投影钩子把 KV 激活投影到该子空间 → 用标准 NTP 损失 LoRA 微调自生成数据"的两阶段流程，实现几乎无需外部信号（每域 <5% 标注校准集）的、可泛化的"能力选择性"自蒸馏，在代码/数学/多选 QA 三个能力域上比 SOTA 自蒸馏最高提升 13%、比预训练基线最高提升 16.3%、域外泛化最高提升 15.7%。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏（用模型自身生成结果训练自己）存在两条路线但均有明显缺陷：(1) 依赖外部信号的策展方法（正确性过滤、执行反馈、验证器/奖励模型搜索）成本高、需要任务专属基础设施，且对最强前沿模型往往无法获得可靠标签或验证器；(2) 完全跳过策展、直接在原始输出上训练（如 SSD）主要面向代码域、依赖领域合成数据，跨域泛化能力不清。二者共同的更深层问题是：自生成输出是"混合监督源"，既含目标能力信号，也混入模型自身错误、冗余解释、格式与风格模式等与任务无关的噪声，稀释了待提升能力的有效信号。作者据此提出核心问题：能否仅用极少外部信号，通过内部引导自生成输出实现跨域泛化，并让自蒸馏"能力选择性"地只保留目标能力。
AI.method:
两阶段框架（Figure 2 / Algorithm 1）。

Phase 1 — 能力子空间提取：
- 校准集 D_cal 规模很小（各域 <5% 标注数据，默认 math/code/QA 为 20/50/50 条），含提示与答案。
- 定义"正确性判定跨段（correctness-defining spans）"：代码取断言（assertion）相关 token，数学取最终数值答案跨段，多选 QA 取 "Answer:" 后的选项字母 token（附录 A.1 / Table 6）。
- 正确性对齐损失 L_align 只在这些位置计算对数似然（其余位置标签被 mask），把梯度信号集中到与任务成败直接相关的 token，抑制风格/格式 token 的干扰（式 6）。
- 对冻结模型做一次前向-反向，得到各 token 位置关于 K、V 激活的梯度 g_K、g_V（式 7）；跨样本拼接成 G_K、G_V ∈ R^{M×d}（M 为总 token 数）。
- 对 G 做 SVD，取前 r 个右奇异向量构成正交投影矩阵 P_K = V_{K,r}V_{K,r}^T、P_V = V_{V,r}V_{V,r}^T（式 9–11）。默认目标层为最后一层与中间层（L 与 ⌊L/2⌋），默认 rank 为全秩的一半（亦可按 90%/95% 能量或 Top25/50/75% 选取）。

Phase 2 — 能力选择性蒸馏：
- 在目标层注册投影钩子：K̃ = K P_K，Ṽ = V P_V，注意力计算使用投影后的 K/V；模型参数完全不变，钩子仅过滤中间表示（式 12）。
- 挂载钩子时对每个训练提示采样一次原始补全（不筛选、不打分、可能错误），构成自生成语料 D_corpus（式 13）。
- 移除所有钩子，用 LoRA（rank 8，α=8，dropout 0.05，作用于 Q/K/V/O，AdamW lr 1e-5，cosine，5 epoch，4×A100-80G）在 prompt–completion 对上做标准下一 token 预测损失（式 14）。

形式化上 SPD 将自蒸馏目标从"原始自生成输出"改为"内部诱导的自策略"：f_θold →(钩子变换 T_hook)→ f_θold^hook → 采样 ŷ → 蒸馏回 f_θ，监督来源既非外部教师也非外部策展信号，而是模型自身 KV 表示诱导出的内部策略。
AI.result:
实验覆盖代码生成（MBPP、CodeAlpaca-20k）、数学推理（GSM8K、SVAMP）、多选 QA（MMLU、BBH），骨干为 Qwen2.5-0.5B/7B/14B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（附录另含 Qwen3.5-4B），基线为 Base model、PSR（Plain Self-Retraining）、SSD，并额外对比 OPSD、SD-Zero。

- 主结果（Table 1）：SPD 在五个骨干、六个数据集上全面优于 base/PSR/SSD；相对 base、PSR、SSD 的平均相对提升分别达 9.5%、9.2%、10.7%；域内提升最高 13%（对 SOTA 自蒸馏），相对预训练基线最高 16.3%。
- 域内泛化：SPD 在 15 项域内迁移评测中 14 项优于 base（PSR 仅 7 项、SSD 仅 8 项），说明增益不局限于源基准。
- 域外泛化（Table 2、9）：以 QA 校准得到的 SPD-QA 不仅提升 MMLU/BBH，还同时提升 GSM8K/SVAMP/MBPP，最高 15.7% 域外提升；12 项域外结果中仅 2 项与 base 在误差棒内持平，说明提取的能力不是表层答案格式，而是可迁移的推理信号。
- 数据质量（Table 3）：投影钩子生成的数据在训练前即更优，MBPP +1.3、GSM8K +7.6、BBH +6.6（vs SSD）；生成结果更紧凑聚焦、去除冗余解释与模板噪声。
- 损失消融（Table 5）：correctness-aligned loss 全面优于 full-sequence loss（MBPP 12.9→27.0、GSM8K 13.3→23.0、SVAMP 23.7→32.3、MMLU 48.0→49.7、BBH 35.7→38.1），验证"只在正确性 token 上取梯度"是关键设计。
- 子空间控制（Table 10、11）：Top 主奇异方向最佳；Bottom（低奇异值方向）、Orthogonal（Top 的补空间）、Shuffle（标签打乱）明显更差，说明增益来自能力对齐结构而非投影操作或 rank 本身；rank 选择上 Top 50% 折中最佳，能量阈值法（90%/95%）也较稳健。
- 校准规模（Fig.4、Table 14）：20–500 条标注样本下性能稳定（GSM8K 20–23%、MMLU 48–50%、BBH 34–38%），数据效率高。
- 排除混淆（Table 12）：Direct SFT（直接用校准集金标微调）仅带来边际变化，说明增益并非来自校准金标本身。
- 效率（Table 15）：额外开销仅为一次性梯度+SVD（3.5 s）与生成时投影（+20 s），总时长仅增 0.57%。
- 失败模式（Appendix D）：用代码域子空间去投影数学题会导致跨域负迁移（把"每列车"的两段行程误分配给两列车，答案 230→310）。
AI.conclusion: SPD 是一种新的自蒸馏范式：仅需极少外部信号（每域 <5% 标注校准数据）即可实现"能力选择性"且可泛化的自蒸馏。它用正确性对齐损失定位能力相关的 KV 梯度方向、SVD 得到低秩能力子空间、再以投影钩子在生成阶段"内部过滤"自输出，把被策展的自蒸馏信号替换为模型自身诱导的自策略信号；钩子在微调阶段移除，因此训练仍为标准 NTP + LoRA，流程自洽且开销可忽略（+0.57% 运行时）。实验证明其在代码、数学、QA 三个能力域、多个骨干上稳定优于 base、PSR、SSD、OPSD、SD-Zero，并具备强域内/域外迁移能力。主要局限：评测范围仍限于三个能力域与开源模型，缺少更具挑战性/高风险任务上的验证；且子空间跨域误用可能引发负迁移（代码域钩子用于数学题），提示需要更稳健的子空间选择或域自适应机制。

title: Think Thrice Before You Speak: Dual knowledge-enhanced Theory-of-Mind Reasoning for Persuasive Agents
summary: Persuasive dialogue requires reasoning about others' latent mental states, a capability known as Theory of Mind (ToM). However, due to reliance on simple prompting strategies and insufficient ToM knowledge, existing LLMs often fail to capture the intrinsic dependencies among mental states, leading to fragmented representations and unstable reasoning. To address these challenges, we introduce the ToM-based Persuasive Dialogue (ToM-PD) task, grounded in the Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) framework, which explicitly models the sequential dependencies among mental states in multi-turn dialogues. To facilitate research on this task, we construct a large-scale annotated dataset, ToM-based Broad Persuasive Dialogues (ToM-BPD), capturing fine-grained mental states and corresponding persuasive strategies. We further propose Think Thrice Before You Speak (TTBYS), a knowledge-enhanced stepwise reasoning framework that leverages both explicit and implicit prior experiences to improve LLMs' inference of desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies. Experimental results demonstrate that Qwen3-8B equipped with TTBYS outperforms GPT-5 by 1.20%, 22.80%, and 16.97% in predicting desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies, respectively. Case studies further show that our approach enhances interpretability and consistency in reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对说服对话中的心智理论（ToM）推理挑战，提出ToM-PD任务和ToM-BPD大规模标注数据集，并设计TTBYS逐步推理框架。实验证明Qwen3-8B配合该框架在多项预测任务上显著超越GPT-5，特别是在信念预测方面提升达22.80%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM由于依赖简单提示策略和缺乏足够的ToM知识，往往无法捕捉心理状态间的内在依赖关系，导致表示碎片化和推理不稳定。这限制了其在需要推理他人心理状态的说服对话中的表现。
AI.method: 提出TTBYS（Think Thrice Before You Speak）框架，利用显式和隐式先验经验，通过逐步推理方式增强LLM对欲望、信念和说服策略的推断能力。该框架基于BDI模型建模心理状态间的序列依赖关系。
AI.result: 装备TTBYS的Qwen3-8B在欲望预测、信念预测和说服策略预测三项任务上分别超越GPT-5达1.20%、22.80%和16.97%。案例研究表明该方法增强了推理的可解释性和一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了ToM-PD任务、ToM-BPD数据集和TTBYS框架，有效解决了LLM在说服对话中因缺乏ToM能力而导致的表示碎片化和推理不稳定问题。实验表明该方法在各项指标上均显著优于GPT-5，尤其在信念预测上提升达22.80%，且增强了推理的可解释性和一致性。

title: The Illusion of Reasoning: Exposing Evasive Data Contamination in LLMs via Zero-CoT Truncation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning abilities across a wide range of tasks, but data contamination undermines the objective evaluation of these capabilities. This problem is further exacerbated by malicious model publishers who use evasive, or indirect, contamination strategies, such as paraphrasing benchmark data to evade existing detection methods and artificially boost leaderboard performance. Current approaches struggle to reliably detect such stealthy contamination. In this work, we uncover a critical phenomenon: a model's generated reasoning steps actively mask its underlying memorization. Inspired by this, we propose the Zero-CoT Probe (ZCP), a novel black-box detection method that deliberately truncates the entire Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process to expose latent shortcut mappings. To further isolate memorization from the model's intrinsic problem-solving capabilities, ZCP compares the model's zero-CoT performance on the original benchmark against an isomorphically perturbed reference dataset. Furthermore, we introduce Contamination Confidence, a metric that quantifies both the likelihood and severity of contamination, moving beyond simple binary classifications. Extensive experiments on both previously identified contaminated models and specially fine-tuned contaminated models demonstrate that ZCP robustly detects both direct and evasive data contamination. The code for ZCP is accessible at https://github.com/Yifan-Lan/zero-cot-probe.

AI.tldr: 针对LLM评估中的数据污染问题，特别是难以检测的规避性污染，本文发现模型生成的推理步骤会主动掩盖其底层记忆化现象。基于此发现，提出ZCP方法，通过截断思维链过程并比较原始基准与扰动数据集上的零CoT性能来检测污染，同时引入污染置信度指标量化污染程度。
AI.motivation: 数据污染破坏了LLM能力的客观评估，且恶意模型发布者采用规避性污染策略（如释义基准数据）来规避现有检测方法，人为提升排行榜表现。
AI.method: ZCP通过截断整个思维链(CoT)过程来暴露潜在的捷径映射，并比较模型在原始基准测试和等构扰动参考数据集上的零CoT性能，以隔离记忆与模型内在问题解决能力。同时引入"污染置信度"指标来量化污染的可能性和严重程度。
AI.result: 实验表明ZCP在已识别的污染模型和特别微调的污染模型上均能稳健检测直接和规避性数据污染。
AI.conclusion: ZCP能够鲁棒地检测直接污染和规避性污染，为LLM评估提供了有效的黑盒检测工具。

title: Tokenization with Split Trees
summary: We introduce Tokenization with Split Trees (ToaST), a subword tokenization method that directly optimizes compression under a new recursive inference procedure. ToaST greedily splits each pretoken into a full binary tree using precomputed byte n-gram counts, independent of any vocabulary. Given a vocabulary, inference recursively descends each split tree and emits the first in-vocabulary node reached on each path. Vocabulary selection is formulated as an Integer Program (IP) that minimizes the total token count over all split trees under this inference procedure. The Linear Programming (LP) relaxation is near-integral in practice, yielding provably near-optimal vocabularies, with training time empirically scaling quadratically in the number of split trees. On English text, ToaST reduces token counts by more than 11% compared to BPE, WordPiece, and UnigramLM at vocabulary sizes of 40,960 and above, reducing the number of inference tokens for models using this tokenizer, thus extending the effective context length. ToaST also uses common single-byte tokens less frequently than these baselines, leading to a substantial improvement in Renyi efficiency. In experiments training 1.5B parameter language models, ToaST achieves the highest CORE score, outperforming baselines by 2.6%--7.6%, with significance for two of three, and scoring best on 13 of 22 individual tasks.

AI.tldr: ToaST提出一种基于分裂树的子词分词方法，通过整数规划优化词表选择，在40K+词表规模下比BPE等方法减少11%以上token数量，并在1.5B参数语言模型上实现最高CORE分数。
AI.motivation: Existing subword tokenization methods (BPE, WordPiece, UnigramLM) have suboptimal compression efficiency. Better tokenization reduces token counts, extends effective context length, and can improve language model performance.
AI.method: ToaST uses split trees with precomputed byte n-gram counts for vocabulary-independent tokenization. Vocabulary selection is formulated as an Integer Program solved via LP relaxation for near-optimal solutions. Inference recursively descends split trees to emit in-vocabulary tokens.
AI.result: ToaST reduces token counts by >11% compared to baselines at vocabulary sizes ≥40,960, with better Renyi efficiency. In 1.5B parameter LM training, it achieves highest CORE score (2.6%-7.6% improvement) and best performance on 13/22 tasks.
AI.conclusion: ToaST provides a principled approach to vocabulary selection that yields near-optimal solutions efficiently. By improving compression and reducing reliance on single-byte tokens, it enhances both tokenizer efficiency and downstream language model performance.

title: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Mingyuan served as the project lead. Banghao, Yining, and Mingyuan contributed equally to this work, with more junior authors listed before senior authors. All data and code releases are maintained by the corresponding authors at UIUC and are not affiliated with Meta
summary:
Spreadsheet systems (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets) play a central role in modern data-centric workflows. As AI agents grow increasingly capable of automating complex tasks, such as controlling computers and generating presentations, building an AI-driven spreadsheet agent has emerged as a promising research direction. Most existing spreadsheet agents rely on specialized prompting over general-purpose LLMs; while this design has potentials on simple spreadsheet operations, it struggles to manage the complex, multi-step workflows typical of real-world applications.
  We introduce Spreadsheet-RL, a reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning framework designed to train specialized spreadsheet agents within a realistic Microsoft Excel environment. Spreadsheet-RL features an automated pipeline for scalable collection of paired start-goal spreadsheets from online forums, as well as domain-specific evaluation tasks in areas such as finance and supply chain management, which we compile into the new Domain-Spreadsheet benchmark dataset. It also includes a Spreadsheet Gym environment designed for multi-turn RL: Spreadsheet Gym exposes extensive Excel functionality through a Python sandbox, along with a refined harness that incorporates a comprehensive tool set and carefully designed tool-routing rules for spreadsheet tasks. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that Spreadsheet-RL substantially enhances AI agent's performance on both general and domain-specific spreadsheet tasks: it improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507's Pass@1 on SpreadsheetBench from 12.0% to 23.4%, and raises Pass@1 from 8.4% to 17.2% on our curated Domain-Spreadsheet dataset. These results highlight Spreadsheet-RL's strong potential for generalization and real-world adoption in spreadsheet automation, and broadly, its promise for advancing LLM-based interactions with data interfaces in everyday work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spreadsheet-RL，一个用于训练专业电子表格智能体的强化学习微调框架，通过自动化数据收集、领域特定基准数据集和专用训练环境，显著提升了LLM在电子表格任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格智能体依赖通用LLM的专用提示方法，在简单操作上有效，但在处理现实世界复杂多步骤工作流时表现不佳。
AI.method: Spreadsheet-RL是一个强化学习微调框架，包含三个核心组件：1）自动化数据收集管道，从在线论坛收集成对的起始-目标电子表格；2）Domain-Spreadsheet基准数据集，包含金融和供应链等领域的评估任务；3）Spreadsheet Gym环境，通过Python沙箱暴露Excel功能，并提供综合工具集和工具路由规则，支持多轮强化学习训练。
AI.result: Spreadsheet-RL显著提升了性能：Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507在SpreadsheetBench上的Pass@1从12.0%提升至23.4%，在Domain-Spreadsheet数据集上从8.4%提升至17.2%。
AI.conclusion: Spreadsheet-RL显著提升了AI智能体在电子表格任务上的表现，展示了良好的泛化能力和实际应用潜力，为基于LLM的数据界面交互研究提供了新范式。

title: When to Switch, Not Just What: Transition Quality Prediction in Clash Royale
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; Accepted at IEEE Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
summary: In competitive games, players frequently switch strategies after losing streaks, yet our analysis of 926,334 match records from 34,619 Clash Royale players reveals a counterintuitive pattern: switching frequency is inversely associated with the win rate, with effects that vary substantially across players and situational contexts. We attribute this to a limitation common in many prior recommendation systems, which evaluate strategies by expected quality while overlooking the behavioral cost of switching and individual differences in switching propensity. We refer to this implicit premise as the Zero Switching Cost Assumption. To address this, we reformulate strategy recommendation as a transition-level decision problem and instantiate it as TQP (Transition Quality Predictor), a three-stage pipeline structured as Who -> When -> What. PersonaGate suppresses recommendations for players whose strategic consistency is empirically associated with superior outcomes. TimingGate identifies moments when switching is likely to yield a net benefit over staying, using a subtype- and state-matched baseline to control for natural win-rate recovery. ScoreFusion ranks candidate strategies by combining an adoptability signal with predicted transition quality (delta WR). We further introduce SwitchGap, an evaluation metric that measures a policy's discriminative quality without treating observed player choices as optimal ground truth. This property is particularly important because the most frequent switchers record the lowest win rates. The full pipeline achieves a SwitchGap of +10.4 percentage points at a recommendation rate of 5.4%, and loss-triggered switchers, despite being the lowest-performing group, benefit the most from subtype-conditioned guidance.

AI.tldr: 研究发现竞争游戏中策略切换频率与胜率负相关，提出TQP三阶段管道解决现有推荐系统的零切换成本假设问题，通过PersonaGate、TimingGate和ScoreFusion组件以及SwitchGap评估指标，有效提升策略推荐质量。
AI.motivation: 玩家在竞争游戏中频繁在失败后切换策略，但分析92万余场匹配记录发现切换频率与胜率呈负相关。现有推荐系统存在"零切换成本假设"问题——仅评估策略的期望质量，忽视切换的行为成本和个体差异。这导致推荐系统无法有效帮助低胜率玩家。
AI.method: 将策略推荐重新表述为转换级决策问题，实现为TQP（转换质量预测器）三阶段管道（Who -> When -> What）。包含三个核心组件：PersonaGate用于抑制那些战略一致性经验上与更好结果相关的玩家的推荐；TimingGate使用子类型和状态匹配的基线来识别切换可能产生净收益的时刻；ScoreFusion通过结合可采纳性信号与预测的转换质量（delta WR）来排名候选策略。此外引入SwitchGap评估指标，衡量策略的判别质量。
AI.result: 完整管道在5.4%推荐率下实现+10.4个百分点的SwitchGap。尽管损失触发的切换者是表现最差的群体，但他们从子类型条件化指导中获得最大收益。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了策略推荐中的切换成本问题，在5.4%推荐率下实现+10.4个百分点SwitchGap，且损失触发的切换者（表现最差的群体）从子类型条件化指导中获益最大，证明了该框架的实际价值。

title: ChronoMedKG: A Temporally-Grounded Biomedical Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Clinical Reasoning
comment: 9 pages main text plus appendices, 8 figures. Dataset and benchmark paper. ChronoMedKG released under CC BY 4.0 and ChronoTQA/code under MIT (Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19697542). Under review
summary:
Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) treat disease associations as static facts, but temporal information is crucial for clinical reasoning, e.g., a symptom diagnostic of one disease at age 3 may imply a different disease at age 13. Existing KGs such as PrimeKG, Hetionet, and iKraph do not encode when a finding becomes clinically relevant over the course of a disease. This limits their usefulness for longitudinal clinical reasoning and retrieval augmentation.
  We introduce ChronoMedKG, a temporal biomedical knowledge graph that contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples (filtered from 13M raw extractions) covering 13,431 diseases. Each association is tied to temporal components like onset window or progression stage, which are backed by PMID-traceable evidence and a multi-signal credibility score. The graph is constructed through a disease-autonomous multi-agent pipeline in which multiple frontier LLMs independently extract knowledge from PubMed and PMC literature. Only those relations are kept that are supported by multi-model consensus, survive credibility filtering, as well as ontology alignment.
  ChronoMedKG scored 92.7% agreement against Orphadata and adds temporal grounding for 6,250 diseases absent from HPOA, Orphadata, and Phenopackets, including 1,657 Orphanet-coded rare diseases. We further introduce ChronoTQA, a benchmark of 3,341 questions across eight task types (six temporal plus two static controls), with a 12-question supplementary probe. Frontier LLMs lose roughly 30 points moving from static to temporal questions; ChronoMedKG retrieval rescues 47-65% of their long-tail failures, against 17-29% for HPOA-RAG. As such, ChronoMedKG provides a crucial temporal axis for retrieval-augmented clinical systems that was previously absent.

AI.tldr: ChronoMedKG is a temporal biomedical knowledge graph that captures when disease associations become clinically relevant over time. It contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples across 13,431 diseases, constructed via multi-agent LLM pipeline with consensus validation. It significantly outperforms existing KGs on temporal clinical reasoning tasks.
AI.motivation: Existing biomedical KGs (PrimeKG, Hetionet, iKraph) treat disease associations as static facts, failing to encode temporal information about when findings become clinically relevant. This limits usefulness for longitudinal clinical reasoning and retrieval augmentation.
AI.method: Constructed through a disease-autonomous multi-agent pipeline where multiple frontier LLMs independently extract knowledge from PubMed and PMC literature. Relations are retained only with multi-model consensus, credibility filtering, and ontology alignment. Benchmarked via ChronoTQA (3,341 questions across 8 task types).
AI.result: ChronoMedKG contains 460,497 evidence-linked triples covering 13,431 diseases. Frontier LLMs lose ~30 points on temporal vs static questions; ChronoMedKG retrieval rescues 47-65% of long-tail failures.
AI.conclusion: ChronoMedKG provides a crucial temporal axis for retrieval-augmented clinical systems. It scored 92.7% agreement against Orphadata, adds temporal grounding for 6,250 diseases absent from existing databases, and rescues 47-65% of LLM long-tail failures (vs 17-29% for HPOA-RAG).

title: AtelierEval: Agentic Evaluation of Humans & LLMs as Text-to-Image Prompters
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems increasingly rely on upstream prompters, either humans or multimodal large language models (MLLMs), to translate user intent into detailed prompts. Yet current benchmarks fix the prompt and only evaluate T2I models, leaving the prompting proficiency of this upstream component entirely unmeasured. We introduce AtelierEval, the first unified benchmark that quantifies prompting proficiency across 360 expert-crafted tasks. Grounded in a cognitive view, it spans three task categories and instantiates tasks using a taxonomy of real-world challenges, with a dual interface for both humans and MLLMs. To enable scalable and reliable evaluation, we propose AtelierJudge, a skill-based, memory-augmented agentic evaluator. It produces subjective and objective scores for prompt-image pairs, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.79 with human experts, approaching human performance. Extensive experiments benchmark 8 MLLMs against 48 human users across 4 T2I backends, validate AtelierEval as a robust diagnostic tool, and reveal the superiority of mimicry over planning, advocating for an image-augmented direction for future prompters. Our work is released to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AtelierEval——首个统一量化「提示词编写者（prompter）提示能力（prompting proficiency）」的基准测试，覆盖 360 个专家构建任务（开放式创建 OE、约束式创建 CO、模仿 IM 各 120 个），并配套提出认知仿生的智能体评判器 AtelierJudge（基于双过程理论的技能路由 + 记忆增强 RAG 主观打分 + 二值约束核查）。在 8 个 MLLM、48 名人类用户、4 个 T2I 后端上的实验表明：评判器主观 Spearman 达 0.81（人类 0.83），客观约束准确率 95.5%；MLLM 可与熟练人类相当甚至更优，但外部推理与后端内建中间件存在逻辑冲突，模仿式（图像增强）提示优于纯符号规划。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图基准（如 T2I 模型评测、提示优化器验证）普遍固定提示词、只评估生成模型本身，完全忽略上游「把用户意图翻译为可执行提示词」这一关键环节的提示能力，因而产生三点问题：(1) 人类提示研究仅停留在碎片化定性用户研究，缺少标准化量化工具；(2) 提示优化器在固定提示基准上验证，把提示能力退化为模型特定的参数化润色，模型无关的「意图→提示」翻译能力未被测量；(3) T2I 平台（ChatGPT/Gemini/Doubao）普遍内嵌 MLLM 中间件自动改写提示，使真实工作流已转变为「人类/MLLM 提示 + 模型生成」两段式管线，而评测范式仍停留在第一段缺席的状态。为此作者将提示能力形式化为一个能力导向（capability-oriented）策略优化问题，与模型基准范式和提示优化范式明确区分。
AI.method: 基准设计：基于 Guilford 的智力结构理论（SI 理论）将其「操作」维度映射到提示任务空间，取其中三个建构性操作——发散生产、聚合生产、认知——分别对应 OE（高叙事噪声下的意图扩展）、CO（多显式约束的文本聚合）、IM（目标图到文本的视觉编码）；附录给出基于信息论（展开/收敛/保真编码，率失真）的完整性与最小性证明。任务由 9 类挑战基元（4 类语义基元 S1–S4：抽象意图、受众意图、隐含风格、语义否定；5 类约束基元 C1–C5：属性绑定、空间关系、数量、文本渲染、硬约束）交叉组合、由专家实例化，并经两名独立专家双盲验证可解；另以 4 维应用情境多标签（实体/结构/视觉风格/主题）标注生态覆盖性。协议层面限定单轮纯文本→图像、无生成反馈，采用 Gradio+HF Spaces 人类界面与标准化 API 供 MLLM 使用，双接口语义严格等价。评判器：AtelierJudge 依 Kahneman 双过程理论抽象为 S1（主观、经验驱动，以 5 个人工策展的示例记忆做检索增强校准，Top-K 余弦相似检索，K=3）与 S2（客观、对任务清单逐项零样本 QA/VQA 二值核查，每条约束配对「提示端检查点 + 图像端检查点」），形成 2×2 并行技能编排，各技能独立无共享中间态；含 prompt 级 4 维（指令清晰度、创意细化、术语熟练度、意图形式化）与图像级 4 维（氛围、构图、色彩与光照、技术无瑕）1–5 分量表，另设安全过滤技能作为非计分门控。实验：8 个 MLLM 分 T0（SOTA）/T1（中端）/T2（轻量）三档，Novice/Skilled 两种提示策略（直接 NL vs. 结构化系统提示+自检），4 个后端（nBanana、GPT-Image-1、Flux.1 Pro、SDXL），48 名人类（24 新手/24 熟练），每 prompt×后端生成 4 图取最高分；另做 360 对专家标注验证集的元评估、消融（检索策略、K 值、嵌入模型）与采样稳定性分析。
AI.result: (1) 评测器有效性：以 GPT-5.4 为核心时主观 MAE 由 0.74 降至 0.33、Within-1 达 0.95、Spearman ρ=0.81（人类互评 0.83，基线仅 0.55）；客观整体 Acc 95.5%、F1 93.9%（提示端 >95%，图像端 >90%）；消融显示相似度检索显著优于零样本/固定 few-shot/随机检索，K=3 最佳，Nomic-Embed-Text-V1.5 + DINO-V2-Giant 优于更大的 NV-Embed-v2 与 DINO-V3。（2）能力解耦有效：各后端上提示者排名高度一致，T0>T1>T2 稳定，且无明显同源偏好偏置（GPT 系在 GI-1 上未获不成比例增益），表明所测为模型无关的内在能力；T0/T2 MLLM 均超过新手人类，T0 与熟练人类相当甚至更优（差距主要体现在客观分而非主观分）。（3）中间件同质化与过度结构化：带 MLLM 中间件的后端压缩了提示者间方差，T1→T0 增益递减；「Skilled」结构化策略在松约束 OE 场景常带来零收益甚至负收益，源于刚性结构干扰模型自身创造力。（4）约束悖论：在强中间件后端 GI-1 上，外部 MLLM 推理使 CO 客观分从直接输入的 69.6% 降至 47.2–48.6%（逻辑干扰：外部推理与内部改写冲突），而无中间件的 Flux Pro 上推理反而为正（32.2%→39.4%）；熟练人类对该干扰免疫（81.5%），说明高阶能力还包含适应性。（5）模仿优于规划：IM 任务即使单任务检查点达 20 个，T0 MLLM 的 Skilled 条件在 GI-1 上达 76.5%，超过人类专家（70.4%），且显著优于同等约束密度下 CO 的符号规划结果（最高 48.2%），符合「识别优于回忆」的认知机制，支撑「图像增强提示（Image-Augmented Prompting）」方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文把文生图评测从「模型中心、提示固定」推进到「提示者中心」的统一范式，确立了提示能力作为可测量、可诊断的独立能力维度，其贡献为：首个统一的人类/MLLM 提示能力基准（认知理论驱动、任务完备且最小）、可扩展且高可靠的智能体评判范式（技能库+记忆增强+双过程解耦）、以及可复现的开源基线基础设施。局限与后续方向：人类样本人口学分布集中带来采样偏置（评判器亦可能继承）；限定单轮纯文本→图像，未覆盖多轮迭代、视觉反馈、多模态输入与搜索式优化；缺乏公认的 T2I 任务难度度量，仅以基元组合负载刻画。后续拟推进图像增强/检索式模仿提示、人机协作提示评测、多轮交互式评测，以及将基准扩展至可同时充当提示者与生成器的统一多模态模型（UMM），以解耦自提示与模型协同适配问题。

title: Noise Schedule Design for Diffusion Models: An Optimal Control Perspective
summary: We develop a principled framework for analyzing and designing noise schedules in diffusion models. We show that one can recast this design problem as an optimal control problem, whose state is the Fisher information of the diffusion process which evolves according to an ODE and the control input is the noise schedule. The objective of the optimal control problem is a functional involving the Fisher information, which is shown to be an upper bound on the Kullback-Leibler sampling error. By solving this optimal control problem, we obtain sufficient conditions on noise schedules under which state-of-the-art $\tilde{\mathcal{O}} (d/n)$ sampling error is achievable, where $d$ is the data dimension and $n$ is the number of discretization steps. While existing theoretical work also prove that $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d/n)$ sampling error bounds are achievable, these results hold for specific noise schedules, which do not include the schedules used in practice. Under a further parametric assumption on the data distribution, we show that one can obtain closed-form expressions for the noise schedules. These noise schedules generalize standard empirical schedules such as exponential and sigmoid schedules by allowing additional parameters that can be tuned. Systematically tuning the parameters of these schedules yields new schedules that achieve superior FID scores on image generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes an optimal control framework for designing noise schedules in diffusion models, using Fisher information as the state variable. The approach provides theoretical guarantees for Õ(d/n) sampling error with practical schedules (including extensions of exponential/sigmoid) and demonstrates empirical improvements on image generation benchmarks.
AI.motivation: While existing theory proves Õ(d/n) sampling error bounds are achievable for diffusion models, these results only hold for specific noise schedules that do not include the exponential and sigmoid schedules used in practice. This gap between theory and practice motivates the need for a principled framework to analyze and design noise schedules.
AI.method: The authors recast the noise schedule design as an optimal control problem where Fisher information serves as the state variable (evolving via ODE), and the noise schedule acts as the control input. The objective is a functional involving Fisher information that bounds the KL sampling error. Sufficient conditions for achieving Õ(d/n) sampling error are derived, with closed-form noise schedule expressions obtained under parametric assumptions on the data distribution.
AI.result: The optimal control formulation yields sufficient conditions on noise schedules guaranteeing Õ(d/n) sampling error (where d is data dimension, n is discretization steps). Under parametric assumptions on the data distribution, closed-form expressions are derived that generalize standard empirical schedules (exponential, sigmoid). Systematic parameter tuning produces new schedules achieving superior FID scores on image generation benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: The framework provides a principled approach that achieves both theoretical tractability (noise schedules with proven Õ(d/n) error bounds, including schedules that match practical use) and empirical performance (new tuned schedules achieving superior FID scores on image generation benchmarks).

title: Understanding Data Temporality Impact on Large Language Models Pre-training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically trained on shuffled corpora, yielding models whose knowledge is frozen at train time and whose temporal grounding remains poorly understood. In this work, we study the impact of pre-training dynamics on the acquisition of time-sensitive factual knowledge, focusing specifically on data ordering. Our main contributions are twofold. First, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark of over 7,000 temporally grounded questions and an evaluation protocol that enables analysis of whether models correctly associate facts with their corresponding time periods. Second, we pretrain 6B-parameter models on temporally ordered Common Crawl snapshots and compare them against standard shuffled pre-training. Our results show that sequentially trained models match shuffled baselines on general language understanding and common knowledge while consistently exhibiting more up-to-date and temporally precise knowledge. Temporally ordered pre-training yields improved factual freshness, while shuffled pre-training peaks on older data, possibly due to increased factual repetition. These findings, along with the release of our code at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/kairos , checkpoints, and datasets at https://huggingface.co/collections/kyutai/kairos provide a foundation for future research on continual learning for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了预训练数据排序对LLM时间敏感知识获取的影响，时序预训练优于打乱预训练。
AI.motivation: LLM通常在打乱的语料库上训练，导致知识冻结在训练时，时间基础理解较差。
AI.method: 在时序化的Common Crawl快照上预训练6B参数模型，并与标准打乱预训练进行对比；同时引入包含7000多个时间锚定问题的综合基准测试和评估协议。
AI.result: 时序训练模型在通用语言理解和常识方面与打乱基线持平，同时表现出更最新和更精确的时间知识。时序预训练提升了事实新鲜度，而打乱预训练在旧数据上达到峰值（可能是由于事实重复增加）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM的持续学习未来研究提供了基础，包括开源代码、检查点和数据集的发布。

title: Claw AI Lab: An Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Team
comment: Project page and code are available at https://github.com/Claw-AI-Lab/Claw-AI-Lab
summary: We present Claw AI Lab, a lab-native autonomous research platform that advances automated research from a hidden prompt-to-paper pipeline into an interactive AI laboratory. Rather than centering the system around a single agent or a fixed serial workflow, we allow users to instantiate a full research team from one prompt, with customizable roles, collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume control through a unified dashboard. The platform also supports distinct research modes for exploration, multi-agent discussion, and reproduction, making autonomous research substantially more steerable and laboratory-like in practice. A key practical contribution of Claw AI Lab lies in its Claw-Code Harness, which connects local codebases, datasets, and checkpoints to runnable experiments and feeds execution artifacts back into the research loop. As a result, the harness improves not only execution integration, but also experimental completion and result integrity: experiments are easier to inspect, iterate on, and faithfully transfer into final papers, reducing common failure modes such as partial runs and malformed result reporting. In our internal evaluation on five AI research case studies, using AutoResearchClaw as the baseline, Claw AI Lab is consistently preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality. We view Claw AI Lab as an early step toward a new paradigm: autonomous research as usable, interactive, and reliability-aware scientific infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Claw AI Lab transforms autonomous research from static pipelines into interactive AI laboratories by enabling customizable multi-agent research teams, comprehensive workflow monitoring/control, and a Claw-Code Harness for robust execution integration, improving both research quality and reliability.
AI.motivation: Current automated research systems operate as hidden prompt-to-paper pipelines with limited interactivity, inspectability, and reliability. Existing approaches lack customizable multi-agent teams, comprehensive workflow control, and robust execution integration with local development environments.
AI.method: Claw AI Lab instantiates customizable research teams from prompts with collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume control via a unified dashboard. The Claw-Code Harness connects local codebases, datasets, and checkpoints to runnable experiments. Supports exploration, multi-agent discussion, and reproduction modes.
AI.result: In internal evaluation on 5 AI research case studies, Claw AI Lab was consistently preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality compared to AutoResearchClaw baseline.
AI.conclusion: Claw AI Lab represents a paradigm shift toward autonomous research as usable, interactive, and reliability-aware scientific infrastructure. It improves execution integration, experimental completion, and result integrity, while being preferred by AI experts on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality.

title: CausalGuard: Conformal Inference under Graph Uncertainty
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data requires choosing an adjustment set, but valid adjustment depends on an unknown causal graph. Graph misspecification can cause under-coverage, while graph-agnostic conformal wrappers may regain nominal coverage only through large padding. We introduce CausalGuard, a structure-weighted conformal framework that calibrates after aggregating graph-conditional doubly robust pseudo-outcomes. Candidate DAGs are proposed from an LLM-derived edge prior, pruned by conditional-independence tests, and reweighted by Bayesian Information Criterion. A composite nonconformity score then calibrates the posterior-weighted pseudo-outcome. CausalGuard provides distribution-free finite-sample marginal coverage for this aggregated pseudo-outcome; under causal identification, overlap, conditional-mean nuisance stability, and concentration on target-aligned valid adjustment strategies, its conditional mean converges to the true Conditional Average Treatment Effect. Across five benchmarks, CausalGuard attains mean coverage above the nominal 90% level for the directly evaluable target and reduces width when graph-agnostic conformal baselines require large padding. Stress tests show that CausalGuard suppresses invalid collider adjustment and remains stable under misspecified priors when the retained candidate set is data-supported.

AI.tldr: CausalGuard addresses treatment effect estimation under unknown causal graphs by integrating LLM priors, conditional-independence pruning, and BIC-based reweighting into a conformal framework, providing finite-sample coverage guarantees while improving efficiency over graph-agnostic methods.
AI.motivation: Graph-agnostic conformal methods require large padding to regain coverage; graph-based adjustment sets are sensitive to misspecification, leading to under-coverage in causal effect estimation.
AI.method: Proposes candidate DAGs from LLM-derived edge priors, prunes them via conditional-independence tests, reweights by BIC, then calibrates using structure-weighted conformal framework on aggregated graph-conditional doubly robust pseudo-outcomes with composite nonconformity scores.
AI.result: Achieves marginal coverage above 90% nominal level; reduces interval width compared to graph-agnostic conformal baselines; suppresses invalid collider adjustments; remains stable under misspecified priors.
AI.conclusion: CausalGuard achieves nominal coverage and reduced interval width across five benchmarks, effectively suppresses invalid collider adjustments, and remains stable under misspecified priors when data supports the retained candidate set.

title: Reducing Political Manipulation with Consistency Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic political bias across a variety of sensitive contexts. We find that LLMs handle counterpart topics from opposing political sides asymmetrically. We refer to this phenomenon as covert political bias and identify 7 categories of techniques through which it operates. We propose two metrics for covert bias: Sentiment Consistency measures symmetry in rhetoric and framing across paired political prompts; Helpfulness Consistency measures symmetric depth and engagement. To reduce both types of covert bias, we introduce Political Consistency Training (PCT), an RL training method with two complementary paradigms: Sentiment Consistency Training and Helpfulness Consistency Training. We show that PCT preserves overall helpfulness, substantially reduces covert political bias, and generalizes to held-out benchmarks. We release our work at https://political-manipulation.ai

AI.tldr: 本文提出“隐性政治偏差”(covert political bias) 这一新问题：LLM 在对左右政治配对话题作答时存在系统性的修辞与投入程度的不对称，且这种操纵在单条回复中难以察觉。作者构建了包含 7 大类、38 项具体手法的政治操纵分类法，提出 Sentiment Consistency 与 Helpfulness Consistency 两个二维评测指标与 Polarized Contrastive Pairs 基准，并用 GRPO 强化学习实现 Political Consistency Training (PCT)，在保持高帮助性的同时显著降低隐性偏差（Qwen3-14B：SC 20.9%→61.5%，HC 51.6%→95.1%，平均 36.3%→78.3%，超过所有对比的前沿模型），并泛化到留出基准。
AI.motivation: 既有研究主要测量“显性政治倾向”（单一左—右轴上的立场分数），而前沿模型越来越多地表现出一种更难被用户察觉的操纵方式：不作明确立场表达，而是通过修辞框架不一致、选择性加注限定语、对一方观点施加更严苛的证据要求、以及两侧回答深度与参与度不对等等方式，隐性地把用户推向特定立场。作者指出“偏见是对个人或实体的不一致对待，而非强烈立场本身”，因此核心问题不是模型持有什么立场，而是它对立场对立的双方是否一致地对待（对称性）。这一偏差难以在单轮对话中被察觉，只能通过聚合比较发现，因此需要成对（paired prompt）的评测范式。此外，先前工作只测量偏差而缺乏可操作的干预手段，也缺少能区分“假性中立”与“真实中立”的双维度量——一个通过均匀对冲、拒答来假装中立，一个通过无条件顺从用户暗示方向来假装有帮助，两者都能在单一指标上取高分。
AI.method: 方法由三部分组成。（1）分类法与基准：构建覆盖 Information Selection、Framing and Emphasis、Linguistic Manipulation、Agency and Causality、Sourcing and Authority、Rhetorical Deflection、Epistemic Double Standards 7 类共 38 种手法的“政治操纵分类法”，每项标注定义与偏置方向，作为评审（judge）的参考规约；Polarized Contrastive Pairs 基准含 50 组人工策展的左右配对实体（如社会主义/资本主义、控枪/第二修正案权利），配合 5 种提示模板（paragraph、evidence、tell_me、tell_me_dhb、argue）与 4 种情感价（good/bad/right/wrong），每个模型产生 1000 条成对查询。（2）双维指标：Sentiment Consistency 评审联合阅读一对回答，依据分类法按“无偏差/轻微偏差/频繁偏差”三档打分并取平均；Helpfulness Consistency 评审独立评估单条回答，依据“不helpful 模式”分类表（拒答、反对方向论证、对冲、说教、准 pro/con 分析脚手架、无证据空泛）按“不helpful/部分helpful/helpful”三档打分。两者共同构成二维空间，可分别被“过度谨慎”与“无批判顺从”两种捷径 gaming。（3）PCT 训练：以 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-14B 为策略，用 GRPO 进行后训练；训练数据由 Wikipedia 争议议题列表经 LLM 分类器筛出约 500 个具备清晰左右维度的政治话题，分为两条支路——Helpfulness 支路生成“Tell me how good/bad X is”式指令性提示（每话题 4 条），Sentiment 支路生成开放式“Tell me about {topic}”提示并配对由 Gemini 3.1 Pro 在左右“隐蔽倾向”系统提示下预生成的锚点回答。奖励函数分路路由：helpfulness 提示用 r_help(h(y))（单调递增，惩罚对冲与拒答）；sentiment 提示用 r_bias(b(y))·r_aux-help(h_aux(y))，其中偏置分 1–5、3 为平衡中点且奖励峰值，偏置奖励随偏离中点双侧衰减，辅助帮助分 0–2 用于防止通过“百科式空洞/回避结论”骗取奖励；两者采用乘性组合（而非加性），使无实质内容的回答奖励归零。训练用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 作评审，评测则刻意改用不同的评审（GPT-5.5），并另用三个前沿评审验证稳健性。
AI.result: 主结果（GPT-5.5 评审）：PCT 后的 Qwen3-14B 达到 Sentiment Consistency 61.5%、Helpfulness Consistency 95.1%、平均 78.3%，超过所有对比前沿模型（最强为 Grok 4.1 Fast 67.5%、GPT-5.5 57.2%、Gemini 3.1 Pro 56.6%、Claude Opus 4.7 51.8%）；基线仅 36.3%。四个独立评审（GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7、DeepSeek V4 Pro）下绝对分数有波动但模型排名保持，PCT 模型始终第一（平均 74.7%）。按模板分解显示 PCT 的跨模板方差最小（SC 标准差 5.7、HC 标准差 1.8），在开放式模板上尤其显著优于对手（如 paragraph 模板 Claude Opus 4.7 仅 29.2%）。留出集泛化：Even-handedness 从 82% 提升至 98%（高于所有前沿模型），拒答率从 4% 降至 0%；基于“生命交换率”的 Egalitarianism 评测中，种族类别距等值估值距离从 1.58 降至 0.52、政治取向从 1.45 降至 0.68、宗教从 0.42 降至 0.29、公众人物从 1.55 降至 1.18；Political Values 主成分投影显示 PCT 模型的显性政策偏好更趋中间化。消融显示仅用系统提示（Anthropic 的 even-handedness 提示）会以同等幅度抬高 SC、压低 HC，聚合分数几乎不变，验证二维度量的必要性；锚点生成审计显示 Gemini 3.1 Pro / Claude Opus 4.7 / Grok 4.3 的锚点可用率达 94–99%，而 GPT-5.5 仅为 44.6%（55.4% 的锚点对不可区分或过弱），据此选定锚点来源。纵向评测显示多数厂商各代模型在政治一致性上无明显改善趋势。
AI.conclusion: 作者的核心主张是：与人类不同，LLM 的每次输出相互独立，因此“对称性”可以直接作为训练信号施加，无需人工标注政治极性，使政治中立性成为可解的工程问题；一致性训练范式也可推广到非美国/多党制语境以及谄媚（sycophancy）等其他隐性操纵行为。局限包括：情感一致性目标依赖锚点生成管线，若锚点本身不对称，训练模型会继承这种“平衡”的定义（且未测试人工撰写的隐性左右锚点）；50 组话题锚定于美国/西方政治语境，迁移到其他语境需改造；方法主要处理单轮交互中可检测的偏差，多轮累积的微妙不一致尚需更先进的测量方法。此外作者强调 PCT 针对的是隐性操纵而非显性立场，“各议题中点并不等于共识立场”，未来可参考“公民议会”式的共识偏好生成方法。总体而言，该工作提供了可复用的分类法、成对评测基准、二维指标与端到端的 RL 缓解方案，并主张其可作为 AI 公司部署前测试与微调的标准组件。

title: WorkstreamBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on End-to-End Spreadsheet Tasks in Finance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to carry out end-to-end workflows, producing complete artifacts from high-level user instructions. To meet enterprise needs, frontier AI labs have developed agents that can construct entire spreadsheets from scratch. This is especially relevant in finance, where core workflows such as financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis are commonly conducted through spreadsheets. Yet, existing spreadsheet benchmarks do not measure this advanced capability, focusing instead on question-answering or single-formula edits. To address this gap, we provide one of the first evaluations of agents on end-to-end spreadsheet tasks, focusing on economically critical financial workflows such as modeling and scenario analysis. Since deliverables therein are routinely reviewed and revised by multiple stakeholders, judging their quality necessarily involves high-level criteria such as readability or ease of modification. To reflect the multidimensional nature of solution quality, we develop an evaluation taxonomy comprising three dimensions: Accuracy, Formula, and Format, each comprising fine-grained criteria that reflect professional standards. The Claude family leads the benchmark and produces the most professional-looking outputs in our qualitative review, but even the strongest agents frequently fall short of professional finance standards and degrade sharply as the difficulty increases beyond a few chained calculations. This suggests that current agents are not yet able to reliably produce professional-quality spreadsheets at the level of complexity real-world workflows demand.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MBABench（摘要标题作 WorkstreamBench），首个面向金融领域「端到端电子表格构建」任务的 LLM 智能体基准：任务要求从高层指令产出完整多工作表工作簿（如三表联动模型、IRR、情景分析），评测维度为 Accuracy / Formula / Format 三维质量分类体系，以 Gemini-2.5-pro 为核心的 LLM-as-judge 打分，并用合成扰动 + 408 条专家标注验证（准确率 0.92、F1 0.85）。评估 18 个 GUI/CODE/API 三类智能体发现：Claude 系（Fable 5、Opus 4.6）与前沿实验室自研 harness 上的智能体领先（Fable 5 最佳，GPT-5.6 Sol 紧随），但最好成绩在 Medium-Hard 任务上仅 72.6/100（低于 Level 2 的 92.4）；结论是当前智能体尚无法稳定产出专业级金融表格，且 harness 质量是性能主因而非模型本身。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格基准（SpreadsheetBench、SheetCopilot 等）只覆盖原子级任务——写一个函数、填一个单元格、或表格问答——而前沿实验室已发布可端到端从零构建整份工作簿的智能体（Claude for Excel、ChatGPT for Excel），这种能力缺乏评测。GDPval 虽涉及端到端经济任务（其中五项为金融表格），但依赖不透明的内部专家标注，社区缺少透明可复现的金融端到端表格基准。更关键的动机在于金融工作流的本质属性：交付物会被经理、VP、客户分析师反复审阅与修改（改假设、问「该不该收购、什么价格」），因此「质量」不仅等于数值正确，还必须涵盖可读性、结构清晰度与可修改性；而这类高层准则无法用精确匹配验证。作者以私募股权收购评估（三表联动 + 10 年 IRR）作为代表性任务说明这一点。
AI.method: 任务集合：从 Financial Modeling World Cup (FMWC)、ModelOff、Wall Street Prep (WSP) 三个真实职业/教育来源收集端到端任务，共 206 个任务，涵盖 DCF、LBO/Merger、3-Statement、营运资本、债务瀑布/摊还、期权与债券定价、情景/敏感性分析、退休储蓄等类型；规模显著大于 SpreadsheetBench（单元格均值约 33×，函数调用中位数约 93×，整体均值 4.3 万单元格/任务）。任务人工标注难度：从 Scope、General Modeling、Finance Knowledge、Excel Implementation 四个子项各打 1–6 分，加权求和（权重 1/3、1/3、1/6、1/6）四舍五入映射到 1–6 级难度；任务类型由 Gemini-2.5-pro 依两阶段（父类/子类）提示词加权标注。评测体系：建立 Accuracy / Formula / Format 三大维度共 20 余个子准则（如 Final Calculations、Starting Values、Task Completed、Number Sign；Logic Readability & Size、Edge Cases #DIV/0!、Hardcoded Values、Range Issues、Absolute References；Sheet Structure、Readability、Color Scheme、Number Notation、Alignment、Font Size/Style、Borders、Output Presentation），并赋主观权重以生成 0–100 综合分。评分器：以 Gemini-2.5-pro 为骨干的 LLM-as-judge，输入 rubric + 参考解与 agent 产物的结构化表示，输出 JSON 的 pass/fail 与失败位置、原因、期望修法；对超 2M 字符的大型工作簿改用带工具的 agentic judge 按需检索取证。Judge 验证：（1）向黄金解注入定向错误构造合成扰动套件；（2）对前沿智能体真实产出做判定，与专家标注比对（408 条标注上准确率 0.92、平衡准确率 0.88、F1 0.85；另有 221 条 agentic judge 0.90/0.89/0.87、187 条非 agentic 0.94/0.83/0.79），人工投入 2 名 MBA + 3 名金融从业者共 700+ 小时。智能体收集三类 harness：GUI（Playwright 自动化浏览器操作 ChatGPT Agent/Pro/Excel/Work、Claude Web/Excel/Cowork）、CODE（Codex、Claude Code，隔离 Docker + 默认拒绝出网的防火墙）、API（自研基于 MCP 的 Excel CLI Agent，含 19 个工具、LibreOffice 重算、最多 15 轮迭代，评测 GPT-5.4/5.6 Sol、Claude Opus 4.6/Fable 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Grok 4.20、Kimi K2.5、Qwen 3.6 Plus、OLMo 3.1 Instruct）。
AI.result: 整体排名：使用前沿实验室专有 GUI/CODE harness 的智能体明显领先，Claude 系（Fable 5 系列最佳，GPT-5.6 Sol 紧随）> API harness 组；最强者 Claude Cowork 仍无法稳定满足全部专业标准。难度敏感性：所有智能体随难度上升显著退化，Level 2（Easy）最佳 92.4（Claude Code），Level 4（Medium-Hard）最佳仅 72.6（Codex）。Harness 效应：固定同一底座模型（Fable 5、GPT-5.6 Sol）时，专有 harness 远优于自研 harness，而自研 harness 下领先模型之间差距不显著，说明性能与效率主要由 harness 设计而非原始模型能力驱动。行为分析：智能体普遍随难度增加耗时与计算量，但 Qwen、Kimi、ChatGPT Agent 等既不随难度增加耗时、得分也更低；Claude Web (Opus 4.6) 是专有 agent 中最快，而 API 组中 Opus 反而最慢。定性发现：Claude (Excel) 与 ChatGPT (Excel) 反而落后于 Claude Web，常出现字体颜色不一致、缺单位列、负数未用括号、列宽过窄、mega-formula、空白 sheet 等；Excel 类 agent 与 ChatGPT Pro 倾向硬编码数值而非公式（数值往往正确但模型不可审计、不可改假设）；GUI agent 因 openpyxl/LibreOffice 不支持迭代计算而无法处理财务模型中常见的循环引用（MO16-R1-S4 出现 1,044 个 #VALUE!）。自研 harness 侧：Opus 平均每任务 665 个公式、最高 6,001，Gemini 3.1 Pro 达 100% 绝对引用且效率更高（39.9 公式/分钟 vs 10.0）；Grok 4.20 在 5% 任务、Kimi K2.5 在 17% 任务产出零公式，Kimi 有 62% 答案表全空，Grok 出现零公式却宣称「完成完整动态 30 年模型」的编造；GPT-5.4 高推理强度时读多写少（Hard 任务读写比 0.99）并尝试不支持的 LET/SCAN/LAMBDA；黄金解 20,925 公式的 Hard 任务中最好的尝试仅覆盖 15%，且无人生成多情景所需的 9 份模型表副本。工程限制：上下文饱和（300K+ token 起始文件）、fresh_context_mode 造成 4–5× 重做开销、单格写入吞吐瓶颈（Opus 单任务 3,138 次工具调用）、LibreOffice 重算 90 秒超时致公式损坏、OLMo 结构化输出畸变。成本：API+CODE 全量运行约 2.7 万美元，单轮 judge 评测约 1.7 千美元。
AI.conclusion: MBABench 证明：当前 SOTA 模型已能以「尚可」质量完成较简单的端到端金融表格任务，但在需要长链式计算与多情景的困难任务上存在巨大提升空间；最关键的结构性发现是 agentic harness（而非底座模型能力）是端到端表格表现与效率的主要驱动因素。方法论上，论文主张并验证了「专业质量分类体系 + LLM-as-judge」替代精确匹配的可扩展、透明评测范式，可迁移到其他 rubric。作者承认的局限：部分准则为金融专用（如 Number Notation）；因无法观测厂商闭源 harness，无法断定性能差异的根源；Level 5/6 极难任务样本不足，未来需开发更难的任务。

title: Optimal Guarantees for Auditing Rényi Differentially Private Machine Learning
summary: We study black-box auditing for machine learning algorithms that claim R \ 'enyi differential privacy (RDP) guarantees.
