Latent-variable policies suffer from regularization trade-offs (mode information vs sampling reliability), while action-space generative policies are fundamentally limited by transport smoothness. Both findings are validated experimentally.
AI.motivation: When a state admits multiple valid actions (multimodal demonstrations), standard behavioral cloning fails because it cannot capture the multi-valued mapping. Understanding why different multimodal policies fail is critical for designing robust imitation learning systems.
AI.method: Theoretical analysis comparing latent-variable policies and action-space generative policies under the action-chunking setting, validated on synthetic multimodal tasks and robotic simulation benchmarks.
AI.result: For latent-variable policies: posterior-prior regularization improves deployment sampling but can excessively remove action-conditioned mode information; prior coverage is crucial. For action-space generative policies: multimodality is bounded by the Lipschitz constant of base-to-action transport—a smooth transport cannot assign probability to many well-separated modes; covering modes requires sharp transitions or off-support bridge regions.
AI.conclusion: Different multimodal parameterizations have distinct failure modes that require tailored solutions; latent-variable policies need balanced regularization while action-space generative policies require careful base-to-action transport design.

title: The Neural Compiler: Program-to-Network Translation for Hybrid Scientific Machine Learning
comment: Use: 21 pages, 10 figures, 10 tables. Preprint; source code available at https://github.com/sheneman/neural_compiler
summary: Scientific machine learning often requires combining known physics with unknown parameters or correction terms learned from data. Existing approaches either ignore known structure, encode it as a soft penalty, or require hand-written PyTorch code for each equation. We present The Neural Compiler, a system that translates programs written in a first-order Scheme-like expression language into frozen, differentiable PyTorch modules. These modules match the source program to floating-point precision and provide gradients through autograd. In hybrid models, the compiled module encodes known physics exactly while learned components model the unknown remainder. We evaluate the compiler across six experiment domains: Feynman physics equations, Lotka-Volterra dynamics, a damped pendulum, a one-dimensional heat equation, three-dimensional vector mechanics, and compositional generalization. Compiled modules match hand-coded PyTorch implementations numerically for single equations, showing no accuracy loss from compilation. With only 1 to 4 trainable parameters, compiled models recover physical constants to less than 1 percent error in most cases, while standard PINN baselines with more than 8500 parameters show 7 to 93 percent error. Compiled modules also compose with zero error, while neural approximations can accumulate large errors in deep composition chains. The main value of the compiler is not improved accuracy over hand-coded equations, but systematic composability: it generates correct, differentiable modules from symbolic specifications without rewriting each equation by hand. The system supports 51 primitive operations, including vector and matrix algebra, enabling PDE discretizations and hybrid scientific models. This string-in, module-out interface also provides a natural target for large language models that translate scientific descriptions into executable differentiable modules.

AI.tldr: Neural Compiler将符号程序编译为精确可微分的PyTorch模块，以极少量参数（1-4个）精确恢复物理常数，显著优于大规模PINN模型，且具有零误差组合特性。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习通常需要将已知物理规律与从未知参数或数据学习的修正项相结合。现有方法存在局限：忽略已知结构、将已知结构编码为软惩罚，或需要为每个方程手写PyTorch代码。
AI.method: 提出"The Neural Compiler"系统，将一阶Scheme类表达式语言的程序翻译为冻结的、可微分的PyTorch模块。这些模块在浮点精度上与源程序匹配，并通过autograd提供梯度。在混合模型中，编译模块精确编码已知物理规律，而学习组件对未知部分建模。
AI.result: 在六个实验领域评估了该编译器（费曼物理方程、Lotka-Volterra动力学、阻尼摆、一维热方程、三维向量力学及组合泛化）。编译模块在数值上与手写PyTorch实现匹配，编译无精度损失。仅用1-4个可训练参数，编译模型将物理常数恢复误差控制在1%以下，而具有8500+参数的标准PINN基线误差高达7-93%。编译模块组合误差为零，而神经近似在深层组合链中会累积较大误差。
AI.conclusion: 该编译器的核心价值在于系统性可组合性，而非超越手工编码的准确性。它能从符号规范自动生成正确、可微分的模块，支持51种原始操作（包括向量和矩阵代数），为大型语言模型将科学描述转换为可执行模块提供了自然接口。

title: The Signal in the Noise: OOD Detection Through Goodness-of-Fit Testing in Factorised Latent Spaces
summary: Deep generative models offer a natural foundation for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, yet prior work has shown that their assigned likelihoods are notoriously unreliable indicators for in- vs out-of-distribution data. In this paper, we address this problem by leveraging the diffeomorphic and mass-preserving properties of continuous normalising flows. Our analysis shows that OOD samples are mapped to noise samples that are highly atypical under the noise prior in ways not captured by the likelihood. Based on this observation, we propose a new method -- Signal in the Noise (SITN) -- for OOD detection on the single-sample level. SITN requires no access to OOD data, incurs minimal computational overhead, and provides strict control of false positive rates. Comprehensive evaluations through standard benchmarks and synthetic perturbations highlight the method's effectiveness and the absence of the complexity bias inherent to likelihood-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Signal in the Noise (SITN)」方法，将 OOD 检测重新表述为连续归一化流（CNF）噪声空间中的单样本拟合优度检验。核心洞察是：OOD 样本经逆流映射后，其噪声潜变量在「边缘正态性」和「维度独立性」上偏离标准高斯先验，而这种偏离无法被似然捕捉。SITN 使用 Anderson–Darling 统计量与功率谱变异系数的分位数最大化聚合，无需 OOD 数据、计算开销极小、且可严格控制第一类错误（假阳性率）。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型（尤其是连续归一化流 CNF / 基于流匹配的模型）常被用作 OOD 检测的基础，但已有大量复现实验表明其似然在高维空间中并不可靠：例如在 CIFAR-10 上训练的模型会给 MNIST、SVHN 分配更高似然（典型集假说、复杂度偏置、低层特征主导等解释）。现有修正方案（典型性检验、复杂度惩罚、似然比、DoSE、WAIC 等）存在三类问题：(1) 仍继承似然固有的复杂度偏置与失败模式；(2) 需要领域特定的压缩算法、依赖通常不可得的 OOD 数据来训练背景模型，或需额外训练模型/逐样本优化，带来显著计算与工程负担；(3) 阈值选取缺乏统计保证。因此作者希望绕开「似然中心」的路线，寻找能在单样本粒度上直接利用流结构本身的信息进行 OOD 检测，并提供严格的第一类错误控制。
AI.method: 框架：设 CNF 的概率流 ODE 为 φ，训练良好时 φ#N(0,I)=P_ID；对 Z=φ^{-1}(X)，有 Z~N(0,I) 当且仅当 X~P_ID，故 OOD 检测等价于对 Z 是否服从完全分解的标准多元高斯做拟合优度检验。复合零假设 H0 分解为两个必要成分：边缘正态性 H_MN（每个 Z_i 服从 N(0,1)）与维度独立性 H_DI（各分量互不相关）。因高斯完全分解，一个 D 维样本可视为 D 个 i.i.d. 的一元标准正态样本，从而可在单样本层面用稳健的边缘统计量检验。统计量：(1) Anderson–Darling 统计量 S_AD（用 Z 的 D 个元素作为经验样本，比较其经验 CDF 与 Φ 的差异，复杂度 O(D log D)）；(2) 功率谱变异系数 S_CV = σ_PSD/μ_PSD，由 Wiener–Khinchin 定理等价于全局自相关检验，高斯白噪声下理论值为 1，结构相关会显著大于 1（借助 FFT，复杂度 O(D log D)，且无需选择最大滞后阶等超参）。聚合：用 ID 校准集估计两统计量的经验 CDF，做分位数变换后取最大值 S_SITN = max(F̂_AD(S_AD), F̂_CV(S_CV))，对应逻辑 OR 的拒绝决策。校准：将校准集划分为不相交的 C1 与 C2，用 C1 估计各统计量 CDF、C2 估计 S_SITN 的 CDF，按 F̂(S_SITN) ≥ 1-α 判为 OOD；基于 DKW 不等式给出有限样本误差界（概率至少 1-δ 下 Type I 误差 ≤ α + 4√(log(4/δ)/n) + √(log(2/δ)/n)），并对 k 个成分假设给出一般化 max 聚合定理。实验设置：在 CIFAR-10、SVHN、CelebA 上各训练一个无条件 CNF（UNet + 线性插值流匹配，dopri5 求解器），基线为对数似然、Typicality、DoSE_KDE，另在附录中比较复杂度修正与 WAIC；跨数据集实验与 CIFAR-10-C 19 种合成扰动实验；分辨率不同的数据集统一下采样到 32×32 以避免“平凡可分”。
AI.result: 跨数据集 AUROC：SITN 在全部 6 个方向上均优于基线——CIFAR-10→SVHN 0.946（似然 0.105）、CIFAR-10→CelebA 0.910（0.728）、SVHN→CIFAR-10 0.986（0.980）、SVHN→CelebA 0.996（0.999，基本持平）、CelebA→CIFAR-10 0.671（0.496）、CelebA→SVHN 0.986（0.179）。附录中 SITN 亦全面优于复杂度修正与 WAIC（WAIC 在本设定下表现很差，因流匹配模型的似然在集成中极稳定，OOD 样本并未表现出更高方差）。CIFAR-10-C 扰动实验：SITN 宏平均 AUROC 0.85，优于 DoSE 0.78、Typicality 0.69、对数似然 0.59；最低 AUROC 为 contrast 0.6，而其他方法在多个条件下降至随机水平以下；在 JPEG、snow、spatter 上优势显著。消融显示 AD 与 CV 互补（AD 对亮度扰动更敏感，CV 对像素化/运动伪影更敏感）；max-quantile 聚合优于 KDE 聚合（0.946 vs 0.915），用训练集或验证集拟合差异可忽略。可视化显示基线方法把高似然的简单/常数背景图像误判为最 OOD（典型性与 DoSE 继承了似然的复杂度偏置），而 SITN 得分最高的样本大多是真实 OOD 样本，且 SITN 本身无复杂度偏置（PNG 压缩大小与得分的 R² 很弱）。已知失效模式：UNet 架构难以将大面积常数背景映射为典型高斯噪声，导致 AD 分量在部分 ID 样本上产生误报。
AI.conclusion: 本文的贡献在于把 OOD 检测从“似然中心”范式转向“流噪声空间中的拟合优度检验”，并给出具体实例 SITN：利用 CNF 的微分同胚与质量守恒性质以及高斯先验的完全可分解性，在单样本层面检验噪声样本的边缘正态性与维度独立性。SITN 无需 OOD 数据、无需额外训练或似然评估、开销可忽略（相对 O(D log D)），且可通过划分校准集的形式化推导 p 值，实现严格的第一类错误控制；同时规避了似然方法的复杂度偏置。作者指出未来方向：缓解常数背景在噪声空间被保留的架构伪影；探索 AD 与 CV 之外的其他依赖性统计量；研究 OOD 检测方法与底层生成模型之间的相互作用与协同优化。

title: Stabilising Explainability Fragility in Cybersecurity AI: The Impact and Mitigation of Multicollinearity in Public Benchmark Datasets
comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ACM TAISAP
summary: This paper investigates a unexplored yet impactful vulnerability in AI explainability used in intrusion detection (IDS): multicollinearity-induced instability. Despite extensive reliance on post-hoc explainability tools such as SHAP or LIME, the impact of correlated features on explanation robustness is not evaluated. We introduce a formal theorem stating that multicollinearity inflates attribution variance. This demonstrates that explanations and feature importances are non-identifiable under multicollinearity. A suite of comprehensive experiments validates the theorem on a representative benchmark dataset, UNSW-NB15. Four widely used families of models are evaluated, including linear, tree-based, kernel, and neural, across full and pruned feature sets based on VIF and correlation thresholding. We propose the novel metric of Explanability Fragility Score and two novel methods to mitigate it with variable integration complexity. CAA-Filtering focuses on stabilising explanations by grouping attributions of trained models. SHARP is a novel training-time regularisation framework that penalises attribution instability, enabling controllable and monotonic improvement of explainability stability. The findings support stable predictive performance, using Kendall's τ to quantify instability across bootstrapped explanations. This work has direct implications for the trustworthiness and reproducibility of XAI in security-critical contexts, and motivates incorporating multicollinearity mitigations into the IDS pipelines, providing a set of guidelines for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了入侵检测系统中AI可解释性工具（SHAP/LIME）的一个关键漏洞——特征多重共线性导致的归因方差膨胀问题。通过形式化定理证明、UNSW-NB15数据集验证，提出Explanability Fragility Score指标及两种缓解方法（CAA-Filtering和SHARP正则化），为安全关键场景下XAI的可信度和可重复性提供了重要理论支撑和实践指南。
AI.motivation: A critical yet unexplored vulnerability in AI explainability (XAI) for intrusion detection systems (IDS): correlated features (multicollinearity) significantly impact explanation robustness, rendering explanations and feature importances non-identifiable.
AI.method: 1) Formal theorem proving multicollinearity inflates attribution variance; 2) Comprehensive experiments on UNSW-NB15 dataset evaluating 4 model families (linear, tree-based, kernel, neural) across full and pruned feature sets (VIF and correlation thresholding); 3) Novel Explanability Fragility Score metric; 4) Two mitigation methods: CAA-Filtering (post-hoc grouping attributions) and SHARP (training-time regularization penalizing attribution instability); 5) Kendall's τ for quantifying instability across bootstrapped explanations.
AI.result: Multicollinearity inflates attribution variance, and explanations are non-identifiable under correlated features. Both CAA-Filtering and SHARP effectively mitigate this instability with controllable and monotonic improvement. Stable predictive performance is achievable.
AI.conclusion: This work has direct implications for the trustworthiness and reproducibility of XAI in security-critical contexts, and motivates incorporating multicollinearity mitigations into the IDS pipelines, providing a set of guidelines for practitioners.

title: Generative Modeling by Value-Driven Transport
summary: We propose a new framework for generative modeling based on a discrete-time stochastic control formulation of measure transport. Adapting classic results from control theory, we formulate our problem as a linear program whose dual variables correspond to the \emph{optimal value function} of the control problem, which directly encodes the optimal control policy. Exploiting this LP formulation, we develop an efficient simulation-free primal-dual algorithm for computing approximately optimal value functions and the associated \emph{value-driven transport} (VDT) policies which approximate the true optimal policy. We show that well-trained VDT policies enjoy numerous favorable properties in comparison with other state-of-the-art methods based on flows, diffusions, or Schrödinger bridges: they lead to straight transport paths which can be simulated quickly and robustly, and can be enhanced in all the same ways as diffusion and flow-based models (e.g., conditional generation, classifier-free guidance, unpaired data-to-data translation are all easy to incorporate). We evaluate our methodology in a range of experiments, with results that indicate strong performance and good potential for scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出基于离散时间随机控制 formulations 的生成模型新框架，通过线性规划和对偶理论导出价值驱动传输(VDT)策略，具有直线传输路径、快速模拟、支持多种增强功能的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型方法（如基于流、扩散或薛定谔桥的方法）在传输路径模拟效率和鲁棒性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 将问题构建为线性规划，利用其对偶变量对应最优价值函数的最优控制策略，开发了高效的无模拟原对偶算法来计算近似最优价值函数和价值驱动传输(VDT)策略。
AI.result: VDT策略具有直线传输路径、可快速鲁棒模拟的特点，同时支持条件生成、无分类器引导、非配对数据到数据翻译等增强功能，性能表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VDT方法具有直线传输路径、可快速鲁棒模拟的优势，并可与扩散和基于流的模型的所有增强功能（条件生成、无分类器引导、非配对数据到数据翻译）相媲美，展现出良好的可扩展性潜力。

title: MoSA: Motion-constrained Stress Adaptation for Mitigating Real-to-Sim Gap in Continuum Dynamics via Learning Residual Anisotropy
summary: Learning real-world dynamics from visual observations is crucial for various domains. A common strategy is to calibrate simulators by estimating physical parameters, yet accuracy is ultimately bounded by the underlying physical models, which often assume materials are homogeneous and isotropic. Even if reasonable, real-world objects typically exhibit mild anisotropy and heterogeneity. After the near-isotropic backbone is well calibrated, these residual effects become the key bottleneck for further closing the real-to-sim gap. Although neural networks can fit dynamics end-to-end, such black-box modeling discards strong physical priors, leading to poor data efficiency and overfitting. Therefore, we propose MoSA, a motion-constrained stress adaptation framework that targets these residual effects to further improve real-to-sim dynamics learning. MoSA uses an isotropic model as a physics prior and learns residual stress operators to capture mild anisotropy and heterogeneity. It progressively adapts stresses via microplane-constrained redistribution in a physics-informed cascaded network. We further impose motion constraints by supervising temporal and spatial derivatives of the deformation field. Experimentally, our learned dynamics achieves superior accuracy, generalization, and robustness, while learning physically meaningful residual anisotropy. Finally, we validate MoSA in a robot manipulation setting, showing that better real-to-sim dynamics modeling translates into more reliable sim-to-real transfer. Project Page is available at https://mercerai.github.io/MoSA/.

AI.tldr: MoSA is a motion-constrained stress adaptation framework that bridges the real-to-sim gap by combining isotropic physics priors with learned residual stress operators, validated on robot manipulation for sim-to-real transfer.
AI.motivation: Real-world objects exhibit mild anisotropy and heterogeneity, but existing physics simulators assume homogeneous and isotropic materials. After calibrating the near-isotropic backbone, these residual effects become the key bottleneck for further closing the real-to-sim gap. Pure neural network approaches discard strong physical priors, leading to poor data efficiency and overfitting.
AI.method: MoSA uses an isotropic model as physics prior and learns residual stress operators to capture mild anisotropy and heterogeneity. It progressively adapts stresses via microplane-constrained redistribution in a physics-informed cascaded network, with motion constraints supervising temporal and spatial derivatives of the deformation field.
AI.result: The learned dynamics achieves superior accuracy, generalization, and robustness compared to baselines, while learning physically meaningful residual anisotropy patterns.
AI.conclusion: Better real-to-sim dynamics modeling through MoSA translates into more reliable sim-to-real transfer in robot manipulation tasks, demonstrating practical applicability of the proposed approach.

title: Disentanglement Beyond Generative Models with Riemannian ICA
summary: There is a gap between the theoretical foundations of disentanglement and the practice of modern representation learning. Existing theoretical frameworks, particularly Independent Component Analysis (ICA) and its nonlinear variants, assume a generative model with statistically independent latent variables underlying the data so that disentanglement amounts to identifying the latents that could have generated the data. This generative framework is interpretable and theoretically justified, but its strong assumptions make it difficult to apply to modern representation learning. Modern pretrained encoders often learn features that exhibit disentangled properties without making generative assumptions, yet there is no general theory for interpreting these features as independent factors of variation. We take a step toward such a theory by introducing Riemannian ICA (RICA), which replaces ICA's global generative model with local geometric structure. RICA is founded on the observation that in ICA, the factors of variation underlying a data point can be understood through radial curves emanating from the point that map to axis-aligned lines in the latent space. We formalize this perspective using Riemannian geometry and introduce our theory in a way that is consistent with the existing generative approach. Our main contribution is the disentanglement tensor, which encodes a second-order notion of disentanglement that we call pointwise disentanglement. This tensor depends on the Hessian of the data log likelihood as well as the Ricci curvature induced by the model. In a controlled source recovery setting with known ground-truth sources, RICA recovers sources across several manifolds, while the success of ICA baselines depends on the coordinates used to represent the observations. Our work provides a theoretical basis for studying local disentanglement without assuming a global generative model.

AI.tldr: Riemannian ICA (RICA) bridges theory and practice of disentanglement by replacing global generative assumptions with local geometric structure based on Riemannian geometry. The novel disentanglement tensor captures pointwise disentanglement via Hessian and Ricci curvature. RICA demonstrates robust source recovery across manifolds independent of coordinate choice.
AI.motivation: A significant gap exists between theoretical foundations of disentanglement (ICA frameworks) and modern representation learning practice. Existing generative frameworks have strong assumptions limiting applicability to pretrained encoders that learn disentangled features without explicit generative models.
AI.method: Riemannian ICA replaces ICA's global generative model with local geometric structure using Riemannian geometry. The key contribution is the disentanglement tensor, which encodes pointwise disentanglement and depends on the Hessian of data log-likelihood and Ricci curvature induced by the model. Factors of variation are understood through radial curves mapping to axis-aligned lines in latent space.
AI.result: In controlled source recovery experiments with known ground-truth sources, RICA successfully recovers sources across multiple manifolds, while traditional ICA baseline success depends on coordinate representation of observations.
AI.conclusion: RICA provides a theoretical basis for studying local disentanglement without assuming a global generative model, applicable across various manifolds with coordinate-independent recovery.

title: Relational Linear Properties in Language Models: An Empirical Investigation
summary: Linear properties are ubiquitous in the representations of language models; however, testing them experimentally remains a challenging task. This work focuses on relational linearity: the hypothesis that, for a fixed relation (e.g., "plays"), the unembedding of an object (e.g., "trumpet") can be predicted from the embedding of its subject (e.g.,"Miles Davis") by a linear map. We present an experimental method to test the formulation of relational linearity by Marconato et al. (2025). Specifically, we introduce a probing method, based on Kullback-Leibler divergence, to evaluate this property and examine its variation across layers and paraphrased relational queries. It is also more efficient than previous work; for example, it avoids the crude Jacobian approximations used in Linear Relational Embeddings by Hernandez et al. (2024). Our findings across four datasets show that relational linearity varies across models, exhibits layer-wise patterns consistent with prior observations about linguistic information in model representations, and is differently affected by changes in how the relation is phrased.

AI.tldr: This paper introduces a computationally efficient KL-divergence-based probing method to test relational linearity in language models. Validation across four datasets reveals that such linearity varies by model, exhibits predictable layer-wise patterns, and is sensitive to paraphrasing variations.
AI.motivation: Linear properties are ubiquitous in language model representations, but experimentally testing these properties remains challenging. Specifically, the hypothesis of relational linearity—that an object's unembedding can be predicted from its subject's embedding via a linear map—needed a rigorous experimental validation method.
AI.method: The authors propose a KL-divergence-based probing method to test relational linearity formulated by Marconato et al. (2025). This approach is computationally more efficient than prior methods, circumventing the crude Jacobian approximations used in earlier work.
AI.result: Experiments across four datasets demonstrate that relational linearity varies across models, shows layer-wise patterns aligning with known linguistic information distribution in model representations, and is differentially impacted by paraphrasing variations.
AI.conclusion: The findings reveal that relational linearity: (1) varies across different language models, (2) exhibits layer-wise patterns consistent with prior linguistic information localization research, and (3) is differentially affected by paraphrasing variations of relational queries.

title: F-TIS: Harnessing Diverse Models in Collaborative GRPO
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Workshop Scalable Learning and Optimization for Efficient Multimodal AI Agents (SCALE)
summary: Reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO have seen great popularity in LLM post-training. In GRPO, models produce completions to a set of prompts, which are rewarded, and the policy is updated towards the relatively high reward completions. Due to the auto-regressive nature of models, the generation phase of such style of training can be extremely time consuming. As a solution, prior work has sought to distribute the inference step across many nodes, working parallel. These works assume primarily homogeneous models in the training in order to keep samples as close to on-policy as possible. This assumption may be impractical in decentralized systems, where parties with various computes and preferences may wish to collaborate on the same task. Thus, decentralized training requires an approach that can handle heterogeneous models - different models collaborating on the same tasks. However, this leads to highly off-policy samples presented during training, which prior work has identified that off-policy samples can hurt GRPO convergence. To enable heterogeneity, we propose Filtered Truncated Importance Sampling (F-TIS) - a GRPO-style training paradigm that can use off-policy samples to improve local model's learning. Our framework allows various models to collaborate in the same RL training run while being communication efficient. We extensively evaluate F-TIS in various heterogeneous setups and we show that it exhibits identical final model convergence to purely on-sample training. Furthermore, we observe in some setups better generalization on out-of-distribution tasks than on-policy training, increasing model's performance by up to 12\%.

AI.tldr: 针对去中心化系统中异构模型协作训练的问题，提出了F-TIS框架，通过过滤截断重要性采样使off-policy样本可用于训练，在保持通信效率的同时实现了与on-policy训练相当的收敛性，并可能在泛化能力上取得优势。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式推理方案假设训练中模型主要是同质的，以保持样本接近on-policy。然而在去中心化系统中，不同计算资源和偏好的参与方希望协作训练，这需要处理异构模型，导致高度off-policy的样本，而prior work已表明off-policy样本会损害GRPO收敛。
AI.method: 提出Filtered Truncated Importance Sampling (F-TIS)，一种GRPO风格的训练范式，通过过滤截断重要性采样来处理off-policy样本，实现异构模型协作，同时保持通信效率。
AI.result: 在各种异构设置下验证，F-TIS展现出与纯on-policy训练相同的最终模型收敛性；在某些设置下，对分布外任务展现出更好的泛化能力，性能提升可达12%。
AI.conclusion: F-TIS在异构环境中展现了与纯on-policy训练相当的最终收敛性，并在某些设置下展现出更好的泛化能力，性能提升高达12%。该框架为去中心化协作学习提供了可行的技术路径。

title: ImplicitTerrainV2: Wavelet-Guided Spatially Adaptive Neural Terrain Representation
summary: Digital elevation models (DEMs) underpin terrain analysis in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), but in their common raster form, they rely on interpolation for off-grid sampling and finite-difference operators for derivative-based analysis. Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous alternative, but prior terrain INRs lack explicit frequency control, neglect the gradient structure of terrain, and remain too large and costly to train for practical deployment. We present ImplicitTerrainV2, which advances terrain INRs toward a compact, efficient neural terrain data format by combining a spectral control mechanism with wavelet-guided spatial adaptivity, derivative-aware supervision, and post-training model compression. At its core, a wavelet complexity field (WCF) derives spatially-adaptive frequency masks from analytically computed wavelet coefficients, localizing high-frequency capacity to complex terrain regions. The same field guides complexity-aware adaptive sampling that concentrates training in high-complexity regions, while gradient matching applies extra supervision to enforce the smooth manifold structure of terrain DEMs for improved derivative fidelity. Post-training mixed-precision quantization and entropy coding reduce storage to 1.23 bpp with a 0.28 dB PSNR drop. On 50 Swiss terrain tiles, ImplicitTerrainV2 reaches 66.25 dB end-to-end PSNR, improving over the prior work by 5.70 dB while using 3.2x fewer parameters and training in 55 s per tile on a single GPU. Our compressed neural format is competitive with several established DEM codecs in rate-distortion performance, while additionally supporting off-grid point queries, closed-form derivative evaluation, and resolution-independent reconstruction, which may benefit many downstream GIS applications.

AI.tldr: ImplicitTerrainV2 proposes a compact neural terrain representation combining wavelet-based spatial adaptivity, derivative-aware training, and model compression to achieve high accuracy (66.25 dB PSNR) with 3.2x parameter reduction, supporting continuous off-grid queries and derivative evaluation for GIS applications.
AI.motivation: Current DEM raster formats have limitations: rely on interpolation for off-grid sampling, finite-difference operators for derivatives; existing INRs lack frequency control, neglect gradient structure, and are too large/costly for practical deployment.
AI.method: Wavelet complexity field (WCF) for spatial-adaptive frequency masks, complexity-aware adaptive sampling, gradient matching for derivative supervision, post-training quantization and entropy coding (1.23 bpp)
AI.result: On 50 Swiss terrain tiles: 66.25 dB PSNR (5.70 dB improvement over prior work), 3.2x fewer parameters, 55s training per tile on single GPU; compressed to 1.23 bpp with 0.28 dB PSNR drop; competitive rate-distortion with traditional DEM codecs.
AI.conclusion: ImplicitTerrainV2 is a compact, efficient neural terrain data format competitive with traditional DEM codecs while offering continuous querying, derivative evaluation, and resolution-independent reconstruction for GIS applications.

title: Neural Flow Operators can Approximate any Operator: Abstract Frameworks and Universal Approcimations
summary: We introduce an abstract neural flow framework for neural networks and neural operators. The framework contains two continuous-depth models, namely neural flows with composition and separation structures, and covers both finite-dimensional function approximation and infinite-dimensional operator approximation. We prove well-posedness and universal approximation properties for the corresponding neural flows, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first universal approximation result for flow-based models between infinite-dimensional spaces. We also obtain universal approximation results for convolutional neural flow models. Through suitable time discretizations, the composition structure recovers ResNet-type architectures, while the separation structure, via a splitting-based discretization, yields plain architectures. This gives a unified flow-based route to both residual and plain architectures for neural networks and neural operators with fully connected or convolutional linear layers.

AI.tldr: 本文在抽象希尔伯特空间层面提出统一的"神经流"（neural flow）框架，含复合结构与分离结构两种连续深度模型，证明其适定性，并在无限维算子逼近上给出（作者所称）首个流模型普适逼近定理；经恰当时间离散，复合结构还原 ResNet 型架构，分离结构经分裂格式还原普通前馈架构，从而统一覆盖全连接/卷积的神经网络与神经算子。
AI.motivation: 现有普适逼近理论呈碎片化状态：有限维 DNN/CNN 的结果依赖具体架构与目标函数假设，无限维神经算子的结果（如 FNO、DeepONet）依赖具体的升维、核表示或谱参数化，无法在单一表述下解释"神经网络"与"神经算子"为何都具普适逼近性。另一方面，连续深度（流）视角虽有控制论式的普适逼近与普适插值结果，但基本局限于有限维，且以往流分析几乎只关注残差型模型，普通前馈（plain）架构在流框架下缺乏解释。作者因此需要一个统一的抽象框架：直接建立在抽象希尔伯特空间上（不限于函数空间），同时涵盖有限维函数逼近与无限维算子逼近，并把残差与普通两类架构统一到同一流模型的离散化之下。分离结构流的思想源于 Potts-MgNet 的连续/离散双视角，但此前其逼近性质基本未被系统分析。
AI.method: 框架建立在抽象设定：X、Y 为实希尔伯特空间，C⊂X 紧；潜在空间 Z 为可分希尔伯特空间（可取 R^d、H^s(Ω) 等），Z^D 为其 D 重乘积。定义两类连续深度模型：复合结构 dz/dt = σ(W_t z + b_t)（参数 θ_t={W_t,b_t}），分离结构 dz/dt = W_t z + b_t + α_t ψ(z)（θ_t={W_t,b_t,α_t}），并用 R∘F^T_{θ_t}∘P 构成抽象神经流模型。离散化：复合结构用显式 Euler 格式 z^ℓ = z^{ℓ-1} + Δt·σ(W^ℓ z^{ℓ-1}+b^ℓ) 给出 ResNet 型架构；分离结构用半隐式分裂格式，配合隐式关系 σ^ℓ(z − Δt α^ℓ ψ(z)) = z 得 z^ℓ = σ^ℓ(W̃^ℓ z^{ℓ-1} + b̃^ℓ)，即普通前馈架构；取 ψ=σ_a（Leaky ReLU 族，a≠1）、α^ℓ=1 时有显式解 σ^ℓ = (1/(1−Δt))·σ_{(1−Δt)/(1−aΔt)}，与层无关，故普通架构可用统一激活。适定性由 Φ 关于 z 的 Lipschitz 性给出（定理4：分段常参数下解唯一存在；定理5：解对参数路径与 |a| 局部 Lipschitz，‖z¹−z²‖_{∞,∞} ≤ MT e^{LT}‖θ¹−θ²‖）。普适逼近（定理6）的证明路线：先用紧集张成闭子空间 X₀ 的可分性（引理7）作有限维投影压缩，再在输出侧作有限维正交展开（误差 ε/3），把问题归约为有限维连续函数向量场的逼近（引理8：D ≥ max(4d_x+2, 2d_y)），由 Lemma 8 的流网络构造完成 ε/3 逼近，三段误差合成 ≤ ε。引理8 中分离结构直接继承文献[17]的结论；复合结构用双宽度构造模拟 dz/dt = D_t σ_a(A_t z + b_t)（D_t 为 ±1 对角），用 ẑ(0) = (σ_a(z(0)), σ_a(−z(0)))/(1+a) 与 (I,−I) 提取 z̃=(I,−I)ẑ，再把 Leaky ReLU 实现为 dz/dt = σ_a(z) 的流（时长 τ = ln a/(a−1)），经时间平移与线性缩放得原结构。卷积情形（定理9）利用"常核卷积精确实现矩阵作用"：W_{i,j}(x−y,t) = [W̃_t]_{i,j}/|Ω|，在常数型隐状态上 W_t*z = W̃_t z。有限深度结果由时间离散得到：引理11（时间校正：把参数路径各常值段长度调整为 Δt 的整数倍，误差可控）、引理12（半隐式格式误差 ≤ C₁Δt + ε）；定理10给出普通型有限深度神经算子普适逼近（并说明 α_k=0 的仿射步可合并，Leaky ReLU 闭式解使离散格式恰为 σ_γ(W^̂_k Z_k + b̂_k)，γ=(1−Δt)/(1−Δt·a)），定理13给出 ResNet 型（0≤a<1）版本，推论14、15给出卷积版普通/残差架构。
AI.result: (1) 适定性：两种流模型在分段常参数下有唯一解，且解对参数局部 Lipschitz 连续，保证流映射良定义与参数扰动稳定性。(2) 定理6：抽象希尔伯特空间上的普适逼近——对任意紧集 C⊂X 与连续算子 O:C→Y，只要 Z 是含常数函数的函数空间，则对任意 ε>0、a≠1，存在 D、bounded 线性算子 L:X→Z^D、R:Z^D→Y 及复合或分离结构神经流算子，使 sup_{v∈C}‖O(v) − R∘F^T_{θ_t}∘L(v)‖_Y ≤ ε；作者称这是首个流模型在无限维空间之间的普适逼近结果。(3) 定理9：把许可线性算子限制为卷积形式后普适逼近仍成立（含卷积神经流网络与卷积神经流算子），因常核卷积可精确复现全连接矩阵在常数隐状态上的作用。(4) 定理10/13 与推论14/15：经适当时间离散，有限深度的全连接与卷积神经算子在普通型与 ResNet 型两种架构下均继承普适逼近性，误差由网络表达力与离散精度 C₁Δt 联合控制。(5) 数值分析视角下，深度 L 被解释为时间步数、Δt=T/L 为离散步长，给出残差与普通架构的统一来源。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了统一抽象神经流框架：在抽象希尔伯特空间（非必须为函数空间）上同时处理有限维函数逼近与无限维算子逼近，并统一解释残差型与普通型架构——前者来自复合结构的显式 Euler 离散，后者来自分离结构的分裂式离散，且全连接与卷积线性层皆可涵盖。作者认为其流模型适定性证明与无限维普适逼近定理为该方向新结果，卷积流模型的普适逼近亦为新增。局限与展望：分析限于参数化 Leaky ReLU 族，尚未给出定量误差界与逼近率；流模型的离散化误差控制可借鉴 ODE/PDE 数值分析以设计更可解释、稳定、高效的架构；框架能否推广至 Transformer 型架构（沿[75,77]的思路）仍是开放方向。

title: Regret-Based $(ε,δ)$-optimal Stopping Criteria for Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used iterative black-box optimization method that utilizes Gaussian process (GP) surrogate models. In practice, BO is typically terminated after a fixed evaluation budget is exhausted, which can incur unnecessary cost and provides no optimality guarantee on solution quality. Recent research in developing a practical stopping criterion has made empirical progress, yet a theoretically sound stopping criterion remains a work in progress. In this work, we present provably tighter instantaneous regret bounds for GP upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) at any given iteration. Then, we propose stopping criteria for GP-UCB based on this tighter bound that ensures an $ε$-optimal solution with high probability $1-δ$ upon termination. Numerical experiments are performed to validate and demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our stopping criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文为GP-UCB提供了更紧的瞬时遗憾界，基于此提出了具有理论保证的停止准则，确保贝叶斯优化以高概率获得ε最优解并避免不必要的评估开销。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在实际应用中通常采用固定评估预算终止，导致不必要的计算成本且无法保证解的质量最优性。现有停止准则缺乏理论支撑。
AI.method: 本文提出了针对GP-UCB在任意迭代时刻的理论上界更紧的瞬时遗憾界，并基于该紧界设计停止准则，确保终止时以高概率1-δ获得ε最优解。
AI.result: 所提停止准则能够以高概率1-δ保证获得ε最优解。
AI.conclusion: 数值实验验证了所提停止准则的有效性和效率。

title: Abstraction for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) often exhibit significant redundancy due to symmetries and shared structure across state-goal pairs in real-world Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (GCRL). While hierarchical policies have been motivated for horizon reduction via temporal abstraction in offline GCRL, we demonstrate that hierarchy also enables absolute abstraction. By introducing relativised options as well as distinct representations for different levels of the hierarchy, we demonstrate how an agent can reuse experience across similar contexts of the state-space. Based on this framework, we introduce two simple algorithms for learning relativised options and abstracting from the absolute frame of reference. Our experiments show that such inductive biases significantly improve performance in offline GCRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相对化选项框架，通过层次化表示实现状态空间中的经验复用，解决离线目标条件强化学习中MDP结构冗余问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界GCRL中，MDP存在由对称性和状态-目标对共享结构导致的显著冗余；现有层次策略仅被用于通过时间抽象缩短规划 horizon，未能充分挖掘层次结构的抽象潜力。
AI.method: 引入相对化选项（relativised options）和层次化表示框架，使智能体能在状态空间的相似上下文中复用经验。
AI.result: 实验证明，所提归纳偏置显著提升了离线GCRL性能。
AI.conclusion: 两个简单算法有效证明了相对化选项和层次表示的可行性，为离线GCRL提供了新的解决思路。

title: GraphFlow: A Graph-Based Workflow Management for Efficient LLM-Agent Serving
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents demonstrate strong reasoning and execution capabilities on complex tasks when guided by structured instructions, commonly referred to as workflows. However, existing workflow-assisted agent serving systems typically rely on predefined templates and shallow matching mechanisms, which limit their ability to capture deep semantic relationships and generalize to previously unseen tasks. To address these limitations, we propose a new workflow management paradigm that represents workflows using a unified graph, termed wGraph, where each node corresponds to an atomic operation. wGraph serves as a shared substrate from which task-specific workflows are dynamically instantiated. Building on wGraph primitives, we introduce GraphFlow, a system that efficiently integrates workflows into agent serving through two key designs. First, adaptive workflow generation dynamically constructs workflows from wGraph based on task semantics and constraint requirements. Second, workflow state management exploits wGraph structure to efficiently manage Key-Value (KV) caches, reducing redundant computation during agent serving. Extensive experiments across five benchmark datasets show that GraphFlow consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding an average performance improvement of approximately 4.95 percentage points, while achieving an approximately 4$\times$ reduction in memory footprint.

AI.tldr: GraphFlow 将 LLM-Agent 的工作流统一抽象为一张全局操作图 wGraph（节点为原子操作，边为合法依赖关系），并在此基础上实现「任务自适应工作流生成 + 拓扑感知状态管理」：前者用 GNN+MLP 在图上按任务语义生成任务特定子图工作流，后者将 KV 缓存分解为上下文无关的 base 与稀疏的拓扑感知残差并做有效路径剪枝。五个基准、三种骨干模型上平均性能提升约 4.95 个百分点，KV 缓存内存约降低 4 倍。
AI.motivation: 现有工作流辅助的 Agent 服务系统存在两大根本局限：(1) 工作流构建方式静态或基于检索（固定模板 + 浅层语义相似度匹配），无法刻画任务需求与流程结构之间的细粒度对应关系，难以泛化到未见/组合型任务；(2) 状态管理以「每个工作流」为粒度维护 KV 缓存，而不同工作流在操作层面（相同的工具调用、推理步、验证模块）高度重叠，造成大量 KV 内存冗余，限制服务扩展性。因此需要一种既能细粒度重组操作、又能跨工作流共享执行状态的统一表示。
AI.method:
提出 wGraph：𝒢_op=(𝒱_op, ℰ_op)，有向无环图，节点为原子操作（工具调用/推理步/验证模块），边为有效结构或功能依赖，是所有任务特定工作流的共享基底。
1) 任务自适应工作流生成：将工作流合成建模为条件子图生成问题 W*=argmax_{W⊆G} E[f(S,W)]。在图中加入虚拟任务节点 v_task，与所有操作节点双向连接，使任务语义在 GCN 消息传递中全局扩散；节点特征由语义指令 D_i 与词汇触发模式 P_i（must/should）经异构编码器 φ 映射，任务节点特征来自查询嵌入。编码器为 2 层 GCN（隐藏维 256，ReLU，对称归一化，初始特征用 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，D=384），解码器为 3 层 MLP 对候选边打分 s_ij=σ(MLP([h_i,h_j,h_task]))，仅在 wGraph 允许的候选边上计算。训练使用 Gumbel-Sigmoid 可微松弛 + 二元交叉熵损失，监督数据由 GPT-4o 合成执行轨迹解析得到的真实工作流；推理阶段采用确定性分数 + 约束解码，从任务节点出发贪心选择高分依赖并满足结构有效性，形成连通子图。
2) 拓扑感知状态管理：差分式 KV 缓存。每个操作节点预存由独立描述计算得到的 base KV 缓存，运行时叠加由执行前缀引入的稀疏残差 ΔKV(P,v)，重构 KV(P,v)=KV_base(v)+ΔKV(P,v)。经验观测表明前缀引起的 KV 变化高度稀疏（>75% 的 key 项与 >70% 的 value 项低于小阈值），故残差可压缩存储。此外做有效路径剪剪：依据执行统计只物化高频转移的残差，稀有路径回退到即时计算，避免状态空间爆炸。
系统分为离线准备阶段（构建 wGraph、训练生成模型、预计算 base KV）与在线服务阶段（生成子图工作流、按需重构 KV、交由下游 Agent 执行）。
AI.result:
在 GSM8K、MATH、HotpotQA、HumanEval、MBPP 五个基准上，以 Qwen-2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B 为骨干，与 Vanilla、MetaGPT、LLMCompiler、TaskWeaver、AgentKB、AutoFlow、AFlow 对比，GraphFlow 在全部 15 组（3 模型 × 5 数据集）设置中均取得最佳精度，同时 P90 延迟更低（如 Qwen 聚合 P90 12.25s vs AFlow 14.06s）。典型增益：Qwen HumanEval pass@1 78.1→86.2，MATH 72.1→76.4；Gemma HumanEval 75.4→82.5。平均性能提升约 4.95 个百分点。
状态管理消融：相对 stateful KV，GSM8K 内存约 50GB→11GB，HotpotQA 约 85GB→25GB，性能仅小幅下降（MATH 52.6% vs 53.8%）；stateless KV 内存最低（8–17GB）但性能显著退化（MATH 降至约 39.4%，HotpotQA F1 约 58.6%），验证前缀上下文对多步推理的必要性。批量扩展性：stateful 内存从 batch=10 的约 0.8GB 增至 batch=50 的 2.4GB+，GraphFlow 在各批量下均低于 0.5GB，实现内存与并发解耦。路径剪枝单独带来 GSM8K 15.0→11.5GB、MBPP 9.9→7.2GB、MATH 约 −5.3GB、HotpotQA 约 −4.2GB。组件消融（Llama-3.1-8B）：去掉 GNN 退化为语义 MLP 时 MATH 52.6→47.1、GSM8K −5.3；去掉虚拟任务节点 MATH −2.3。GCN 深度消融显示 2 层最优，3 层平台、4 层因过平滑退化（如 Gemma 上 MBPP pass@1 63.8→<59%）。
AI.conclusion: GraphFlow 将 LLM-Agent 编排从「静态工作流检索」推进到「共享操作图上的动态子图构建」：以 wGraph 统一多工作流的原子操作与依赖，显式建模操作级共享与合法执行路径，使工作流可按任务细粒度重组，同时支持跨工作流、拓扑感知的 KV 状态复用。实验证明其在多域多骨干上一致提升执行质量，并把 KV 缓存内存降低约 4 倍，且内存增长与并发解耦，优于 stateful 与 stateless 两种极端方案。其局限在于依赖高质量离线合成轨迹与静态 wGraph（新增操作需重建图）、GCN 消息传递带来的少量延迟开销、以及训练/推理依赖浅层 GCN 编码可能限制极复杂长程依赖建模。

title: The Value of Covariance Matching in Gaussian DDPMs and the Lanczos Sampler
summary: A central error measure in Gaussian DDPMs is the path-space KL divergence between the exact reverse chain and the learned Gaussian reverse process. This quantity is especially relevant for procedures such as classifier guidance, which perturb the entire reverse trajectory rather than only the terminal sample. Prior analyses show that standard isotropic reverse covariances suffer an unavoidable $Ω(1/T)$ path-KL error as the number of denoising steps $T$ grows. We show that matching the full posterior covariance breaks this barrier, yielding an order-wise improvement that reduces the path KL to $O(1/T^2)$. To make full covariance matching practical, we introduce the Lanczos Gaussian sampler (LGS), a training-free, matrix-free method for sampling from the optimal reverse covariance using only covariance-vector products, which are available through Jacobian-vector products of the posterior mean. LGS avoids dense covariance storage and auxiliary covariance models. We prove that LGS approximation error decays exponentially in the number of Lanczos steps, where each Lanczos step requires a single Jacobian-vector product. Empirically, using only just three such steps improves sample quality over strong diagonal-covariance baselines, including OCM-DDPM, across standard image benchmarks. This identifies full covariance matching as both theoretically valuable and practically accessible for fast DDPM sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文证明匹配完整后验协方差可突破Gaussian DDPM中路径-KL误差的Ω(1/T)下界，将其降至O(1/T²)；并提出实用化方案LGS采样器，以指数级效率逼近最优逆向协方差，仅需少量Jacobian-向量积即可显著提升采样质量。
AI.motivation: 标准各向同性逆向协方差存在不可避免的Ω(1/T)路径-KL误差，当扩散步数T增大时误差无法降低。该误差对分类器引导等扰动整个逆向轨迹的过程影响尤为严重
AI.method: 提出Lanczos Gaussian采样器(LGS)，一种无需训练、无需存储稠密协方差矩阵的方法，利用Lanczos算法从最优逆向协方差中采样，仅需协方差-向量积（通过后验均值Jacobian-向量积获得）。LGS的核心是Lanczos步骤，每步仅需一次Jacobian-向量积
AI.result: 理论与实验双重验证：(1) 理论上证明全后验协方差匹配将路径-KL误差从O(1/T)降低至O(1/T²)，实现量级改进；(2) LGS的近似误差随Lanczos步数指数衰减；(3) 仅用3步Lanczos迭代即可在标准图像基准上超越OCM-DDPM等强对角协方差基线方法
AI.conclusion: LGS方法在仅使用三个Lanczos步骤的情况下即可在标准图像基准上提升样本质量，验证了全协方差匹配的实用价值

title: Post-Training is About States, Not Tokens: A State Distribution View of SFT, RL, and On-Policy Distillation
summary: Large language model post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and distillation are often analyzed through their loss functions: maximum likelihood, policy gradients, forward KL, reverse KL, or related objective-level variants. We study a complementary factor: the state distribution on which supervision is applied. For an autoregressive policy, a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states, while RL and on-policy distillation (OPD) train on states induced by the current learner. We formalize post-training as state-distribution shaping and run a controlled smallscale study using Qwen3-0.6B-Base on GSM8K, with TruthfulQA and MMLU as retention evaluations. Our results show three phenomena. First, a mild SFT run improves GSM8K with little forgetting, while a stress SFT run causes substantial retention loss. Second, OPD from a degraded SFT teacher surpasses that teacher on GSM8K, TruthfulQA, and MMLU, despite using the teacher as its only supervision source. Third, a lightweight on-policy RL run improves GSM8K while preserving retention. These results support a state-centric view of post-training: the source and locality of training states can be as important as the form of the supervision signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"后训练关乎状态分布而非 token 目标"的视角：自回归策略的"状态"定义为 prompt + 已生成前缀，后训练方法可分解为"状态来源"（数据集/教师/学生自身 rollout）与"信号来源"（gold token/教师 logit/奖励）两个正交维度。作者在单卡上以 Qwen3-0.6B-Base + LoRA、GSM8K 为目标任务、TruthfulQA 与 MMLU 为保持性评测，验证了三个现象：温和 SFT 提升 GSM8K 且几乎无遗忘；过载 SFT（5 epoch、lr 5e-4、rank 64）产生明显遗忘并退化；以该退化教师做在策略蒸馏（OPD，用教师从学生状态生成续写）可在三项指标上全面超越教师；轻量在策略 RL 提升 GSM8K 且保持能力。同时发现标量漂移（MMD）不足以解释遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有对 SFT、RL、蒸馏的分析几乎全部集中在损失函数层面（最大似然、策略梯度、前向/反向 KL），但这些目标级视角无法解释若干常见现象：SFT 简单高效却可能灾难性遗忘；RL 奖励稀疏噪声大却稳定提升；蒸馏通常被理解为"复制教师"，但学生有时能匹配甚至超过教师。作者指出被忽略的另一个维度是"目标作用在哪里"：自回归模型的 token 预测总是以状态（prompt + 已生成前缀）为条件，同样的 token 级信号作用在不同状态分布上会产生截然不同的结果。因此需要把"状态分布"提升为与"目标函数"并列的一级分析轴，用以统一解释 SFT/RL/OPD 的稳定性差异与师生反转现象。
AI.method: 形式化：(1) 定义状态 s_t=(x, y_<t)、动作 y_t、策略诱导的状态访问分布 d^π(s)（rollout 近似）；(2) 将后训练分解为状态源 q_k 与信号源 S 两个正交轴，给出 SFT（q_k=d_data，离策略状态拟合、暴露偏差重述）、RL（q_k=d^{π_θk}，在策略局部改进）、OPD（q_k=d^{π_S,k}，信号来自教师但状态由学生采样，类似 DAgger）的统一损失与统一三步算子框架 s~q_k、z~S(s)、梯度更新，并归纳出四个被混淆的问题（更新在哪、信息是什么、信号多稠密、策略能移动多远）与四条预测 P1–P4。实验：Qwen3-0.6B-Base + LoRA，单张 RTX 3090 24GB；纯 GSM8K 风格 prompt（base 模型不用 chat 模板）；温和 SFT、压力 SFT、两种 OPD 变体（一步 logit 匹配 vs. 教师续写）、基于 group-relative 精确答案奖励的轻量在策略 RL；指标为目标准确率、保持性遗忘 F=Score_base−Score_post、保持率 Score_post/Score_base，以及状态漂移 MMD（RBF 核）+ 质心距离/切片 Wasserstein/词汇 Jaccard。
AI.result: Base: GSM8K 0.448 / TruthfulQA 0.300 / MMLU 0.436。温和 SFT：0.512 / 0.295 / 0.444，遗忘 -0.0015、保持率 1.0008，MMD 0.00956（无遗忘，充当负对照）。压力 SFT：0.420 / 0.245 / 0.364，遗忘 0.0635、保持率 0.8258，MMD 0.01093——目标与保持能力同时退化，形成"退化教师"。OPD（源自压力 SFT 教师，续写式）：0.466 / 0.275 / 0.430，遗忘 0.0155、保持率 0.9515，在三项指标上全面超越教师。OPD（源自温和 SFT）：0.512 / 0.290 / 0.434，保持率 0.9810，MMD 0.01470（漂移最大但保持良好，进一步反驳标量漂移定律）。轻量在策略 RL：0.472 / 0.290 / 0.442，遗忘仅 0.0020、保持率 0.9902。一步（one-step）OPD 崩溃，GSM8K 仅 0.040，说明一步 logit 匹配对推理任务信号过弱，需轨迹级稠密续写监督。漂移分析：压力 SFT 与其 OPD 的 MMD 几乎相同（0.01093 vs 0.01092）但保持率差异巨大（0.8258 vs 0.9515），证明"MMD 越大遗忘越多"的简单标量定律不成立。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张后训练行为由"监督信号 × 训练状态分布"的交互决定：在策略（学习者诱导）状态上施加监督具有局部性，能保留既有能力并允许学生超越退化的教师；状态来源、局部性与学习者依赖性，与目标函数形式本身同等重要。研究同时修正了原始论点：遗忘并非仅由更新幅度、标量分布漂移或 SFT 本身引起，而应结合状态源与信号稠密度共同解释。实践启示：在策略采样 + 稠密轨迹级（续写）监督是可行的配方，"本地修复式"提问（"在我所处的位置教师会怎么做"）比复制教师完整轨迹更有效。局限：单一基座模型、单一目标数据集、LoRA、有限保持任务、词汇特征漂移估计、简化版 GRPO 式 RL trainer，结论应视为机制性假设的证据而非基准性结论；后续需更丰富的状态分布分析（不仅是漂移幅度，还包括哪些状态被监督、是否局部可达）。

title: Do Deep Ensembles Actually Capture Uncertainty in Graph Neural Networks?
summary: While deep ensembles are widely considered to be the default method for uncertainty quantification in deep learning, their effectiveness for graph-structured data is often simply assumed based on successes in domains like computer vision. We investigate standard deep ensembles specifically for message-passing graph neural networks. Benchmarking across seven datasets representing varied tasks and complexities, we reveal that ensembles provide surprisingly little improvement over a single model. Instead, the observed marginal gains stem primarily from stabilizing optimization noise in point predictions rather than yielding meaningfully better uncertainty estimates. Through an aleatoric-epistemic decomposition, we identify epistemic collapse: independently trained networks consistently converge to overly similar predictions. Because disagreement is the fundamental mechanism through which ensembles capture epistemic uncertainty, this lack of diversity neutralizes their key advantage. Analyzing this phenomenon further, we suggest this collapse is driven by functional rather than weight-space convexity, where distinct parameter solutions induce almost identical behavior. Our results suggest that deep ensemble success does not seamlessly transfer to graph machine learning.

AI.tldr: 标准深度集成（Deep Ensemble）在消息传递型 GNN 上几乎不能捕获不确定性：在 8 个图数据集上，其相对单模型的似然提升在分类任务不足 1%、回归约 5%，远低于计算机视觉领域约 20% 的典型增益；且这些提升主要来自对点预测的平均（平滑优化噪声），而非更好的校准。作者将这一现象命名为"认知崩塌"（epistemic collapse）：不同随机初始化训练出的 GNN 收敛到几乎相同的函数，因此集成成员之间几乎没有分歧，DE 的核心机制被中和。理论上作者证明了一个把认知方差上界与图拓扑（锚定谱间隙）和 Dirichlet 能量预算联系起来的界，说明消息传递的平滑偏置（而非过平滑）正是崩塌的成因，并预测异配图上崩塌更弱。
AI.motivation: 深度集成（DE）因只需重复训练同一架构而成为深度学习不确定量化的事实标准，其原理是独立初始化模型的"分歧"刻画认知（epistemic）不确定性。然而在图结构数据上，DE 的有效性通常仅是从计算机视觉的成功直接类推而来，缺乏系统检验：综述与大量工作把 DE 当作现成基线而非研究对象，也很少与"更简单基线"比较，已有评估结论彼此矛盾（从"难以超越"到"与单模型难以区分"，甚至在 PEMS 基准上劣于平凡基线）。因此本文旨在回答：标准 DE 机制用于消息传递 GNN 时，究竟比单个模型多获得了什么，以及为何如此。
AI.method: （1）基准测试：8 个数据集覆盖节点/图级分类与回归（CiteSeer、Tolokers2、MolHIV、Artnetviews、Chameleon、QM9-5%、Cora、PEMS），架构按任务选 GCN/GATv2/GIN，回归任务加方差头并联合优化均值与方差；指标为 NLL（严格恰当评分规则）、ECE（回归用 miscalibration area×2）与点估计指标 PEM，10 次独立运行。（2）动机实验：PEMS 上比较单 GCN、5 模型 DE、贝叶斯 GCN（SVI）、图上的 Matérn GP 与平凡高斯基线。（3）NLL 增益解构：回归用 DE-R（DE 均值+单模型方差）、DE-A（DE 均值+偶然方差）两个构造基线分离点预测与不确定性贡献；分类用 Jensen 间隙（个体期望 NLL 与集成 NLL 之差）衡量分布层面的集成收益。（4）多样性分析：按 aleatoric–epistemic 分解（式 2、3）量化认知方差与认知熵/log C 的比例；"model soup"（权重平均）性能差于单模型，据此判定崩塌源于函数空间而非权重空间的凸性。（5）分布偏移：TLK2 与 ARTNV 采用基于局部聚类系数的密度式划分，测试集由邻域更稠密的节点构成。（6）理论：设图拉普拉斯 L、锚点集 S（训练节点）、Dirichlet 能量 E(z)=zᵀLz；假设 1 期望预测能量 E_w[E(f_w)]≤ρ（能量预算），假设 2 锚点拟合误差 E_w[(f_w(s)-y_s)²]≤ε²；证明带锚定谱间隙 λ_α=min_{||x||=1}(E(x)+αΣ_{s∈S}x_s²) 的界 V_epi ≤ inf_{α>0}(ρ−E_min+α|S|ε²)/λ_α；含 Lemma 1（锚定/接地谱不等式）、Lemma 2（给定标签的最小能量 bᵀRb）、Lemma 3（中心化能量恒等式）、硬钉扎推论、非连通图逐分量推论，并引用 Proposition 1（l 层无偏置 ReLU GCN 的 E(X^(l))=O((sλ̄)^l)）说明深度导致能量收缩。
AI.result: （1）PEMS 上 DE 失败：DE 的 NLL 2.39 远差于 Trivial 1.37（单 GCN 2.51），不确定性图整体过低且在训练节点处异常尖峰；Graph GP 最优（NLL 0.98），B-GCN（1.32）优于平凡基线，说明失败特定于 DE 而非 GNN 本身。（2）其余数据集上 DE 一般优于平凡基线，但似然比 exp(NLL_GNN−NLL_DE) 显示分类提升不足 1%、回归约 5%（最优的 CHAM 约 14% 且置信区间很宽），而经典 CV 文献约 20%；扩大集成到 10 个模型趋势不变。（3）NLL 增益来源被解构：DE、DE-R、DE-A 的 NLL 几乎相同，说明增益来自 DE 均值带来的更准（更平滑）的点预测而非更好校准；CHAM、QM9-5% 上 DE 提升 NLL 却恶化 ECE 正是该现象的体现；分类的 Jensen 间隙接近 0，成员概率分布几乎相同。（4）认知崩塌被证实：偶然不确定性主导，认知方差远小于偶然方差（CV 报告的认知/偶然比约 5，此处远低于 1），分类认知熵/log C 接近 0（很少超过 0.1）；即使在误差增大的协变量偏移下 DE 的 NLL 增益也不足 3%。（5）model soup 普遍劣于单模型（回归的点预测退化到接近平凡基线），说明权重空间高度非凸，崩塌是功能性的。（6）理论：界表明认知方差受"剩余能量"ρ−E_min 与锚定谱间隙共同限制；GCN 深度使能量按 O((sλ̄)^l) 收缩，平滑偏置使 ρ 小，故分歧受限；异配图需要更大 ρ，界更松，与 CHAM 上崩塌最弱、认知/偶然比最高的观察一致（作者谨慎指出这只是可信机制而非定理直接推论）。
AI.conclusion: 深度集成在图神经网络上的成功不能从计算机视觉直接迁移：DE 相对单模型的收益几乎全部来自对优化噪声的方差平滑与点预测精度提升，而非更有意义的不确定性估计；其赖以工作的成员分歧机制被"认知崩塌"抵消。理论上，这一崩塌与消息传递的平滑偏置（而非过平滑）直接相关，可由图拓扑与 Dirichlet 能量预算给出的认知方差界刻画，并预测在异配图上约束更松。实践建议：既然多随机种子中最好的单个模型常能接近集成，用验证集选种子可保留大部分收益而只付单模型推理成本；同时平滑偏置只是限制、并未排除 GNN 中有用的认知不确定性（PEMS 上 B-GCN 优于平凡基线），图特定的多样性机制或消息传递之外的架构值得进一步探索。局限：理论仅覆盖节点级任务、不涉及训练动力学，无法单独解释 PEMS 上 DE 与同族 B-GCN 的差距；异配图的解释属推测；论文摘要称 7 个数据集而正文为 8 个，存在表述不一致。

title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses
summary: Distillation attacks create a deployment trade-off for model providers: the same outputs that make a model more useful can also make it easier to imitate. We study this trade-off through a minimax game between a utility-constrained teacher and an adaptive student. Our framework yields tractable one-sided response rules: an adaptive evaluation rule in which the student reweights high-value examples, and a teacher-side defense template that suppresses outputs most useful for distillation. From a cheap proxy for example value, we derive Product-of-Experts (PoE), a simple forward-pass-only defense that combines the teacher with a proxy student during generation. Empirically, adaptive evaluation reveals a large passive--adaptive gap: on state-of-the-art defenses, adaptive students recover substantially more capability than passive evaluation suggests on GSM8K and MATH. Under this stronger evaluation, the apparent robustness gap between expensive defenses and PoE narrows considerably, while PoE remains substantially cheaper and preserves higher-quality reasoning traces. Overall, our results suggest that strong distillation remains difficult to stop, and that progress on antidistillation should be judged against adaptive students rather than passive ones. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ysfalh/distillation-game.

AI.tldr: 本文把"抗蒸馏防御"建模为一个极小极大博弈：受效用约束的教师（保真预算 ε）与可自适应调整训练权重的学生（适应预算 ρ）对抗，核心结果是一对"指数倾斜"形式的单边最优响应——学生侧给出"按样本学习价值重加权"的自适应评估规则，教师侧给出统一的防御模板。由此用廉价代理价值（师生对数似然差）推导出仅需前向传播的 Product-of-Experts（PoE）防御。实验证明：现有 SOTA 防御（ADS）在被动评估下看似很强，但面对自适应学生时泄漏大幅增加（学生准确率相对提升约 50%）；在同等教师效用下 ADS 与 PoE 的差距大幅收窄，而 PoE 成本更低（1.64× vs 2.93×）且推理轨迹质量更高。结论是：抗蒸馏进展必须以自适应学生为基准来评判，并同时权衡泄漏、生成成本与轨迹质量三者。
AI.motivation: 模型提供商暴露越丰富的输出（答案、中间推理、工具调用序列、错误纠正、候选解反馈等），越容易被聚合为模仿训练数据，形成"有用性—易模仿性"的部署权衡。现有抗蒸馏文献把"防御设计"与"评测"割裂开来：防御提出一种修改教师输出的规则后，只用一个在释放数据上均匀训练的被动蒸馏器来测试。两个问题未被回答：(1) 防御应当以什么样的蒸馏器为准？真实攻击者会过滤、重加权或聚焦高学习价值样本，若忽略这种适应性，评测会陷入"猫鼠游戏"，每代防御只针对其隐含假设的弱蒸馏器；(2) 不同防御隐含了不同的"什么输出对蒸馏者有用"的理论，缺少统一框架来比较它们或指明防御应针对哪一种有用性。论文还指出，仅隐藏完整 CoT 换成摘要并不足以消除蒸馏风险：实验表明即便是商业前沿模型的摘要轨迹，被动学生也能恢复相当能力。
AI.method:
**1. 博弈形式化（minimax 框架）**
- 三个对象：参考教师 π_ref（未防御）、释放教师 π_rel（实际暴露、已防御）、有效学生分布 π_eff（学生对已释放输出的重加权后训练分布，注意 π_eff ≠ 最终学生模型 π_stu）。
- 两个 KL 预算：教师保真集 Π_ε(π_ref) = {π : E_x D_KL(π(·|x)‖π_ref(·|x)) ≤ ε}（该方向 KL 惩罚释放模型把质量放在参考模型认为不可能的输出上）；学生适应集 Π_ρ(π_rel) = {π : E_x D_KL(π_eff(·|x)‖π_rel(·|x)) ≤ ρ}。ρ=0 即被动学生；KL 约束隐含攻击者只能对已释放输出做绝对连续的"换度量"，不能凭空创造新数据源。
- 标量价值函数 v(x,y) 衡量样本对下游蒸馏的价值；一阶代理 v_grad(x,y) = −⟨∇_θL(θ_0), ∇_θ log π_stu(y|x;θ)|_{θ_0}⟩（下游损失梯度与学生样本梯度的负内积）。框架本身不依赖任何具体的学生更新规则或参数化。
- 极小极大目标：V(ε,ρ) = inf_{π_rel∈Π_ε} sup_{π_eff∈Π_ρ} E[v(x,y)]。

**2. 定理 3.1（最优响应，指数倾斜）**
学生最优响应：π_eff*(y|x) ∝ π_rel(y|x)·e^{η v(x,y)}；教师最优响应：π_rel*(y|x) ∝ π_ref(y|x)·e^{−λ v(x,y)}，其中 η、λ≥0 为对偶变量，约束紧时唯一且期望 KL 预算取等。证明用强对偶 + 惩罚化分解（KL 恒等式）+ 紧性/存在性。附录 B 进一步给出变分形式 Ψ(π_rel)=inf_{η>0}[ρ+E_x log Z(x,η)]/η，用 Berge 最大值定理证明 Stackelberg 最优教师—学生对存在。

**3. 攻击算法（Algorithm 1）**
按 minibatch 估计 v_grad，按 w(x,y) ∝ exp(η·v_grad(x,y)) 归一化后做加权 SFT；η=0 退化为被动训练。攻击者被刻意限制为只重加权已释放轨迹（不做 prompt 选择、不追加查询、不改写轨迹），因此所报告泄漏是更强自适应攻击的下界。

**4. 防御算法（Algorithm 2，PoE）**
代入梯度价值得到 ADS 的博弈解释（Savani et al. 2025 的目标即一阶梯度价值下教师最优响应的近似）。由于解码期需要学生梯度代价过高，改用廉价代理 v_gap(x,y)=log π_ref(y|x) − log π_stu(y|x)（师生似然差，刻画教师有能力而代理学生尚未覆盖的区域），代入教师最优响应得 π_rel* ∝ π_ref^{1−λ} π_stu^λ，即 Product-of-Experts 几何混合；实践用 token 级近似（每步插值教师与代理学生的 log-probs，混合权重 γ，温度 τ），仅需前向传播、无梯度。

**5. 实验设置**
教师 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B；防御代理 Qwen2.5-3B；最终学生 Llama-3.2-3B（刻意与代理不匹配，构成迁移式评测）。数据集 GSM8K（5238/2246/1319 划分）与 MATH（5000/2500/5000）。教师生成 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95、prompt 截断 512、生成长度上限 1024、附加答案强制后缀。学生 LoRA 微调：rank 128、α=128、3 epoch、lr 5e-4、cosine、batch 6、累积 4、序列长 2048；自适应学生锐度 β_s=0.5；3 个种子（123/456/789），报告均值±标准误；硬件 B200/H200/A100。对比三种教师：无防御、ADS（扫 λ）、PoE（扫 γ），画出"效用—可蒸馏性"前沿。
AI.result:
**1. 被动—自适应差距巨大（核心发现）**
GSM8K：ADS 教师准确率 82.13% 时，被动学生 34.33%，自适应学生达 51.50%（相对提升 50.04%）；PoE 教师 81.61% 时，39.26% → 49.46%（+25.98%）。MATH：ADS 8.96% → 13.45%（+50.07%），PoE 9.00% → 12.92%（+43.56%）；无防御教师几乎不受影响（GSM8K 57.24% vs 56.74%，MATH 15.17% vs 15.29%）。差距足以改变对防御效果的定性解读。

**2. 自适应评测下 ADS 与 PoE 差距显著收窄**
同教师精度下 GSM8K 被动评估 ADS 34% 优于 PoE 39%，但自适应下变为 52% vs 49%（PoE 甚至略低）。加入成本：GSM8K 上 PoE 教师生成时间开销 1.64×，ADS 为 2.93×；MATH 上 2.33× vs 3.85×。结论不是某一方全面占优，而是评测协议与成本共同重排比较。

**3. 前沿平移幅度缩小**
GSM8K 上 ADS 牺牲约 5 点教师精度，被动下学生降 23 点，自适应下仅降 5 点；PoE 牺牲约 6 点教师精度，被动降 18 点、自适应仅降 7 点。

**4. PoE 保留更高质量推理轨迹**
Claude Sonnet 4.6 按"可审计性"1–5 分 rubric 评判（忽略长度与文风）：PoE 的高分轨迹多于 ADS 且更接近无防御教师；定性对比显示 PoE 更简洁紧凑、常保留完整逻辑但去除赘述与回退，有时给出另一条等价有效的解题路径；ADS 有时更长更机械，并偶发 "raid/raiding" 类退化重复 token。判官校准：30 条轨迹的人类盲评与判官的二次加权 Cohen's κ=0.76，MAE=0.40，平均带符号误差 +0.13。词数对比显示 PoE 轨迹显著更短。

**5. 消融与外部证据**
- 简单过滤（异常字符/连续重复 token>8）能提升被动学生（ADS +2.58pp、PoE +5.46pp），但远不及自适应重加权（自适应分别高出过滤后被动基线 15.73pp 与 12.69pp），说明该现象非平凡过滤所致。
- 换用同族 1.5B 代理：ADS 强度需重调（λ=0.052 时教师精度崩至 21.42%，λ=0.027 恢复 81.56%，此时自适应仍高被动 11.92pp），PoE γ=0.65 仍可用（教师 78.00%，自适应高 7.70pp）——代理规模影响标定但不消除被动—自适应差距。
- 另一族防御（轨迹改写，Ma et al. 2026）：其公开优化版 GSM8K 数据中位轨迹长度由 240 词降至 2 词（1381→27 字符），71.7% 改写不超过 5 词，说明仅看教师—学生准确率会遗漏严重的可用性损失。
- 前沿模型蒸馏（附录 C.2）：以 Gemini 3 Flash / Claude Sonnet 4.6 / GPT-5.4 mini 的轨迹微调 Llama-3.2-3B，GSM8K 从基座 0.76%、仅问答监督 3.43% 提升至 51.75%/53.57%/54.78%；MATH 从 1.01%/11.25% 提升至 12.09%/16.33%/14.83%，表明摘要式轨迹仍携带可复用信号。
- 方法论主张：抗蒸馏防御应联合按 (i) 对自适应学生的泄漏、(ii) 生成成本、(iii) 释放轨迹质量三者评估。
AI.conclusion: 本文以博弈论视角统一了抗蒸馏的"设计"与"评测"：在给定价值函数后，框架同时给出学生侧的自适应评估协议与教师侧的防御模板，且证明 Stackelberg 最优对存在。用廉价对数似然差代理值导出的 PoE 是一种仅需前向传播、无需梯度的防御，在自适应评测下其与昂贵的 ADS 的鲁棒性差距大幅收窄，同时具备更低生成开销（1.64× vs 2.93×）和更好的推理可审计性（κ=0.76 与人类一致），因此在"泄漏—成本—质量"三维权衡下更具吸引力。核心方法论结论是：抗蒸馏研究应以自适应学生而非被动学生为基准，且任何新防御都应说明其针对何种威胁模型下的何种自适应攻击。局限与未来方向：适应形式被刻意限制为对已释放轨迹的重加权（因此所测泄漏是下界）；价值函数仍为代理近似，PoE 采用 token 级近似而非序列级最优；可扩展到更丰富的自适应攻击、更广的模型/任务族与更强的价值代理，并需与轨迹改写等解码后防御正交结合。作者同时呼吁社区在报告防御时同时披露自适应泄漏、生成成本与轨迹质量。

title: Factored Diffusion Policies:Compositionally Generalized Robot Control with a Single Score Network
summary: Robotic tasks are typically specified by a tuple of factors, such as the object to be grasped, the obstacles to be avoided, the color of the target, and so on. Collecting expert demonstrations for every combination of factor values grows combinatorially. We present factored diffusion policies: a single shared diffusion network trained with per-factor null-token dropout, whose score decomposes additively across factors at inference. Under approximate conditional independence between factors given the action-observation pair, this composition approximates the true joint score with a bounded uniform error, reducing the training-task budget from a product of factor cardinalities to a sum. A trajectory-tube certificate chains this score-level bound through the reverse-time sampling ODE and a contracting tracking controller into a closed-loop state-trajectory tube whose radius factors into an ODE-sensitivity constant and a per-factor score-error budget. Unlike compositional-diffusion methods for control that combine separately trained networks, we use one shared network. Drone racing experiments confirm both the generalization bound and the certificate. On state-based multi-gate racing, the factored policy passes 90% of held-out gates -- matching an oracle -- while a K-network composition baseline collapses to 3%; on vision-based single-gate traversal, it transfers zero-shot to an unseen venue with +11.7pp success-rate gain and 2.4X crash-rate reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"因子化扩散策略"（Factored Diffusion Policies）：用**单个共享**的扩散分数（score）网络配合**逐因子 null-token dropout**训练，使分数在动作空间可加分解 s_comp = s_∅ + Σ_i Δ_i，从而把任务训练预算从因子基数的**乘积**降为**和**，并获得对未见因子组合的组合泛化。理论上给出：(1) 分解误差界 ‖s − s_comp‖ ≤ 2√(GM)（Theorem 1，近似条件独立假设下）；(2) 分解残差 = 因子交互对数比的**动作梯度**（Proposition 1），可仅用前向传播**逐任务实测**、假设可证伪；(3) 闭环**轨迹管证书**（Theorem 2），把分数误差经采样 ODE 敏感性与收缩跟踪控制器串成状态轨迹管半径。无人机竞速实验证实：状态式全赛道设置中因子化策略通过 87% 留出门（26/30，oracle 100%，K-network 基线仅 10%），稀疏（sum-sized）覆盖下 dropout 把留出通过率从 3–16% 提升到 36–50%；视觉式单门任务零样本迁移到未见场地 +11.7pp 成功率、崩溃率降 2.4×。但严格证书半径未达到门半宽，仅可作鲁棒性诊断。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务天然是因子元组 z=(z1,…,zK)（目标位姿、障碍物、环境外观、赛道几何、门开口大小、参考速度、场地、门颜色、进近方向等）。现有做法把任务当作**单体条件输入**，为每个因子组合单独采集专家演示并训练专用策略，数据与工程成本随 ∏|Z_i| 组合爆炸（竞速赛道上每条赛道+门尺寸组合都需人工调参或单独训练，竞赛队伍常需数天到数周）。若无头组合训练，策略在未见组合上完全失效（本文 baseline 留出门通过率仅 10%）。核心观察是：许多任务因子在给定动作-观测对 (a,o) 后**近似条件独立**（如赛道形状决定几何路径、门宽只调速），此时密度的因子化在**分数空间变成加法**，而分数正是扩散策略的可操作对象；且动作点估计（行为克隆）不具备这种可分解性。作者的目标由此是：把乘积级的任务预算降为和级，并在**闭环**控制下把分数误差转化为任务级（过门）保证。
AI.method:
**模型与训练**：单条 1D 时序 ConvNet 去噪器（4.3M 参数），每个因子各有嵌入（Emb(8,64) 赛道、Emb(3,64) 门宽、Emb(3,64) 速度）加**可学习 null token**；训练时以 p_drop=0.1 **独立**将每个因子条件替换为 null token，网络见到全部 2^K 因子子集，从而**钉住**分解的可辨识性（否则 s 与 Δ_i 之间存在常数自由度，Theorem 1 的界无法传递到学到的模型）。推理时组合分数 s_comp = s_∅ + Σ Δ_i（K+1 次前向/去噪步），并与"联合读出"（一次前向同时给全部因子）对比。

**理论**：以交互对数比 g_σ(z,a,o)=log[p_σ(z|a,o)/∏_i p_σ(z_i|a,o)] 度量因子交互；Assumption 1（|g_σ|≤G）与曲率条件（‖∇²g_σ‖_op≤M）经 Taylor 展开+三角不等式给出 Theorem 1 的统一界 2√(GM)；Proposition 1 证明 s−s_comp=∇_a g_σ，故残差 ε_D 可由网络前向传播直接测量（训练任务均值 0.45、留出 1.08），成为可证伪的假设检验量。Lemma 1 给出共享初值下反向概率流 ODE 的 Grönwall 敏感度 C_ode^ana；Lemma 2 将 DDIM 逐步雅可比线性化、用后向 Gramian 递推给出路径依赖 LTV 界 C_ode^LTV（实验中比 Grönwall 紧 5–6 个数量级）。Theorem 2 串接：分数扰动 ε_s ≤ 2√(GM)+(2K−1)η+Σ_i L_i δ_i → 动作误差 ≤ C_ode ε_s → 收缩型级联 ‖e_{t+1}‖≤λ‖e_t‖+B_κ‖Δa‖+w → 状态轨迹管 ‖x_t−x_t^nom‖ ≤ λ^tδ_0 + (B_κ C_ode ε_s+w)/(1−λ)，并特化为"半径 R < 门半宽则必过门"的逐门判据。

**实验**：0.5 kg / 25 cm 竞速级四旋翼（13 状态欠驱动 Newton–Euler、4 输入、600 Hz 仿真），SE(3) 几何控制器 + carrot tracker；扩散输出 32 关键点（位置+速度）插值为 256 路点。设置一（状态式全赛道，K=2：8 赛道 × 3 门宽=24 任务、20 可行）训练 14 个任务、留出 6 个 (赛道,门宽) 组合；设置二（视觉式单门，K=4：场地×门色×门ID×进近侧=120 任务，ResNet-18/320×240 相机+噪声陀螺）。对照包括无因子输入 baseline、因子化（本文）、oracle（见过留出任务）、no-dropout（p_drop=0）网络、K-network 组合基线（PoCo/DSE 式 12 个独立网络求和）。
AI.result:
**主表（状态式全赛道，104 门/20 任务，训练 14 留出 6）**：因子化+组合推理 98/104（94%）、留出 26/30（87%）；oracle 103/104、留出 30/30（100%）；因子化+联合读出与 no-dropout+联合读出均 101/104、留出 29/30（97%）；no-dropout+组合 94/104；K-network 组合 61/104、留出仅 3/30（10%）；无因子输入 baseline 19/104、留出 3/30（10%）。⇒ 增益来自**共享参数+因子 dropout** 的训练机制，而非加法分数本身（K-network 同规则崩溃），也非测试期组合（组合推理从不优于同网络联合读出，因其携带 (2K−1)η 误差）。

**稀疏覆盖（Theorem 1 的关键场景）**：K=2 时 8 个任务的 sum-sized 覆盖（两个不相交覆盖×2 种子）把留出通过率从 3–16% 提升到 36–50%；K=3（加参考速度因子，8/60 覆盖）从 5–11% 提升到 25–32%。这正是 dropout 的收益首次显现处，而 14/20 覆盖属插值区间，两者接近。

**假设失效的受控实验**：向专家速度剖面注入 α·narrowness(z2)·curvature(z1) 非可加项，ε_D 随 α 单调上升（0.45→0.64），组合推理留出通过率从 26 降至 11（α=1.0），而联合读出完全不受影响（恒 101/104）——与理论预期一致。

**证书**：LTV 界比 Grönwall 紧 6 个数量级（如 race3_standard：C_ode^LTV≈4.0 vs C_ode^ana≈8.4e5），但仍比经验放大高 13–170×；残差诊断分解为"非线性流形收缩"（约 5.9×，分数场指回数据流形）与"方向对齐"（约 2×）两部分，属范数分析的固有局限。严格 R_ss 即使按逐组合 ε_s 收紧约 10×，仍无一组合低于门半宽（0/20），故**只作鲁棒性诊断而非部署级任务成功保证**；经验变体 N=50 时 R_ss^emp=0.59 m 可通过标准/宽门。留出组合的 LTV 值对种子脆弱（CV 最高 5.2，出现数百量级爆炸），训练组合则稳健（CV 0.4–0.7）。

**视觉式单门（附录 C，初步性质）**：训练场馆内留出三元组仅 +1.1pp（59.4% vs 58.3%），符合"插值区优势有限"；但对完全未见的 pool 场馆零样本迁移：36.7% vs 25.0%（+11.7pp），崩溃率 15.0% vs 36.7%（2.4× 降低）——注意该结果由**联合条件**（无 dropout）模型取得，且涉及定理覆盖之外的因子取值（OOD）。崩溃率主要受训练时长支配，作者明确说明不应视作方法属性。

**其他**：DINO-v2 ViT-B 替换 ResNet-18 后因子化优势仍保持（Field 留出 60.0%），冻结 cls token 则崩溃，证优势非骨干伪影；视觉任务的证书不闭合（R_ss≈2023 m）。

摘要与正文存在轻微不一致：摘要称留出通过率"90%、与 oracle 持平"，而表 1 与正文为 87%（26/30）vs oracle 100%，K-network 为 10%（3/30）而非 3%。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是三件套：(i) 用**单个共享分数网络 + 逐因子 null-token dropout** 实现可加分解的扩散策略，在近似条件独立下把训练任务需求从 ∏|Z_i| 降到 O(Σ|Z_i|)，并对未见因子组合给出组合泛化；(ii) 一个可检验的残差恒等式（s−s_comp=∇_a g_σ），使"因子近似条件独立"成为可在部署前逐任务证伪的假设而非不可及前提；(iii) 把分数层误差经 ODE 敏感度与收缩控制器串成闭环轨迹管证书。实验的机理分离相当清晰：参数共享与因子 dropout 是泛化来源，加法组合规则本身不是（K-network 基线崩至 10%）；测试期组合推理在数值上从不优于联合读出，其价值在于提供**结构**（可分解的误差预算、可测残差、证书），而非精度——这是本文诚实且重要的定位。局限也明确：全部为仿真、单一机器人域；理论依赖近似条件独立这一实质假设（域本身弱相互作用因子的选取有助益）；严格证书半径无法覆盖任何门半宽，只能作保守诊断，其与经验值之间约 13× 的差距源于非线性流形收缩，需要非范数式、流形感知的敏感度分析；证书无法迁移到图像条件的视觉策略。作者也指出，Factorized 与 joint 两种证书界互不统属优劣，取决于交互强度 G、M 与扰动 δ 与 Lipschitz 主方向的alignments，且 K≥3 时 speed 与 gate size 明显相互影响，提示未来需研究更强的条件独立基准（支撑集、交互式因子、组合泛化中解耦通道设计）以判断方法的普适性。

title: Proxy-Based Approximation of Shapley and Banzhaf Interactions
summary: Shapley and Banzhaf interactions capture the complex dynamics inherent in modern machine learning applications. However, current estimators for these higher-order interactions trade off between speed and accuracy. To overcome this limitation, we introduce ProxySHAP. ProxySHAP reconciles the high sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with a principled path to consistency via residual correction. On a theoretical level, we derive a polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP to compute exact interaction indices for tree ensembles, successfully bypassing exponential tree-depth dependencies in prior methods. Furthermore, we formally analyze the residual adjustment strategy, characterizing the specific conditions under which Maximum Sample Reuse (MSR) corrects proxy bias without its variance scaling exponentially with interaction size. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that ProxySHAP sets a new state-of-the-art standard for approximation quality, including in large-scale applications with thousands of features. By achieving the lowest error in both small- and large-budget regimes, ProxySHAP significantly outperforms the prior best estimators ProxySPEX and KernelSHAP-IQ, while also delivering superior performance on downstream explainability tasks.

AI.tldr: ProxySHAP introduces a novel framework for estimating Shapley and Banzhaf interactions that achieves exact computation for tree ensembles in polynomial time (via interventional TreeSHAP generalization) while maintaining high sample efficiency through residual correction. It establishes new state-of-the-art accuracy across all computational budgets, outperforming ProxySPEX and KernelSHAP-IQ.
AI.motivation: Current estimators for higher-order Shapley and Banzhaf interactions face a trade-off between speed and accuracy, limiting their practical applicability in complex machine learning systems.
AI.method: ProxySHAP combines high sample efficiency of tree-based proxy models with a residual correction strategy. The paper derives a polynomial-time generalization of interventional TreeSHAP for exact interaction indices on tree ensembles, bypassing exponential tree-depth dependencies. The residual adjustment strategy is formally analyzed to characterize when Maximum Sample Reuse (MSR) corrects proxy bias without exponential variance scaling.
AI.result: ProxySHAP significantly outperforms prior best estimators (ProxySPEX and KernelSHAP-IQ) in both small- and large-budget regimes, achieving the lowest approximation error. Superior performance is also demonstrated on downstream explainability tasks.
AI.conclusion: ProxySHAP sets a new state-of-the-art for interaction estimation, achieving the lowest error across all budget regimes while maintaining practical applicability to large-scale problems.

title: Cyber-Physical Anomaly Detection in IoT-Enabled Smart Grids Using Machine Learning and Metaheuristic Feature Optimization
summary: Modern smart grids rely on dense measurement infrastructures, communication links, and intelligent field devices. Although this improves supervision and control, it also increases vulnerability to cyber-physical disruptions. Operators must distinguish physical incidents, such as faults or line disturbances, from malicious actions, such as false data injection or unauthorized command execution. This chapter investigates this problem using the well-known MSU/ORNL Power System Attack Dataset. The proposed method combines machine learning with genetic-algorithm-based feature selection. The objective is twofold: to classify attack and natural events accurately, and to determine whether a reduced set of physically informative PMU/IED measurements can support reliable detection. Several baseline models are evaluated, including logistic regression, RBF-SVM, XGBoost, Random Forest, and Extra Trees. The results show that tree-based ensemble models are the most effective for the considered dataset, with Extra Trees providing the strongest full-feature baseline. After feature selection, the GA + Extra Trees model reduces the clean PMU feature space from 112 attributes to an average of 27.4 attributes over five runs, while increasing macro-F1 from 0.9118 to 0.9212 and ROC-AUC from 0.9791 to 0.9837. These results indicate that many synchronized electrical measurements are redundant. A compact subset of phasor-based features can still provide accurate and interpretable anomaly detection in smart grids.

AI.tldr: 本章在 MSU/ORNL 电力系统攻击数据集上提出「遗传算法特征选择 + Extra Trees」的智能电网信息物理异常检测框架：将 112 维"纯净 PMU/IED 测量"特征压缩到平均 27.4 维（约减少 75.5%），同时宏平均 F1 从 0.9118 提升至 0.9212、ROC-AUC 从 0.9791 提升至 0.9837，证明大量同步电气量测存在冗余，仅靠相量量测即可实现高精度、可解释的攻击与自然事件二分类。
AI.motivation: 智能电网引入 PMU、IED、智能电表与 IoT 层后，可观测性与控制能力增强，但也带来虚假数据注入（FDIA）、命令注入/继电保护篡改等网络物理攻击风险；运维人员必须区分物理故障/自然扰动与恶意攻击。现有 AI 检测方法存在三方面问题：(1) 多数模型使用全部量测，特征冗余导致计算与通信开销高，难以部署到边缘网关、变电站与 IoT 设备；(2) 高精度模型可解释性不足，关键基础设施需要可解释决策依据；(3) 集中式处理带来时延与隐私风险。此外，还需防止分类器依赖"捷径"特征（如控制面板日志、Snort 告警、继电器状态标志等直接事件指示器）而非学习物理机理模式。因此本文目标有二：准确完成"攻击 vs 自然事件"二分类，并验证一组精简、物理可解释的 PMU/IED 量测是否足以支撑可靠检测。
AI.method: 数据集：MSU/ORNL Power System Attack Dataset（2 台发电机、4 个 IED+PMU、4 个断路器、2 回输电线的网络物理试验台），Attack/Natural 二分类共 78,377 条样本（攻击 55,663，自然 22,714，严重不平衡），原始 128 个输入属性（前 116 个为 PMU/IED 量测，末 12 个为控制面板/继电器/Snort 日志）。特征集三种：all(128)、pmu_only(116)、pmu_without_status(112，进一步剔除 4 个继电器状态标志)。预处理：无穷值置为缺失并用训练集median插补（因视在阻抗在电流极小时可能数值无穷），分层划分 70%/15%/15% 训练/验证/测试；评估指标包括准确率、平衡准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、macro-F1、ROC-AUC。基线模型：逻辑回归、RBF-SVM、XGBoost（默认与调参）、Random Forest、Extra Trees。GA 特征选择：以二进制掩码 z∈{0,1}^d 表示特征子集，适应度 J(z)=α·(1−MacroF1(z))+(1−α)·‖z‖₀/d，α=0.95，即在保证 macro-F1 的同时压缩特征数；随机初始化种群（保证最少特征数）、锦标赛选择、交叉、变异、精英保留；用 Extra Trees（辅以 Random Forest）作为评估分类器，验证集计算 macro-F1，最终最优掩码在完整训练集重训并在测试集评估。GA 以 5 个不同随机种子独立运行以检验稳定性。
AI.result: 基线结果：逻辑回归最差（macro-F1 0.5802/0.5722），RBF-SVM 有所改善但仍低（0.6093），XGBoost 调参后提升至 0.7955，仍不及树集成；Random Forest 最优基线 macro-F1 0.8959，Extra Trees 最强（pmu_only 116 维 macro-F1 0.9134、Acc 0.9312）。消融实验显示：去掉全部日志属性后性能不降反微升，再去掉继电器状态标志（112 维）后 Extra Trees macro-F1 仍达 0.9118，说明分类主要依赖物理量测而非直接事件指示器。GA + Extra Trees 结果：5 次运行分别选出 26、30、25、28、28 个特征，平均 27.4（标准差 1.95），较 112 维减少约 75.5%；测试集平均 Acc 0.9371、Bal Acc 0.9085、F1 0.9566、macro-F1 0.9212（0.9212 vs 0.9118）、ROC-AUC 0.9837（vs 0.9791），标准差极小（macro-F1 0.0020，ROC-AUC 0.0009），表明压缩模型同时提升泛化能力。选中的特征覆盖全部四个 PMU/IED 位置，包含相电压幅值、相电流幅值、相角、序分量、频率及频率变化率、视在阻抗及其角度等，且不含任何日志或继电器状态标志，具备明确的电力系统物理解释性。
AI.conclusion: 结论：树集成（尤以 Extra Trees）比线性、核方法与所测 boosting 更适合 MSU/ORNL 二分类任务；仅凭 PMU/IED 电气量测即可高精度区分攻击与自然事件，剔除日志与继电器状态标志不损害性能；GA 特征选择在约 75.5% 维度压缩下反而提升了 macro-F1 与 ROC-AUC，说明大量同步量测冗余，模型可在检测质量、紧凑性与可解释性之间取得良好折中，从而更适合边缘网关、变电站与 IoT 能源基础设施的低开销部署。讨论部分提出结合 SHAP 的全局/局部可解释性分析、边缘—中心协同的部署流程（本地计算特征子集与轻量检测器，中心运行强模型与 XAI 模块）以及联邦学习的隐私保护方案。局限与展望：基准数据集为仿真/实验环境、真实电网数据受安全隐私法规限制、攻击会演化而监督模型针对固定攻击类型训练；未来方向包括三分类/多分类扩展、引入电网拓扑的图神经网络、物理信息损失函数、联邦学习、对抗鲁棒性与在线/持续学习，以及与最优潮流、需求响应联动。

title: Benchmarking Machine Learning Architectures for Antimicrobial Stewardship in Pediatric ICUs
summary: Antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) is critical in pediatric intensive care units (PICUs), where diagnostic uncertainty often drives broad-spectrum antibiotic use, increasing antimicrobial resistance and potential long-term harms. Machine learning offers a promising approach for identifying patient-level opportunities for stewardship interventions from electronic health record data, yet prior work has focused largely on adult populations and static tabular representations. We present a systematic benchmarking study of AMS intervention prediction in the PICU across a public dataset and a private institutional cohort. We define four clinically relevant proxy targets for reducing antibiotic exposure: intravenous-to-oral switching, de-escalation, discontinuation, and short-course therapy. Under a unified evaluation framework, we compare tabular, sequence-based, and graph-based temporal models at multiple temporal resolutions. We find that predictive performance is driven primarily by target prevalence and dataset characteristics rather than model complexity. Sequence models improve the precision-recall trade-off over tabular approaches at coarse (24-hour) resolution, while finer temporal modeling provides limited additional benefit. However, these gains come at the cost of poorer calibration, with simpler tabular models yielding more reliable probability estimates. Multi-task learning produces only marginal improvements, suggesting limited shared structure across stewardship targets. Our findings highlight the importance of target design, temporal representation, and calibration in clinical machine learning, and provide practical guidance for developing reliable decision support systems for pediatric AMS.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在儿童重症监护病房（PICU）抗菌药物管理（AMS）干预预测上开展系统性基准研究：在公共 PIC 数据集与苏黎世大学儿童医院私有 MELODY-KISPI 两个队列上，定义四个代理目标（IV转口服、降阶梯、停药、短疗程），统一比较表格型、序列型、图型时序模型及多种时间分辨率。结论是性能主要由目标患病率与数据特性而非模型复杂度决定；24 小时分辨率下序列模型在 AUPRC/F1 上优于表格模型，但更细粒度时间表示增益有限且以更差的校准为代价；多任务学习几乎无收益。
AI.motivation: 抗菌药物管理（AMS）对减少 PICU 中不必要的广谱抗生素暴露至关重要，但成人 ICU 的既有证据与模型难以直接迁移到儿科：PICU 患儿年龄小、静脉给药占比高（85–98%）、静脉转口服（IV-to-oral）极罕见（仅 0.34%–0.98%），且既往 AMS 干预预测研究多集中于成人、多为静态表格表示，目标定义单一或被合并为单一二分类结局。此外，临床 ML 实践中模型选择往往凭惯例而非证据，时序表示的影响、AUROC 与 AUPRC 的脱节、校准可靠性等关键问题均缺乏系统评估，因此本文在 PICU 场景下同时考察目标构建、时间表示与模型架构三者的影响。
AI.method: 任务形式化为患者-日（patient-day）分类：在每个抗生素治疗日固定时点（默认 08:00）仅用该时点前信息，预测未来 24 小时内是否发生 AMS 干预，特征统一取自 37 个临床变量（人口学、入院背景、生命体征、实验室、抗生素暴露），最终 194 维表格特征。数据：公开 PIC（PhysioNet，浙江大学儿童医院，2010–2018，5,671 次入院/5,515 名患儿，79,831 患者-日）与私有 MELODY-KISPI（苏黎世大学儿童医院，2015–2023，2,789 次入院/2,059 名患儿，18,148 患者-日），抗生素按 ATC 统一映射、24 小时内合并为疗程。四个代理目标：IV-to-oral（疗程内静脉转非静脉）、de-escalation（ASI 严格下降）、discontinuation（停药且距出院≥72 小时无后续抗生素）、short-course（疗程 24–96 小时，排除预防用头孢唑林）；降阶梯严格按谱系（ASI）而非药物数量定义。模型三类：表格型（逻辑回归、LightGBM、MLP、预训练 TabPFN）、序列型（GRU/LSTM/TCN/Transformer/Mamba 风格 SSM、预训练 CLMBR-T-Base）、图型时序（RAINDROP，处理不规则采样）；时间表示为 24 小时聚合、24 小时+1 小时事件栅格（EventGridEncoder CNN 联合学习嵌入后融合）、以及保留原生不规则采样的表示。评估：按患者划分 70/10/20 划分、测试集提前封存、3 个随机种子、F1 阈值在验证集优化；指标含 AUROC、AUPRC、F1@0.5 与阈值优化 F1，并做校准分析、MTL（硬共享/不确定性加权/MMoE+PCGrad）、拆分策略与聚类 bootstrap 敏感性分析、多任务、1h 编码器消融。
AI.result: 1) 与成人结果对比：PICU 中 IV-to-oral 患病率 0.3–1.0%（成人约 3.0%）、停药 1.7–5.7%（成人 9%），虽可达高 AUROC（如降阶梯 0.93），但罕见目标的 AUPRC/F1 极低，说明 AUROC 会高估性能，成人模型不可直接迁移。2) 24 小时分辨率下序列模型 AUROC 与表格模型相近（0.85–0.95），但 AUPRC 与阈值优化 F1 明显更优：PIC 降阶梯 F1 由表格组 0.33 提升至序列组 0.51，短疗程由 0.24 提升至 0.32，MELODY-KISPI 呈同向较小增益。3) 细化到 1 小时分辨率仅带来约 0.01–0.03 的 F1/AUPRC 提升；CNN 可学习编码优于线性投影与直接小时建模，但表格模型加时间嵌入仍不及序列模型；RAINDROP 与表格模型相当或更差，提示不规则采样的图表示在这些任务上反而干扰预测。4) 校准：LightGBM 等表格模型校准最佳，序列模型系统性过度自信，且提高时间分辨率并不改善校准，构成“判别力—可靠性”权衡（对罕见目标所有模型校准均不稳定）。5) MTL 仅有边际收益（因目标重叠少、层次关系与标签质量差异），支持按任务单独建模。6) 预训练模型迁移性差：TabPFN 在更细时间实验中被剔除，CLMBR-T-Base（成人 EHR 预训练）在各目标上明显落后（降阶梯 AUPRC 0.07–0.09），说明成人预训练表征难以直接迁移至儿科。7) 拆分策略：患者-时间拆分性能一致低于患者随机拆分，随机拆分偏乐观；朴素与住院级聚类 bootstrap 置信区间几乎相同，住院内相关性对不确定性影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 在 PICU 的 AMS 干预预测中，标签设计与目标患病率对性能的影响大于模型架构复杂度；24 小时聚合特征已包含大部分预测信号，显式纵向建模（序列模型）在 24 小时分辨率下能改善精确率-召回率权衡，而更细时间分辨率与图型不规则建模收益有限甚至为负；序列模型以更差的概率校准为代价，部署前需显式后验校准（可考虑贝叶斯/集成/共形预测）。实践建议：以仪表盘形式每日输出风险预测辅助 AMS 复核排序，LightGBM 在判别力、校准与可解释性上综合最优；当目标常见、需最大化筛出率且疗程较长时可选用经校准的 GRU。局限与展望：标签为回顾性代理事件而非经裁定的前瞻性 AMS 意图，需儿科感染病与 PICU 临床专家基于病历记录验证临床有效性，随后开展前瞻性评估；尚需研究不确定性感知方法、GRU-D 等缺失感知时序模型，以及更合适的缺失插补策略。总体结论是——目标定义、时间表示与校准与模型选择同等重要，仅增加模型复杂度不足以构建可靠的临床决策支持系统。

title: Evolutionary Multi-Task Optimization for LLM-Guided Program Discovery
summary: Recent LLM-guided evolutionary search methods have shown that iterative program mutation can discover strong algorithms, but they typically optimize each task independently, even when related tasks share reusable structure. We introduce Evolutionary Multi-Task Optimization (EMO) for LLM-guided program discovery, and propose EMO-STA (Shared-Then-Adapt), a two-stage framework that first evolves a shared archive of executable programs across a task family and then adapts selected shared candidates to each target task. Within EMO-STA, we explore multiple adaptation strategies, including warm-starting from the shared archive, adapting the best average shared program, and adapting the shared program that performs best on each target task. Across eight task families spanning continuous optimization, geometric construction, modeling, and algorithmic optimization, EMO-STA improves over matched-compute single-task evolution in most settings, with STA Best-Local providing the strongest in-distribution adaptation and STA Best-Shared yielding robust transfer to unseen tasks. Compute-allocation experiments show that allocating a substantial fraction of the family-level budget to shared evolution is consistently beneficial, with roughly balanced shared and adaptation budgets often being optimal. Beyond compute efficiency, we show that shared evolution can mitigate overfitting in low-evidence settings (e.g. few training data), including ARC tasks and time-series feature engineering, by favoring programs that generalize across all tasks rather than exploiting task-specific brittle artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMO-STA框架，通过两阶段（共享进化+任务适应）将多任务优化引入LLM引导的程序发现，在8个任务家族上验证了其在计算效率和泛化能力上的优势，特别是在低证据场景下可有效缓解过拟合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索方法虽能发现强算法，但通常独立优化每个任务，未能利用相关任务间的可复用结构，导致计算效率低下且泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出EMO-STA框架，包含两个阶段：(1)Shared阶段：在任务家族层面共享进化程序存档；(2)Adaptation阶段：探索多种适应策略——Warm-Start、STA Best-Average、STA Best-Local、STA Best-Shared。在8个任务家族上验证，覆盖连续优化、几何构造、建模和算法优化领域。
AI.result: 在大多数设置中EMO-STA优于匹配计算的单任务进化；STA Best-Local提供最强的分布内适应性能，STA Best-Shared对未见任务具有稳健迁移能力；共享进化在低证据场景（如ARC任务、时间序列特征工程）中可缓解过拟合。
AI.conclusion: EMO-STA通过两阶段框架在多任务场景下实现高效的程序进化，在8个任务家族上优于单任务进化，且共享进化有助于缓解低证据场景下的过拟合问题。

title: CogAdapt: Transferring Clinical ECG Foundation Models to Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment via Lead Adaptation
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026)
summary: Real-time cognitive load assessment is essential for adaptive human-computer interaction but remains challenging due to limited labeled data and poor cross-subject generalization. Recent ECG foundation models pre-trained on millions of clinical recordings offer rich representations, but cannot be directly applied to wearable devices due to sensor configuration mismatch and task differences. In this paper, we propose CogAdapt, a framework that adapts clinical ECG foundation models to wearable cognitive load assessment. CogAdapt introduces LeadBridge, a learnable adapter that transforms 3-lead wearable signals into anatomically consistent 12-lead representations, and ProFine, a progressive fine-tuning strategy that gradually unfreezes encoder layers while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Evaluations on two public datasets (CLARE and CL-Drive) under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation show that CogAdapt substantially outperforms baselines trained from scratch, achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.626 and 0.768. These results demonstrate the promise of foundation model adaptation for subject-independent cognitive load assessment from wearable sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CogAdapt框架，通过LeadBridge适配器和ProFine渐进式微调策略，将临床ECG基础模型成功迁移至可穿戴设备认知负荷评估任务，解决了传感器配置不匹配和跨被试泛化的挑战。
AI.motivation: 实时认知负荷评估对于自适应人机交互至关重要，但面临标注数据有限和跨被试泛化能力差等挑战。临床ECG基础模型虽在大规模临床数据上预训练表现良好，但由于传感器配置不匹配和任务差异，无法直接应用于可穿戴设备。
AI.method: 该方法包含两个核心组件：1) LeadBridge，一个可学习的适配器，将3导联可穿戴信号转换为解剖学上一致的12导联表示；2) ProFine，一种渐进式微调策略，逐步解冻编码器层同时防止灾难性遗忘。在CLARE和CL-Drive两个公共数据集上采用留一被试交叉验证进行评估。
AI.result: CogAdapt在两个数据集上均显著超越从头训练的基线模型，分别达到0.626和0.768的宏F1分数。
AI.conclusion: CogAdapt通过将临床ECG基础模型适配到可穿戴设备，实现了对认知负荷的跨被试评估，在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集上分别取得了0.626和0.768的宏F1分数，显著优于从头训练的基线模型，证明了基础模型适配在可穿戴传感器认知负荷评估中的潜力。

title: A note on convergence of Wasserstein policy optimization
summary: Wasserstein Policy Optimization (WPO) is a recently proposed reinforcement learning algorithm that leverages Wasserstein gradient flows to optimize stochastic policies in continuous action spaces. Despite its empirical success, the theoretical convergence properties of WPO in environments with continuous state and action spaces have yet to be fully established. In this note, we argue that WPO within the framework of entropy-regularised Markov Decision Processes converges linearly. This is done by leveraging recent advances in mean-field analysis for convergence of gradient flows using log-Sobole inequalities. Assuming existence of sufficiently regular solution to the gradient flow equation we demonstrate monotonic energy dissipation along the flow and establish a local log-Sobolev inequality. Ultimately, these properties allow us to argue that the value function should converge linearly to the global optimum.

AI.tldr: This paper provides theoretical convergence guarantees for Wasserstein Policy Optimization (WPO) in entropy-regularized Markov Decision Processes, demonstrating that WPO achieves linear convergence to the global optimum. The analysis relies on mean-field techniques and log-Sobolev inequalities, establishing monotonic energy dissipation and a local log-Sobolev inequality along the gradient flow.
AI.motivation: The theoretical convergence properties of Wasserstein Policy Optimization in continuous action spaces had not been fully established, despite its empirical success
AI.method: Uses log-Sobolev inequalities and mean-field analysis for gradient flow convergence; establishes monotonic energy dissipation along the flow and local log-Sobolev inequality under the assumption of sufficiently regular solution to the gradient flow equation
AI.result: Linear convergence of WPO to the global optimum in entropy-regularized MDPs
AI.conclusion: WPO converges linearly to the global optimum of the value function

title: MambaGaze: Bidirectional Mamba with Explicit Missing Data Modeling for Cognitive Load Assessment from Eye-Gaze Tracking Data
comment: Submitted to IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI 2026)
summary: Real-time cognitive load assessment from eye-tracking signals could potentially enable adaptive human-centered-AI such as safety-critical applications such as driver vigilance monitoring or automated flight deck assistance, yet two challenges persist: handling frequent data missingness from blinks and tracking failures, and efficiently modeling long-range temporal dependencies. We propose MambaGaze, a framework that addresses these challenges through 1) XMD encoding, which augments raw features with observation masks and time-deltas to explicitly model data uncertainty, and 2) bidirectional Mamba-2, which captures temporal dependencies with linear computational complexity. Experiments on CLARE and CL-Drive datasets under leave-one-subject-out evaluation show that MambaGaze achieves 76.8% and 73.1% accuracy, respectively, outperforming CNN, Transformer, ResNet, and VGG baselines by 4-12 percentage points. Edge deployment benchmarks on NVIDIA Jetson platforms demonstrate real-time inference at 43-68 FPS with power consumption below 7.5W, confirming feasibility for wearable cognitive load monitoring.

AI.tldr: MambaGaze是一个用于眼动信号实时认知负荷评估的深度学习框架，通过XMD编码处理数据缺失问题，结合双向Mamba-2架构高效建模时间依赖，在两个数据集上显著优于CNN、Transformer等基线方法，并具备边缘设备实时部署能力。
AI.motivation: 实时认知负荷评估在安全关键应用中具有重要价值，但面临两个核心挑战：1) 眨眼和追踪失败导致的数据频繁缺失；2) 长程时间依赖的高效建模。
AI.method: MambaGaze采用双模块设计：1) XMD编码，通过观察掩码和时间差分增强原始特征以显式建模数据不确定性；2) 双向Mamba-2架构，以线性计算复杂度捕获长程时间依赖关系。
AI.result: 在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集的留一被试评估中，MambaGaze分别达到76.8%和73.1%的准确率，较CNN、Transformer、ResNet和VGG基线模型提升4-12个百分点。NVIDIA Jetson平台边缘部署测试实现43-68 FPS推理速度，功耗低于7.5W。
AI.conclusion: MambaGaze框架通过XMD编码和双向Mamba-2架构，在认知负荷评估任务上实现了最优性能，同时满足边缘部署的实时性要求，为可穿戴认知负荷监测应用提供了可行的技术方案。

title: SDPM: Survival Diffusion Probabilistic Model for Continuous-Time Survival Analysis
summary: Survival analysis aims to estimate a time-to-event distribution from data with censored observations. Many existing methods either impose structural assumptions on the hazard function or discretize the time axis, which may limit flexibility and introduce approximation errors. We propose the Survival Diffusion Probabilistic Model (SDPM), a generative approach to continuous-time survival analysis. SDPM models the conditional distribution of the survival outcome, represented by the pair of observed time and censoring indicator, $\mathbb{P}(T,δ\mid \mathbf{x})$, using a denoising diffusion model.
