Under the assumption of conditionally independent censoring, conditional samples generated by the model can be transformed into survival function estimates using the Kaplan-Meier estimator. This formulation avoids parametric assumptions on the event-time distribution and does not require a discretization of the output time space. The model operates in a transformed target space, using standardized log-times and a continuous Gaussian-mixture representation of the censoring indicator. We evaluate SDPM on ten real survival datasets and compare it with five strong baselines, including tree-based, boosting-based, and neural survival models. Results show that SDPM achieves competitive predictive performance across C-index, integrated time-dependent AUC, and integrated Brier score. A study on synthetic Cox-Weibull data demonstrates that SDPM can recover the shape of an underlying continuous survival distribution more accurately than a strong nonparametric baseline when sufficiently many samples are generated. An ablation study confirms the importance of the proposed target-space transformations, which improve event-rate calibration, reduce invalid generated times, and provide consistent gains in predictive discrimination. Codes implementing the proposed model are publicly available.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes SDPM, a diffusion probabilistic model for continuous-time survival analysis that avoids parametric assumptions and time discretization. It achieves competitive performance on multiple benchmarks and accurately recovers underlying survival distributions.
AI.motivation: Traditional survival analysis methods either impose structural assumptions on the hazard function or discretize the time axis, which limits flexibility and introduces approximation errors. There is a need for methods that avoid parametric assumptions and don't require time discretization.
AI.method: SDPM employs a denoising diffusion model to learn the conditional distribution P(T,δ|x) for survival outcomes. The model operates in a transformed target space using standardized log-times and continuous Gaussian-mixture representation of censoring indicators. Generated samples are converted to survival function estimates via Kaplan-Meier estimator under conditionally independent censoring assumption.
AI.result: SDPM achieves competitive predictive performance across C-index, integrated time-dependent AUC, and integrated Brier score on 10 real survival datasets compared to 5 strong baselines. On synthetic Cox-Weibull data, it recovers continuous survival distributions more accurately than nonparametric baselines. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed target-space transformations improve event-rate calibration, reduce invalid generated times, and provide consistent gains in predictive discrimination.
AI.conclusion: SDPM provides a flexible generative approach for continuous-time survival analysis, with target-space transformations being crucial for good performance. The method offers a promising alternative to traditional and neural survival models, particularly when accurate recovery of continuous survival distributions is needed.

title: Why SGD is not Brownian Motion: A New Perspective on Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is commonly modeled as a Langevin process, assuming that minibatch noise acts as Brownian motion. However, this approximation relies on a continuous-time limit and a sqrt(eta) noise scaling that does not match the discrete SGD update at finite learning rate. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of SGD as deterministic dynamics in a fluctuating loss landscape induced by minibatch sampling. Starting directly from the discrete update, we derive a master equation for the parameter distribution and obtain a discrete Fokker--Planck equation that differs from the standard Langevin form at order eta^2. Using this framework, we analyze SGD dynamics near critical points of the loss. We show that the behavior decomposes along the eigenbasis of the mean Hessian into qualitatively distinct regimes. In particular, nearly-flat directions do not admit a stationary distribution: the variance grows over time, corresponding to effective diffusion along valleys with a coefficient proportional to the learning rate. We provide empirical evidence supporting these predictions on neural network models in computer vision and natural language processing, observing a clear qualitative separation between confined and diffusive modes.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，把 SGD 视为朗之万/布朗运动只是在连续时间极限下的近似；在有限学习率下，标准 Langevin 截断遗漏了与扩散项同阶（O(η²)）的项，会给出定性错误结论。作者直接从离散更新式出发，导出精确的主方程与离散 Fokker–Planck 方程，发现其中必然含有 (∇L̄)² 修正项（可用修正朗之万模型 dθ = −∇L̄ dt − √(η(D+(∇L̄)²)) dW 复现）。进一步在临界点邻域用二次近似分析协方差，得到平均 Hessian 特征基下显式方差公式：尖锐方向方差饱和于 ≈ηγ/2（与曲率无关，逆方差–平坦关系），近乎平坦方向无稳态分布、方差随时间线性增长（有效扩散系数 ∝η），即 SGD 动力学分解为“受限模式”与“扩散模式”。实验在 MLP-386/MNIST、NanoGPT/Shakespeare（稠密 Hessian）与 NanoGPT 6.6M/WikiText-2（随机 Lanczos，N=50 轨迹，η∈{0.001,0.005,0.01}）上验证：平台值与 λ_i 几乎无关且随 η 线性（R²=0.90）；η=0.01 时标准 Langevin 低估平台约 23%，而完整公式落在 90% bootstrap 置信区间内。
AI.motivation: 统计物理视角把 SGD 视为 Langevin 过程（Mandt et al. 2017; Simsekli et al. 2019），将小批量梯度噪声当作布朗涨落，并引入 √η 噪声标度以获得非平凡的连续时间极限与 Gibbs 稳态。但这一构造并不与离散 SGD 更新一致：真实更新中随机性通过小批量损失本身进入，量级为 O(η) 而非 O(√η)。同时它依赖高斯梯度噪声与稳态存在等假设，在深度学习实践中往往不成立；已有工作指出噪声的重尾/各向异性（Jastrzębski 2018; Zhu 2018）、非高斯波动（Yaida 2020）以及 Feng & Tu 的逆方差–平坦关系均难以被经典 Langevin 框架统一解释。作者的目标是：放弃连续时间近似与现象学噪声模型，从第一性原理重新推导 SGD 的分布演化方程，并在有限学习率下给出与实验一致的统一动力学图景。
AI.method:
1) 主方程：取有放回（with replacement）采样，SGD 更新 w_{n+1}=w_n−η∇L_n(w_n) 诱导精确主方程 p_{n+1}(w)=∫p_n(v)E_L[δ(w−v+η∇L(v))]dv；用傅里叶表示展开 δ 与指数，得到精确离散恒等式 p_{n+1}(w)=Σ_m η^m/m! ∇^m(E_L[∇^m L(w)] p_n(w))，截断至 O(η²) 给出离散 Fokker–Planck 方程（命题1），其扩散项仅含梯度二阶矩。
2) 与 Langevin 对照（命题2）：一维情形下用矩条件 E[∇L]=∇L̄、E[(∇L)²]=D+(∇L̄)²，得离散展开比标准 Langevin 多出 (η²/2)∇²((∇L̄)²p) 项；由于 Langevin 保留的扩散项本身已是 O(η²)，该截断不自洽。给出修正朗之万模型可复现二阶结果；玩具模型 L=L₀+Gθ+½Hθ²（G~N(0,d)，E[H]=λ，E[H²]=λ²+Γ）显示离散 SGD 的稳态条件为 ηΓ<λ(2−ηλ)、极限方差 ηd/[λ(2−ηλ)−ηΓ]，而标准 Langevin 给出 ηΓ<2λ 与 ηd/(2λ−ηΓ)；在 λ−ηλ²<ηΓ<2λ 区间，前者预言方差指数发散而后者预言有限稳态，属定性差异。
3) 临界点邻域分析：在 v（∇L̄(v)=0）处对 L 做二次展开，得到均值与协方差的闭合递推；转到平均 Hessian 特征基（λ_i, O），在独立性、近似对角性、ηλ_max<1、E[G_iG_j]≈γ(E[H_ij]+ε) 等假设下解出显式方差公式（命题3，附录B）：Π̃_ii^n = ηγ[1−(1−2ηλ_i+η²E[H̃_ii²])^n]·(λ_i+ε)/(2λ_i−ηE[H̃_ii²])。推论1：λ_i≈0 时 Π̃_ii^n≈γη²n(λ_i+ε) 线性增长（无稳态）；尖锐方向 |1−2ηλ_i+η²E[H̃_ii²]|<1 时方差饱和至 ≈ηγ/2；中间方向插值。附录还给出 E[G_iG_j]∝E[H_ij] 的一个机制性解释（Φ(Σb_i(w_i−v_i)) 型损失展开）。
4) 实验：MLP-386/MNIST 与 NanoGPT/Shakespeare（稠密 Hessian，1000 条轨迹）验证结构假设（特征基近对角、饱和/扩散分离）与理论-实测方差轮廓的定性一致；NanoGPT 6.6M/WikiText-2 用随机 Lanczos（top-20 特征方向，HVP 平均 5 个大小为 4 的小批量）、N=50 条独立 SGD 轨迹、η∈{0.001,0.005,0.01}（T=500/1000 步），单一 γ̂=1.81×10⁻⁴ 由 η=0.001 标定后不再重拟合，检验平台值与 λ_i 无关性、η 线性性，并对比标准 Langevin 预测；另做有/无放回采样对照与离散高斯代理基线。
AI.result: 理论层面：（i）建立了从离散更新严格导出的离散 Fokker–Planck 框架，明确了 O(η²) 阶的有限步长修正项及其与保留扩散项同阶的事实，说明 Langevin 截断在有限 η 下不自洽，但并不与 η→0 的连续时间扩散极限矛盾；（ii）给出修正朗之万模型可在二阶内复现离散结果；（iii）明确了方差动力学在平均 Hessian 特征基下的显式表达式与两类定性不同的动力学模式：曲率为正且足够尖锐的方向被“受限”（方差趋于有限平台 ≈ηγ/2，与 λ_i 基本无关，从而统一解释了 Feng–Tu 的逆方差–平坦关系），近乎平坦方向保持非稳态、方差随时间近似线性增长，单条轨迹发散，扩散系数 ∝η，且累积效应显著；（iv）实验上，MLP/NanoGPT 小模型的实测方差轮廓与理论曲线在结构上一致（Hessian 特征基中协方差近对角、γ 跨种子稳定）；6.6M 模型中平台值与 λ_i 近似无关且随 η 线性（理论直线 R²=0.90），η=0.01 时标准 Langevin 低估平台约 23%（η=0.001 时两模型相差 <3%），而含 −ηE[H̃²_ii] 修正的完整公式在三个学习率下均落入 90% bootstrap 置信区间、中位相对误差 <10%；无放回采样显著抑制集合方差并引入时间相关性，说明采样规则是概率模型的一部分。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：SGD 更适合被理解为“涨落损失景观中的确定性动力学”而非“固定势场中的布朗运动”，在有限学习率下二者给出定性不同的结论。框架统一了若干经验现象：尖锐方向方差饱和、近乎平坦方向持续扩散、平台宽度与曲率几乎无关（逆方差–平坦关系），并揭示标准 Langevin 近似在有限 η 下的失效区间。作者明确列出局限：仅用局部二次近似且仅分析临界点邻域；假设特征基中 Hessian 涨落近对角与独立（仅经验支持）；理论限于有放回采样，与标准按 epoch 训练不同；γ 等常数不可由理论确定，比较多为结构性；大尺度实验只能通过 Hessian-向量积/Lanczos 探测尖锐方向，无法直接验证扩散区；复现性受实验管线与随机性影响。后续方向为推广到非局部动力学、放宽结构性假设、完善大规模验证。

title: ChronoVAE-HOPE: Beyond Attention -- A Next-Generation VAE Foundation Model for Specialized Time Series Classification
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have become a new component of the state-of-the-art in general time series forecasting. However, adapting them to specialized classification tasks remains constrained by two interconnected challenges: the quadratic cost of standard attention mechanisms and the inability to disentangle the structural components underlying time series variability. This technical report introduces ChronoVAE-HOPE, a next-generation TSFM that reconciles massive generalization with structured latent representation for time series classification. The core of the proposal is a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) framework built upon the HOPE Block, which replaces quadratic attention with a dual-memory system: Titans modules for dynamic short-term retention and a Continuum Memory System (CMS) for the abstraction of long-term historical context. A key architectural novelty is the disentangled latent space, which factorizes representations into independent trend and seasonal components via dedicated encoder heads and separate decoder pathways. ChronoVAE-HOPE undergoes self-supervised pre-training on the Monash archive, combining a Masked Time Series Modeling (MTSM) auxiliary objective with a disentangled VAE reconstruction loss. The pre-trained encoder is subsequently frozen and used to generate fixed-length embeddings for downstream classification on the UCR benchmark datasets. Empirical results demonstrate strong performance across diverse temporal domains, particularly in settings characterized by strict causal structure. ChronoVAE-HOPE establishes a robust and interpretable framework for the adaptation of foundation models to time series classification through structured generative representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChronoVAE-HOPE：一种面向时序分类的基础模型。其编码器用 HOPE Block（Titans 快速权重 + Continuum Memory System 多级记忆）替代二次复杂度的自注意力，实现线性复杂度；中间瓶颈采用解耦 VAE，把潜空间显式分解为「趋势」与「季节」两个正交子空间，分别配独立编码头与独立解码器，并以移动平均分解信号（SeriesDecomp）作为重建监督。在 Monash（m4_hourly/weather/electricity/tourism 等 5 个数据集）上以「解耦 VAE 重建损失 + KL + 掩码时序建模（MTSM，20% 掩码）」复合自监督目标预训练，随后冻结编码器、取后验均值拼接得到定长嵌入 [μ_t‖μ_s]，仅训练轻量分类头（LayerNorm+MLP+Dropout）在 UCR BakeOff 上评测。全量 86 数据集平均准确率 61.1%（F1 0.583）；在「类别数<8 且序列长度<400」的过滤子集上平均准确率 76.52%（F1 0.741），SPECTRO 最高 85.30%，MOTION 最低 66.31%。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TSFM）在预测上已取得进展，但迁移到分类任务仍受两个彼此关联的瓶颈制约：(1) 计算瓶颈——标准自注意力对序列长度呈二次增长，限制了单次前向可经济编码的历史上下文；(2) 表征瓶颈——主流架构把所有时序变化压缩进单一纠缠的潜向量，将平滑宏观趋势与振荡季节模式混同，导致嵌入的结构可解释性差、跨域迁移弱，下游分类器必须隐式地拆解编码器从未被训练去分离的结构。作者主张以结构化生成表征（VAE 的显式后验因子化）为核心，把「广义化能力」与「结构化解耦表征」在同一框架内统一，从而为时序分类提供可解释、可迁移的基础模型先验。
AI.method: 整体管线为「嵌入 stem → HOPE 编码器 → 解耦 VAE 瓶颈 → 结构化解码器」。(1) EmbeddingStem：kernel=7、padding=3 的 1D 卷积 + GELU 把 X∈R^{L×1} 投到 D=128 维（保持 L 不变），叠加可学习位置编码 P∈R^{1×Lmax×D} 与 Dropout(0.1)，无需显式 patch 化即可捕获局部多尺度模式。(2) HOPE Block（替代自注意力，线性复杂度）：a) Self-Modifying Titans 作为短中期工作记忆，维护 M_k、M_v、M_main∈R^{D×D} 快权重矩阵，按稳定化 DGD 规则在 L2 回归目标上逐步更新（衰减 α=0.99、学习率 η=0.01、权重裁剪至 [-5,5]），并与慢权重 MLP 提供的元学习先验并行；b) Proper Continuum Memory System（CMS）负责长时抽象，含 L_CMS=4 个层级（每级为两层 MLP+GELU+LayerNorm），更新频率分别为 [1,4,16,64] batch，各层维持持久记忆 m_i∈R^D，按 0.1/(i+1) 的 EMA 整合率更新，深层更慢，形成多时间尺度记忆固化循环，并通过门控在快激活与慢持久记忆间混合；两模块顺序接入并配残差与 LayerNorm。(3) 解耦潜空间：时间维自适应平均池化得 h∈R^D，两套独立投影头给出 μ_t,logσ_t² 与 μ_s,logσ_s²（各∈R^Z），重参数化采样 z_t、z_s，推理时用 μ_t‖μ_s∈R^{2Z} 作为定长嵌入。(4) SeriesDecomp：kernel=25、stride=1、same padding 的 1D 平均池化取趋势、其残差为季节，提供与潜空间对齐的显式监督信号。(5) 双解码器：趋势支路为两层 MLP 直接映射 z_t→L×1 趋势序列；季节支路先将 z_s 线性扩展为 L×D 序列、经 HOPE 块堆叠再线性投影回原维度；最终重建为两支路逐元素相加。预训练损失 L = L_recon + λ_KL·L_KL + λ_MTSM·L_MTSM（λ_KL=0.01、λ_MTSM=0.5），其中 L_recon 为趋势/季节两支路 MSE 之和，L_KL 对两个后验分别计算后平均，L_MTSM 为 20% 随机置零输入、以完整序列为目标的掩码位置重建 MSE（辅助线性头作用于全序列 H）。训练用 Adam，预训练最多 300 epoch、lr 1e-3、batch 256，早停 patience 5/min δ=0.5。下游冻结编码器，仅训分类头（LayerNorm→隐藏线性+GELU→Dropout→线性分类），交叉熵，Adam、lr 1e-3、batch 256、最多 300 epoch、早停 patience 10/δ=1e-3。数据：预训练用 Monash 的 m4_hourly、weather、electricity、traffic、tourism_monthly；下游用 UCR BakeOff 86 数据集，并过滤为类别数<8 且序列长度<400 的子集。指标：预训练侧 L_recon、L_KL、L_MTSM；分类侧 Accuracy 与 Macro-F1。
AI.result: 1) 全量 BakeOff 86 数据集：平均准确率 61.1%、F1 0.583。2) 过滤子集（<8 类且长度<400）：平均准确率 76.52%、F1 0.741。3) 按数据类型：SPECTRO 85.30 > SIMULATED 82.45 > HAR 79.33 > SENSOR 78.58 > ECG 75.31 > IMAGE 74.03 > DEVICE 67.42 > MOTION 66.31。4) 按类别数：二分类 71.50/F1 0.70，>2 类 55.04/F1 0.52，差距显著。5) 按序列长度：L≤80 72.31、80<L≤136 69.24、136<L≤235 73.62、L>235 骤降至 53.89（F1 0.51）。6) 按训练集规模：TS≤30 71.00、30-70 61.90、70-400 52.17、>400 67.64，呈非单调，论文归因于类别数、序列长度等混淆因素。7) 单数据集最佳者包括 Wafer 97.37、SyntheticControl 96.67、Coffee 96.43、Plane 92.38、CBF 91.00、ECG5000 91.47、StarLightCurves 87.55 等；最差为 Adiac 14.07、CricketZ 13.08、CricketY 13.33、InlineSkate 16.00 等少数类多/难分数据集。总体结论：性能天花板更多源于解耦先验与目标域内在几何结构之间的表征匹配度（domain alignment），而非 HOPE 编码器容量本身。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张三点核心结论：(1) HOPE Block 以 Titans 快权重 + CMS 多级固化循环取代二次自注意力，实现序列长度上的线性复杂度，直接决定了预训练可处理的历史上下文上限与注入 VAE 瓶颈的表征丰富度；(2) 趋势/季节正交分解由 SeriesDecomp 重建信号监督，构成强归纳先验，提升嵌入可解释性与迁移性，并在分解语义不对应的域中提供隐式正则；(3) 冻结编码器范式高效且在低数据场景更稳健（全量微调易过拟合并抹去预训练的通用结构）。局限与后续：多类场景与长序列（>235 步）分别受固定维拼接嵌入的信息瓶颈与 VAE 固定长度瓶颈限制；训练规模与性能无单调关系（混淆所致）。未来方向包括引入 β-TCVAE 式总相关惩罚做显式互信息最小化的信息论解耦、利用生成先验对低资源类（尤其 MOTION/DEVICE）做合成数据增强、课程式掩码与更大预训练语料以探索零样本分类、以及面向多变量输入的通道级后验因子化/组稀疏潜变量设计。需注意的证据不足之处：全文未给出与 ROCKET/HIVE-COTE/InceptionTime/TSLANet 等强基线的同表对比，也未做消融实验（解耦、序列分解、MTSM、HOPE 各组件的独立贡献未验证），预训练语料仅 5 个预测导向数据集，过滤后的子集指标与全量指标差距较大且子集选择偏向类别少、序列短的较易任务，因此「优于现有 SOTA」的强结论尚缺乏直接实验支撑。

title: The Matching Principle: A Geometric Theory of Loss Functions for Nuisance-Robust Representation Learning
comment: 54 pages. 13 empirical task blocks. Companion software: matching-pmh (PyPI; https://github.com/vishalstark512/matching-pmh). Related arXiv note: 2604.21395 (geometric blind spot / isotropic PMH)
summary:
Robustness, domain adaptation, photometric and occlusion invariance, compositional generalisation, temporal robustness, alignment safety, and classical anisotropic regularisation are usually treated as separate problems with separate method families. This paper argues that much of their shared structure is one statistical problem: estimate the covariance of label-preserving deployment nuisance, then regularise the encoder Jacobian along a matrix whose range covers that covariance (the matching principle). CORAL, adversarial training, IRM, augmentation, metric learning, Jacobian penalties, and alignment-style constraints are different estimators of that object, not independent robustness tricks.
  In the linear-Gaussian model we prove closed-form optimality (Theorem A), including cube-root water-filling within the matched range; necessity of range coverage for quadratic Jacobian penalties (Theorem G); the same range dichotomy at deep global minima; and two falsification controls (Lemma C; Corollaries E), with seven conditional consistency lemmas (D1-D7) for estimation under standard identifiability assumptions.
  We introduce the Trajectory Deviation Index (TDI), a label-free probe of embedding sensitivity when task accuracy or Jacobian Frobenius norm is insufficient.
  Thirteen pre-registered blocks from classical ML through Qwen2.5-7B test the predicted matched, then isotropic, then wrong-W ordering on geometry and deployment drift; twelve pass, and the sole exception (Office-31) is an eigengap failure named before the run. At 7B scale, matched style-PMH improves selective honesty and preserves Style TDI where standard DPO degrades it.
  The contribution is naming the deployment nuisance covariance, stating what the regulariser must do, and supplying a closed-form falsifiable theory once that object is identified, not universality on every leaderboard.

AI.tldr: This paper unifies six robustness problems (domain adaptation, invariance, alignment safety, etc.) under one statistical framework by identifying "deployment nuisance covariance" estimation as the core task, then proves the "matching principle" is optimal in linear-Gaussian settings, and validates the theory at 7B scale with 12/13 pre-registered experiments passing.
AI.motivation: Six robustness problems (domain adaptation, photometric/occlusion invariance, compositional generalization, temporal robustness, alignment safety, anisotropic regularization) are traditionally treated separately. The paper identifies their shared structure as one statistical problem to achieve unified understanding.
AI.method: Unified framework: estimate covariance of label-preserving deployment nuisance, then regularize encoder Jacobian along matched covariance (matching principle). Applied to linear-Gaussian model with cube-root water-filling, TDI metric, and style-PMH at 7B scale (Qwen2.5-7B).
AI.result: Theorem A proves closed-form optimality with cube-root water-filling; Theorem G shows necessity of range coverage for quadratic Jacobian penalties; same range dichotomy at deep global minima. Two falsification controls (Lemma C; Corollaries E) with seven conditional consistency lemmas (D1-D7). 12 out of 13 pre-registered experiments pass.
AI.conclusion: Authors introduce TDI as a label-free probe and validate the matched-isotropic-wrong ordering hypothesis through 13 pre-registered blocks, with 12 passing. At 7B scale, matched style-PMH improves selective honesty while preserving Style TDI. The paper's contribution is framing deployment nuisance covariance estimation as a unified problem and providing a closed-form falsifiable theory.

title: Posterior Collapse as Automatic Spectral Pruning
summary:
We show that posterior collapse in $β$-VAEs implements automatic spectral pruning. A latent mode collapses if its contribution to reconstruction is below the cutoff set by $β$. Equilibrium solutions with different $β$ thus reveal a cascade of collapses as latent modes decouple from least to most useful.
  We derive this as a consequence of the loss via a Landau stability analysis. We define a latent-rescaling-invariant order parameter that ranks active latent modes and whose collapse thresholds identify which effective variables to inspect first.
  In the linear Gaussian case, the collapse spectrum, utility spectrum, and normalized PCA spectrum coincide, and each collapse follows a mean-field law. We test these predictions on the WorldClim dataset.

AI.tldr: This paper shows that posterior collapse in β-VAEs is equivalent to automatic spectral pruning, providing a theoretical framework through Landau stability analysis that connects collapse dynamics, utility ranking, and PCA, with experimental validation on climate data.
AI.motivation: The paper addresses the phenomenon of posterior collapse in β-VAEs, where latent modes become inactive, and seeks to understand its mechanism and implications for variable selection.
AI.method: The authors derive this connection through a Landau stability analysis of the β-VAE loss function, defining a latent-rescaling-invariant order parameter that quantifies the utility of each latent mode and establishes collapse thresholds. They validate the theory analytically in the linear Gaussian case, demonstrating that the collapse spectrum, utility spectrum, and normalized PCA spectrum coincide, with each collapse following a mean-field law.
AI.result: The analysis reveals that posterior collapse in β-VAEs naturally implements spectral pruning, where latent modes collapse from least to most useful as β increases, providing a principled ranking of active latent modes and identifying which effective variables to inspect first. The theoretical predictions are confirmed through experiments on the WorldClim dataset.
AI.conclusion: This work provides a theoretical foundation for understanding posterior collapse in β-VAEs as a form of automatic spectral pruning, with practical implications for variable selection in high-dimensional data.

title: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a central paradigm for scaling LLM reasoning, yet its optimization often suffers from training instability and suboptimal convergence. Through a systematic dissection of clipping-based GRPO-style objectives, we identify the rigid clipping decision induced by hard clipping as a key practical bottleneck in the studied RLVR setups. Specifically, our analysis suggests that informative signals can lie in the near-boundary region just beyond the clipping threshold, and are therefore discarded by the standard hard-clipping rule. Notably, once this bottleneck is precisely identified, even simple stochastic perturbations at the boundary can recover meaningful performance gains. Building on this finding, we propose Near-boundary Stochastic Rescue (NSR), a minimal, plug-and-play modification that stochastically retains these slightly out-of-bound tokens to recover lost signals. While NSR, via stochastic sampling, can be interpreted as inducing an implicit gradient decay in expectation, our ablations reveal that its stochastic, boundary-local rescue mechanism is consistently more effective than deterministic gradient decay. Validated by extensive experiments across model sizes from 7B to 30B and both dense and MoE architectures, as a plug-and-play solution, NSR substantially improves training stability and delivers consistent gains over strong baselines such as DAPO and GSPO.

AI.tldr: 本文针对RLVR中硬裁剪导致的训练信号丢失问题，提出NSR随机保留近边界token，在多种模型架构上验证有效，超越DAPO/GSPO基线。
AI.motivation: 基于GRPO的RLVR方法中，硬裁剪规则过于刚性，将近边界区域（阈值边缘）的有价值信号丢弃，导致优化信息损失。
AI.method: 提出Near-boundary Stochastic Rescue (NSR)方法：对边界附近超出裁剪阈值的token进行随机保留，通过随机采样隐式引入梯度衰减，同时保持边界局部的随机救援机制。
AI.result: NSR在7B到30B不同规模及Dense/MoE架构上均实现稳定训练和性能提升。
AI.conclusion: NSR作为一个即插即用的方案，在7B至30B模型规模上验证有效，提升了训练稳定性并超越DAPO和GSPO基线。

title: Reading Task Failure Off the Activations: A Sparse-Feature Audit of GPT-2 Small on Indirect Object Identification
summary: We report a small, reproducible audit of which sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features of GPT-2 small fire differently on failed versus successful trials of the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task. On 300 prompts, GPT-2 small reaches 79.7% accuracy; 146 of the 24,576 features in the layer-8 residual-stream SAE release of Bloom (2024) clear a Holm-corrected significance threshold and 105 reach a large effect size (|Cohen's d| > 0.8). The strongest single correlate of failure -- feature 17,491, d=+2.93, Neuronpedia label 'cryptographic keys' -- is essentially silent except when the prompt's transferred object is 'the keys,' on which GPT-2 small fails 93.3% of the time vs. 7.5% on the other seven objects (Fisher exact p = 8.79 x 10^-33). We put this correlate through three controls that a mechanistic claim should pass. (i) A causal ablation: zeroing feature 17,491 in the residual stream across all token positions of the 45 keys prompts does not restore accuracy (6.7% -> 4.4%); the feature is a correlate, not a sufficient cause at this layer. (ii) A representation baseline: a logistic regression on the raw 768-dimensional residual stream reaches 5-fold ROC AUC = 0.929, matching the top-100 SAE features (0.927); the SAE basis adds interpretability, not predictive power. (iii) A seed-robustness check: across five random seeds the keys-subset failure rate stays in 75.0--93.3% (the behavioural effect is real), but feature 17,491 is the top-|d| feature in only 1 of 5 runs. The methodological contribution is therefore the audit pipeline (cheap, model-agnostic, surfaces named correlates) rather than any single feature found through it. We release the code, the 300-prompt corpus, the 300x24,576 activation matrix, the ablation and baseline scripts, and the figures. The full pipeline runs on a laptop (Apple M3 Max, no discrete GPU).

AI.tldr: 对GPT-2 small的SAE特征进行任务失败关联审计，发现"加密密钥"特征17,491与IOI任务失败高度相关，但三重控制实验表明该特征仅是相关而非因果，且SAE基底并未增加预测能力——核心贡献是可复现的廉价审计pipeline本身。
AI.motivation: 理解大语言模型内部表征与行为失败之间的对应关系，识别哪些SAE特征可作为任务失败的指标，为可解释性研究提供可复现的方法论框架。
AI.method: 三阶段审计pipeline：(1) 显著性筛选——300个提示下对24,576个SAE特征进行Holm校正显著性检验和Cohen's d效应量分析；(2) 三重控制实验——因果消融（置零特征）、表征基线（逻辑回归对比）、种子鲁棒性检验（5个随机种子）；(3) 关键案例解剖——Fisher精确检验特征17,491与特定对象的关联。
AI.result: 146个特征通过Holm校正显著性阈值，105个达到大效应量(|d|>0.8)。最强相关特征17,491（标记为"加密密钥"）在"the keys"转移对象上GPT-2 small失败率93.3%对其他对象7.5%（Fisher精确p=8.79×10⁻³³）。但因果消融未能恢复准确率，逻辑回归在原始768维残差空间达到0.929 ROC AUC（匹配top-100 SAE特征），特征17,491仅在1/5随机种子中保持top-|d|排名。
AI.conclusion: SAE特征提供了可解释性而非额外预测能力；单一特征不足以解释失败，审计pipeline（低成本、模型无关）是主要贡献。全部资源（代码、语料库、激活矩阵、脚本）已开源，可在笔记本电脑运行。

title: Multiple Neural Operators Achieve Near-Optimal Rates for Multi-Task Learning
summary: We study the approximation and statistical complexity of learning collections of operators in a shared multi-task setting, with a focus on the Multiple Neural Operators (MNO) architecture. For broad classes of Lipschitz multiple operator maps, we derive near-optimal upper bounds for approximation and statistical generalization. On the lower-bound side, we establish a curse of parametric complexity and prove corresponding minimax rates. Together, these results show that shared representations across tasks do not increase the overall cost: multi-task operator learning follows the same scaling laws as single operator learning. We also compare MNO with a multi-task extension of DeepONet based on concatenated task inputs and show that, from a worst-case approximation-complexity perspective, both architectures satisfy essentially the same asymptotic rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多任务场景下学习算子集合的近似和统计复杂度，以MNO架构为核心，推导了Lipschitz多算子映射的近优上界，并建立了参数复杂度的维度诅咒和极小极大速率。研究表明，跨任务共享表征不会增加总体成本，多任务算子学习与单任务学习遵循相同缩放定律；MNO与拼接式DeepONet扩展在渐近速率上基本等价。
AI.motivation: 研究多任务场景下算子学习（尤其是MNO架构）的近似能力和统计泛化能力，建立多任务算子学习的理论基础
AI.method: 对广泛类的Lipschitz多算子映射推导近优上界；建立参数复杂度的维度诅咒并证明相应的极小极大速率；与基于任务输入拼接的多任务DeepONet扩展进行比较分析
AI.result: 多任务算子学习遵循与单任务算子学习相同的缩放定律；两种架构（MNO与多任务DeepONet）满足基本相同的渐近速率
AI.conclusion: 共享表征策略不会增加多任务算子学习的总体复杂度成本；MNO与扩展版DeepONet从最坏情况近似复杂度角度遵循相同的渐近率

title: Ternary Decision Trees with Locally-Adaptive Uncertainty Zones
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 5 appendix sections. Submitted to Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (DAMI)
summary: Decision trees partition the feature space using hard binary thresholds, assigning identical confidence to instances far from a decision boundary and to those directly on it. We introduce ternary decision trees, which augment each split node with an uncertainty zone of half-width delta centered on the optimal threshold. Instances in this zone receive predictions formed by weighted blending of both child subtrees and are flagged as boundary-uncertain, signaling that downstream applications may treat these predictions differently. Crucially, delta is computed locally at each node from statistics already available during standard CART split finding, requiring no external noise specification. We propose and evaluate five delta-estimation methods: quality-plateau (plateau width of the split criterion curve), class-overlap (empirical class-distribution overlap), gain-ratio (split quality relative to split entropy), node-bootstrap (threshold variance under node-level resampling), and margin (SVM-inspired distance to the nearest cross-class training example). Evaluated across 72 OpenML-CC18 datasets with 5-fold cross-validation, all five methods with probabilistic routing significantly outperform standard CART on decided accuracy (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p < 0.001). The margin method achieves the best efficiency (0.104 accuracy gain per unit of boundary-uncertain flagging rate), wins on 42 of 72 datasets, and requires zero additional hyperparameters. Analysis on three Breiman synthetic benchmarks reveals that margin is self-calibrating on clean data while node-bootstrap and quality-plateau best track theoretical irreducible error. Experiments on four medical and financial datasets demonstrate practical value: on mammography, node-bootstrap achieves +0.71% decided accuracy by flagging 10.8% of screening cases as boundary-uncertain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三叉决策树，通过在学习过程中自动估计的局部不确定性区域δ，将标准二分类决策扩展为"确定拒绝-融合预测-确定接受"的三路分支，在保持预测性能的同时为下游应用提供可解释的不确定性信号。Margin方法以其零超参数特性和最高效率成为推荐首选。
AI.motivation: 传统决策树使用硬二值阈值划分特征空间，导致远离决策边界的样本与紧贴边界的样本获得相同的置信度预测，无法有效表达预测不确定性。
AI.method: 提出三叉决策树框架，在每个分裂节点引入宽度为δ的不确定性区域。落入该区域的样本通过加权融合两个子树的预测结果进行预测，并被标记为"边界不确定"。δ的计算基于CART分裂过程中已获取的统计量，无需外部噪声参数。五种δ估计方法：(1) quality-plateau基于分裂准则曲线的平台宽度；(2) class-overlap基于经验类分布重叠；(3) gain-ratio基于分裂质量与分裂熵的比值；(4) node-bootstrap基于节点级重采样的阈值方差；(5) margin基于SVM风格的最近异类样本距离。
AI.result: 在72个OpenML-CC18数据集的5折交叉验证中，所有五种方法在"已决策准确率"指标上均显著优于标准CART（Wilcoxon符号秩检验p < 0.001）。margin方法效率最高（0.104）、获胜率最高（42/72）、且无超参数。在Breiman合成数据上验证了margin的自校准特性，以及node-bootstrap和quality-plateau对理论不可约误差的追踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在统计和实际应用中均验证有效：margin方法凭借零超参数和最高效率（0.104）成为最佳选择；node-bootstrap和quality-plateau在追踪理论不可约误差方面表现最优；在医学影像筛查任务中，node-bootstrap仅标记10.8%的边界不确定样本即可获得+0.71%的准确率提升。

title: SeqLoRA: Bilevel Orthogonal Adaptation for Continual Multi-Concept Generation
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables fast personalization of text-to-image diffusion models, but composing multiple custom concepts remains challenging due to representation interference. Existing modular methods either rely on expensive post-hoc fusion or freeze adaptation subspaces, which limit expressiveness and concept fidelity. To address this trade-off, we propose Sequential regularized LoRA (SeqLoRA), a constrained continual learning framework that jointly optimizes both LoRA factors via bilevel optimization. Theoretically, we establish strong convergence guarantees for our algorithm and model the residual layer activations as a matrix sub-Gaussian process to derive high-probability bounds on catastrophic forgetting. We further prove that learning the LoRA basis from data minimizes residual interference energy more effectively than frozen-basis methods. Experiments on multi-concept image generation demonstrate that SeqLoRA improves identity preservation and scalability across up to 101 concepts, while avoiding costly fusion and reducing attribute interference in composed generations.

AI.tldr: SeqLoRA是一种新的约束持续学习框架，通过双层优化联合训练LoRA因子，用于解决文本到图像扩散模型中多概念组合的表征干扰问题。理论证明了收敛性和灾难性遗忘界限，实验验证了在101个概念规模下的身份保持和属性干扰减少效果。
AI.motivation: 参数高效微调方法虽能快速个性化文本到图像扩散模型，但在组合多个自定义概念时存在表征干扰问题。现有模块化方法依赖昂贵的后处理融合或冻结适应子空间，限制了表达力和概念保真度。
AI.method: SeqLoRA采用约束性持续学习框架，通过双层优化联合优化LoRA的两个因子；同时建立层激活的矩阵次高斯过程模型来推导灾难性遗忘的高概率界，理论证明从数据学习LoRA基比冻结基方法更有效降低残余干扰能量。
AI.result: 在多概念图像生成任务中，SeqLoRA在101个概念规模下提升了身份保持能力和可扩展性，同时避免了昂贵的融合过程并减少了组合生成中的属性干扰。
AI.conclusion: SeqLoRA通过联合优化LoRA因子，有效解决了多概念组合中的表征干扰问题，在保持表达力的同时避免昂贵的后处理融合。

title: Plug-in Losses for Evidential Deep Learning: A Simplified Framework for Uncertainty Estimation that Includes the Softmax Classifier
summary: Real-world sensor-based learning systems require uncertainty estimation that is both reliable and computationally efficient. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides single-pass uncertainty estimation by modeling the class probabilities via Dirichlet distributions, where the Dirichlet parameters are predicted by a learned neural network mapping. However, this approach can lead to computational challenges, as Dirichlet expected objectives are more complex than standard supervised learning losses, complicating their analysis and implementation. We address this issue by approximating the objective of the first-order empirical risk minimization problem induced by EDL with a plug-in loss evaluated at the Dirichlet mean and show that, under mild assumptions, the approximation error decays with growing evidence for a broad class of loss functions, including mean-squared error and cross-entropy loss. As a special case, our analysis provides justification for the use of softmax in the context of uncertainty estimation, since under a particular evidence-to-Dirichlet mapping, our framework includes the standard softmax classifier. We validate the proposed simplified objectives on the Google Speech Commands dataset and show that they achieve predictive accuracy and selective prediction performance comparable to classical EDL, while being simpler to implement using standard deep learning losses and training pipelines. To the best of our knowledge, this empirical analysis is the first to obtain coverage-accuracy trade-offs for speech recognition tasks through EDL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了对Evidential Deep Learning (EDL)目标的简化近似方法，通过Dirichlet均值处的plug-in损失替代复杂的目标函数，证明了近似误差随证据增加而衰减，并验证了该方法在语音识别任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 真实传感器学习系统需要可靠且计算高效的的不确定性估计方法。EDL通过Dirichlet分布建模类别概率实现单次传递的不确定性估计，但其目标函数比标准监督学习损失更复杂，增加了分析和实现难度。
AI.method: 用Dirichlet均值处的plug-in损失近似原始EDL目标；针对MSE和交叉熵等损失函数，证明了在温和条件下近似误差随证据增长而衰减；通过softmax映射将框架与标准分类器统一。
AI.result: 在Google Speech Commands数据集上，简化后的目标函数在预测准确性和选择性预测性能上与经典EDL相当，同时更易于使用标准深度学习损失和训练流程实现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为EDL提供了理论分析和简化实现方案，证明了在证据增长时近似误差会衰减，并首次将EDL应用于语音识别任务获得覆盖-准确性权衡曲线。

title: Uniform Diffusion Models Revisited: Leave-One-Out Denoiser and Absorbing State Reformulation
summary:
Discrete diffusion models are often trained through clean-data prediction, but the prediction can be used in different ways to define the reverse dynamics. In Masked Diffusion Models (MDM) these choices largely coincide, whereas in Uniform Diffusion Models (UDM) they do not. We show that the standard plug-in bridge parameterization for UDM is not optimized by the denoising posterior, but by a leave-one-out posterior that predicts each clean token without using its own noisy observation. This identifies a mismatch between the plug-in ELBO and the usual cross-entropy denoising objective. We characterize the leave-one-out target and derive exact conversions between the denoiser, the leave-one-out posterior, and the score. These conversions allow us to disentangle parameterization and training objective. Our results also lead to inference improvements without any additional training through an informed predictor-corrector sampler and improved temperature sampling based on the leave-one-out predictor.
  We further introduce an absorbing-state reformulation of uniform diffusion that preserves the UDM joint law while decomposing it into masked-diffusion-like sampling operations, with simpler denoising posteriors, carry-over unmasking, and a natural remasking mechanism. On language modeling, leave-one-out parameterizations consistently improve UDM generation, while the absorbing construction matches or surpasses masked diffusion. These results suggest that the empirical gap between masked and uniform diffusion is driven less by the choice of marginals themselves than by parameterization and sampling design. The code and models can be found at https://github.com/samsongourevitch/rev_udm.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了Uniform Diffusion Models (UDM)中标准插件参数化与去噪目标之间的理论不匹配，提出用leave-one-out后验替代标准桥参数化。通过精确转换推导、改进采样策略和吸收态重构，统一了掩码与均匀扩散框架，实验证明两类扩散模型的性能差距主要源于参数化和采样设计而非边缘分布选择本身。
AI.motivation: 在离散扩散模型中，干净数据预测可以以不同方式用于定义反向动力学。Masked Diffusion Models (MDM)中这些选择基本一致，但Uniform Diffusion Models (UDM)中并不一致。标准插件桥参数化存在理论不匹配：优化目标并非去噪后验，而应是一种leave-one-out后验，导致插件ELBO与常规交叉熵去噪目标之间存在偏差。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：识别标准插件桥参数化与去噪后验之间的不匹配，定义leave-one-out后验来预测每个干净token而不使用其自身的噪声观测。2. 精确转换：推导去噪器、leave-one-out后验和分数函数之间的精确转换关系，实现参数化与训练目标的解耦。3. 推理改进：设计informed predictor-corrector采样器和基于leave-one-out预测器的改进温度采样。4. 吸收态重构：将均匀扩散重新表述为包含掩码式采样操作的形式，保留UDM联合分布，同时简化去噪后验、引入unmasking和自然重掩码机制。
AI.result: 1. 识别并解决了UDM中参数化与训练目标的理论不匹配问题。2. 推导出去噪器、leave-one-out后验与分数函数之间的精确转换。3. 提出无需额外训练的informed predictor-corrector采样器和改进温度采样方法。4. 提出吸收态重构，保持UDM联合分布同时简化采样操作。5. 语言建模实验表明leave-one-out参数化一致提升UDM生成质量，吸收态构造达到或超越掩码扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过引入leave-one-out后验解决了UDM中参数化与训练目标不匹配的问题，并提出了改进的采样策略和吸收态重构，为统一理解掩码扩散与均匀扩散提供了理论框架。实验表明，掩码与均匀扩散之间的性能差距主要源于参数化和采样设计，而非边缘分布本身的选择。

title: Remember to be Curious: Episodic Context and Persistent Worlds for 3D Exploration
summary: Exploration is a prerequisite for learning useful behaviors in sparse-reward, long-horizon tasks, particularly within 3D environments. Curiosity-driven reinforcement learning addresses this via intrinsic rewards derived from the mismatch between the agent's predictive model of the world and reality. However, translating this intrinsic motivation to complex, photorealistic environments remains difficult, as agents can become trapped in local loops and receive fresh rewards for revisiting forgotten states. In this work, we demonstrate that this failure stems from a lack of spatial persistence and episodic context. We show that effective curiosity requires a model of the world that is persistent and continuously updated, paired with an agent that maintains an episodic trajectory history to navigate toward novel regions. We achieve this using an online 3D reconstruction as a persistent model of the world, while the agent policy is parameterized as a sequence model over RGB observations to maintain episodic context. This design enables effective exploration during training while allowing the agent to navigate using solely RGB frames at deployment. Trained purely via curiosity on HM3D, our agent outperforms RL-based active mapping baselines and generalizes zero-shot to Gibson and AI-generated worlds. Our end-to-end policy enables efficient adaptation to downstream tasks, such as apple picking and image-goal navigation, outperforming from-scratch baselines. Please see video results at https://recuriosity.github.io/.

AI.tldr: This work reveals that effective curiosity in photorealistic 3D environments requires a persistent world model (online 3D reconstruction) combined with episodic trajectory context (sequence model over RGB), enabling effective exploration purely via intrinsic rewards and successful zero-shot generalization to new environments.
AI.motivation: Curiosity-driven RL in complex photorealistic 3D environments suffers from local loops and redundant rewards for revisiting forgotten states due to lack of spatial persistence and episodic context in traditional approaches.
AI.method: The method uses two key components: (1) An online 3D reconstruction as a persistent world model that is continuously updated, and (2) An agent policy parameterized as a sequence model over RGB observations to maintain episodic trajectory history. At deployment, the agent navigates using solely RGB frames without the reconstruction module.
AI.result: On HM3D, the proposed agent outperforms RL-based active mapping baselines. It generalizes zero-shot to Gibson and AI-generated worlds. End-to-end policy enables efficient adaptation to downstream tasks (apple picking and image-goal navigation), outperforming from-scratch baselines.
AI.conclusion: By combining online 3D reconstruction with sequence-based policy modeling, the method achieves effective exploration purely via curiosity signals. The approach demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization across different 3D environment datasets and successful adaptation to downstream tasks like apple picking and image-goal navigation.

title: Integrable Elasticity via Neural Demand Potentials
summary: We propose the Integrable Context-Dependent Demand Network (ICDN), a demand-first neural model for multiproduct retail demand. The model learns log-demand as a smooth, context-conditioned function of log-prices, allowing elasticities to be derived exactly from the learned demand surface. On the Dominick's beer dataset, ICDN improves out-of-sample generalization over a directed log-log benchmark and yields more stable, economically plausible elasticity estimates, especially for weakly identified cross-price effects.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「可积上下文相关需求网络」(ICDN)：一种"需求优先"的多产品零售需求神经网络。它把对数需求建模为对数价格与情境协变量的光滑函数，弹性不再单独建模，而是作为同一需求面的精确导数（解析可算，无需稠密 Jacobian/Hessian），从而天然满足逐行可积性（路径无关）。在 Dominick 啤酒数据上，ICDN 相对 OLS/Ridge/同特征 MLP 取得正的样本外 ΔR²，且自身价格弹性的自助抽样分布更集中（相对效应量归一化后信噪比更高）；但跨价格弹性对模型设定高度敏感，跨数据集上预测优势也不一致。
AI.motivation: 多产品定价实务依赖价格弹性作为情景模拟、收入优化与促销规划的原语，但在零售扫描数据上难以稳定估计：(1) 需求在门店/产品间异质、随时间非平稳、受促销与品类结构影响；(2) 价格之间高度相关并受商业规则约束，弹性若被"独立参数化"拟合，容易出现不稳定或经济上不可信的导数；(3) 弹性本质是需求映射的导数，需求面的小扰动会被放大为弹性的大幅波动；(4) 跨价格效应弱于自身价格效应且被相关定价与促销混淆，识别尤其困难；(5) 通用深度学习需求预测器虽灵活，但弹性通常靠自动微分事后提取，既不透明也不保证与单一需求面一致。已有方法在"可解释性、灵活性、导数一致性、可扩展性"之间存在持续权衡，缺少把显式价格结构、情境条件化、稀疏有向交互、解析导数与导数导向正则化统一在一个架构中的方案。
AI.method:
理论层面：定义点价格弹性矩阵 E_ij=∂log v_i/∂log p_j，把弹性视为 log-价格空间上的 1-形式 ω_i；命题 1 用 Poincaré 引理说明：若 ω_i 闭（交叉偏导相等），则存在唯一到正乘性常数的 log-需求势函数，价格响应路径无关；反之若直接输出弹性，场可能路径依赖或不对应任何全局需求映射。命题 2 说明任何 C² 的需求优先模型其 ω_i=dg_θ,i 自动精确、闭合。方法论上作者明确声明"可积性"是需求优先的通用设计原则而非 ICDN 独有贡献。

架构：g_θ,i(u,x)=b_i(x)+Σ_j[β_ij(x)u_j + w_ij(x)^T B_j(u_j)]+Σ_{j≠i} B_i(u_i)^T U^(ij)(x) B_j(u_j)，u=log p。(1) 价格基：每个 SKU 独立的截断三次幂样条 B_ik=[ReLU((u_i-κ̃_ik)/σ_i)]³，节点取训练集经验分位（0.05–0.95 分位区间），σ 下限 0.2，保证 C² 光滑与解析导数 B^(r)=3!/(3-r)!·σ^-r·ReLU(...)^(3-r)。(2) 上下文编码：共享编码器把每个 SKU 的 token（门店/SKU 标识、季节、促销等）映射为 h_i，自身价格参数由 h_i 生成，跨价格参数由有序对 (h_i,h_j) 生成，故 E_ij≠E_ji（不施加对称性、Slutsky 对称或齐次性/加总限制）。(3) 稀疏有向注意力：缩放点积打分加 SKU 元数据相似度奖励 ξ_ij，训练期在线 top-k 选邻居（k_eff=min{k,n-1}），收敛后在训练集上冻结图，评估期使用冻结图并按观测级 softmax 权重调制交叉项；候选打分 O(n²)，选定边计算 O(nk)。(4) 正则化：掩码 Huber 拟合项（按观测到的 SKU 数归一）、自身价格曲率惩罚 L_sm=Σκ_i²（κ_i=∂²g_i/∂u_i²）、弹性带惩罚 L_elast（自身 [-5,0]、跨价 [-1,1] 的 ReLU 越界罚）；自身价格线性系数经 -softplus 强制非正，但样条与交互项不受约束，故不保证全局单调或凹性。

训练：两阶段——Phase 0 冻结样条与交互头、用 8 周滚动平均目标做上下文 log-线性热启动，自身价格偏置按逆 softplus 初始化为 β_EDA=-2；Phase 1 解冻非线性头、用原始目标训练。AdamW、验证 plateau 降学习率、梯度裁剪、保留最佳验证 checkpoint、混合精度。

评估：主实验 Dominick's Finer Foods 啤酒类目（清洗后 463,722 条 store-UPC-week 观测，按周历网格补全并生成滞后/滚动/季节/缺口感知特征，训练折内重算防泄漏）；对比 OLS、Ridge（均按"门店×有向 UPC 对"局部回归，弹性即回归系数）、以及同特征同调参预算的 demand-first MLP（自动微分取弹性）。嵌套时间折 Optuna 调参（每外折 20 候选×3 内折×3 种子，选择准则 R̄²-0.25sd 加弹性合理性分 0.7S_own+0.3S_cross），5 个扩展外折 + 独立留出；周块自助重抽样给弹性分布；消融（去曲率罚、去弹性带罚、均匀交叉权重、去交叉项、去样条）与经济约束敏感性（自由符号、去符号+去带、宽边界）；2×2 架构替换（截断幂 vs 自然三次样条 × 点积 vs 加性注意力）；计算可扩展性压力测试（n∈{5,25,50,100,200}，k∈{4,8,16,32,199}）；跨数据集 Walmart M5、Dunnhumby、Dominick 的匹配评估（仅按预测 MAE 选型）。
AI.result: 1) 预测：4-UPC Dominick 面板上平均 ΔR² 分别为 vs OLS +0.3185（配对 t 检验 p=0.1236）、vs Ridge +0.0648（p=0.0384）、vs MLP +0.0260（p=0.1003）；除 OLS 外差异较小但方向一致。2) 自身价格弹性（212 条匹配序列）：ICDN 自助百分位区间更窄的比例为 94.8%/95.8%（对 OLS/Ridge），中位区间宽 0.794 对 2.650/2.543；折间变异中位 sd 0.381 对 0.641/0.606；同号率 99.5%/99.5%/100%。MLP 绝对离散更小（中位宽 0.283）但效应量也小得多（中位 |E| 0.211 对 0.615，弹性贴近 0，与价格-促销强相关、价格变异弱一致）；按 SNR=|\bar E|/sd(E) 归一化后 ICDN 在 82.5% 匹配序列更高（中位 3.208 对 2.701）。3) 跨价格弹性（544 个有向对）：ICDN 比 OLS/Ridge 更集中（更窄区间比例 85.1%/79.4%），但不优于 MLP（18.8%）；跨模型同号率仅 49.1%/50.4%/40.4%，ICDN 给出正负兼有（324 正/220 负）而 MLP 全为负（0/544）；ICDN 折间变异优势弱且不均匀（对 OLS 55.3%、对 Ridge 41.9%）。4) 不确定性诊断：ICDN 折估计落入自助 95% 区间的比例仅 39.7%（自身）/66.3%（跨价），低于基准的 85%–93%，说明自助区间应视为重抽样敏感度诊断而非校准区间。5) 消融：去样条项反而提升 R²（0.546 vs 0.516）且弹性分数上升；去曲率罚 R² 几乎不变但自身价格落入 [-5,0] 比例由 100% 降至 89.3%；去掉符号变换与弹性带、仅按预测选型时，100% 自身弹性仍为负且在 [-5,0] 内（中位 -1.35），说明负号并非仅由约束制造，但 β_EDA=-2 初始化、曲率罚与两阶段训练仍在起作用；放宽边界使自身弹性中位从 -0.84 移到 -0.27，区间内占比降至 89.6%/79.1%。6) 架构替换：预测对样条基与注意力形式基本不敏感（配对自助区间均含 0）；自然三次样条显著降低曲率 RMS（14.31→9.86）与跨价极端尾部（5.06→2.45）但加大极端自身弹性；加性注意力无一致优势。7) 可扩展性：n=200、k=4 仅保留 2.01% 有向交互，评估约快 15.8 倍、增量显存少 44.3 倍，稀疏弹性输出 1.024 MB 对稠密 40.96 MB；候选打分仍 O(n²)，训练阶段仍物化 n×n 稠密弹性张量；参数规模 61,721 且与 n、k 无关。8) 跨数据集：Walmart 上 ICDN 最优（ΔMAE=-0.0453，区间不跨 0），Dunnhumby 上 Ridge 最优，Dominick 上 MLP 明显最优（ΔMAE=+0.1683），说明预测优势依数据集而定，跨价稳定性优势亦不普遍（Walmart 81.0% vs Dominick 34.8%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是：在多产品零售需求中把"弹性"从独立估计对象转为单一光滑需求面的导数，从而以构造性方式获得逐行可积、路径无关的价格响应；ICDN 把该原则落地为"显式价格基 + 情境条件化系数 + 稀疏有向注意力 + 解析导数 + 导数导向正则化"的结构化多产品架构，使弹性在解析上可算、方向可辨、非线性且随情境变化，且不施加 Hicksian/Slutsky 对称等经典可积性结构。实证结论是审慎的：ICDN 在 Dominick 主应用上相对 OLS/Ridge 取得明显预测增益并显著改善自身价格弹性的重抽样集中度与相对信噪比，自身价格负向模式并非仅由硬符号约束与弹性带造成；但自身价格的单调性/凹性并不被保证，跨价格弹性的量级、符号与稳定性高度依赖模型设定（甚至与基准模型同号率仅约 50%），自助区间并非校准的置信区间，且观测性数据的强价格内生性使所有弹性只能解释为"当前定价制度下拟合需求面的局部、情境条件化导数"，而非价格干预的因果效应。作者据此把 ICDN 定位为"有吸引力的结构化替代方案"而非普遍占优的估计器，并提出未来方向：改进有向注意力以提升跨价识别与稳定性、把推断的替代关系建模为产品交互网络并与属性/市场行为关联、构建能刻画需求关系时变与时间依赖的不确定性程序，以及在收入/利润/促销优化任务中结合随机或外生价格变动做因果评估。
